body.en: Ezmerelda marks enemies that she attacks, training other Champions to spot their vulnerable points. Marked enemies take % more damage from all Champions for each Debuff Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Ezmerelda debuffs enemies as she strikes them, causing them to take more damage when attacked by any Champion. Every time a debuff is applied to an enemy, the effect of Training Montage is increased by %, stacking multiplicatively, up to times and resetting when changing areas. Undead are Ezmerelda's favored foes. Whenever one of Ezmerelda's favored foes are killed while she is in the formation, she tracks it, increasing the base effect of Training Montage by % for each favored foe killed (additively then multiplicatively). These stacks persist for the entire adventure, resetting when you complete it. Caps at favored foe kills. Ezmerelda increases her debuffs as the Champions defeat more undead, her favored foe. Ezmerelda can add additional favored foes with feats. Ezmerelda gains the Breaker role, and all Champions deal % more damage against enemies with armor-based health, increasing their chance of breaking an armor piece. Additionally, if a hits-based or armor-based enemy is affected by Training Montage, successful hits against them remove an additional hit or armor piece. Ezmerelda expands her training regiment to concentrate on well-armored foes. The effect of Training Montage is increased by % on enemies who are one of Ezmerelda's favored foes, and Threat Tracking counts each favored foe killed twice. Ezmerelda focuses on dispatching her favored foes quickly and efficiently. Increases the effect of Training Montage by %, or by % if the current adventure is a Strahd patron adventure or variant. Increases the effect of Training Montage by %, or by % if the current adventure is a Strahd patron adventure or variant. Ezmerelda steels herself in preparation when participating in adventures that Strahd has taken an interest in. While Ezmerelda is in the formation, 0-2 "Mist" enemies can spawn with each wave. When a "Mist" enemy is defeated, an enemy whose type matches one of Ezmerelda's favored foes appears from the mist, and all nearby enemies gain the Training Montage debuff. I don't have the luxury for nightmares. My mentor taught me that you can always forgive. Always. Watch their feet. Which one is stronger? Take that one out. Those old cuts on Zombies still hurt. Target them. Tonight, we shall return the dead to their graves. Use whatever you have around you. Put them to rest. If I've fought it - I can track it. No monster is safe from my blade. We will save this land by killing the devil of Ravenloft! Healing spells cannot save you from my blade! Did you know owlbears are monstrosities? Very strange... The more I read, the more I crave battle with these creatures. I already know all of - What do you mean giants aren't humanoid? Every creature has a weak spot. Watch and learn. Van Richten taught me well. Allow me to demonstrate. You could say I'm married to my career. I love what I do. What, that old thing? I have those hidden everywhere. There's two under your seat. It works on heads in a pinch. She slices, she dices, she beheads! I alone hunt the nightmares that haunt Barovia. Don't be frightened. I've got your back. There's no blade I'd rather have when packs of werewolves are approaching. I picked it up from a particularly well-dressed werewolf. A gift from Ireena Kolyana, the Burgomaster of Barovia. It's sharp, and it gets the job done. Catch the light just right and you can momentarily distract a vampire. It's like a sunsword, just... compartment sized. Let the Morninglord light a new dawn throughout Barovia! Please explain how your... Patrons work again? Handle delicately. Watch your prey. Learn from their movements. Wait for them to lunge. It's a present for an old friend. The important passages are marked. He taught me much. I hope he's found peace. When I'm in a bad mood, I put them on and repeat some of his more silly sayings. You never know when you'll need to bust into a Vampire's lair. Best to be prepared. Oil it too much, and you've got difficult terrain under your feet. My first model after my emergency peg leg. Boy, did that one hurt! It's... It's perfect... How do you think I scaled the walls of Strahd's castle? Ezmerelda (Ez) d'Avenir, a legendary monster hunter, has devoted herself to ridding the world of evil in all of its forms. After years of tutelage by her mentor, the vampire hunter Rudolph van Richten, Ez struck out on her own. She has since amassed a sizable personal fortune and an impressive arsenal of weapons for hunting monsters. Following the defeat of Strahd von Zarovich, Ez joins the Champions on their journeys through the world of Toril. Ezmerelda hurls a mote of fire at a random enemy. Ezmerelda hurls a mote of fire at a random enemy. Ezmerelda attacks the enemy with the highest health, greatly debuffing them. Ezmerelda attacks the enemy with the highest health, greatly debuffing them. The debuff gets stronger with each debuff applied in the current area. Ezmerelda marks enemies in various ways to help the rest of the formation take them down. Ezmerelda increases the damage of Champions in her column against Undead or other types of creatures via her specializations. body.zh: 艾丝美拉达会在她攻击的敌人身上做标记，训练其他勇士发现敌人的弱点。阵型中每有一位减益勇士，所有勇士对被标记的敌人造成的伤害就会增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 艾丝美拉达在攻击敌人时会给他们造成减益，使他们在受到任何勇士攻击时都会受到更多伤害。 每次对敌人施加减益时，“训练剪辑”的效果都会提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多 层；在变更区域后重置。 亡灵是艾丝美拉达的偏好对手。每当艾丝美拉达在阵型中，而有一名她的偏好对手被杀死时，她会记录已死亡的偏好对手数量，并使“训练剪辑”的基础效果增加 %（先加后乘）。这些效果会在整个冒险中持续叠加，在完成冒险时重置。上限为 名偏好对手。 随着勇士们击败更多亡灵（艾丝美拉达的偏好对手），艾丝美拉达能够施加更多减益。艾丝美拉达可以通过专长增加更多的偏好对手。 艾丝美拉达获得突破者角色，所有勇士对拥有护甲的敌人造成的伤害提高 %，破甲几率也会提高。此外，如果基于命中或基于护甲的敌人受到“训练剪辑”的影响，成功击中他们会额外移除一次命中或一件护甲。 艾丝美拉达将训练范围扩大，以对抗护甲精良的敌人。 “训练剪辑”的效果对艾丝美拉达的偏好对手提高 %，“威胁追踪”会将每个偏好对手被杀死的次数翻倍。 艾丝美拉达专注于快速有效地击退她的偏好对手。 将“训练剪辑”的效果提高 %，如果当前冒险是斯特拉德赞助者冒险或支线任务，则效果提高 %。 将“训练剪辑”的效果提高 %，如果当前冒险是斯特拉德赞助者冒险或支线任务，则效果提高 %。 在参加斯特拉德有兴趣的冒险活动时，艾丝美拉达会时刻做好准备。 当艾丝美拉达处于阵型中时，每波攻势都会产生 0-2 名“迷雾”敌人。击败“迷雾”敌人后，迷雾中会出现一个类型与艾丝美拉达偏好对手相同的敌人，且附近的所有敌人都会获得“训练剪辑”的减益。 我没有做噩梦的闲暇时间。 我的导师教我，总是可以原谅，总是如此。 看看他们的脚，哪个更强壮？干掉那个。 僵尸身上的那些伤口仍然会痛。瞄准那里。 今晚，我们要让死者回归墓地。 利用你周围的一切东西。 让他们安息。 和我交过手的，我都能找到。 我的剑刃制裁一切怪物。 我们会杀死鸦阁魔域的魔鬼来拯救这片土地！ 治疗法术也没法从我的剑下救你的命！ 你知道枭熊也是怪物吗？很奇怪吧…… 越看越想和这些生物战斗。 这些我都已经知道了——什么叫巨人不算类人生物？ 所有生物都有弱点。好好看，好好学。 范·里希顿把我教得很好。 让我来展示一下。 You could say I'm married to my career. I love what I do. 什么，那个破旧玩意？那种东西我到处都藏着有。你座位底下就有两把。 紧要关头用它来砍脑袋还是挺有用的。 她能切片，能切块，还能砍头！ 我独自寻猎常在巴洛维亚出没的梦魇。 别害怕，有我支持你。 当一群狼人靠近时，我不想要什么兵刃。 我从一个穿着考究的狼人身上捡的。 巴洛维亚的市长伊莉娜·克里安娜送的礼物 它很锋利，而且能伤人。 只要捕捉到合适的光线，你就能暂时转移吸血鬼的注意力。 它就像一把太阳之剑，只是......有一个隔间那么大。 让晨光之神点亮照耀整个巴洛维亚的新黎明！ 请解释一下你的......赞助者怎么又工作了？ 请轻拿轻放。 看着你的猎物。从它们的动作中学习。等着它们猛扑过来。 这是送给一位老朋友的礼物。 重要的篇章都做了标记。 他教会了我很多。愿他安息。 当我心情不好时，我就会戴上它，重复几句他那更愚蠢的语录。 你永远不知道你什么时候需要闯入吸血鬼的巢穴。最好做好准备。 给它上太多油的话，你脚下的地形就会变得难走。 我应急用的木制义肢之后的第一个样式。天啊，这玩意弄得人可疼了！ 这......这太完美了...... 你以为我是怎么爬上斯特拉德城堡的墙壁的？ 艾丝美拉达（艾茨）·达文尼尔是一名传奇怪物猎人，致力于消除世上各种形式的邪恶。在她的导师，吸血鬼猎人鲁道夫·范·里希顿的多年指导之后，艾茨开始独立行动。此后，她积累了一笔可观的个人财富，以及各种用来猎杀怪物的特别武器。在击败斯特拉德·冯·扎罗维奇后，艾茨加入了勇士们在托瑞尔世界的旅程。 艾丝美拉达向一名随机敌人洒出一把火焰之尘。 艾丝美拉达向一名随机敌人洒出一把火焰之尘。 艾丝美拉达会攻击生命值最高的敌人，对其施加减益。 艾丝美拉达会攻击生命值最高的敌人，对其施加减益。当前区域内每多施加一个减益，都会使该减益变得更强。 艾丝美拉达用多种方式标记敌人，协助阵型中的其他人将其击杀。 艾丝美拉达通过她的专精，来提高与她同列的勇士对亡灵或其他类型生物的伤害。

body.en: Uggie joins the party, starting next to Anson unless she's already in the formation next to another Fallbacks Champion. Uggie increases the damage of all non-adjacent Champions by %. Anson increases the damage of all Champions in the columns behind him by %. Anson increases the damage of all Champions in the columns behind him, and Uggie increases the damage of Champions not next to her. Uggie's buff is increased by % when Anson is in the formation. When Uggie is with Anson, Uggie attacks the closest enemy whenever Anson attacks. Uggie's damage deals 1 second of BUD-based damage and drives the enemy berserk. Berserk enemies move 50% faster and attack twice as often, but deal 90% less damage. Each time Anson is attacked or takes damage in an area, he gains a Meditation stack. Each Meditation stack increases the effect of Unshakable by %, stacking multiplicatively. Anson can have a maximum of Meditation stacks, and they reset when changing areas. When Anson gets hurt, his Combat Trance meditation increases, further increasing his Unshakable buff. Anson increases the effect of Unshakable by % for each Good Champion or Fallbacks Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Good or Fallback Champions: Anson would do anything for his friends. Anson increases the effect of Unshakable by % for each unaffiliated Champion or Fallbacks Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Unaffiliated or Fallback Champions: As an orphan that grew up in the streets, Anson is always willing to lend a hand to those in need. Anson increases the effect of Unshakable by % for each formation slot blocked by an escort or Fallbacks Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Escorts or Fallback Champions: Anson's tendency to put himself in harm's way is what Tess loves and fears most about him. Anson leaps out and attacks the toughest enemy for one ultimate hit. At the same time, a flash of lightning envelops him and all enemies in a large area, dealing an additional ultimate hit to any enemy in the area. When Anson uses his Storm Crash ultimate ability, Anson's sword ignites in lightning for 45 seconds. For the duration, Anson's attacks deal an additional seconds of BUD-based damage, damage him for damage equal to % of his Maximum Health, and increase the maximum stacks of Combat Trance's Meditation by , up to a maximum of additional maximum stacks. The increase to the maximum stacks resets when changing areas. Anson increases the health of all other Champions by % of his max health, and healing effects on all Champions are increased by %. Family is complicated, or at least mine is. What's left of it. I'm not giving up, and neither are you! Let's go! Does everything in this adventure have to be painful and unnatural? Need to keep going... They're all counting on me... Their stance is too wide. Watch this. It'll be quick. After what we faced on our first adventure, I'm ready for anything. I keep my friends close. My enemies? I keep them away from my friends. She just loves people, you see. She won't bite. She's just the sweetest. [Intense stare] ... True mastery is a continuous cutting motion. Wait for the perfect opportunity... then... STRIKE! I am the storm that is approaching. This is going to hurt, but it will be far worse for you. I put everything I have into a single strike. Then I do it again. Watch out! I can't control it! I don't know what will happen! How about the League of Loot? No? Walkers of Waterdeep? You can always count on me. I've got your back. Lark's been giving me lessons! Here, watch. No, wait. I need props. I just don't think it's a good idea leaving Cazrin alone with all these books. You won't lay a hand on them as long as I still stand! I don't remember where I got this from, or how long I've had it. We have to make this right. What do we do? Be careful. It's unstable. I have no idea what it might do. My father gave his life to save us. Now his legacy is mine to wield. That was a fun night, but I'll never go back to those sewers again. See these? Solid metal. Built to last. She looks so peaceful sleeping there. I wonder what she dreams about? Ha! Even the tavern agrees. Uggie's one of us. It's probably got one more shot left in it before it snaps. Nothing flashy, but it gets the job done. That's all I need. Anyone need arrows? I have spares. A lot of spares. This is one of my most prized possessions. Want to hear the story? I just have to remember to only store things that can't slip out the holes. I keep stitching it back together, but it's only a matter of time. There we go. I can fit so many useful tools and potions in these. What do you need? Healing potions? How many? Hm. It might be starting to mold. I really should wear this more often. Stupid intellect devourers... The visor comes down when it's time to get serious. My favorite place to be is 'in the way.' I remember those days with fondness. If I'd only known... Valen... where are you now? Can someone bring me a bucket of rancid bacon grease? Looks like I've joined the Tavern Club. Anson has known his share of hardship in his life. Orphaned at a young age, he and his younger brother were forced to live on the streets, doing what they had to do to keep from starving. But while that experience taught his brother to fear and mistrust the world, it had the opposite effect on Anson. Beaten, battered, or bruised, the fighter refuses to stay down, and he doesn't believe in giving up, on anyone or anything. No person is too broken, no cause too lost. It's a philosophy that makes him fiercely loyal to his companions, but sometimes it also results in him charging in recklessly when he should stop and think. Anson attacks the closest enemy, dealing 1 hit. Anson attacks the closest enemy and deals one hit. Anson attacks the toughest enemy and creates a blast of deadly lightning. Anson attacks the toughest enemy with his sword, while blasting all nearby foes with deadly lightning. body.zh: 乌吉加入探险队，并将默认与安森相邻，除非她已在阵型中并与另一位“后备队”勇士相邻。乌吉会使所有非相邻的勇士伤害提高 %。 安森会使所有处于他身后各列中的勇士伤害提升 %。 安森会使所有处于他身后各列中的勇士伤害提高，而乌吉会使不与乌吉相邻的勇士伤害提高。 当安森在阵型中时，乌吉的增益提高 %。 当乌吉跟着安森时，每当安森发动攻击，乌吉会攻击最近的敌人。乌吉的伤害会造成等同于 1 秒基础杀招伤害的伤害，并使敌人发狂。发狂的敌人移动速度增加 50%，攻击频率加倍，但造成的伤害减少 90%。 每当安森在一个区域中遭到攻击或受到伤害，他会获得一层“冥想”堆叠层数。每层“冥想”堆叠层数会使“坚定不移”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。安森最多可拥有 层“冥想”堆叠层数，且会在变更区域时重置。 安森受到伤害时将堆叠“战斗恍惚”冥想层数，进一步提升他的“坚定不移”增益。 阵型中每有一名善良勇士或“后备队”勇士，安森会使“坚定不移”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 善良或“后备队”勇士数量： 安森愿意为了他的朋友赴汤蹈火。 阵型中每有一名无从属组织勇士或“后备队”勇士，安森会使“坚定不移”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 无从属组织或“后备队”勇士数量： 作为一个在街头长大的孤儿，安森总是愿意帮助那些有需要的人。 每有一个阵型格子被护卫占据，或阵型中有一名“后备队”勇士，安森会使“坚定不移”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 护卫或“后备队”勇士数量： 安森总是把自己置于危险之中，这是苔丝最喜欢也最害怕他的一点。 安森一跃而出攻击最强硬的敌人，造成一次杀招命中。同时，一道闪电将他与一大片范围内的敌人笼罩起来，对该范围内的所有敌人造成一次额外的杀招命中。 当安森使用他的“风暴轰鸣”杀招技能时，他的剑会被闪电点燃，持续 45 秒。在此期间，安森的攻击会造成等同于 秒基础杀招伤害的额外伤害，同时对他自身造成相当于他最大生命值 % 的伤害，并使“战斗恍惚”的“冥想”堆叠层数上限提高 层，最多可额外提高 层。堆叠层数上限的提升会在变更区域时重置。 安森会增加所有其他勇士的生命值，数值相当于他最大生命值的 %，并且所有勇士的治疗效果提高 %。 家庭是很复杂的，至少我的家庭，或者说我的家庭还剩下的那部分是如此。 我不会放弃的，你们也一样！我们走！ 是不是这趟冒险中的一切都得这么痛苦和反常？ 我得继续前进……他们全都指望着我呢…… 他们的姿势破绽太大了。瞧好了，我三两下就收拾他们。 经历过我们第一次冒险中的那些事后，我现在什么都不怕了。 我让我的朋友待在我身边。 我的敌人？我让他们远离我的朋友。 你看，她很喜欢人的。她不会咬人的。她最乖了。 [紧紧地盯着]…… 真正的精通是连续不断的劈砍。 等待完美的时机……然后……出击！ 我就是那正在逼近的风暴。 这会很痛，但你所受到的痛苦会比这大得多。 我将我的全部功力凝聚在一击当中。然后我再次出击。 小心！我控制不了它！我不知道会发生什么！ “战利品联盟”怎么样？不行吗？那“水深城行者”呢？ 你可以随时依靠我。我会支持你的。 拉克一直在教导我！来，看好了。不，等等。我需要道具。 我还是觉得把卡兹琳一个人留在这一堆书里不是个好主意。 只要我还没倒下，你就别想动他们一个手指头！ 我不记得这东西我是从哪儿得来的，也不记得它在我这儿多久了。 我们得想办法补救。我们该怎么办？ 小心。它很不稳定。我也不知道它会引发什么。 我父亲为了拯救我们牺牲了他的生命。现在他的遗产就由我来继承。 那是一个有趣的夜晚，但我永远也不会再到那些下水道里去了。 看到这玩意没？纯金属的，耐用得很。 她睡在那上面的样子看起来很安详。不知道她梦到了什么呢？ 哈！就连酒馆也同意，乌吉是我们的一员。 它大概再射一箭就要断了。 它一点也不花哨，但很实用。对我来说这就够了。 有没有人需要箭？我这儿有多余的，很多多余的。 这是我最珍贵的收藏品之一。想听听它的故事吗？ 我只要记住别用它装会从破洞掉出来的东西就行了。 这东西我补了又补，但它迟早会破到用不了的。 很好，我可以用它来装很多有用的工具和药剂。 你需要什么？治疗药剂？要多少？ 唔……它可能开始发霉了。 我真的应该多点戴这顶帽子。那些该死的噬脑怪…… 到了得动真格的时候，面罩会落下来。 我最喜欢的地方就是“挡道的地方”。 我十分怀念那些日子。要是早知道…… 瓦伦……你现在在哪里？ 谁能给我一桶腐臭的培根油吗？ 看样子我加入了酒馆俱乐部。 安森的一生经历了许多苦难。他年幼时便失去双亲，不得不与弟弟露宿街头，做着一切能让他们不至于饿死的营生。这段经历虽然让他弟弟学会了恐惧和不信任这个世界，但却对安森产生了相反的影响。无论被打得如何遍体鳞伤，这位战士都拒绝屈服，他不相信放弃，也不相信任何人或事。没有什么人是无可救药的，没有什么事业是毫无希望的。这一人生观使得他对同伴极为忠诚，但有时候也会导致他在应该停下来冷静思考一下的时候鲁莽行事。 body.en: Orkira heals all non-adjacent damaged Champions for health per second. Orkira heals non-adjacent Champions who are damaged. Whenever Orkira damages an enemy, they receive one stack of Elemental Fire, taking % of Orkira's damage per second for seconds and receiving % additional damage from all attacks. This ability stacks up to times (additively) and attempting to add another stack will reset the cooldown of all stacks. Orkira leaves a stacking debuff and DoT on enemies she damages. Increase the effect of Elemental Fire by % for each order of magnitude worth of effective healing done with Lesser Restoration on the current run. Effective healing done: Increase the size of Orkira's Burning Hands AoE cone and have Elemental Fire apply two stacks instead of one. Orkira focuses on applying more stacks of Elemental Fire as quickly as possible. Increase the effect of Lesser Restoration by %. Lesser Restoration will now "heal" undamaged Champions and Healing Flame will count % of this non-effective healing as well. Orkira focuses on healing those who are injured, and even those who are not. If a Champion Orkira is able to heal (ie. non-adjacent) is about to take a killing blow, Orkira instantly swaps formation slots with that Champion for seconds and takes the hit for them. During this time Orkira's overwhelm point is set to twice the other Champion's and neither Orkira or the other Champion can be moved, removed, or swapped out; after the time expires they swap back regardless of whether Orkira and/or the other Champion died during the time. This effect can only occur once every seconds. I'm just here to help! I'll stand with you, if you'll stand by me. Here you go. You'll be up and about in no time! Stay with me! Have you ever just watched fire? It's mesmerizing! Trust me on this... ok? How can I explain... OH! I'll show you! It gets rough sometimes, but you're way more important. Nothing a little fire can't fix! Catches you by surprise, doesn't it? Change can be good? Right? Yeah. Yeah, this is good... Right? Look at my WINGS! Friends are like marshmallows, flammable and sweet. I won't let them harm you, no matter what it takes! In a way... you've actually got the Phoenix here helping. The Phoenix is going to be SO excited to hear about this!!! The Phoenix represents creation, destruction, resurrection, and renewal. The Phoenix is wonderful! They're warm, welcoming...and they always listen! Hi. Did you have any questions? I get this a lot. It's real hard to find clothing that fits, I gotta make what I have last! I got custom-tailored clothing in Waterdeep! They even fit around the tail! Yeah. I'm used to being weird everywhere. When you find... people, friends... family, It's easy to feel welcome finally. Got some burns? I've got the antidote. It's REALLY fluffy. I made some for everyone! Who me? I can sleep anywhere. Can you pass the scratchy rock? One problem at a time. We're going to get coffee and truffles soon. I'd do anything to protect him! I feel bad about the accordion though... Tell Avren I do NOT need one of his creepy bags, this'll work just fine! Do you not have dragonborn in this plane of existence? My whole life is in this bag. I'm always ready to go! I need to save a little bit, in case one of you dies... I hate being cold. Even the reminder of warmth helps! Wow! I really like... all the... flames. Can I keep this? It's my job to keep others from getting burned. Doesn't it just... So pretty... Orkira Illdrex is a gold dragonborn from the Nentir Vale, where she grew up nurturing a love of healing and fire. Between a strange life filled with monsters, Gods, time and multiplanar travel, death, the destruction of worlds and the saving of others, Orkira has survived and adapted to deal with any situation with a motto of 'One problem at a time.' Orkira leaps to a random enemy and attacks with a small AoE cone of fire. Orkira leaps to a random enemy and attacks with a small AoE cone of fire. Orkira summons The Phoenix to rain Elemental Fire down upon the battlefield. This deals damage and increases the Elemental Fire stacks. Orkira flies up over the enemies, grasping The Domain of the Phoenix and uttering a prayer, summoning The Phoenix to rain Elemental Fire down upon the battlefield. This deals damage and increases the Elemental Fire stacks of affected enemies by 1 every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. body.zh: 奥尔基拉每秒为所有不相邻的受伤勇士回复 生命值。 奥尔基拉治疗受伤的非相邻勇士。 奥尔基拉对一名敌人造成伤害时，会给该敌人附加一层元素火焰，使其每秒受到奥尔基拉伤害值 % 的伤害，持续 秒，并使其受到的所有攻击伤害提高 %。此技能可以叠加 次（加算），附加额外层数时会重置整个堆叠的冷却时间。 奥尔基拉在她伤害的敌人身上留下可堆叠的减益和持续伤害。 在当前关卡中，使用次级复原术造成的有效回复量每达到十的 n 次方，即提升元素火焰的效果 %。 有效回复量： 提升奥尔基拉的燃烧之手造成范围伤害的角度，并使元素火焰造成两层堆叠而非一层。 奥尔基拉专注于尽快堆叠更多元素生物火焰层数。 提升次级复原术的效果 %。次级复原术现在将“回复”未受到伤害的勇士，并且疗愈火焰也将把这些无效回复的 % 回复量计算在内 奥尔基拉专注于治愈伤者，甚至是没有受伤的人。 如果满足奥尔基拉回复条件的某位勇士（例如不与她相邻）即将被击杀，奥尔基拉会立即与该勇士互换在阵型中的位置并代替其承受该次伤害，持续 秒。在此期间奥尔基拉的击溃点数变为该勇士击溃点数的双倍，并且无论奥尔基拉或是该勇士都无法被移动、移除或替换出场。时间结束后双方交换回原本的位置，无论奥尔基拉和/或该勇士是否已在此期间死亡。此效果在 秒内仅能发动一次。 我只是想来帮忙而已！ 只要你愿意，我会跟你并肩作战。 走你。你很快就能焕然一新恢复战斗力了！ 不要放弃！ 你有细心观察过火焰吗？真的好迷人！ 你就信我这一把......好吧？ 我该怎么解释......噢！我展示给你看吧！ 有时情况会很艰难，但你更重要。 没有什么东西是一点火解决不了的！ 让你大吃一惊，不是吗？ 改变可以是好事？对吧？嗯。这是好事......对吧？ 看看我的翅膀！ 朋友就像棉花糖，易燃且甜蜜。 无论付出什么代价，我都不会让他们伤害你的！ 在某种程度上......凤凰是在帮你。 凤凰要是听说了这个一定会很高兴的！！！ 凤凰代表着创造、毁灭、复活和重生。 凤凰可太棒了！它们温暖、热情......而且它们总是在倾听！ 嘿，你有什么问题吗？我有很多这样的。 要找到合身的衣服是很难的，我得让我手上有的东西经久耐用！ 我在深水城量身定做了衣服！连尾巴的部位都做得很贴合！ 是啊。我已经习惯了到处都很怪。 当你找到......人、朋友......家人，最后很容易就会有受欢迎的感觉。 哪里烧伤了吗？我有药。 真的很松软。 我给每个人都做了一些！ 谁？我吗？我在哪儿都能睡。你能把那块扎人的石头递给我吗？ 一次一个问题。 我们很快就会有咖啡和松露了。 我愿意做任何事来保护他！不过手风琴的事我很过意不去...... 告诉阿夫伦我不需要他那变态的包，这东西就挺好！ 你在这个存在的位面里没有龙裔吗？ 我的一生全在这个包里了。我时刻准备着，随时都能走！ 我得存起来一些，以防你们中有人死了...... 我讨厌寒冷。即使是能让我想起温暖的东西也很有帮助！ 哇！我真的很喜欢......所有这些......火焰。我能留着这东西吗？ 不让别人被烧伤是我的职责。 这是不是......很漂亮...... 奥尔基拉·伊德雷克斯是一个来自南提尔谷地的黄金龙裔，她在那里长大，培养了对治疗和火焰的热爱。在充满怪物、神灵、时间和多位面旅行、死亡、世界毁灭和拯救他人的奇怪生活之间，奥尔基拉存活了下来，并适应了处理任何情况，她的座右铭是“有问题就一个个来”。 奥尔基拉跳向一名随机敌人，用锥形火焰造成小范围伤害。 奥尔基拉跳向一名随机敌人，用锥形火焰造成小范围伤害。 奥尔基拉召唤凤凰对战场降下元素火焰。此攻击会造成伤害，并增加元素火焰堆叠层数。 奥尔基拉从敌人头顶飞过，掌控凤凰领域并吟唱祈祷，召唤凤凰对战场降下元素火焰。此攻击会造成伤害，同时每 2 秒对受影响的敌人叠加 1 层元素火焰，持续10秒。

Lighter than your average clips, they let my beard swing furiously when I attack. Crafted from a meteorite that fell near Icewind Dale. Ancient family clips found in the depths of the Mithral Hall. It'll hold up your pants, if you don't move around too quickly. It's seen better days, but it still does the trick. It's quite slimming! An ancient family belt recovered from a Battlehammer heirloom cache. A simple ring with little magical power. A shiny ring that seems to radiate mild heat on its own. A magical ring crafted from a fallen meteorite. Specially crafted by the craftsmen in Mirabar as a peace offering to Clan Battlehammer. Looks like someone took a warhammer to this. If you can get it up in time, it'll do the job. It's strong enough to stop a blow from a raging giant. A magical shield with secret and mysterious powers. To be fair, I think it's supposed to be broken. Someone needs to get some spit and polish on this thing. Stronger than steel, and far lighter. This helm has seen Bruenor through a hundred sticky situations. Hailing from the Spine of the World, Bruenor is the leader of Clan Battlehammer. He is close friends with the celebrated drow Drizzt Do'Urden and the halfling Regis. Rounding out the 'Companions of the Hall' are his two adopted human children: Catti-Brie and Wulfgar. Bruenor slashes at the closest enemy with his axe. Bruenor delivers a devastating blow to the closest enemy. Bruenor delivers a devastating blow to a single enemy using his shield and axe. body.zh: 每与一名勇士同列，即提升 % 伤害 相邻的勇士越多，布鲁诺造成的伤害越高。尽量将其放置在更多勇士身边。 与 同列的勇士提升 % 伤害 布鲁诺使同纵队勇士的伤害提高。尽量将其与杀伤力最强的勇士放在同一纵队。 当距离布鲁诺 2 格范围内的勇士被攻击时，在 10 秒内提升 的效果 %（最多可堆叠 25 层） 布鲁诺举起盾牌。当附近盟友受到攻击时，使同纵队勇士的伤害提高。 布鲁诺专注于制定小队战术，不断提高同纵队勇士的伤害。 阵型中每有一位矮人（除 外）， 的效果即提升 % 你的阵型获得一层秘银厅堆叠。每层秘银厅堆叠均使布鲁诺的“振奋”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 是的，我是个无私的矮人。 好了，不要再跟我废话了。 到我身边来，马上要变得混乱了。 你可算会用脑子战斗了！ 不管是不是为了国王，我们得把这些矮人召集起来！ 有人自称是费伦最强壮的矮人？ 我扮演凶狠的宾温。 什么？我还不够聪明？ 区区几个豺狼人吓不倒我！ 抬起你的屁股滚出去！ 守住阵线！他们无法击败团结的我们！ 与你并肩作战是我的荣幸。 当王的感觉真棒！ 虽然并不完美，但还能用。 锋利得可以用来取代刀叉。 数不清有多少地精成了此斧的斧下亡魂。 此斧头征战沙场千百次，无一不是凯旋而归。 虽然是有点沉，但能够确保我的胡子整整齐齐。 比一般的夹子轻盈，而且能够确保我每次挥击武器时，胡子也会随之摆动。 这是采用冰风谷的某块陨石为材料打造而成的。 这是在秘银厅深处找到的上古家族夹子。 只要小心翼翼地移动，这腰带绝对可以捆得住裤子不往下滑。 虽然是破旧了一点，还是能派上用场的。 戴上后整个人看起来瘦多了！ 这是从某个战锤家传宝库中所发现的古老家族腰带。 简简单单的一枚戒指，没有什么魔力。 闪闪发亮的一枚戒指，似乎在散发着微弱的热能。 这是采用某块陨石所打造而成的魔法戒指。 这是米拉巴的匠人打造给战锤部落的和解礼物。 这块盾牌似乎被战锤锤击过。 你要是举得动它，它肯定能保你安全。 它可以抵挡愤怒巨人的全力一击。 这面魔法盾牌蕴含着许多秘密和神奇的力量。 说实话，我觉得这头盔本来就是长这样子的。 得找个人来擦洗下这玩意。 强度比钢铁高，但却更加轻盈。 此头盔陪伴过布鲁诺出生入死百余次。 布鲁诺来自世界之脊，是战锤氏族的领袖，他与著名的卓尔精灵崔斯特·杜垩登以及半身人瑞吉斯是亲密好友。在“秘银五侠”中，还有他收养的两个人类孩子，凯蒂布莉儿和沃夫加。 布鲁诺用斧头劈砍距离最近的敌人。 布鲁诺对距离最近的敌人打出毁灭性的一击。 布鲁诺用他的盾牌和斧头对一名敌人打出毁灭性的一击。

When the fighter is active and enemies are attacking the NERDS buff the Champions behind them. When the NERDS attack while the {Ranger}#e50035 is active, damaged enemies take % more damage for the next 15 seconds. Enemies attacked by the NERDS while the ranger is active take more damage from other champions too. Increases the damage of Champions adjacent to the NERDS by % while the {Bard}#6ac359 is active. Heals all Champions in all columns in front of the NERDS for HP per second while the {Cleric}#f8e432 is active. When the NERDS attack while the {Rogue}#e035aa is active, they leave behind a small NERD-shaped trap filled with smoke powder which explodes after 5 seconds, dealing 10x the NERDS' normal damage. The NERDS also attack 0.5 seconds faster while the {Rogue}#e035aa is active. When the NERDS attack while the {Wizard}#856fd3 is active, their initial attack spawns 3 magic missiles, which fly out and deal normal damage to 3 random enemies if possible. When the {Fighter}#ed8730 is active, the max health of the NERDS is increased by %. The {Fighter}#ed8730 will always appear in the front of the cart when Shake The Box is used. The NERDS choose Orange to lead! The {Ranger}#e50035 will always appear in the front of the cart when Shake The Box is used. The NERDS choose Red to lead! The {Bard}#6ac359 will always appear in the front of the cart when Shake The Box is used. The NERDS choose Green to lead! The {Cleric}#f8e432 will always appear in the front of the cart when Shake The Box is used. The NERDS choose Yellow to lead! The {Rogue}#e035aa will always appear in the front of the cart when Shake The Box is used. The NERDS choose Pink to lead! The {Wizard}#856fd3 will always appear in the front of the cart when Shake The Box is used. The NERDS choose Purple to lead! Gather your party and do your best! Adventure together on an epic quest! Fighters are masters of combat. Rangers are warriors of the wilderness. A bards' musical songs inspire allies and can turn foes into friends! Clerics channel divine healing magic that can defend their allies. You don't always have a healing potion available! For when it's been a while since your last long rest. Fighters love to kick down doors. Fighters love to charge headlong into dungeons. Fighters use their bravery to do whatever it takes to save a friend in need. Fighters are masters of weaponry and martial skill. Rangers love to track & hide in the brush and brambles. Rangers are highly skilled in monster tracking. Rangers' companions are trained to fight alongside them. After perfectly stalking their foe, it ends with a surprise attack! Bards are adventurous and often humorous. Bards love to tell stories which create illusions and beguile minds! Bards weave magic through performance and song. As masters of the arts, bards can be highly skilled at anything they set their minds to. The power of the gods flows through clerics. Clerics are a bastion against the unholy. Clerics can call flames down from the skies to battle their enemies. A powerful mace is sure to make a clerics' foes run for the hills! A rogues' skill allows them to navigate dungeons safely. A rogues' curiosity help spots traps to disarm and to pick locks. Rogues are experts in stealth, cunning, and agility. Rogues strike from the shadow with precision and speed! Wizards are scholars of the arcane arts. Wizards' lives are seldom mundane. When wizards are around, you might want to stand back! Wizards are known for knowledge, determination, and ingenuity. A spontaneous fighter, a creative ranger, and a daring rogue team up with a humorous bard, a deep-thinking wizard, and a logical cleric. Together, they form a sweet partnership! Each NERD has a role, but like all adventuring parties, they're better together! Leaps out of the cart and hits the nearest enemy with their shield. The NERDS dive into their cart and a random assortment of NERDS leap out to replace them. The nerds dive into their cart causing it to shake and a random assortment of nerds leap out to replace them. If a specialization is chosen, the front-nerd will always be the nerd picked by the specialization. body.zh: 激活“{Fighter}#ed8730”时，每当有敌人攻击呆宝们，使呆宝们身后的所有勇士的伤害提高 %。 当战士处于活动状态，敌人正在攻击呆宝们时，会使他们后面的勇士们变强壮。 激活“{Ranger}#e50035”时，每当呆宝们发动攻击，受到伤害的敌人在接下来的 15 秒内受到的伤害提高 %。 巡林客活跃时被呆宝们攻击的敌人也会受到其他勇士的更多伤害。 激活“{Bard}#6ac359”时，使与呆宝们相邻的勇士的伤害提高 %。 激活“{Cleric}#f8e432”时，每秒为呆宝们前方各列的所有勇士治疗 点生命值。 激活“{Rogue}#e035aa”时，每当呆宝们发动攻击，他们会留下一个装满烟粉的呆宝们形状小陷阱，陷阱将在 5 秒后爆炸，造成等同于呆宝们基础伤害 10 倍的伤害。激活“{Rogue}#e035aa”时，呆宝们的攻击速度还会加快 0.5 秒。 激活“{Wizard}#856fd3”时，每当呆宝们发动攻击，他们的初始攻击会生成 3 发魔法飞弹，飞出后最多对 3 名随机敌人造成基础伤害。 激活“{Fighter}#ed8730”时，呆宝们的最大生命值提高 %。 使用“摇摇盒子”后，“{Fighter}#ed8730”总是会出现在购物车的最前面。 呆宝们选择领导橙色！ 使用“摇摇盒子”后，“{Ranger}#e50035”总是会出现在购物车的最前面。 呆宝们选择领导红色！ 使用“摇摇盒子”后，“{Bard}#6ac359”总是会出现在购物车的最前面。 呆宝们选择领导绿色！ 使用“摇摇盒子”后，“{Cleric}#f8e432”总是会出现在购物车的最前面。 呆宝们选择领导黄色！ 使用“摇摇盒子”后，“{Rogue}#e035aa”总是会出现在购物车的最前面。 呆宝们选择领导粉色！ 使用“摇摇盒子”后，“{Wizard}#856fd3”总是会出现在购物车的最前面。 呆宝们选择领导紫色！ 召集你的队伍，使出全力来吧！ 一起冒险，踏上史诗征程吧！ 战士是战斗的大师。 巡林客是荒野的战士。 吟游诗人的乐曲能鼓舞队友，也能将敌人变成朋友！ 牧师引导神圣的治疗魔法来守护他们的同伴。 治疗药剂可不是什么时候都常备的！ 你已经很长时间没好好休息过了。 战士喜欢撞门。 战士喜欢低着头直冲进地牢。 英勇的战士会尽自己的一切力量去拯救有需要的朋友。 战士是武器和武术的大师。 巡林客喜欢追踪，以及躲在灌木和野蔷薇丛里。 巡林客是追踪怪兽的高手。 巡林客的伙伴接受过训练，总是与他们一起作战。 在完美跟踪敌人之后，再用一次奇袭完美结束！ 吟游诗人很有冒险精神，通常也很幽默。 吟游诗人喜欢讲各种制造幻象和欺骗心灵的故事！ 吟游诗人会用表演和歌曲来组成魔法。 作为艺术大师，吟游诗人可以精通一切他们想要精通的东西。 神的力量在牧师的体内流动。 牧师是对抗不洁者的碉堡。 牧师可以从空中召唤火焰来打击他们的敌人。 一根强力的权杖能把牧师的敌人都赶跑！ 游荡者的技能可以帮助他们在地牢中安全地行进。 游荡者的好奇心能帮助他们发现需要拆解的陷阱和开锁。 游荡者都是潜行、诡计和技巧方面的专家。 游荡者会在阴影中以最快的速度打出精准一击！ 法师是奥术学者。 法师的人生大多不凡。 如果有法师在身边，你最好躲开点！ 法师以知识、决心和智慧闻名。 一位自然而然的战士，一位有创意的巡林客，一位果敢的盗贼与滑稽的吟游诗人、深思熟虑的法师和有条有理的牧师所组成的队伍。他们一起组建了甜蜜的伙伴关系！每个呆宝都有自己的角色，但就像所有的冒险团队一样，他们在一起的时候更厉害！ 跳下车，并用盾牌攻击最近的敌人。 呆宝们跳进他们的马车，一群呆宝随机跳出来代替他们。 呆宝们跳进他们的马车，导致马车摇晃，一群呆宝随机跳出来代替他们。如果选择了某个专精，那么该专精挑选的呆宝将始终处于最前面。

body.en: When attacks she paints the enemy red. An enemy can be painted up to three times. 's damage is increased by 33% for each stroke of paint she has applied to a normal enemy in the current area, and 1000% for each stroke of paint she has applied to a boss enemy in the current area, stacking multiplicatively. Normal enemy strokes cap at 100, and boss area strokes cap at 6. D'hani paints enemies she attacks, this causes them to take extra damage based on the number of paint strokes she can see. keeps track of the total number of enemies she has painted across all time. This tracking persists between resets. 's damage is increased by 0.03% for each enemy she has ever painted, stacking additively. Total Monsters Painted: ^Total Bonus: % D'hani remembers all the enemies she has ever painted, this strengthens her attacks against all future enemies. Enemies paints have a % chance to gain a splash of yellow. Enemies painted in this way drop % more gold when they are killed. Enemies paints have a % chance to gain a stroke of green. Enemies painted in this way cause 's attacks against them to damage nearby enemies as well at % damage. This effect does not chain, but does apply paint to the enemies it damages. Enemies paints have a % chance to gain a blotch of blue. Enemies painted in this way are stunned for seconds when attacks them and boss enemies painted in this way take % more damage from all attacks. Increase the gold find effect of Splash of Yellow by %. D'hani adds more yellow to increase gold found. Increase the damage done by Stroke of Green by % D'hani adds more green to increase damage to nearby enemies. Increase the bonus damage done to bosses by Blotch of Blue by %. D'hani adds more blue to increase damage against bosses. 's damage is increased by % for each Rival of Waterdeep in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Oh, I'm IN! They're focused on my hands, so they never see the feet or the wings coming. Could we get some new paints on the way home? This shade matches your mood, doesn't it? See the red ones? Punch the red ones! The Cassalanters planted me as a spy, but that sort of backfired, didn't it? I didn't understand what friendship was until I met the rivals. If I survive this battle, I'm going to paint it. Careful study reveals truth--in life and in art. We need more yellow? Oh, that's fine - I've got red and green! I think we need a bit more mossy colors. Imagine a dark green. Now, darker. Darker. Keep going. It wouldn't be complete without all of us. A refreshed fighter is a strong fighter. Fighting is like mixing paint. You need to know what works for a situation. What? I didn't want to get my hands dirty! Practice makes perfect! I know, the paint gets everywhere. Isn't it wonderful!? I keep them in the corner of my room. They have a satisfying clink when I punch things! You can tap them together for secret messages while flying. I think these really compliment my sash! Only for fancy occasions. Is that paint, or blood? Doesn't really matter. For when I need to explore some colors. Don't distract me, I have a dinner to attend right after I'm done! Now, this is what I call an UPGRADE! It also doubles as a headscarf in a storm. When I was foraging, it was a good sack in a pinch. It reminds me of my favorite snack. It's not often you meet the Open Lord of Waterdeep! Always keep those paintbrushes handy. For rinsing, not sipping! I'm painting the entrance to Trollskull Manor regal red. With my art supplies, even my staff gets used. They'll do for a tavern brawl. I know they are master-crafted, but they just don't feel balanced. No one suspects the paintbrushes! It's poison-tipped. Best used with an oil-based paint. D'hani's adventures began when she left Chult out of boredom to travel the world. She joined the Rivals as a spy for their enemy but liked them enough to stay! When not out on missions with the rest of the team, she enjoys painting the things and people she's seen on her travels. D'hani attacks the nearest enemy and one other random enemy. D'hani attacks the nearest enemy and one other random enemy. The weather clears and D'hani flings sharpened paint brushes at five random enemies, dealing damage and applying paint. The weather clears and D'hani pulls a quiver of sharpened paint brushes from her robes and flings them out at five random enemies. They deal damage and apply D'hani's paints to all enemies they hit. D'hani paints the enemies she attacks up to three times. She does additional damage based on the total number of paint strokes she can see D'hani remembers all the enemies she has ever painted, this strengthens her attacks against future enemies. body.zh: 每当 发动攻击，她会给敌人涂上红色。一个敌人最多可以被涂色 3 次。每对普通敌人施加一个笔触， 的伤害提高 33%；每对当前区域内的首领敌人施加一个笔触，伤害提高 1000%，以乘算方式堆叠。普通敌人笔触上限 100 笔，首领区域笔触上限 6 笔。 德·哈尼会对她攻击的敌人涂上颜色，她会根据所能看到的涂色总数造成额外伤害。 会一直记录曾经被她涂色过的敌人总数。这一记录不受重置影响。 每涂色一个敌人，自身的伤害增加0.03%，以加算方式堆叠。 涂色过怪物总数： ^总加成： % 德·哈尼能记住所有她曾经涂色的敌人，从而强化她对未来敌人造成的攻击伤害。 被 涂色的敌人有 % 几率被染上一抹黄色。被这样涂色的敌人在被击杀时会额外掉落 % 的金币。 被 涂色的敌人有 % 几率被涂上一笔绿色。 攻击被涂上绿色的敌人时，附近的敌人也会受到 % 的伤害。此效果不会连锁，但也会给同时受到伤害的敌人涂色。 被 涂色的敌人还有 % 几率会被染上一斑蓝色。 攻击被涂上蓝色的敌人时会使其眩晕 秒，被涂上蓝色的首领受到的所有伤害会提高 %。 提升“黄色飞溅物”的金币寻获效果 %。 德·哈尼加入更多黄色，提升找到的金币数量。 使“一道绿色”造成的伤害提升 % 德·哈尼加入更多绿色，提升对附近敌人的伤害。 使“蓝色斑点”对首领造成的加成伤害提升 %。 德·哈尼加入更多蓝色，提升对首领的伤害。 阵型中每存在一个“深水城的竞争对手”， 的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 噢，算我一个！ 他们会重点关注我的手，所以他们从来都预料不到脚和翅膀的攻击。 我们能在回家的路上买点新颜料吗？ 这块阴影跟你的心情很相称，不是吗？ 看到红色的那些了吗？狠狠地揍他们！ 卡萨兰特尔人栽赃我说我是间谍，但好像他们自食其果了，不是吗？ 在遇到对手之前，我从不理解什么是友情。 要是这场战斗过后我还没死，我得把它画下来。 谨慎研究揭露真相 - 生命和艺术莫不如是。 我们需要更多黄色？噢，没关系，我有红色和绿色！ 我觉得我们需要多一点苔色。 你在脑海中想象一下暗绿色。现在想象那颜色更暗一点，再暗一点，继续加暗。 没有我们大家，就不算完整。 清新的战士就是强大的战士。 战斗就好像混合颜料。你需要知道应对情况要用什么。 什么？我可不想把手弄脏！ 熟能生巧！ 我知道，油漆弄得到处都是。是不是很棒！？ 我把它们放在我房间的角落里。 我揍人的时候它们会发出令人倍感舒畅的咔咔声！ 你可以在飞行的时候碰撞它们来发出秘密信息。 我觉得这东西真的很衬我的肩带！ 仅用于高调场合。 那是颜料还是血？这真的不重要。 我需要尝试色彩的时候可以用得着。 别打扰我，等这里的事搞定了，我还要去赴晚宴呢！ 这才像是升级嘛！ 在风暴里它还能用来当头巾。 我寻找食物的时候，它是一个很好用的临时口袋。 让我想起了我最爱的零食。 我可不是经常能遇到深水城的公开领主的！ 用来放笔刷很顺手。 有颜料，不能喝！ 我要把巨魔头骨庄园的大门涂成庄严的红色。 我的作画用品这么多，就连木棍都用上了。 在酒馆里打架时能用得上。 我知道它们工艺精良，但总觉得有点不太平衡。 谁都不会怀疑笔刷！ 镖尖上还涂了毒。最好跟油基颜料一起使用。 德·哈尼因为无聊而离开了楚尔特，开始环游世界。她加入深水城对手团本来是作为一名间谍，但却又因为喜欢勇士队而留了下来！没和大家一起执行任务的时候，她喜欢画旅途中看到的各种人与物。 德·哈尼会攻击最近的敌人和另外一个随机敌人。 德·哈尼会攻击最近的敌人和另外一个随机敌人。 天空放晴，德·哈尼向五名随机敌人投掷尖锐的画笔，造成伤害并涂抹颜料。 天空放晴，德·哈尼从她的长袍中抽出一把尖锐的画笔，向五名随机敌人扔去。它们会造成伤害，并将德·哈尼的颜料涂在所有被击中的敌人身上。 德·哈尼最多可以给她攻击的敌人涂色 3 次。她会根据所能看到的涂色总数造成额外伤害 德·哈尼能记住所有她曾经涂色的敌人，从而强化她对未来敌人造成的攻击伤害。

body.en: Deekin gains a Doom stack every seconds, to a max of stacks. Champions adjacent to Deekin do % more damage per Doom stack, stacking multiplicatively. Each enemy killed reduces the current Doom stacks by %. Deekin tells a story to those adjacent to him, increasing their damage the longer he isn't distracted. Place him next to your highest damage dealers! When Deekin has or fewer stacks of Story of Doom, he causes enemies to spawn % faster. Deekin's Confidence in the Boss ability is increased by % for each familiar you have assigned to attacking enemies, stacking multiplicatively. Deekin increases the speed that enemies spawn when you are killing them quickly. Deekin will make them spawn even faster if you have assigned familiars to attack enemies. Deekin increases the damage of Story of Doom by % for each Champion in the formation that is not a Standard Species, stacking multiplicatively. Standard species are Aasimar, Dragonborn, Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goliath, Halfling, Human, Orc, Tiefling, Half-Orc, and Half-Elf. Non-Standard Species Champions: The best tales come from unusual situations. Deekin increases the damage of Story of Doom by % for each Champion in the formation with a Ranged base attack, stacking multiplicatively. Ranged Champions: The best storytellers have a lot of range. Deekin increases the effect of Story of Doom by % for each Bard in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Bard Champions: Deekin is always willing to learn from the best. When you complete an area with Deekin in the formation, he sets his Current Events stacks to the area number. The effect of Story of Doom is increased by % for each Current Events stack, stacking multiplicatively. Deekin increases the effect of Story of Doom by % for each Champion he is adjacent to, stacking multiplicatively. Hew Maan counts as three Champions for this ability. Deekin is most selfless kobold. Deekin enjoy leading group. Everyone listen to Deekin. Deekin lead you all to DOOM. DOOM comes for you! DOOM comes for all! Doomy doomy doom doom DOOM is good, yes, but what if mooore DOOM? Deekin believes DOOM is for everyone! Deekin trusts boss. They would never lead Deekin wrong. Deekin is not worried. Boss promised Deekin would never be scared again. Deekin sing you a song? Deekin starts -- you all join on the second verse! Once upon a time, boss and Deekin went on several hundred adventures... Boss and Deekin fought many, MAAAAAANY scary enemies... Deekin stay back here where Deekin won't be seen. Deekin shy. Deekin feels more confident now. Deekin wants to sing! Deekin ready for anything! All eyes on Deekin! DoOoOoOoM! Deekin best dodger in world. Never get hit! Deekin lifts from knees, never back! Deekin find comfort in others like Deekin. Deekin great kobold hero, but still just little kobold. Ooo! You wants to hear Deekin sing! Deekin gladly sing for hero! The suspense builds! The music swells! He forgets how it goes, but nobody knows, 'cause Deekin's singing a so-ooong!! Is you talking to Deekin? You not the boss, so Deekin not gots to talk to you. Has Deekin told you recently about doom? Is hard to write epic story when blood be everywhere. Doom doom DOOM! Doomity doom doom DOOM! You like? Ummm... Deekin not feels so good. Maybe Deekin pencil you in as sidekick? Deekin busy writing great, epic tale, so he not gots time to talk to you. Lots of epic story gets cut out. But not the doom. No. Never the Doom. . . Heh... Deekin just thinkings to that one time you yells at Deekin. Ahhh, good times... Stop Deekin if you've heard this one: There once was a man from the Moonsea. . . Deekin might have shiny bracers, but Deekin still gots bad back. And suddenly, boss came upon the lair of their enemy! Huzzah! Deekin feel like bag of clamshells bashed on ground repeatedly. Overall is good. The boss and Deekin, faithful kobold companion, continue their voyage. The boss pretends not to notice that Deekin recently passed gas. Ummm... is 'backpack' be one word or two? Deekin hurts pretty bad. Is adventuring always likes this? Deekin gots complete confidence in you. Deekin knows that you is great hero, you is! Deekin pretends not to notice that the boss' clothes have not been washed recently. We be in the dungeon with monsters! Ooooh yeah! A former member of the Dripping Fang clan, Deekin was once a Skald for a White Dragon named Tymofarrar. Once he was released from Tymofarrar's service, he set out to become the most amazing storyteller in all of Faerûn. He yearns to sing and tell stories of heroic deeds, but his songs often devolve into 'tales' of the doom that is coming to him or his companions. Deekin takes aim with his crossbow and fires at a random enemy. Deekin shouts DOOM as loudly as he can, dealing massive damage and buffing Story of Doom. Deekin shouts DOOM as loud as he can, dealing massive damage and setting Story of Doom to max stacks for 30 seconds. Deekin increases the damage of those adjacent to him. The buff increases rapidly over time, but is reduced by monster kills. When Deekin's Story of Doom stacks are low, monsters spawn more quickly. body.zh: 德金每隔 秒获得一层“厄运”堆叠层数，最高堆叠 层。每有一层“厄运”堆叠层数，与德金相邻的勇士额外造成 % 伤害，以乘算方式堆叠。每有一名敌人被击杀，当前“厄运”堆叠层数减少 %。 德金对相邻的勇士讲故事。他保持专注的时间越长，听故事者的伤害就越高。将他放置在最厉害的伤害输出者身边！ 当德金拥有的“厄运故事”堆叠层数小于等于 ，他会使怪物的刷新速度提高 %。 你每指派一只魔宠攻击敌人，德金的“首领信心”技能效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 当你迅速击杀敌人时，德金会加快敌人的刷新速度。如果你指派了魔宠来攻击敌人，德金会进一步加快敌人的刷新速度。 阵型中每有一位不是标准种族的勇士，德金会使“厄运故事”的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。标准种族是指神裔、龙裔、矮人、精灵、侏儒、巨人、半身人、人类、兽人、提夫林、半兽人和半精灵。 非标准种族勇士数量： 最精彩的故事往往源自不同寻常的情境。 阵型中每有一位远程基本攻击勇士，德金会使“厄运故事”的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 远程勇士数量： 最优秀的讲故事者总是涉猎广泛。 阵型中每有一位吟游诗人，德金会使“厄运故事”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 吟游诗人数量： 德金总是愿意向最优秀的人学习。 当你在德金位于阵型中的情况下完成一个区域，他会将他的“当前活动”堆叠层数设为区域数字。每有一层“当前活动”堆叠层数，“厄运故事”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 每有一位勇士与德金相邻，他会使“厄运故事”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。此项技能会把休马恩算作三位勇士。 德金是最无私的狗头人。 德金喜欢领导团体。所有人都听德金的。 德金带领你们所有人走向厄运。 你要完了！所有人都要完了！ 糟了，糟了，糟了，糟了 厄运是不错，但要是再多来点厄运呢？ 德金相信厄运会降临到每个人头上！ 德金相信首领。首领绝不会带领德金走错。 德金并不担心。首领保证过德金永远不用再害怕了。 德金给你唱歌了？ 德金打头阵--你们都殿后！ 从前，首领和德金进行过几百次冒险…… 首领和德金与很多很多很多很多可怕的敌人战斗过…… 德金就待在这里，这里没人看得见德金。德金害羞。 德金现在感觉自信多了。德金想唱歌！ 德金做好了应对一切的准备！全体看向德金！厄运！ 德金是世上最好的闪避者，从未被击中过！ 德金是用膝盖，不是用背！ 德金在和德金一样的人身上找到了慰藉。 德金虽然是狗头人的大英雄，但终究只是个渺小的狗头人。 哦？你想要听德金唱歌？德金其实很乐意为英雄豪杰高歌一曲！ 琵琶一曲肠堪断，风萧萧兮夜漫漫！ 他忘了歌词，但却没人察觉，因为德金正在引吭高歌！！ 你是跟德金说话？你不是老大，德金才不搭理你。 德金有跟你说过十字弩的故事吗？ 在浴血奋战时，的确难以抽空撰写一篇传奇故事。 厄运难逃！死亡的声音在空气中回荡！喜欢吗？ 唔......德金整个人都不太好了。 也许可以把你写作德金的搭档？ 德金在忙着撰写史诗级传奇故事，没空搭理你。 被迫删减了很多传奇故事。唯有厄运故事是例外。对，绝对不能动厄运故事...... 唉......德金不禁回想起那一次你对迪金大吼出声。往事不可追忆啊...... 你若是已经听过这个故事的话可以打断德金：很久以前有一个来自月海的人...... 德金虽然佩戴着闪亮的护腕，但却护不住疼痛的后背。 说时迟那时快，老大突然从天而降出现在敌人的大本营！呜哇！ 德金感觉自己像是被装在袋子中不断被抨击的蛤壳一样。整体而言状态还行吧。 忠诚的狗头人德金伴随着老大继续闯荡江湖。 老大假装没发现德金刚刚放了个屁。 呃......背包是一个词还是两个字？ 德金这次伤得很严重。冒险时经常会这样受伤的吗？ 德金对你有百分百的信心。德金相信你是位盖世豪侠！对的！ 德金假装没发现老大的衣服已经很多天没洗了。 我们进入了充斥着怪物的地下世界。太棒了！ 德金是滴血毒牙氏族的前成员，曾经为一只名叫泰默法拉的白龙担任吟游诗人。从泰默法拉的麾下离开后，他开始成为整个费伦最了不起的说书人。他渴望歌唱和讲述英雄事迹，但他的歌声却常常演变成他或他的同伴即将面临厄运的“故事”。 德金用弩弓瞄准并向一名随机敌人发射。 德金用尽最大的力气喊出“厄运”，造成高额伤害并增益厄运故事。 德金用尽最大的力气喊出“厄运”，造成高额伤害，同时使厄运故事堆叠至最高层数，持续 30 秒。 德金提高与他相邻勇士的伤害。增益会随时间快速提高，但会因为击杀怪物而降低。 德金的厄运故事堆叠层数较低时，怪物的刷新速度会加快。

body.en: Thellora gains a Rush stack for every areas she completes in an adventure, and these stacks persist through resets. Thellora's Rush Target is equal to her number of Rush stacks or the current campaign's favor exponent, whichever is smaller. When Thellora attacks her first enemy she has enough damage to defeat in an adventure, she spends all her Rush stacks and skips to the first area past her Rush Target. Thellora gathers all the rewards (including gold) from bosses skipped in this fashion, but nothing from normal monsters. Thellora skips the first few areas of adventures, depending on the campaign's favor and the number of rush stacks she acquired in a previous adventure. Thellora increases the damage of Champions in the column behind her by %. Thellora increases the damage of Champions in the column behind her. Each time Thellora attacks and doesn't kill an enemy, she increases the effect of Strength of the Luma by % until the area changes, stacking multiplicatively and capped at stacks. Thellora increases the damage of Champions with a STR of or less by % for each such Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Buffs apply to the pre-stack value. Qualified Champions: Thellora focuses on improving the weakest Champions. Thellora increases the damage of Speed Champions by % for each such Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Buffs apply to the pre-stack value. Qualified Champions: Thellora runs with the fastest Champions. Thellora increases the damage of Female and Non-Binary Champions by % for each such Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Buffs apply to the pre-stack value. Qualified Champions: Thellora allies with those that have been blessed by her deity. Thellora increases the health of all other Champions by % of her max health and any healing effect on those Champions is increased by %. The effects of feats assigned to Thellora also apply to all adjacent Champions. Note that feats that buff her formation abilities have no effect when applied to other Champions. My life for my people. The shadows are descending! Together we will show them the light! I'm not even close to finished. I will see this battle to its end! Shields up! No matter how many there are, my devotion to Callessa will never waver. Their eyes will be on my spear when my sword cuts through them. Stand together! They will not break us! Even if they surround us, they will not break our strength! Callessa will not abandon us! Her power flows through our blades! I will not let the Luma down. Ever. We've cut them off! Take them while their numbers are low! We're not done here yet. A tactician is only as good as their knowledge. ??? (TEST) ??? With me! Overwhelm them with our combined might! Make them fear us! Altogether now! The bards shall sing of our charge! We WILL win this day! We shall NOT fail her! I fashioned this in a time of need. It became my most trusted weapon. When I meet Callessa, this will be the item I ask to be blessed. Created at my request when I became a Luma at last. Forged in Mount Celestia with the power to defeat the gods themselves. As a child, I could barely move in this, let alone gallop. After a few years of training, this armor felt like a second skin. I dreamt of wearing this armor for many years before I finally donned it. I led the Luma to face the shadows. Callessa and her people shall never fall! The weight of steel always felt natural in my hand. I kept this blade for longer than I should have. But never once did it fail me. A prayer to Callessa is etched on the blade to keep her with me at all times. Legends say this comes from another world. It burns with magic we do not know. 'Strong as the herd' is etched on the back. An item that has saved my life more times than I can count. I led the charge in the battle of Sophress. They called me the Aegis of Luma. Blood of Callessa be with me. Given to me on the day of my first training. I will always think of the person that gave me this and what they meant to me. I need energy on the battlefield to crush my enemies! Made from part of Callessa herself. One of my most cherished gifts. The ruby was harvested from a vein close to the peak of Mount Callessa. This represents an oath I failed to uphold. That will not happen again. The final adornment that truly marks you as one of the Luma. Summoned by the Amber Circlet and a direct connection to Callessa. Thellora, a centaur paladin, belongs to an all-female regiment known as the Luma. These fifty-three centaurs are diverse, but unified in that each possess a distinctive golden right eye. The centaurs believe these individuals are chosen by their god, Callessa, to be devoted guardians and trained warriors. With their divine connection and martial prowess, they protect their land, embracing their unique gifts with unwavering dedication. Thellora strikes an enemy with her hooves, and another with her blade. Thellora charges through the enemies, and then increases the damage of all champions for a short while. Thellora charges through the enemies, dealing 1 massive hit to them in a wide path. She then increases the damage of all champions by 400% for 15 seconds. Thellora increases the damage of Champions in the column behind her. Thellora skips the first few areas of adventures, depending on the campaign's favor and the number of rush stacks she acquired in a previous adventure. Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Male Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation with a LAWFUL alignment Increases the damage of all Champions with a CON score of 11 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Champions with a INT score of 11 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Melee Champions by %
body.zh: 在一次冒险中，德萝拉每完成 个区域就会获得 1 层猛冲堆叠，并且这些堆叠层数会持续到冒险重置。德萝拉的猛冲目标等于她的猛冲堆叠层数或当前战役的恩赐指数，以较少者为准。当德萝拉在一次冒险中攻击以她的伤害足以将其击败的第一个敌人时，她会消耗掉她所有的猛冲堆叠层数，并直接跳到她猛冲目标之后的第一个区域。德萝拉会收集跳过的首领掉落的所有奖励（包括金币），但不会收集普通怪物掉落的任何奖励。 德萝拉会跳过冒险的前几个区域，具体取决于战役的恩赐以及她在之前的冒险中获得的冲刺堆叠数量。 德萝拉会使处于她后方一列的勇士提高 % 伤害。 德萝拉会提高处于她后列勇士的伤害。 每次德萝拉攻击且未杀死敌人时，她会使“露玛之力”的效果增加 %，直到区域改变，该数值以乘算方式堆叠，上限为 层。 阵型中每有一位力量小于或等于 的勇士，德萝拉均使此类勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。增益作用于堆叠前的数值。 满足资格勇士： 德萝拉专注于强化最弱的勇士。 阵型中每有一位速度型勇士，德萝拉就会使所有此类勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。增益作用于堆叠前的数值。 满足资格勇士： 德萝拉与最迅捷的勇士同行。 阵型中每有一位女性及无性别勇士，德萝拉就会使所有此类勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。增益作用于堆叠前的数值。 满足资格勇士： 德萝拉与被她的神祇祝福过的人结盟。 德萝拉会增加其他所有勇士的生命值，数值相当于她最大生命值的 %，并且针对这些勇士的所有治疗效果提高 %。 德萝拉配备的专长效果也会作用于所有相邻勇士。请注意，增强她阵型技能的专长对其他勇士没有作用。 我的生命属于我的人民。 阴影降临了！我们将齐心协力向他们展示光明！ 我可不会轻易倒下。 我要将这场战斗进行到底！ 举起盾牌！ 无论有多少敌人，我对卡莱萨的忠诚绝不动摇。 当他们盯着我的矛时，我的剑将切开他们的身体。 靠拢！他们无法击溃我们！ 他们即使包围我们，也无法摧毁我们的力量！ 卡莱萨不会抛弃我们！她的力量在我们的剑刃上流淌！ 我不会让露玛失望。绝不。 我们把他们截断了！趁他们人数不多时干掉他们！ 我们还没完呢。 战术家的能力取决于其知识。 ???(TEST) ??? 跟着我！用我们联合的力量击溃他们！让他们惧怕我们！ 大家一起上！吟游诗人们会用歌声传颂我们的冲锋的！ We WILL win this day! We shall NOT fail her! 这是我在情况紧急时制作的。现在它是我最可靠的武器。 当我见到卡莱萨时，我会请求其为这件物品赐福。 这是在我最终成为一名露玛时按我的要求打造的。 在天堂山中铸造，具有击败诸神本身的力量。 我小时候穿上它几乎无法移动，更别提飞奔了。 经过多年训练，这幅盔甲几乎成了我的第二层皮肤。 多年来我一直梦想穿上这件盔甲，最后终于如愿。 我领导露玛对抗暗影。卡莱萨和她的子民永远不会倒下！ 钢铁的重量在我手中总是显得很自然。 我本不该把这柄剑留这么久的。但它从未辜负过我。 刃上蚀刻着对卡莱萨的祷文，让她时刻与我同在。 传说它来自另一个世界。剑上燃烧着我们所不知的魔法。 背面刻着“强如兽群”的字样。 一件曾经无数次拯救我生命的物品。 我在索弗莱斯之战中带头冲锋。他们称我为露玛之盾。 卡莱萨之血与我同在。 我在第一次训练时获得。 我会永远记得给我这个礼物的人，以及此人对我的意义。 我需要在战场上补充能量，以碾碎我的敌人！ 由卡莱萨本体的一部分制成。我最珍视的礼物之一。 红宝石采自卡莱萨山顶峰附近的一条矿脉。 这代表我未能坚守的誓言。决不能再发生这种事。 真正标志着你成为露玛一员的最终装饰。 由琥珀圆环召唤，与卡莱萨直接相连。 半人马圣武士德萝拉隶属于一个名为露玛的全女性军团。军团中的五十三位半人马各形各色，但共同点是都拥有一只独特的金色右眼。半人马族群坚信这些同胞由他们的神祇卡莱萨亲自遴选，都是忠诚的守护者和训练有素的战士。凭借神圣的羁绊与高超的武力，她们保家卫国，以坚定不移的奉献精神发扬着自己独特的天赋。 德萝拉用她的蹄子攻击一个敌人，用她的剑攻击另一个敌人。 德萝拉冲过敌人，然后增加所有勇士的伤害，持续片刻。 德萝拉冲过敌人，沿着一条宽阔的路径对他们造成一次巨大的打击。然后她让所有勇士的伤害提高 400%，持续 15 秒。 德萝拉会提高处于她后列勇士的伤害。 德萝拉会跳过冒险的前几个区域，具体取决于战役的恩赐以及她在之前的冒险中获得的冲刺堆叠数量。

body.en: As an Ally of Elminster, Gale can be used in any Elminster Patron adventure or variant, even if he would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions. Gale increases the damage of Champions in the three columns in front of him by %. Gale increases the damage of Champions in his column and the column behind him by %. Gale increases the damage of Champions in the two columns in front of him by %. Gale increases the damage of Champions in the two columns in front of him. The first time Gale damages any enemy, they take % additional damage from all subsequent attacks. The power of the Netherese Orb leaves enemies that Gale damages vulnerable to all subsequent attacks. Gale's Fire Bolt deals damage to all enemies in a small area. Gale embraces the explosive school of Evocation. Gale gains the Control role and attacks against Champions miss % of the time. Gale focuses on the protective school of Abjuration. Increases Archmage's Insight's number of columns by one. Gale immerses himself in the captivating school of Enchantment. Archmage's Insight now affects his column and the column behind, and enemies that attempt to choose Gale as a target instead choose to attack another Champion, assuming another valid target exists. Gale envelops himself in the deceptive school of Illusion. Your formation gains one Ceremorphosis stack due to the mind flayer tadpole in Gale's brain. Gale increases the damage of Netherese Orb by % for each Ceremorphosis stack, stacking multiplicatively. Current Ceremorphosis Stacks: Gale seeks out other companions suffering from the fate of Ceremorphosis. Gale increases the effect of Netherese Orb by % for each Champion in the formation with an Intelligence of or higher, stacking multiplicatively. Int 13+ Champions in Formation: Gale teaches intelligent companions the secrets of the Weave. Gale increases the effect of Netherese Orb by % for each Champion you have unlocked that is not eligible for the current adventure, stacking multiplicatively. Ineligible Champions: Gale seeks out the limited number of allies that can complete the adventure. Gale increases the effect of Archmage's Insight by % for each Elminster Patron variant you have completed, stacking multiplicatively. If it's me or the realms - I'll save the realms every time. Their magic is strong, but our will is stronger! It's not as easy for me as a sorcerer or warlock. No offense, Wyll. I've had experiences that other wizards can only dream of. You can't manipulate the entire Weave, merely a small piece of it. Maybe I was wrong, as rare of an event as that is. This power is strong! It has a nice ring to it, don't you think? Gale of Waterdeep! One day, my name will be known up and down the Sword Coast! These are certainly things Elminster wouldn't have taught me... The risk is worth the reward. This could be just what we need to save everyone! My mind can be changed. ...Sometimes. Magic can be elegant, but sometimes, a good fireball is the answer. Just stare at the stars with me a bit longer. Ah-Thran Mystra-Ryl Kantrach-Ao... If Mystra will not hear my pleas, I shall seek succor elsewhere. Mark my words well. My name will be counted among the greatest wizards of all worlds! Even at my lowest, playing with Tara lifted my spirits... ...though the ball's purpose eluded her. I was always the one fetching it... Tara comes and goes as she pleases. But she's always pleased to help me. A ring as evasive as Tara, when I asked how she obtained it... Comfortable, practical, and relatively unsinged. Not as flashy as Elminster's, but at least they've plenty of pockets. I could get used to these. Elegant, but powerful - just like Tara. Incredible! Every stitch is infused with Weave. Like wearing magic itself... I'd have preferred something with a library... ...but it will do. For now. Handy for glimpsing the future. And also shaving. I like gazing at the heavens. To remember. And to forget... At least they're written in full sentences. I've lost count of how many times I've read these. Still just as magical. A spell for all situations. And my improvements in the margins. You can trust me with this - you have my word. A little pick-me-up, for when any Weave will do... A snack-sized shoe for the wizard who travels light. Blink and you'll miss me. But I'll always hit you. These were a gift from... well, never mind. Magical musings and mullings. Not my best handwriting. This was... well, it was expensive, let's leave it at that. A symbol of Mystra's faith in me. Former faith, I suppose... All manner of wizarding sundries. Pungent but powerful. Gale of Waterdeep was a prodigious archmage, his talents earning him the attention of Mystra, the goddess of magic. At her side, he learned all that mortals might accomplish with the Weave, in time earning his place as her lover, and her Chosen. And yet, he was not satisfied. In an attempt to prove he was ready for even greater power, he accidentally unleashed 'the orb' - a highly volatile fragment of pure Weave, corrupted by Netherese magic, which buried itself in his chest. Cast out by Mystra, humbled by his downfall, he does all he can to prevent the orb's cataclysmic detonation, watching for his chance to get back everything he lost, and more. Gale deals 1 hit to a random enemy, prioritizing enemies he hasn't hit yet. Gale knocks back all enemies, dealing ultimate damage and slowing them for 15 seconds. Gale casts Gust of Wind, knocking back all enemies, dealing ultimate damage and slowing them for 15 seconds. body.zh: 作为艾尔明斯特的盟友，盖尔可用于任何艾尔明斯特赞助者冒险或支线任务，即使以前由于支线任务或赞助者限制条件无法使用。 盖尔会提高他前面三列勇士的伤害 %。 盖尔提高同列和后列的勇士伤害 %。 盖尔会提高他前面两列勇士的伤害 %。 盖尔会提高他前面两列勇士的伤害。 盖尔首次伤害任意敌人时，敌人会从所有后续攻击受到额外 % 伤害。 耐瑟瑞尔球体的力量令被盖尔伤害过的敌人易于受到所有后续攻击的伤害。 盖尔的“火焰箭”对小范围内的所有敌人造成伤害。 盖尔信奉热衷爆炸的召唤学派。 盖尔获得控制者角色，针对勇士们的攻击会有 % 落空。 盖尔注重断绝的防护学派。 “大法师的洞察”的队列数增加一。 盖尔沉浸于令人神往的附魔学派。 “大法师的洞察”现在会影响自己的列和背后一列，且尝试选择盖尔为目标的敌人现在会改为攻击另一勇士（假定存在另一有效目标）。 盖尔浸淫在欺骗性十足的幻觉学派之中。 盖尔大脑中的夺心魔蝌蚪使你的阵型获得一层“蜕变”堆叠。每有一层蜕变堆叠，盖尔的“耐瑟瑞尔球体”伤害提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 当前蜕变堆叠层数： 盖尔在寻找其他遭受蜕变命运折磨的同伴。 阵型中每有一位智力高于或等于 的勇士，盖尔令“耐瑟瑞尔球体”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中智力 13+ 的勇士数量： 盖尔向聪慧的同伴教授魔网之秘。 你解锁的每个不符合当前冒险限制条件的勇士均使盖尔的“耐瑟瑞尔球体”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 不适用勇士： 盖尔寻求可以完成冒险的有限数量伙伴。 每完成一个艾尔明斯特赞助者支线任务，均使盖尔的“大法师的洞察”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 若要在我和国度中做出选择，我每次都会拯救国度。 他们的魔法很强大，但我们的意志更胜一筹！ 对我来说，这不像术士或邪术师那么容易。无意冒犯，瓦尔。 我拥有其他法师梦寐以求的经历。 你无法操纵整个魔网，只能挑拨其中的一小部分。 也许我错了，这是非常罕见的情况。这力量太强大了！ 听起来很有派头，你不觉得吗？深水城的盖尔！ 总有一天，我的名字会响彻剑湾！ 艾尔明斯特肯定不会教我这些…… 高风险，高回报。这可能正是我们拯救大家所需要的！ 我的想法会改变……有时会。 魔法虽然优雅，但有时，一个大火球就是答案。 和我再多看一会儿星星吧。 啊-特兰密斯特拉-瑞尔坎特拉赫-奥…… 如果密斯特拉不理会我的哀求，我将到别处寻求慰藉。 记住我这句话。我的名字必将被列入诸界最伟大的法师之列！ 即便在最低谷的时候，和塔拉玩耍都会令我振奋起精神…… ……但球的路线避开了她。我永远是那个接球的人…… 塔拉随心所欲地来来往往。但她总是愿意来帮我。 和塔拉一样难以捉摸的戒指，我问她是怎么拿到这个的时候…… 舒适、实用，相对干净。 和艾尔明斯特的相比不那么闪耀，但至少有许多的口袋。 我会习惯的。优雅，但是强大 - 就和塔拉一样。 不可思议！每一针都注入了魔网。感觉好像穿着魔法本身一样…… 我更喜欢有图书馆的地方…… ……凑活。至少暂时如此。 窥测未来挺不错。也可以当成剃须用的镜子。 我喜欢窥视天堂。好铭记在心。也好遗忘过往…… 至少文句完整。 我已经不记得自己读过多少次了。但还是令人着迷。 适合所有情况的法术。我的改进写在空白的地方。 这个你可以相信我 - 我向你保证。 只是略微提提神，因为任何魔网都能做到…… 轻便旅行的法师使用的小巧鞋子。 一眨眼你就找不到我了。但我却总是能打到你。 这曾是那人给我的馈赠……唉，算了。 魔法上的创意与思索。字体不是我写的最好那种。 这个......嗯，总之很贵，就说这么多吧。 密斯特拉信任于我的圣徽。曾经信任吧…… 各式各样的法师杂物。辛辣但强力。 深水城的盖尔是一位了不起的大法师，他的才华为他赢得了魔法女神密斯特拉的注意。在女神之侧，盖尔学会了凡人通过魔网可能完成的一切，并及时赢得了他作为女神的情人和天选者的位置。然而，他还没有满足。在尝试证明自己已经准备好接受更大力量的时候，他意外放出了“球体”- 受到耐瑟瑞尔魔法腐坏、极不稳定的纯粹魔网碎片；后者深埋进了他的体内。被密斯特拉逐出的他，因为自己的失势而变得自惭；他竭尽全力，意图阻止“球体”的灾难性爆炸，寻找机会夺回他失去的一切，甚至更多。 盖尔对 1 名随机敌人造成 1 次击中，优先选择其之前未曾击中的敌人。 盖尔击退所有敌人，造成杀招伤害并使其减速 15 秒。 盖尔施放“阵风”击退所有敌人，造成杀招伤害并缓慢敌人 15 秒。

body.en: Hank increases the damage of Champions adjacent to him by %. Hank's primary support ability increases the damage of Champions next to him in the formation. Enemies that Hank hits are knocked back. The distance they're knocked back increases the closer they are to the formation. Hank increases the damage bonus of Stalwart Encouragement by % for each Champion in the formation with a total ability score of 78 or less, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Heroism isn't measured by skill, but by courage. Hank increases the damage bonus of Stalwart Encouragement by % for each Champion in the formation with a Ranged attack, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Precision comes from practiced coordination. Hank increases the damage bonus of Stalwart Encouragement by % for each member of the Saturday Morning Squad in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. This also adds the Saturday Morning Squad affiliation to Dungeon Master. Adds the Saturday Morning Squad affiliation to Qualified Champions: Together, even the softest voices can overcome the mightiest foes. Hank can help scavenge up to additional Time Gate Pieces when killing bosses. While this cap is not reached, Hank has a % chance of scavenging Time Gate Piece each time a boss is defeated. The cap increases by / every day. Time Gate Pieces Scavenged: ( this adventure) Hank has a chance to uncover Time Gate Pieces with each defeated boss, with a cap that increases every day. Hank fires a flurry of five arrows, each at a random enemy, dealing 1 ultimate hit and stunning them for 8 seconds Hank increases the effect of Stalwart Encouragement by % for each item that has ever been collected by Scavenger abilities, stacking additively. Whenever an enemy is knocked back, Hank gains a Tactics stack. For each Tactics stack, the Critical Hit Chance of all Champions in the formation is increased by %, and the Critical Hit Damage of all Champions in the formation is increased by %. Tactics stacks stack additively up to times and reset when changing areas. Knock them off balance, then strike where it counts. Hank gains the Hunter role with Dragons as his Favored Foe. Non-boss waves spawn a Dragon % of the time. Stalwart Encouragement's effect is increased by % for each Dragon defeated in the current area, stacking multiplicatively up to times. In boss areas, non-boss waves always spawn a dragon, and defeated dragons provide 5 stacks. No monster is invincible, not even the five-headed queen. Look out! Get behind me! No matter what Venger throws at us, I know we'll make it! I believe in you, and I'm right here with you. When the going gets tough, we rely on you. You've got this. If we all give a little bit, together it makes a big difference. Hey, you're not alone. Let's do this together, okay? Don't fight, you guys! We have to work together! Great job, gang! Now that's what I call teamwork! I've gotta stay sharp to keep my edge against Venger. All this running around has been great for keeping me in shape! This bow isn't just for show, you know. Go ahead. Make my day. I won't leave a single one of my friends behind! Come on, everyone! If we all work together, we can't lose! Ugh, these are starting to smell. That's much better. I'm ready for a great day out with my friends! Not too loose, not too tight. Not too dark, not too bright. Come on, everyone! We can do anything if we work together! Hey, I remember this! I would play with it for hours. I won this for Bobby at a carnival game. I hope he likes it. You're wondering where the string is? Don't worry about that. The arrows it fires can tie up baddies and even make ladders to climb! We might be able to stop Demodragon with this! I have an idea! Get down and cover your eyes! This better be worth the trouble... I learned an important lesson from my time with the cloud bears. Too... stiff... Can't... move... Go Dragons! Does this make me look heroic? I sure hope so. I'll blend into the trees with this on. Venger will never know what hit him. I really don't want to put this on. It's not much better, but at least the itching stopped. Tough and reliable, just like me and my friends. My stance has improved ever since I put this on. It helps me aim better. My parents got these on sale years ago. They don't really fit now. Now we're talking! I can run for miles with these on! I'm ready to wander the whole world now! No matter where I go, these boots will always bring me back home. Hank is the steadfast and courageous leader of the group of friends that has been swept away into the perilous realm of Dungeons & Dragons. As the Ranger, he wields his signature Energy Bow to fend off danger and light the way forward. Though the weight of leadership tests him at every turn, Hank's tactical insight and unwavering resolve keep the party moving forward in their quest to find a way back home. Hank attacks the closest enemy, dealing 1 hit. Hank attacks the closest enemy, dealing 1 hit. (They are also knocked back once the Energy Bow ability is unlocked.) Hank attacks 5 random enemies, damaging and stunning each of them. Hank fires 5 arrows at random enemies, dealing 1 ultimate hit and stunning each of them. body.zh: 所有与汉克相邻的勇士提升 % 伤害。 汉克的主要辅助技能可以增加阵型中与他相邻的勇士的伤害。 汉克命中的敌人会被击退。敌人离阵型越近，被击退的距离就越远。 阵型中每有一位总技能值低于等于 78 的勇士，汉克会使坚定鼓舞的伤害加成增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 英雄主义不是由技能衡量的，而是由勇气决定的。 阵型中每有一位远程攻击的勇士，汉克会使坚定鼓舞的伤害加成增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 精准源自反复练习的协作。 阵型中每有一位星期六早晨的小队成员，汉克会使坚定鼓舞的伤害加成增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。这也会将“星期六早晨的小队”从属组织赋予“地地下城主”。 将“星期六早晨的小队”从属组织赋予“ ”。 满足资格勇士： 齐心协力，哪怕最微弱的声音也能战胜最强大的敌人。 击杀首领时，汉克可以帮助收集最多 个额外的时空门碎片。没有达到此上限时，每次击败一名首领，汉克有 % 的几率收集 个时空门碎片。此上限每天增加 / 。 已收集时空门碎片： （此冒险共收集 ） 汉克有几率在每个被击败的首领身上发现时空门碎片，上限随日期提升。 汉克射出五支箭，每支箭射向一个随机敌人，造成 1 次杀招命中伤害并使敌人眩晕 8 秒。 汉克每有一件通过“拾荒者”技能收集到的物品，就会使“坚定鼓舞”的效果提升 %，效果以加算方式堆叠。 每当击退一名敌人，汉克就会获得一层“战术”效果。每有一层“战术”效果，阵型中所有勇士的暴击率提升 %，阵型中所有勇士的暴击伤害提升 %。“战术”效果以加算方式堆叠，最多叠加 次，改变区域时重置。 先让敌人失去平衡，然后攻击要害之处。 汉克获得猎人角色定位，龙族成为他的偏好对手。非首领区域有 % 的几率刷新一条龙。当前区域内每有一条龙被击杀，“坚定鼓舞”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 次。首领区域的非首领波次总是会刷新一条龙，被击败的龙会提供 5 层效果。 没有怪物是不可战胜的，哪怕是五头蛛后也不例外。 小心！站到我身后去！ 不管复仇者给我们带来什么挑战，我知道我们一定能成功！ 我相信你，而且我会一直陪着你。 当情况变得艰难时，我们依靠你。你能行的。 如果我们都出一份力，聚在一起就能产生巨大的影响。 嘿，你不是一个人。我们一起努力，好吗？ 你们别打架！我们必须齐心协力！ 干得好，伙伴们！这才叫团队合作！ 我得保持机警，才能在与复仇者的对抗中占据优势。 跑来跑去对保持我的状态很有帮助！ 这把弓可不是摆设。来啊，让我过把瘾。 我不会抛弃我任何一个朋友的！ 加油，各位！如果我们同心协力，我们不会输的！ 呃，这些衣服开始有味道了。 这就好多了。我准备好和朋友们一起度过美好的一天啦！ 不太松，也不太紧。颜色不太深，也不太亮。 来吧，各位！只要我们齐心协力，没有什么做不到的！ 嘿，我记得这个！我以前能玩上好几个小时。 这个是我在嘉年华游戏里给鲍比赢来的。希望他会喜欢。 你想知道弓弦去哪儿了？别担心那个。 它射出的箭可以捆住坏人，甚至还能变出梯子来攀爬！ 我们也许能用这个阻止魔化龙！ 我有个主意！趴下，捂住眼睛！ 这最好别让我们白忙活…… 和云熊相处的那段时间让我学到了很重要的教训。 太……硬了……动……不……了 加油，巨龙！ 这会让我看起来很英勇吗？我真心希望如此。 穿上这个我就能融入树林之中。复仇者绝对想不到是什么袭击了他。 我真的不想系上这个。 这个也好不到哪儿去，但至少不痒了。 坚固可靠，就像我和我的朋友们一样。 自从系上这个腰带，我的站姿都变好了。它还能帮我更好地瞄准。 这是我父母几年前打折买的。现在穿着不太合脚了。 这才对嘛！穿上这个我能跑好几英里！ 我现在准备好环游世界啦！ 无论我走到哪里，这双靴子总会带我回家。 汉克是一名坚定而勇敢的领袖，带领着被卷入《龙与地下城》危险领域的伙伴们。作为巡林客，他可以使用标志性的“能量之弓”抵御危险，照亮前行的道路。尽管领袖的重担时刻考验着汉克，但他的战术洞察力和坚定不移的决心支撑着队伍在寻找回家之路的征程中不断前进。 汉克攻击最近的敌人，造成 1 次打击。 汉克攻击最近的敌人，造成 1 次打击。（解锁“能量之弓”技能后，敌人也会被击退。） 汉克随机攻击 5 名敌人，对每个敌人造成伤害并使其昏迷。 汉克向随机敌人射出 5 支箭，造成 1 次杀招伤害并使他们昏迷。

The last person that grappled with me is a pile of ash now. Self - what? I don't understand. Look at this Fireball! Can't you feel the fire in your hearts?! AHAHAH! See, if you just use fireball these fights go faster. Antrius says everyone looks more flattering in the warm glow of the flames! Wait, I can cast this? Hehehe... AHAHAH! Evandra and I have been working out - look at this muscle! When I see fire I just get really excited and want there to be more fire, okay? But, I'm a fireproof plushie, right? Can't spell charm without harm! Look at me! I'm huge! I don't need a fireball anymore! I can just step on them! These have maybe one or two more Burning Hands before they're done... I found these on a dead guard - I mean bandit. Yeah, it was a bandit. Marquis gave me these in exchange for not setting his manor on fire. I can't burn these?! Let me try - FIREBALL! I can do so many cool poses in this! Check out this one! Now this one! Look what it does when I spin - wheeeeeee! I got this one in the Witchlight Carnival when I was a Bearowl trainer! This cloak is magic! I don't know what it does, but it's magic! Wild Magic turned two merchants into these. They're prettier now! Aren't these cute? You should see them when I cast fireball - they get extra shiny. No, I didn't steal this crystal from the Minotaurium Emporium - I would never! This makes my fire burn things more. I guess that's as good as another fireball? The only thing I have from my family's manor that burned down. It wasn't me. The last one burned up. Hey, just like the manor! Evandra says it looks stupid, but she's what's stupid! Okay, I DID steal this one... What do you mean it doesn't cast FIREBALL?! If something looks like a fireball... THEN IT SHOULD CAST FIREBALL! FIRE. BALL. What don't you understand about this? Fireball! Fireball! FIREBALL! FINALLY - AHAHAH! All of these are flammable - so they help me cast Fireball, right? These taste like crap. The dying wizard was all like, 'No, stop. They're for the students.' Psh. Weirdo. I have everything I need! Bat guano. Sulfur. It's all here! Nixie is a charismatic tiefling that brings a chaotic element to the party. Growing up in a wealthy but oppressive household, Nixie was punished for using magic despite her natural talent. In a rebellious move, she stole the family grimoire to teach herself dark sorcery only to result in the burning down of her family manor and all her family inside. Despite this tragedy, Nixie is now on a journey to enjoy her newfound magical freedom and find a new family. When confronted by enemies, and occasionally even friends, she's always ready to hurl her favorite spell, Fireball, with unbridled enthusiasm. Nixie attacks with a ball of fire centered on a random target dealing 1 hit of damage to all enemies in a small radius. Nixie casts a fireball that engulfs the battlefield, hitting all enemies. Each monster hit may be surrounded by Engulfing Flames. Nixie casts a gigantic fireball that engulfs the entire enemy's side of the screen, dealing 1 ultimate hit to all enemies. In addition, there is a 10% chance for each monster hit by this attack to be surrounded by Engulfing Flames. Nixie increases the damage of all Champions with 17+ Charisma including herself. Each time Nixie makes a normal attack, there is a high chance that a random wild magic event happens. Many are good, some are not. body.zh: 使所有魅力值为 17+ 的勇士（包括她自己）的伤害提高 %。 妮茜使所有魅力值为 17+ 的勇士伤害提高，包括她自己。 每当 发动普通攻击，均有较大几率发生随机的野魔法事件。 吞噬烈焰 - 点燃她攻击的区域，持续 20 秒。点燃时，每秒对受影响的敌人造成 的基础杀招伤害^盆栽能量 - 变成盆栽 5 秒，期间无法攻击。在此状态下， 的伤害加成提高 ，之后额外持续 15 秒^金币瀑布 - 她的攻击爆炸中还会飞散出金币，价值为普通怪物击杀的 ^冲击波 - 的攻击还会发射冲击波，使攻击区域内的怪物眩晕 ^蓝色忧郁 - 的皮肤变蓝 10 秒^恐怖随从 - 随机召唤一个怪物^放大 - 的体型变大。她的伤害也提高 %，持续 20 秒。 每当妮茜发动普通攻击，均有较大几率发生随机的野魔法事件。大部分有益，少数有害。 阵型中每有一位提夫林勇士，即使 的 伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 提夫林勇士： 妮茜专注于她的提夫林同胞。 阵型中每有一位总属性值低于等于 78 的勇士， 均使 的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 妮茜专注于她与其他属性不佳者的纽带。 阵型中每有一位混乱阵营勇士，即使 的 伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 混乱阵营勇士： 妮茜专注于混乱。 提高 的伤害加成：盆栽能量 %，以及 ：放大 % 你知道可以用别人的脑袋砸碎瓶子吗？？？伊万德拉表演给我看过！ 上一个和我扭打在一起的人现在已经化为灰烬了。 无什么？我不理解。 瞧瞧这颗火球！你难道感受不到心中的火焰吗？！哈哈！ 看，只要用上火球术，这些战斗就会加速。 安裘斯说温暖的火焰让所有人看起来都更可爱了！ 等等，我能施放这个？ 呵呵呵......哈哈！ 伊万德拉和我一直在锻炼--瞧瞧这肌肉！ 我看到火焰的时候就会异常兴奋，希望制造更多火焰，明白了吗？ 不过，我是个防火的毛绒玩具，对吧？ 迷人和害人，不就一字之差吗？ 看看我！我现在巨大无比！我已经不需要火球了！我可以直接踩扁他们！ 彻底报废之前，这些可能还得爆炸一两只“燃烧之手”...... 我在一个死去的守卫--我是说土匪身上发现的。没错，是土匪。 侯爵给我这些，用以换取我不放火烧掉他的庄园。 我烧不掉这些？！让我试试--火球术！ 穿着它，我可以摆出很多酷炫姿势！看看这个！或者这个！ 看我穿着它旋转--哟呵呵！ 我在女巫之光嘉年华上得到了这个，当时我还是个熊鸮训练师！ 这件斗篷很神奇！我不知道它能做什么，但它很神奇！ 野魔法把两个商人变成了这些。它们现在更漂亮了！ 是不是很好看？最好等我投掷火球时再看--它们会变得格外闪亮。 不，我没有从牛头怪集市里偷走这颗水晶--绝对没有！ 它让我的火燃烧得更猛。可能就像另一颗火球一样？ 我从烧毁的家族庄园中带出来的唯一一件东西。不是我的错。 上一条烧毁了。嘿，就像庄园一样！ 伊万德拉说它看起来很愚蠢，但她才是最蠢的！ 好吧，这个的确是我偷的...... 你说它不发射火球是什么意思？！ 如果某件东西看起来像火球......那么它就应该发射火球！ 火。球。你有什么不能理解的？ 火球！火球！火球！终于--啊哈哈！ 所有这些都是易燃的，所以它们可以帮助我施放火球，对吧？ 尝起来像垃圾。 那个垂死的法师说：“不要，请住手。那是给学生。”呸。怪人。 我拥有所需的一切！蝙蝠粪。硫黄。全都在这里！ 妮茜是一个魅力无边的提夫林，为探险队增加了些许混乱元素。妮茜在一个富裕但压抑的家庭长大，尽管天赋异禀，却曾因为使用魔法而受到惩罚。在一次叛逆行动中，她偷走了家族的魔典，用以自学黑暗魔法，结果却烧毁了她的家族庄园和里面的所有家人。经过这场悲剧之后，妮茜踏上了享受全新的魔法自由，以及寻找新家人的旅途。遇到敌人，有时甚至在遇到朋友时，她时刻准备着施放最爱的火球术，挥洒她肆无忌惮的热情。 妮茜以一名随机目标为中心发动火球攻击，对小范围内的所有敌人造成 1 次伤害。 妮茜施放一颗火球吞噬战场，击中所有敌人。每个被击中的怪物都有可能被吞噬烈焰所包围。 妮茜施放一颗巨型火球，吞噬敌侧的整个屏幕，对所有敌人造成 1 次杀招攻击。此外，被此攻击击中的怪物均有 10% 的几率被吞噬烈焰所包围。 妮茜使所有魅力值为 17+ 的勇士伤害提高，包括她自己。 每当妮茜发动普通攻击，均有较大几率发生随机的野魔法事件。大部分有益，少数有害。

body.en: Turiel increases the damage of all Champions by 100% for each column they are behind him, stacking multiplicatively. Turiel buffs Champions in the columns behind him, based on how far back they are. When an enemy attempts to attack Turiel, they instead attack a different valid target, if one is available. When this occurs, Turiel increases the effect of Embodiment of the Law by %, stacking multiplicatively up to 30 times and resetting stacks when changing areas. Fiends are Turiel's Favored Foe. After attacking a fiend-type enemy, Embodiment of the Law is increased by %. When Order's Demand redirects the attack of a fiend-type enemy, its effect is increased by % as well. Both effects last until you change areas. Turiel hates fiends with a fiery passion and buffs the formation even more when fighting fiends. Increases the effect of Embodiment of the Law by % for each Lawful Champion in the formation Champions in Formation Targeted: All Champions deal bonus damage based on their individual CON scores (+ % per point of CON above , stacking multiplicatively). Increases the damage of by % Turiel increases the damage of Champions based on their Constitution. All Champions deal bonus damage based on their individual CHA scores (+ % per point of CHA above , stacking multiplicatively). Increases the damage of by % Turiel increases the damage of Champions based on their Charisma. Turiel has a keen eye for deception; % of non-boss enemies that spawn are actually duplicitous Rakshasa, fiend enemies who have shape-shifted into other forms. These enemies count as fiends (in addition to their original enemy type) for the purpose of Favored Foe mechanics and Turiel's Unflinching Hatred. You never know when YOU will be the needy one. I suggest hitting them instead. It's not luck, it's... oh you wouldn't understand just follow me. Follow me and you'll do the Platinum Dragon proud. Bahamut's will be done. Do you have a moment to talk about the Platinum Dragon? I am but an illusion. A leaf on the wind. To know your enemy, you must understand your enemy. You can pick them out in the crowd if you pay attention. Trust me. I speak out against the Queen of Dragons! How many of us are here? Perhaps a few can wait outside? The time for debate is over! Strength of Bahamut, flow through me! Don't Panic. Hold the line! Good may be corrupted, but law is ineffable by definition. It still covers my shoulders. I offered my last one to a traveling band of halflings. If only it were less flammable. It protects me from the weather as my deity protects me from harm. Flexible. Comfortable. Still good. When danger arises, freedom of movement is key. Fiends beware. Those who tread the Nine Hells will meet my wrath. Bahamut has entrusted me with his divine power. Are we facing down the gods? No? Then this will do. I've used it as a bludgeon on more than one occasion. He watches and protects me. I wear his visage with pride. Whenever I wear this armor, someone asks me to remove my mask. It's... tiring. He learns. He forgives. He empowers. Bahamut's will be done. My power first broke through along my cheeks, cradling my tears. It's only a curse if you let it control you. I wear the face of my god with pride. Even though some may look away. PREPARE TO UNMASK THE POWER OF THE GODS. Arkhan gave it to me. I believe it is poison. You never know when you might have an undead problem. Gromma gifted it to me. It is one of my prized possessions. I have been channeling power into it for ages. One use only. Wherever the aasimar known as Turiel goes, devils and demons know to tread lightly. Acting on orders of his divine patron, Bahamut, Turiel works tirelessly to bring law, order, and justice to Toril. When not busy with inquisitions or crusades, Turiel calls the endless libraries of Candlekeep his home, studying ancient tomes and seeking guidance for his next holy mission. Turiel points at a random enemy and flame-like radiance strikes them from above. Turiel pushes back enemies and slowly increases party damage for 30 seconds as long as no one in the party is attacked. Turiel removes his mask and becomes enveloped in a pillar of light. All enemies are pushed back and the party's damage slowly increases over 30 seconds. If a Champion gets attacked, this buff is reduced. The ultimate will end early if the party gets hit by too many attacks. During this time Turiel is immobile and doesn't attack. Increases the damage of all Champions by % Increases the damage of all Nonbinary Champions by % Increases the damage of all Aasimar Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a WIS score of 11 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a DEX score of 11 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Lawful Champions by %
body.zh: 图里尔身后的每列勇士均使所有勇士的伤害提高 100%，以乘算方式堆叠。 图里尔为他身后纵队中的勇士提供增益，具体取决于他们之间的距离。 当一名敌人尝试攻击图里尔时，会转为攻击另外一个有效目标（如有）。此情况发生时，图里尔使“秩序象征”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最高可堆叠 30 层，并在改变区域时重置层数。 炼狱生物是图里尔的偏好对手。攻击一名炼狱生物类型的敌人后，“秩序象征”的效果提高 %。当“秩序之令”改变一名炼狱生物类型敌人的攻击对象时，其效果提高 %。两种效果均持续到改变区域为止。 图里尔对炼狱生物的恨意熊熊燃烧，在与炼狱生物战斗时进一步强化阵型。 阵型中每有一名守序勇士，“秩序象征”的效果提高 % 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 所有勇士依据其各自的体质点数造成额外伤害（多于 点体质的每点体质 + % 伤害，以乘算方式堆叠）。 使 的伤害提高 % 图里尔依据勇士的体质提高他们的伤害。 所有勇士依据其各自的魅力点数造成额外伤害（多于 点魅力的每点体质 + % 伤害，以乘算方式堆叠）。 使 的伤害提高 % 图里尔依据勇士的魅力提高他们的伤害。 图里尔善于洞悉伪装；刷新的 % 非首领敌人其实都是狡诈的罗刹--可转变成其他形态的炼狱生物敌人。这些敌人均被视为炼狱生物（除其原本的敌人类型之外），适用于偏好对手机制及图里尔的“坚定仇恨”。 你也不知道什么时候，你会成为那个需要帮助的人。 我建议攻击他们。 这不是运气，这是......算了你不会懂的，跟着我就行。 跟着我，你就会成为白金巨龙的骄傲。 巴哈姆特的意志将会得到贯彻。 有时间听我讲讲白金巨龙吗？ 我只是一个幻觉。像风中的一片树叶。 若要了解敌人，就必须理解敌人。 如果注意观察，你可以在人群中找出它们。 相信我。 我公开宣告反对龙后！ 我们这里有多少人？也许有几个可以在外面等着？ 辩论时间结束了！ 巴哈姆特之力流遍我全身！ 别慌，守住阵线！ 善良可能会被腐化，但律法本质上是不可言喻的。 依然能够盖过我的肩膀。 我将最后一件披肩卖给了一群远行的半身人。 可惜不耐烧。 它能为我遮风挡雨，正如我信仰的神明会为我保驾护航一样。 灵活、舒适、依然可靠。 面对危险时，不受拘束的行动是保命的关键。 恶魔们都听好了，行走于九层地狱的所有生物都会受到我的制裁。 巴哈姆特将一部分神力赐给了我。 我们是要对战神祇吗？不是？那此护甲足矣。 我曾多次使用它来撞击敌人。 祂关注着我保护着我。我很荣幸成为祂的使者。 每当穿上此护甲时，总有人会要求我摘下面具。真的是......心累。 他参悟。 他宽恕。 他授权。 巴哈姆特的意志将会得到贯彻。 我的力量最先划过我的脸颊，成为我的泪水的摇篮。 只要不让它支配你，那它就不再是诅咒。 我很荣幸地佩戴着我信奉的神的面孔。哪怕有些人不喜欢见到这张面孔。 准备好摘下其他神明的面具吧。 这是阿克汉送我的。我怀疑里头装的是毒液。 天知道什么时候会碰上亡灵。 这是格罗玛送我的。是我最珍贵的收藏品之一。 多年量我一直在引导魔力灌输到瓶子中。只能使用一次。 这位被称为图里尔的神裔所到之处，魔鬼和恶魔都会小心谨慎。根据他的神圣守护者巴哈姆特的命令，图里尔不知疲倦地工作，将法律、秩序和正义带到托瑞尔。在不忙于审讯或远征的时候，图里尔会将烛堡无尽的图书馆当作自己的家，研究古老的书籍，为他的下一个神圣使命寻求指导。 图里尔指向一名随机敌人，如火焰般的光辉打击从天而降。 图里尔将敌人击退。并且如果队伍中无人受到攻击，他将在 30 秒内逐步提高队伍的伤害。 图里尔摘下面具，然后被光柱所包围。所有敌人都被击退，队伍的伤害在 30 秒内缓慢提高。如果勇士遭到攻击，此增益将会减弱。当队伍遭到过多攻击时，杀招将会提前结束。在这时，图里尔将无法移动，而且也不会发动攻击。
