body.en: When Mehen is in the formation, Farideh and Havilar become eligible for the current adventure, even if a Patron, Variant, or other restriction would say otherwise. Mehen gains a stack of Grumpy for each of the following checks that is met. He increases the damage of all Champions in the formation by % for each stack of Grumpy he has, stacking multiplicatively. Mehen gets more powerful if you meet the positional requirements for his Grumpy ability. When a monster tries to attack any Champion in the formation for the first time, the damage is prevented and the monster is stunned for seconds and takes % more damage during this time. If the attacked Champion is Havilar, the duration is seconds instead. Some of Mehen's abilities have special effects if Havilar and Farideh are in the formation. Mehen increases Gold Find of the formation by % for every stack of Grumpy that he has, stacking multiplicatively. When a Champion adjacent to Mehen applies a stun, berserk, knockback, slow, or root, the enemy takes % more damage for seconds. If Farideh is adjacent to Mehen, she prioritizes attacking those enemies. This debuff does not stack, but the duration is extended if it applies again before it expires. Mehen increases the effect of Grumpy by % for each DPS Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively and applying to the post-stack value. Champions in Formation Targeted: Mehen rallies a fearsome crew of hard-hitting heroes. Mehen increases the effect of Grumpy by % for each Champion in the formation who is 20 years old or younger, stacking multiplicatively and applying to the post-stack value. Champions in Formation Targeted: Mehen supports promising young adventurers, guiding them with the same wisdom that shaped his adopted daughters. Mehen increases the effect of Grumpy by % for each Dragonborn Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively and applying to the post-stack value. Farideh and Havilar both gain the Dragonborn species when this spec is chosen. Champions in Formation Targeted: Mehen embraces his role as a father by welcoming Farideh and Havilar fully into his Dragonborn family. If you mean willing to take a hit, yeah. That's me. Blades out, eyes up, spells ready and don't get cocky! Keep your eyes on the road ahead! Count your coins before you store your pouch. There are those we can't trust among us. If I have to come up there, I swear I'll turn this caravan around. We'll just call it an extra bounty. People always need sellswords. I've fought tougher battles in my sleep. Let's end this quickly. Keep your wits about you. You never know who you'll run into here. You don't scare easily, do you? I can fix that. Where my girls go, I go. Gold's no use to you if you're dead. Since I'm here, that won't happen. I've seen a thousand battles, and I'll see a thousand more. You don't survive long in my line of work without learning exactly where to strike. Watch how they move. They put too much weight on one side. Sweep the leg. The moment they slip, you strike. If you miss, that's your problem. I've seen enough battles to know how this ends. Watch and learn. What are you wearing? Actually, I don't care. Just stay alive. You fight like family, or close enough. Sometimes you just have to burn everything in your way. I'm certain of few things in this life. Disappointment is one of them. Havi keeps sneaking these into my haversack. Havi, this is not subtle. That is not mine...but if you lose my place, you're polishing armor til supper. ...I don't know if I'm glad Havi's friends with this woman or if I should worry. Every child should have a sword. How else will they learn? Farideh favored this before Lorcan came around. She could have been a fighter. More reliable than that cambion of hers, not that Fari wants to hear it. I'm just saying: she could use a sword AND eldritch blast. I keep it under my chestpiece, close to my heart. It's hard to believe my fierce, clever girls were ever so small. You have to admire the bravery of a man rhyming 'passion' with 'slashing.' No one writes Kallan's letters for him--at least not to me. I miss him. You'll never go wrong with this by your side. I'd prefer you back away so I don't have to re-sharpen this once we're done. In Tymanther, even ceremonial weapons have an edge. This is a sweet gift, girls, but Havi, I am not calling it 'Monster Gutter.' You can grow your piercing, or get a larger blade to make the cut. Your call. You get used to being clanless, but in the meantime, these help. The piercings of my clan--bunch of tyrannical snobs. Verthisathurgiesh is adaptable after all--my girls and I are a package deal. Hit them before they have a chance to hit you. Listen, nothing looks good once it's gone through a behir. Tough and flexible--it does the job. It itches and the gems have no defensive purpose. Mehen's life changed three times: once when he was exiled from the dragonborn stronghold of Djerad Thymar for refusing to be his tyrannical father's puppet; once when he took in twin tiefling babies abandoned in the snow; and once when his teenaged daughter, Farideh, made a pact with a devil from the Nine Hells. But Mehen is both adaptable and resilient; nothing out there will break his love for his daughters, his sense of self, or the strike of his falchion. Mehen leaps out and attacks a random enemy, swinging down and then up, scoring a hit each time. Mehen leaps out and attacks a random enemy, swinging down and then up with a second swing, scoring a hit each time. Mehen breathes a cone of lightning that hits and potentially stuns all enemies. Mehen breathes a cone of lightning that hits all enemies in the area. If it hits more than 5 enemies, or a boss, it stuns all enemies for 10 seconds. body.zh: 当梅亨处于阵型中时，即使赞助者、支线任务或其他限制另有规定，法莉德和哈维拉也有资格参与当前冒险。 梅亨每满足一项以下的条件，他就会获得一层“暴躁”层数。他每拥有一层“暴躁”层数，他会使阵型中所有勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 如果你满足了梅亨“暴躁”技能的位置要求，他将变得更加强大。 当一个敌人第一次试图攻击阵型中的任何勇士时，其伤害会被阻挡，而且该敌人会眩晕 秒，并在此期间多受到 % 的伤害。如果被攻击的勇士是哈维拉，怪物眩晕的时间将为 秒。 如果哈维拉和法莉德在阵型中，梅亨的一些技能会有特殊效果。 梅亨每拥有一层“暴躁”层数，他会使阵型的金币寻获量提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 当与梅亨相邻的一名勇士施放眩晕、发狂、击退、减速或定身效果时，敌人在 秒内多受到 % 的伤害。如果法莉德与梅亨相邻，她会优先攻击这些敌人。此减益不会堆叠，但如果在失效前再次施放，持续时间会延长。 阵型中每有一位伤害输出型勇士，梅亨会使“暴躁”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，并且会应用于堆叠后的数值。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 梅亨召集了一支令人生畏的队伍，其成员都是冲击力强劲的英雄。 阵型中每有一位年龄小于等于 20 岁的勇士，梅亨会使“暴躁”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，并且会应用于堆叠后的数值。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 梅亨会支持有前途的年轻冒险者，用智慧引导他们，他曾经用同样的智慧培养了他的养女。 阵型中每有一位龙裔勇士，梅亨会使“暴躁”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，并且会应用于堆叠后的数值。当此项专精被选中时，法莉德和哈维拉都会算作龙裔。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 梅亨接受了他作为父亲的角色，完全把法莉德和哈维拉接纳进了他的龙裔家庭。 如果这是指愿意挨揍的话，那我的确算是很无私。 拔剑，抬头，法术就绪，不要骄傲！ 都打起精神，注意前方的危险！ 在存放你的钱袋之前，要数一下你的钱币。我们当中有一些不可信的人。 你要是连这点事情都办不好，我就取消行程让车队原路折返。 我们都称之为额外的赏金。 人人都需要雇佣兵。 我在睡梦中打的仗都要比这难。我们快点结束战斗吧。 保持冷静。你永远不知道会遇到谁。 你轻易不会被吓到，对吧？我可以治你这毛病。 我的宝贝女儿去哪，我就去哪。 如果你死了，金子对你来说就没用了。有我在，那样的事不会发生。 我目睹过上千场战斗，而且我还将目睹上千场。 干我这行，你不知道打哪里的话活不了多久的。 看看他们是怎么移动的。他们把太多的重量放在了一侧。扫他的腿。 他们滑倒的那一刻，你就出击。如果你失手了，那就是你的问题。 我见过太多的战斗了，我知道这会如何终结。好好看，好好学。 你穿的那是什么啊？事实上，我并不在乎。你只要别死了就行。 你们要像家人或足够亲密的人一样战斗。 有时候你不得不把阻挡你去路的一切都烧掉。 这辈子我确定的事情很少。失望是其中之一。 哈维老是偷偷把这种书塞进我的背囊里。 哈维，这一点都不微妙。 这不是我的......但如果你把我的位置弄丢了，就得一直抛光盔甲直到晚饭时间。 ......哈维跟这个女人交了朋友，我不知道是该高兴还是担心的好。 每个孩子都应该拥有一把剑。不然他们该怎么学习呢？ 洛肯来之前法莉德就喜欢上这个了。她本应成为一位战士。 比她的魔裔更可靠，但法莉可能不太爱听这话。 我只是随口一说：她可以同时用剑和魔能爆弹。 我把它保存在我的胸甲下，贴近我的心口。 很难相信我的凶狠而聪明的姑娘也曾经是个小不点。 你必须承认，一个人的勇敢与“激情”和“砍杀”是挂钩的。 没人能替卡尔兰写信--至少不能写给我。我很想念他。 身上有这东西，你就永远不会出差错。 我希望你走开，这样我就不用等完事之后再磨一次这东西了。 在泰曼瑟尔，就连祭祀用的武器都是开刃的。 这是一件好礼物，姑娘，但哈维，我可不会给它起名叫“怪物开膛手”。 你可以扩大你的洞眼，或者找一把更大的刀来切。你自己决定。 你会逐渐习惯于脱离部落，但与此同时，这些东西也能帮上忙。 我的部落--那群泰曼瑟尔势力小人的穿环饰品。 维尔蒂萨瑟吉尔希人毕竟还是很有适应能力的--我和我的姑娘们只打包出售。 在他们有机会攻击你之前，先下手为强。 被青足龙蛇蹂躏过的任何东西都不会好看。 坚固而柔韧--能用就行。 弄得人痒得很，而且宝石完全没有防御效果。 梅亨的生活发生过三次改变：一次是因为拒绝做他暴虐父亲的傀儡，而被流放出龙裔要塞杰拉德·提玛尔城；一次是他收留了被遗弃在雪地上的双胞胎提夫林婴儿；还有一次是他青春期的女儿法莉德，与来自九层地狱的魔鬼签订了契约。但梅亨既能适应，又有韧性--外面的一切都无法影响他对女儿们的爱，他的自我的意识，以及他弯刀的攻击。 梅亨跃向前方攻击一名随机敌人，武器上下挥舞各自造成一次伤害。 body.en: Minthara gains a Strife stack for each Evil or Neutral (Good/Evil axis) Champion in the formation, including herself. Minthara increases the damage of these Champions by % for each Strife stack, stacking multiplicatively. Minthara gains a Strife stack for each Evil Champion in the formation, including herself. Minthara increases the damage of these Champions by % for each Strife stack, stacking multiplicatively. Minthara buffs Evil Champions, and these abilities improve as more Evil Champions are in the formation. When Minthara damages an enemy, they take % additional damage from all subsequent attacks, stacking multiplicatively up to the number of Strife stacks Minthara has. Max Stacks: Minthara debuffs enemies she hits, causing them to take more damage from subsequent attacks. Minthara provides benefits based on the number of Strife stacks she has.^3+ Strife stacks: Unyielding: Minthara increases her health by % for each Strife stack she has, stacking additively.^5+ Strife stacks: Piercing: Enemies affected by at least two Soul Branding stacks lose an additional armor or segmented health piece when they are attacked.^7+ Strife stacks: Scarring: When Minthara damages an enemy, she immediately applies the maximum possible number of Soul Branding stacks.^9+ Strife stacks: Nobility: Increases the base value of Noble of Menzoberranzan by %. Minthara increases her health by 10% for each Strife stack she has, stacking additively. Monsters affected by at least two Soul Branding stacks lose an additional armor or segmented health piece when they are attacked. When Minthara damages an enemy, she immediately applies the maximum possible number of Soul Branding stacks. Increases the base value of Noble of Menzoberranzan by 400%. Unlocks Minthara's Spider's Lyre Ultimate Attack Your formation gains one Ceremorphosis stack due to the mind flayer tadpole in Minthara's brain. Minthara increases the health of all other Champions by % of her max health, plus % for each Ceremorphosis stack the formation has, stacking additively. Increases the Health of by Noble of Menzoberranzan now also grants Strife stacks for Neutral Champions in the formation (on the Good/Evil axis). Minthara calls upon the ancient power of her lineage, extending her influence to encompass those that tread the line between good and evil. Your formation gains 2 additional Ceremorphosis stacks. Minthara draws upon the sinister power of the mind flayer tadpole within her. The maximum number of Soul Branding stacks is doubled. Minthara harnesses the full potential of her dark magic to inflict even greater suffering on her enemies. Only the most deserving are granted my aid. Obey my command, and we shall win the day. The Underdark breeds fine warriors, by necessity. They tried to break me. And yet, I persist. Watch for an opening, then strike without hesitation. Panic's home is within our enemy, not our hearts. I am a daughter of House Baenre. I lived a life of privilege and danger. I enjoyed every luxury, and survived my first assassination attempt as a babe. Do you still dare to cross me? I do not have violent urges. I have violent intentions. If somebody angers me, I hurt them. It teaches them not to anger me again. If somebody causes me sorrow, I remove their ability to do so again. Now there is freedom. Soon there will be vengeance. Our foes will be reduced to nothing in time. They will fall. It is simply a matter of patience. They broke my mind. We are going to break them back. Hear me, creatures! I am your foe this day! You think yourself broken? Defeated? I've only just begun. Still capable, in the right hand. Clean. Sharp. Yes, this shall serve. I will crush them where they stand. Ice cold and engraved with spiderwebs. Stay quiet. Maintain the element of surprise. They shall not hear my approach until it is too late. The leather is long-lived, like my kind. With every step, I grow closer to my revenge. Broken, but not useless. Armour more befitting my bearing. Comfort and elegance, yet formidably fearsome. Somewhat gaudy, but pronounced in its practicality. This old thing must do for now. Ease of mobility is paramount in the Underdark. Lizard hide is both supple and flexible. Menzoberranzan's most ancient and powerful House. This marking is familiar to me. My enemies shall know my wrath. The source of a terrible yet intriguing power. My vengeance, writ in blood. This bauble is incapable of providing any aid. Sufficient protection against the Shadow Curse. The creature will come when called. May the Spider Queen guide my blade, should I be worthy. Minthara, once a House Matron from the esteemed House Baenre in Menzoberranzan, was cast aside by the Absolute after failing to recover a powerful and mysterious artifact. Having broken free from the Absolute's control, she now harbors an intense hatred for her former master. Fueled by vengeance and a desire to reclaim her lost honor, Minthara channels her dark powers and cunning to oppose the Absolute and any who stand in her way. Minthara dashes toward the healthiest enemy and damages nearby foes with a swing of her maces. A summoned Drider attacks all enemies, potentially completing the current area. Minthara summons Kar'niss the Drider to attack all enemies. In a non-boss area, the Champions advance to the next area if Kar'niss defeats at least one enemy and no enemies remain after the attack. body.zh: 阵型中每有一位邪恶或中立（以善良/邪恶划分时）勇士（包括明萨拉自己），明萨拉即获得一层“冲突”堆叠。明萨拉每堆叠一层冲突，即可使这些勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中每有一位邪恶勇士（包括明萨拉自己），明萨拉即获得一层冲突层数。明萨拉每堆叠一层冲突，即可使这些勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 明萨拉为邪恶阵营勇士提供增益，并且随着阵型中邪恶阵营勇士的增加，这些能力会进一步提升。 明萨拉伤害任意敌人时，敌人会从所有后续攻击受到额外 % 伤害。该伤害将以乘算方式堆叠，最高堆叠层数等同于明萨拉拥有的冲突层数。 最大堆叠层数： 明萨拉对被她命中的敌人施加减益，使他们从后续攻击中受到更多伤害。 明萨拉根据她所拥有的冲突堆叠层数提供增益。^3+ 冲突堆叠层数：不屈：明萨拉每拥有一层“冲突”堆叠层数，即提升自身生命值 %，以加算方式堆叠。^5+ 冲突堆叠层数：穿刺：如果敌人受到至少两层灵魂烙印影响，则在受到攻击时将失去一点额外护甲生命值或一段分段式生命值。^7+ 冲突堆叠层数：伤疤：在对敌人造成伤害时，明萨拉会立即向其施加最大可能数量的灵魂烙印层数。^9+ 冲突堆叠层数：高贵：“魔索布莱城贵族”的基础效果数值提高 %。 明萨拉每拥有一层“冲突”堆叠层数，即提升自身生命值 10%，以加算方式堆叠。 如果怪物受到至少两层灵魂烙印影响，则在受到攻击时将失去一点额外护甲生命值或一段分段式生命值。 在对敌人造成伤害时，明萨拉会立即向其施加最大可能数量的灵魂烙印层数。 “魔索布莱城贵族”的基础效果数值提高 400%。 解锁明萨拉的“蜘蛛七弦琴”杀招攻击 明萨拉大脑中的夺心魔蝌蚪使你的阵型获得一层“蜕变”堆叠。明萨拉提高所有其他勇士的生命值，数值相当于她最大生命值的 %，外加阵型拥有的“蜕变”堆叠层数乘以 %，以加算方式堆叠。 使 的生命值提升 “魔索布莱城贵族”现在还会为阵型中的中立勇士（以善良/邪恶划分时）赋予“冲突”堆叠层数。 明萨拉唤醒她血脉中的古老力量，将她的影响力扩展至那些游走于善恶之间的人。 你的阵型额外获得 2 层“蜕变”堆叠层数。 明萨拉能汲取体内夺心魔蝌蚪的邪恶力量。 灵魂烙印的最大堆叠层数加倍。 明萨拉能利用她黑暗魔法的全部潜力，给敌人带来更大的痛苦。 只有最值得帮助的人才能让我伸出援手。 听我指挥，我们能赢。 幽暗地域注定会孕育出优秀的战士。 他们想打垮我。但我撑过来了。 看准空当果断出击。 恐慌在敌人心里，而不是我们心里。 我是班瑞家族的女儿。我过着特权与危险并存的生活。 我享受着万般奢华，并在婴儿时期就躲过了第一次暗杀。 你还敢和我作对吗？ 我没有暴力冲动。只有暴力倾向。 谁惹我生气，我就揍谁。揍到那家伙不敢再惹我为止。 如果有人让我伤心，我会让他再也没法这样做。 自由已至。复仇将临。 假以时日，我们的敌人终将化为乌有。 他们会倒下的。只是需要一点耐心。 他们让我伤心欲绝。而我们要用同样的手段报复。 怪物们，听着！今天我来当你们的对手！ 你觉得自己崩溃了吗？挫败了吗？我才刚刚开始呢。 在会用的人手里，它还是有用的。 干净，锋利。嗯，这应该能派上用场。 我会当场粉碎他们。 冰冷且刻有蜘蛛网。 保持安静，维持着出其不意的优势。 他们不会听到我靠近，直到为时已晚。 这皮革经久耐用，和我之族类一样永世长存。 每踏出一步，我离复仇就近了一步。 破损了，但并非没用了。 更符合我身份的盔甲。 舒适又优雅，但极其令人生畏。 有点花哨浮夸，但胜在十分实用。 暂时只能凑合着穿这件旧衣服了。 在幽暗地域，行动灵活是至关重要的。 蜥蜴皮既柔软又有弹性。 魔索布莱城最古老最强势的家族。 我觉得这个标记很熟悉。 我的敌人会感受到我的怒火。 一种可怕而有意思的力量的源泉。 我的复仇，用鲜血书写。 这小玩意提供不了任何帮助。 足以抵御暗影诅咒。 这生物随叫随到。 愿蛛后指引我的利刃，如果我有这个荣幸的话。 明萨拉曾是魔索布莱城受人尊敬的班瑞家族的家族主母，由于没能拿回一件强大且神秘的神器而被真神抛弃。在挣脱了真神的控制后，她现在对曾经的主人怀有强烈的仇恨。在复仇和渴望恢复失去的荣誉的驱使下，明萨拉运用她的黑暗力量和诡诈来对付真神以及一切胆敢阻挠她的人。 明萨拉冲向血量最高的敌人，并用她的权杖挥砍附近的敌人造成伤害。 一只召唤出来的蛛化精灵攻击所有敌人，有可能完成当前区域。 明萨拉召唤蛛化精灵卡尼斯攻击所有敌人。在非首领区域，如果卡尼斯击败了至少一个敌人，并且攻击结束后没有敌人存活，勇士队将推进到下一个区域。

body.en: is eligible to start in all Strahd patron adventures, even if variant restrictions would say otherwise. recovers a bit of her lost memory as she adventures. If is in the formation when you complete an area for the first time, she gets a % damage bonus, stacking additively. These bonuses persist through resets. Nahara does more damage for every adventure area she completes over all time. When attacks and defeats at least one enemy, she gains a Levity stack, with a maximum of stacks. When she attacks and doesn't defeat an enemy, she loses a Levity stack. gets a % damage bonus for each Levity stack she has below , and at the start of each area, she reduces the area requirements by % for each Levity stack above . Nahara allows champions to complete future areas more quickly when she is easily defeating enemies, and when she is not she starts to deal more damage. 's damage is increased by % for each Black Dice Society affiliation member in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. The counter increments three times for every area cleared. Nahara focuses on her experience to deal more damage gets a % increase and Black Dice Society members can be used if Strahd is currently the Patron, even if they do not qualify for the other variant requirements. Additional Champions Unlocked: Nahara focuses on her companions to bring the fight to Strahd The area reduction in is increased by %. Nahara focuses on her amusement to move more quickly A lady doesn't start brawls, but she does finish them. Do not lay a hand on me, or you shall quickly regret it! I almost feel as if I remember this... These hands hold dangerous power. Do not cross me. What I've done before cannot be undone. Perhaps what I can become is as important as who I was. We shall forge our path through this. It can't get worse! I shall remain by your side, and we will see the battle through. Shall we share stories or fight to the death? Stand with me now, as I stand with all of you. There are benefits to making certain promises. We live but once...unless the Mists declare otherwise... I feel stronger... You will burn for this, and it will be by my hand. It's always wise to have a weapon in reserve. I much prefer my spells. If a witch bolt won't do, the bolts from this are a suitable substitute. The gilding doesn't improve the accuracy, but it adds a touch of style. I see faint shapes in its depths... It takes practice to understand what appears in the crystal. Let me look into the crystal. Sometimes you don't want to know what's coming. A gift from Granny. They are oddly accurate. Oh...this next one...bodes poorly... What messages can we receive from beyond? A holy symbol sacred to the good-hearted faithful of Barovia It doesn't stay tuned very well. This is one of my favorite melodies. Granny taught me this song. There's power in my music. In my first life, in Barovia, did I own anything this fine? I don't know how many times I've lived. I wonder if I've always favored red? Do you think Brother Uriah will like it? The world is dark, but my heart is light. Mostly. I am no angel. The brightness lifts my spirits. This is as lovely as the spell but, sadly, less effective against enemies. Sometimes when I keep watch, I look up at the stars and wonder what's out there. Nahara is a reborn fallen Aasimar undead warlock/college of the spirits bard. She fell into the mists of Ravenloft unable to remember anything from her life (or past lives as we've come to learn). All she knows is that her current Patron, Azalin Rex, has asked her to aid him against his foe Strahd von Zarovich, who for reasons unknown to her, has been desperately seeking her out. Nahara attacks a random enemy and every enemy that she already hit with a bolt of energy. Nahara attacks a random enemy and every enemy that she has already hit with this attack. Nahara takes off and channels Azalin Rex, increasing her damage for 15 seconds. Nahara takes off into the air and channels the power of her patron Azalin Rex for 15 seconds. Her damage is increased by 1,000% while in this form and any enemy she hits has a 50% chance of being stunned for 2 seconds. The more Nahara adventures, the more she remembers of her past life; slowly increasing her damage. If Nahara is easily defeating enemies she helps her companions speed through later areas. If she is not defeating enemies easily she increases her damage. body.zh: 即使不满足支线任务限制要求， 仍有资格开始所有斯特拉德赞助者冒险。 在冒险途中会恢复少许遗失的记忆。如果你首次完成某个区域时 位于阵型中，她会获得 % 的伤害加成（加算）。此加成在重置后会保留。 在任何时间内，纳哈拉每完成一个冒险区域，都会造成更多伤害。 当 攻击并击败至少一名敌人时，她会获得 1 层“轻浮”堆叠层数，最多可堆叠 层。 当她发动攻击但未能击败敌人时，会失去 1 层“轻浮”堆叠层数。 拥有的“轻浮”堆叠层数每比 层少 1 层，她会获得 % 伤害加成，此外，在每个区域开始时，她拥有的“轻浮”堆叠层数每比 层多 1 层，她会使该区域的任务要求降低 %。 纳哈拉轻松击败敌人时，可以让勇士们更快通过后续区域；而当她没有轻松击败敌人时，她会开始造成更多伤害。 阵型中每有一名黑骰子协会从属组织的成员， 的伤害就提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 每完成一个区域， 的计数器增加 3 次。 纳哈拉将她的经验专注于造成更多伤害 额外提升 %，且如果当前赞助者为斯特拉德，即使不满足其他支线任务要求，也可以使用黑骰子协会的成员。 额外勇士已解锁： 纳哈拉专注于她的同伴，向斯特拉德开战 提供的区域要求削减效果提高 %。 纳哈拉专注于她的娱乐才能，使移动速度更快 女士不会挑起争斗，但她会结束争斗。 别对我动手动脚，否则你很快就会后悔！ 我几乎觉得我好像想起来了...... 这双手蕴含着危险的力量。别激怒我。 我曾经做过的事，是无法更改的。 我将来的成就也许与我的曾经一样重要。 我们将从中重铸我们的道路。不会更糟了！ 我会留在你身边，我们要战斗到底。 我们究竟是讲故事还是战斗至死？ 现在和我并肩而立吧，就像我一直与你们并肩而立一样。 做出某些承诺是有好处的。 我们的生命只有一次......除非迷雾另有所说...... 我感觉变强了…… 你将为此付出代价，葬身于我的手中，承受烈火的灼烧。 备一把武器总是明智的。 我更喜欢我的法术。 如果巫术箭不管用，就用这个发射弩箭来替代。 镀金并没有提高准头，但增加了个性。 我在它深处看到模糊的形状...... 需要练习后，才能理解水晶中出现的东西。 让我看看这个水晶。 有的时候，你并不想知道将要发生什么事。 来自奶奶的礼物。它们算得特别准。 哦......这下一张......预兆可不好...... 我们能从外界获得什么信息？ 对巴洛维亚心地善良的信徒来说，这是一个神圣的徽记。 调音不太好。 这是我最喜欢的旋律之一。 奶奶教会了我这首歌。 我的音乐中蕴含力量。 在我的第一世生命里，在巴洛维亚的时候，我拥有过这么精致的东西吗？ 我不知道我活了多少世。我想知道，我是不是一直偏爱红色？ 你觉得乌利亚修士会喜欢么？ 这个世界满是黑暗，但我的心充满光明。大部分是。 我不是天使。 光亮让我精神振奋。 这和法术一样可爱，但遗憾的是，对敌人不太有效。 当我守望之时，有时我会抬头看着繁星，好奇那里有些什么。 纳哈拉是一个重生的堕落神裔亡灵邪术师/鬼灵学院的吟游诗人。她坠入鸦阁魔域的迷雾中，无法记起她生命（或我们已经了解到的前世）中的任何事。她只知道她现在的赞助者亚扎林·雷克斯，要求她协助对付他的敌人斯特拉德·冯·扎罗维奇，而后者由于她不知道的原因，一直在拼命寻找她。 纳哈拉用能量束攻击一名随机敌人和她之前击中过的所有敌人。 纳哈拉攻击一名随机敌人和她之前使用此攻击方式击中过的所有敌人。 纳哈拉飞向空中并引导亚扎林·雷克斯，在 15 秒内增加自身伤害。 纳哈拉飞向空中，引导她的赞助者亚扎林·雷克斯的力量，持续 15 秒。她的伤害增加 1000%，而在此形态下，她击中的任何敌人都有 50% 几率被眩晕 2 秒。 纳哈拉参与的冒险越多，就回忆起更多自己的过去，缓慢提升她的伤害。 如果纳哈拉能轻松消灭敌人，就可以提升队伍向更深区域推进的速度。如果她无法轻松消灭敌人，则会提升自己的伤害。

body.en: Increases the damage of Champions in the column behind by % Nayeli increases the damage of Champions in the column behind hers. Place her in front of your most damaging Champions. Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each enemy attacking and/or each enemy enrage stack. Nayeli increases your formation's damage for each enemy attacking her. Place her at the front of your formation to take advantage of this. Nayeli focuses on rallying her fellow Champions and further increasing the damage of anyone in the column behind her. Nayeli focuses on tanking enemies and party survivability, keeping her foes from attacking her friends. Increases the Health of all other Champions by % of 's Max Health Stand behind me! The forces of darkness will not overcome us! You call that a hit? It barely tickled. Nothing can take down this champion. Justice will be dealt. Courage grows with experience. It'll take more than a couple of you to take me down! We must not give in to our fears! Watch and learn, friends. The bullywugs are easy to train, once you learn to fit in with them. Get behind me! One of you has to be powerful enough to give me a good fight. As long as I have a weapon, my form doesn't matter. Does anyone want to go for a swim? A faded owl motif. Someday I'll tell you the story of it. A magical item used to hunt down those who have done wrong. A brilliant serpentine owl figurine imbued with magical power. A wondrous item that grants me the power to track down those I've sworn vengeance against. It's starting to rust, but it can still take a few good blows. A sturdy breastplate. Well enough to deliver evenhanded justice in, at least. A fine breastplate, crafted using a special steel alloy known only to a few. It borders on gaudy, but you can't deny its raw power. It restricts my movement, but not enough to hinder the Maimed God's justice. As fine a shirt as you could expect to find, from a common merchant. Even dwarven folk can appreciate the need for Tyr's justice. Gifted to me by Lord Maldwyn, shortly before... I'd rather not talk about it. Your run of the mill plate gauntlets. They won't budge in battle, and with a sturdy wrist will deflect all but the strongest attack. A finely crafted gauntlet worn by many Paladins throughout the land. Pristine scalemail gauntlets that give my blows a little extra oomph. The symbol of Tyr strikes fear into evil-doers everywhere. This symbol has been meticulously cared for over the years. A great sign of respect. The Lord of Justice himself blessed this necklace. I've devoted my life to justice for all in Tyr's name. A trainee's sword, but in the right hands, it can still do damage. Crafted by the finest smithy in Daggerford. This sword vanquishes all foes, whether or not they come from this plane. The Lord of Justice blessed this sword and my mission on his behalf. A once trusted guardian and advisor of Duke Maldwyn of Daggerford, Nayeli Goldflower is now a paladin without a lord who wanders Toril on the hunt for devils and those who would summon and commune with the infernal. She worships Tyr, the god of justice, who has blessed her sword to seek out and destroy any infernal presence. Nayeli cleaves all targets near the closest enemy. Nayeli deals massive damage to a random enemy and stuns all enemies. Nayeli leaps to a random enemy, dealing massive damage and stunning all enemies. body.zh: 处于 后列的勇士提升 % 伤害 纳耶莉使纵队后方的勇士伤害提高。将她放置在杀伤力最强的勇士前方。 每有一名攻击 或使其堆叠怒气的敌人，即所有勇士提升 % 伤害。 每个攻击纳耶莉的敌人均使阵型伤害提高。将她放置在阵型前方从而利用此效果。 纳耶莉专注于振奋勇士战友，并进一步提高同纵队后方所有人的伤害。 娜亚莉专注于抵御敌人和强化探险队的生存能力，防止敌人攻击她的盟友。 提高所有其他勇士的生命值，数值相当于 最大生命值的 %。 站我身后！ 黑暗的力量无法战胜我们！ 你管这叫攻击？连挠痒痒都算不上。 没什么能击倒这位勇士。 正义将得到伸张。 勇气会随着经验而增长。 想放倒我，还得多来几个你这样的！ 我们绝不向恐惧屈服！ 见识见识吧，朋友们！ 只要学会如何与它们相处，布利伍格就很容易驯服。 站到我身后去！ 你们之中必须有足够强大的人，才配与我酣战一场。 只要我手持武器，形态无关紧要。 有没有人想去游个泳？ 这是个褪色的猫头鹰雕像。或许有一天我会把事情的来龙去脉告诉你。 这是个魔法物品，可以用来追踪犯了过失的罪人。 这个猫头鹰蛇纹石小雕像蕴含着魔力。 这个神奇的物品可以帮助我追踪仇人。 虽然已逐渐锈迹斑斑，但还是可以承受得住打击的。 很结实的胸甲。至少足够用来对付不法之徒。 很精致的一副胸甲，所使用的特殊钢铁合金在世上已经没多少人懂得制作了。 虽然说外观有点俗气花俏，但其威力的确是毋庸置疑。 这副护甲限制了我的行动，但却限制不了残神的正义审判。 从普通商人手中能买到这种质量的上衣已经算很不错了。 就连矮人族有时候都须要仰赖提尔的正义。 马尔德温公爵当时把它送给我后就......算了，这件事我不想重温。 最常见的板甲护手。 在战斗中绝不会掉链子，而且要是腕力够强大，它甚至可以助你拨挡敌人的攻击。 这种精雕细琢的护手是大陆上许多圣武士的首选。 崭新的鳞甲护手让我的攻击更上一层楼。 提尔的徽记在每一位不法之徒心中都是一门丧钟。 这个徽记多年来受到呵护备至的照料，这才能彰显出对神明的尊重。 正义之神亲自赐福过此项链。 我奉献自己的一生，为提尔伸张正义。 这是给学徒训练用的剑，但是在大师手中一样能发挥出强大的威力。 这是由匕首滩最优秀的匠人所铸造而成。 无论敌人来自本土或异界，此剑照样能够斩妖除魔。 提尔赐福过我的使命和这把剑。 娜亚莉·金花曾是匕首滩的马尔德温公爵所信任的监护人和顾问，如今她是一位没有领主的圣武士，在托瑞尔游荡，追捕魔鬼和那些召唤并且与地狱交流的人。她崇拜正义之神提尔，提尔赐福了她的剑，让她寻找并消灭所有的地狱生物。 娜亚莉顺劈距离最近的敌人附近的所有目标。 娜亚莉对一名随机敌人造成大量伤害，并眩晕全部敌人。 娜亚莉跃向一名随机敌人，对其造成大量伤害，并眩晕全部敌人。

body.en: Omin recruits adjacent Champions, Champions affiliated with Acquisitions Incorporated and/or The "C" Team, and Champions adjacent to an Acquisitions Incorporated or "C" Team member to be Champions of Tymora. Champions of Tymora have their damage increased by %. Omin himself is also a Champion of Tymora. Omin recruits all adjacent Champions to be Champions of Tymora. Champions of Tymora have their damage increased by %. Omin himself is also a Champion of Tymora. Omin recruits all adjacent Champions to be Champions of Tymora and increases their damage. Omin increases the party's gold find by % each time a Champion of Tymora attacks an enemy, stacking additively with no cap. The percentage per attack increases by 1% additively for every 100 stacks. Omin increases the party's gold find each time a Champion of Tymora attacks. Champions who are affiliated with Acquisitions Incorporated and/or The "C" Team also become Champions of Tymora, and recruit Champions adjacent to them as well. Champions of Tymora are healed for health per second. Omin increases the effect of Champion of Tymora by % for each Champion of Tymora in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Champions of Tymora in Formation: Omin increases his damage buff based on the number of Champions of Tymora in the formation. Omin increases the effect of Champion of Tymora by % for each Acquisitions Incorporated and/or The "C" Team champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Acq. Inc. and "C" Team Champions in Formation: Omin increases his damage buff based on the number of Acquisitions Incorporated and "C" Team champions in the formation. Once Adventuring Capital has 1,000 stacks, Omin increases the effect of Champion of Tymora by %, and then increases it again each time the number of Adventuring Capital stacks doubles, stacking multiplicatively. Omin increases his damage buff based on the number of Adventuring Capital stacks he has. body.zh: 欧敏会招募相邻勇士、与艾奎兹玄有限责任公司和/或 C 小队有关联的勇士、与艾奎兹玄有限责任公司或 C 小队成员相邻的勇士，使他们成为泰摩拉的勇士。泰摩拉的勇士伤害提升 %。欧敏自己也是一名泰摩拉的勇士。 欧敏会招募所有相邻勇士成为泰摩拉的勇士。泰摩拉的勇士伤害提升 %。欧敏自己也是一名泰摩拉的勇士。 欧敏会招募所有相邻勇士成为泰摩拉的勇士，并提高其伤害。 每当一位提莫拉的冠军攻击敌人一次，奥明就会使队伍的金币获取量增加 %；该效果可叠加，且无上限。每叠加 100 层，每次攻击带来的百分比加成将额外增加 1%。 每当一名泰摩拉的勇士攻击敌人，欧敏就使队伍的金币寻获量增加。 与艾奎兹玄有限责任公司和/或 C 小队有关联的勇士也会成为泰摩拉的勇士，并且会招募与自己相邻的勇士。 泰摩拉的勇士每秒得到 点生命值的治疗。 “奥明”会根据阵容中每名“提莫拉的冠军”的存在，将“提莫拉的冠军”的效果提升 ，且效果呈乘法叠加。 提莫拉的冠军们列阵： 欧敏依据阵型中泰摩拉的勇士的数量强化伤害增益。 每当阵容中包含一名“收购公司”和/或“C队”的冠军时，奥明会将“蒂莫拉的冠军”的效果提升 %，且效果呈乘法叠加。 Acq. Inc. 和“C”队荣获编队赛冠军： 欧敏依据阵型中艾奎兹玄有限责任公司和“C”小队勇士的数量强化伤害增益。 当“冒险资本”叠加至1,000层时，奥明会将“提莫拉的冠军”的效果提升 %；此后，每当“冒险资本”的叠加层数翻倍，该效果便会再次提升，且效果呈乘法叠加。 欧敏依据拥有的“探险资本”堆叠层数强化伤害增益。 你在这次冒险中每收集到一个数量级的金币，泰摩拉的勇士效果就提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 是的，是的，非常真实。确实。 为了那新鲜羊皮纸的味道战斗吧！不？只有我愿意吗？ 说谎者。 议会的规模最近扩大了。 并非所有劳工都是体力活。 请看看第 243 页 J 条款，我等着。 我有充分的理由认为这是一个明智的决定。 大家各就各位。 第三季度的冒险看起来不错！ 事实证明，听我说话可以让我更富有。 关于你的冒险费用...... 让我们用魔法阵来回顾你在探险队中的金币寻获表现吧。 你有没有填写过一式三份的《轻伤治疗表格 B》？ 我的生命值相当于至少四位 CEO。 你有带文件来吗？ 终于成功了！我就知道分散投资最终会有回报的。 只要有足够的金钱，你就能获得任何领域的荣誉学位。 或许我可以建议换一个比较牢固的武器。 这个二手武器是在战斗中使用过的还是只是有过主人而已？那是截然不同的两回事。 我们的每一位公证人都有此盖章。 对我来说是幸运的地方。对你来说可能就不是了。 怎么走私的？这才是关键。 要是碰见锈蚀怪，记得掷硬币。 不是我说，我们真的有很多值得纪念的经历。 证明自己吧。 护肩下的透气软垫才是夏天也适合穿着它们的关键。 我们开新分店时我穿过。当时就是为了搞点特殊的气氛。 她总是那么的关注我。我的一生就是最佳证明。 我可不是什么公开领主哦。 这份合约是我四岁时试图说服我妈房子是属于我的时候立下的。过去的好时光啊。 多恩格斯小姐从来没让人失望过。 人们都认为我崇尚暴力，但其实呢？我的暴力主要都是体现在纸面上。 这是我为我妈保管的。 这玩意有点......格格不入吧？根本不符合我批准的蓝图。 我们之前不是谈好的吗？ 现在不用到酒馆也能喝酒了。 嘿，兄弟。 我有太多的想法，所以会把它们都记下来。 这是我们的员工手册的草案初稿。 欢迎光临艾奎兹玄有限责任公司。 这是某位披着斗篷的吉斯洋基人送我的，随后他就瞬间消失了。或许他是来自未来的人？我至今还没猜透这个谜。 欧敏·德兰建立了名为艾奎兹玄有限责任公司的组织，以帮助自己寻找他真正的妹妹，至少这是他的一部分理由。尽管他在建立整个剑湾的特许冒险市场方面取得空前成功，但大多数人都不了解欧敏的情况。众所周知，他是泰摩拉的崇拜者。在生意上冷酷无情，在爱情上无动于衷，在运气游戏上毫无希望。他经常被认为是深水城的幕后操纵者，尽管这样一来有些事就说得通了...... 欧敏用他的双手锤猛砸距离最近的敌人。 欧敏召唤 15 个魂灵守护者，每 2 秒对一个随机区域造成伤害。 欧敏召唤 15 个魂灵守护者，每 2 秒产生爆炸，对大范围的所有怪物造成伤害。只要还有魂灵存在，“泰摩拉的勇士”效果提高。

body.en: Unlocks Spurt's ultimate attack: You Dead! When Spurt uses his ultimate he becomes Spurt's Spirit until his ultimate is 10s from cooling down. While he's a Spirit, he increases the party's damage and buffs his other formation abilities in unique ways. Spurt's ultimate causes him to temporarily sacrifice himself, increasing the effects of his other abilities. Spurt increases the damage of Champions two slots away by % Spurt increases the damage of adjacent Champions by % ({Spirit:}#99C7F7 This effect is increased by 2% for each second of Spurt's maximum Ultimate cooldown, stacking multiplicatively) Spurt gains a stack of Wa-spiration every time he attacks. Every Wa-spiration stacks, Spurt invents a random effect. Effects can stack up to times each and persist until the area changes. ({Spirit:}#99C7F7 Wa-spiration stacks are gained when an adjacent Champion attacks and the base multipliers of the invented effects are increased by 100%) Spurt's attacks grant him the inspiration he needs to create new and interesting buffs for the party. Increases the damage of all Champions by % for every Kobold and Unaffiliated Non-Kobold in the formation, including Spurt. Increases the damage of all Champions by % for every Kobold in the formation, including Spurt. ({Spirit:}#99C7F7 Base multiplier increased by 100%) Increases the effect of Pack Tactics by % Spurt loves his kobold brothers and sisters. Even the tall, old, non-koboldy ones. Centipede Net instead affects champions who are 2 formation slots away from Spurt and its effect is increased by % Spurt tosses helpful centipedes to Champions even further away. Unaffiliated Non-Kobold Champions count as Kobolds for the purposes of Pack Tactics Unaffiliated Non-Kobold Champions: Spurt adopts Unaffiliated Non-Kobold Champions into his family. I kill giants! Don't you worry! I help the group, even after I splatted. Centipedes are my friends! Has anyone seen my brother? I mean, my slime? WHOA! That's a big net! What you call pack of Kobolds? Pack of Kobolds, duh. I'm the most durable kobold of all kobolds! You get a wasp. And YOU get a wasp! I'll rub some dirt on it. Keep going, most important. For Glory! I call this bag the angries. I'm ADORABLE! I made a discovery! Wyvern tail VERY stingy! Agent Spurt, ready! Let's have some FUN! Together, WE WIN! I want to be friends with everyone! EVERYONE! Bath? What's that? He always got revenge. He kept getting squished. Trust me. No hugs. He once stung a Goblin in the eye. Chew well. Whoops. Make sure you squish the burrowers. Open wide! Complete with access holes! This one is Carl. You want some? It throws centipedes real far! Don't shake it! I warned you. Umber Hulk droppings. It's the only way to smell better. He doesn't listen. It leaks. Your dagger is gone. No refunds. My brother's in there. Wanna see? It doesn't like bright lights. It's not that kind of nest. Ow. Ow. Ow. Quit it. They like it there! Watch this. Hold my skunk. Spurt the Kobold Inventor is crafty and quick with his hands. He builds improvised weapons in the hope of gaining some new advantage in combat. Spurt never knew he would have such lasting appeal when he met a mighty group of adventurers in a cave, but here we are. Packed to the gills with his 'awesome' inventions this clever kobold brings his 11-days of life experiences to the Champions, along with a really cool 'Centi-pult'! Spurt tosses a wasp nest at a random enemy, dealing damage. Spurt tosses a wasp nest at a stalking giant, and then is immediately killed. Spurt tosses a wasp nest at a stalking giant, and then is immediately killed by a giant hammer, which damages all Enemies on screen. Spurt then comes back as a spirit, increasing the effects of his abilities until he revives. body.zh: 解锁斯普特的杀招攻击：你死了！当斯普特使用杀招时，他会变成斯普特的魂灵，直到他的杀招剩余 10 秒进入冷却。处于魂灵形态时，他会提高探险队的伤害，并以独特的方式强化他的其他阵型技能。 斯普特的杀招使他暂时献祭自己，以强化其他技能的效果。 斯普特使距离他两个栏位的勇士伤害提高 % 斯普特使与他相邻的勇士伤害提高 % （{魂灵:}#99C7F7 斯普特的最大杀招冷却时间每秒均使此效果提高 2%，以乘算方式堆叠） 斯普特每次攻击都会获得一层黄蜂启迪。每 层黄蜂启迪均使斯普特发明一个随机效果。每个效果可以堆叠 层，并持续到改变区域。 （{魂灵:}#99C7F7 相邻勇士发动攻击可使其获得“黄蜂启迪”堆叠层数，并且发明效果的基础乘数提高 100%） 斯普特的攻击赋予他所需的灵感，从而为队伍创造有趣的新增益。 阵型中每有一名狗头人（包括斯普特）以及无从属组织的非狗头人勇士均使所有勇士的伤害提高 %。 阵型中每有一名狗头人（包括斯普特）即提升所有勇士 % 伤害。 （{魂灵:}#99C7F7 基础乘数提高 100%） 集群战术的效果提高 % 斯普特热爱他的狗头人兄弟姐妹。包括高大的、年老的，或者不是狗头人的那些。 蜈蚣之网改为影响距离斯普特 2 个阵型栏位的勇士，并且效果提高 % 斯普特将有益蜈蚣扔向距离更远的勇士。 无从属组织的非狗头人勇士也被“集群战术”算作狗头人 无从属组织的非狗头人勇士： 斯普特收养无从属组织的非狗头人勇士，将其纳入自己的家族。 我能杀掉巨人！别担心！ 哪怕我挂了，也还是能帮到团队。 蜈蚣是我的朋友！ 有人看到我弟弟吗？我是说，我的软泥怪。 哇！好大的网！ 一群狗头人叫什么？狗头人群，哈。 我是耐力最好的狗头人！ 你得到一只黄蜂。然后你又得到了一只黄蜂！ 我会在上面擦一些泥土。继续前进，最重要。 为了荣耀！ 我把这个包叫做怒怒。 我可真可爱！ 我发现了一点！双足飞龙的尾巴有非常多的刺！ 特工斯普特，准备就绪！我们来找点乐子吧！齐心协力，我们必胜！ 我想和所有人交朋友！所有人！ 洗澡？那是啥？ 他总会笑到最后。 他总会被压扁。 听我的。不要抱他。 他曾经蛰了一个地精的眼睛。 好好咀嚼吧。 哎呦喂。 记得要碾死那些掘穴动物。 门户大开！ 充斥着无数个开孔！ 这个名字叫卡尔。 要来一点吗？ 可以将蜈蚣投射到超遥远的地方！ 不要摇晃！ 我提示过你的。 土巨怪的粪便，那是唯一比它臭的玩意。 他就是不听劝告。 漏水了。 你的匕首消失了。我不负责赔偿的哦。 我兄弟就在里头。想要瞧瞧吗？ 它不适应强光。 不是你想象中的那种巢穴。 嗷嗷嗷。快住手。 它们喜欢里头的环境！ 瞧我的。拿好我的臭鼬。 狗头人发明家斯普特是个狡猾的家伙。他双手灵巧，会打造一些简易武器，以期在战斗中不断获得优势。当斯普特在一个山洞里遇到一群强大的冒险家时，他还不知道自己会有如此强大的魅力。但现在，这个聪明的狗头人带着他“伟大”的发明，把他 11 天的生活经验，连同他那个非常酷的蜈蚣弹弓一起带给了勇士们。 斯普特向一名随机敌人投掷黄蜂巢，造成伤害。 斯普特向一名尾随的巨人投掷黄蜂巢，然后瞬间被杀死。 斯普特向一名尾随的巨人投掷黄蜂巢，然后瞬间被巨型战锤杀死，同时对屏幕上的所有敌人造成伤害。斯普特随后会以灵魂状态存在，在复活前提升其技能效果。

Eric prefers to hang out at the back of the formation due to his cautious nature. Boss enemies count as 25 enemies for this ability. Eric's first specialization choice buffs different areas of the formation, and his Cavalier's Code increases these buffs and gold find as enemies spawn. Eric increases the health of all other Champions by % of his max health, and when any Champion in the formation gains temporary health, the amount gained is increased by %. Unlocks Eric's Protective Field Ultimate Attack All Ranged and Magic attacking enemies target Eric before any other Champion in the formation. For the first seconds in any area, Eric increases the distance of all knockback effects by %. Eric can help scavenge up to additional Corrupted Gems when killing bosses. While this cap is not reached, Eric has a % chance of scavenging Corrupted Gems each time a boss is defeated. The cap increases by every day. Corrupted Gems Scavenged: ( this adventure) Eric has a chance to uncover Corrupted Gems with each defeated boss, with a cap that increases every day. Champions in Formation Targeted: Eric thrives alongside Champions who share the vitality of youth. Champions in Formation Targeted: Eric excels alongside Champions who seek both riches and glory. Okay, okay. I'll help! And I won't even ask for a reward this time. Don't worry, guys. The old Cavalier knows what he's doing. TBD My folks always say you have to save money to make money. Hey, those monsters dropped treasure! Don't mind if I do! It'll take more than that to keep me down! When the going gets tough, the tough get tougher! These baddies mean business! Stay close, guys! I just have to stay cool and don't panic. Easier said than done. Just don't expect me to fight a dragon, okay? There's more to me than just a fancy shield, you know. There, I saved you. You're welcome. Now be more careful! You guys handle the fighting. I'll stay back here and hold them off! Let's keep a safe distance. Way over there sounds perfect. Stand where I tell you to and we just might survive! It's not my fault if we lose, but I'll take the credit if we win. I have a strategy! It's called Don't Get Hit! Venger! Don't worry, guys. I'll hold off this hornhead myself. We'll all make it back home one way or another, and we'll do it together. See? I'm smarter than I look. Now let's follow MY plan for once. Let's hear about this quest first, then I'll decide how I feel about it. I'll just throw this out tomorrow. I always dress to impress. How did Dungeon Master know yellow is my color? Hey, nice threads! Now, what would Dungeon Master say? Cheap and fake, but looks real enough. Real steel is real heavy! Venger's goons can't hurt me now! Not even Tiamat can melt this metal! Not another hand-me-down! Of course it's a designer brand. It really ties the whole outfit together. Get it? See how it glows? That's how you know it's good. I need more allowance! What I wouldn't give for a few dollars more! It's a good start. Now let's find some more! If I'm going to be trapped in this world, why not be trapped in style? That's the last time I let Bobby borrow anything. Does this make me look heroic? I can be courageous when it counts. I'll show you! That's what I call luxury! I look like a million bucks! Oh, great. What am I supposed to do with this old thing? Whatever works, I guess. Now get behind me! Hey, no fair! Dungeon Master gave the others way better stuff! I'll always protect my friends. Just don't tell them I said that. Eric is the Cavalier of the group of friends trapped in the magical world of Dungeons & Dragons. Known for his sarcasm and frequent cowardice, he's often the butt of jokes. Yet, when danger strikes, Eric's bravery emerges, and he uses his magical shield to protect his friends. Despite his complaints and fears, his loyalty and courage make him an essential part of the group's quest to find their way home. Eric knocks back the closest enemy with a hit from his shield. Eric hits the closest enemy with his shield, dealing one hit and knocking them back a short distance. A field from Eric's shield knocks back enemies and protects the Champions for 10 seconds. Eric's shield projects a powerful force field, dealing 1 ultimate hit to all monsters while protecting the Champions from all damage for 10 seconds. 嘿，那些怪物掉了宝物！我笑纳了！ 想让我起不来，这样可不够！ 当形势变得艰难时，坚强的人会变得更坚强！ 这些坏蛋可不是开玩笑的！大家都跟紧点！ 我得保持冷静，不要惊慌。说得倒是轻巧。 别指望我能去跟一条龙打，好吗？ 告诉你，我可不仅仅是一面华丽的盾牌。 好了，我救了你，不用客气。你得更小心一点！ 你们负责战斗，我留在后面挡住他们！ 我们保持一下安全距离吧。你退到远远那边最好。 站到我让你站的地方去，我们就说不定能活命！ 如果我们输了，那不是我的错，但如果我们赢了，那功劳是我的。 我有一个策略！叫做“不要被打到”！ 复仇者！别担心，各位。我自己来拖住这个有角的家伙。 无论如何，我们大家都会回到家的，而且我们会一起回去。 看到了吧？我要比我看起来聪明。现在我们就按我的计划行事一次吧。 我们先听听这个任务是怎么回事，我再来决定我的态度。 我明天就把它扔了。 我总是穿得很讲究，给人留下深刻印象。 地下城主怎么知道我喜欢黄色的？ 嘿，好漂亮的衣服！地下城主会怎么说呢？ 便宜的假货，但看起来挺真的。 真正的钢真的很重！ 复仇者的那些暴徒这下伤不着我了！ 就连提亚马特也熔化不了这金属！ 不要啊，又是别人用过的旧东西！ 这当然是设计师品牌的。 它能把整套着装绑在一起，懂了吗？ 看到它在发光吗？看见这个你就知道这是好东西。 我需要更多的零花钱！ 只要能再多给我几美元，我什么都愿意！ 这是个好的开始。现在我们再去多找一些吧！ 如果我要被困在这个世界里，那为什么不有风度地被困住呢？ 那是我最后一次让鲍比借东西。 这会让我看起来很英勇吗？ 我在关键时刻可以很勇敢。我会证明给你看的！ 这就是我说的奢侈！我看起来棒极了！ 噢，这下好了。我该拿这旧玩意怎么办？ 算了，只要有用就行。快站到我身后去！ 嘿，这不公平！地下城主给了其他人更好的东西！ 我会永远保护我的朋友。不过别告诉他们我说过这句话。 埃里克和一群朋友被困在了《龙与地下城》的魔法世界中，他是其中的骑士。他出了名爱挖苦别人，还常常表现得很懦弱，经常被人当笑柄。然而，当危险来临时，埃里克会迸发出勇气，用他的魔法盾牌保护他的朋友。尽管他老是怨天怨地，怕这怕那，但他的忠诚和勇气使他成为了团队寻找回家之路不可或缺的一员。 埃里克用他的盾牌一击击退离他最近的敌人。 埃里克用他的盾牌攻击离他最近的敌人，造成一次打击，并将其击退一小段距离。 埃里克的盾牌产生的力场击退敌人，并保护众勇士 10 秒。 埃里克的盾牌释放出一个强大的力场，对所有敌人造成 1 次杀招打击，同时保护众勇士免受所有伤害 10 秒。

Chaotic Champions: Antrius focuses on Chaotic Champions to power his song. Being a bard is difficult, but with a face like this, how could I not? There's no 'I' in 'Team,' but there is an 'A' which stands for Antrius! Everybody sing along! Thank goodness I'm here. This one's going to hurt. I once killed a man with 'your mum' insults. Don't test me. I think of the rest of the party as 'backup vocals.' Let me handle this. I'm a card, I go hard on lutes, flutes and guitars! Timing and tenderness, terribly talented, topped with a bit of alliteration! And you thought I was irresistible before! Come on, sing! It will LIFT your spirits! Get it? Gods, I'm good. There is also a 'T' in both 'Team' and 'Antrius,' and I think that's terrific! It's no vicious mockery, but it's good in a pinch. When it hits metal armor, it makes a perfect D-flat. Swords are more Evandra's thing. But it does complete the outfit. Sharp as my wit! Cutting as my words! They hand these out in bard college. Really, I should have used the sword to hit that goblin. I'm the star they regard as the bard spittin' bars! Just to be clear, the rest of you are singing back-up. This is a travesty. You could say I'm wanted most everywhere. Who shall I make it out to? It would look great on your mantlepiece. For those lonely nights. They stop attacks, but they don't look great. Always wear protection. Sturdy and stylish. Prepare to be dazzled. Every bard needs a look. I like to wear it open at the neck. Some fancier frills to draw the eye... How could you possibly take your eyes off me? One moment, I need to check my smile. I still look fantastic. Well, hello handsome. Alllll of me! Why not take allllll of me! Antrius is your classic fantasy Bard - he's a lover, not a fighter. After his supportive parents paid his way through Bard College, Antrius is out on the road trying to make a name for himself. With a glorious mane of hair and his lute, he is ready to charm anyone who gets in the party's way, friend or foe. His golden pipes bring inspiration to all who hear his song! Antrius attacks the enemy with the most health, causing it to take +100% damage until he attacks again. Antrius smiles into a mirror causing it to shatter. The shards create a cloud dealing damage to all enemies within it. Antrius takes a hand mirror out and smiles into it, causing it to shatter. Shards of glass fly out towards the enemy with the most health forming a cloud upon reaching the target. The cloud deals ongoing damage for 10 seconds. Antrius grants protects and buffs adjacent champions. High Charisma Champions cascade this ability on to additional Champions. Antrius' Inspiring Song ability is buffed for each feat owned by any Champion. body.zh: 激励每个相邻的勇士，每 秒赋予他们 点临时生命值，并使其伤害提高 %。任何魅力大于等于 17 的勇士都会进一步激励所有未受影响的相邻勇士，层层扩散。 的歌声太过振奋，也能激励自己。每个勇士的护盾总量上限为勇士最大生命值的 10 倍。 每 秒获得 点临时生命值。临时生命值总量最多只能达到 最大生命值的 % 安裘斯可以保护并增益相邻勇士。 每有一位勇士被 的效果影响， 均使该技能的临时生命值加成提高 %，以加算方式堆叠。 激励之歌依据受其影响的勇士数量提供增益。使用高魅力勇士来传播和强化此技能。 每有一位勇士被 的效果影响， 均使该技能的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠增益作用于堆叠前的数值。 你的勇士每解锁一个专长， 均使 的伤害加成提高 %，以加算方式堆叠 阵型中每有一位吟游诗人， 均使 的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 吟游诗人勇士： 安裘斯专注于吟游诗人同伴，为他的歌曲注入力量。 阵型中每有一位总属性值低于等于 78 的勇士， 均使 的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 安裘斯专注于其他属性不高的勇士，为他的歌曲注入力量。 阵型中每有一位混乱阵营勇士， 均使 的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 混乱阵营勇士： 安裘斯专注于混乱阵营勇士，为他的歌曲注入力量。 成为吟游诗人并不容易，但拥有一张这样的脸，我有什么资格退缩呢？ “Team”（团队）中没有“I”（我），但有一个“A”，代表安裘斯！ 大家跟着一起唱！ 谢天谢地，有我在这里。 注意会痛哦。 我曾经用“你妈”相关的侮辱杀死过一个人。不要挑衅我。 我认为其他团队成员都是“伴唱”。 交给我来解决。 我是个怪咖，我能把鲁特琴、长笛和吉他都弹出花！ 时机与温柔，卓绝的天赋，再加上一点点押韵！ 你还以为我之前无法抗拒来的！ 来吧，唱起来！这会让你心情振奋的！懂我意思吧？天哪，我唱得真好听。 “Team”（团队）和“Antrius”（安裘斯）里都带个字母“T”，我觉得这简直太妙了！ 这不是恶意的嘲笑，但在危机关头很不错。 当它击中金属铠甲时，会发出完美的降 D 调。 剑更适合伊万德拉。但它让这套服装完整了。 像我的智慧一样敏锐！像我的言语一样锋利！ 吟游诗人学院里人手一把。 说真的，我应该用剑砍死那个地精。 他们认为我是吟游诗人中的摇滚明星！ 事先说清楚，你们其他人都是和声。 这是毁谤。 可以说全世界都想找到我。 我该把它送给谁？ 挂在你的披风上会很好看。用以度过孤独的夜晚。 虽然能阻挡攻击，但看起来有点丑。 永远要佩戴防护装备。 结实又时尚。 做好眼花缭乱的准备。 每个吟游诗人都需要打扮。 我喜欢解开脖子上的扣子。 用花哨的装饰来吸引眼球...... 谁能将目光从我身上移开？ 稍等，我练习一下笑容。 我看起来还是那么帅。 你好，帅哥。 我的全身！为什么不照出我的全身！ 安裘斯是经典的奇幻吟游诗人--他更偏向于情人，而非战士。热心支持的父母为安裘斯支付了吟游诗人学院的学费，此后他便踏上了扬名立万之旅。凭借一头浓密的秀发和鲁特琴，他随时准备诱惑任何挡在探险队前方的人，无论对方是敌是友。他的金嗓子能激励所有听到他歌曲的人！ 安裘斯攻击生命值最高的敌人，使其受到的伤害 +100%，直到他再次攻击为止。 安裘斯对着镜子微笑，导致镜子破碎。碎片会产生一团云，对陷入其中的所有敌人造成伤害。 安裘斯掏出一面手镜并对着它微笑，导致手镜破碎。玻璃碎片飞向生命值最高的敌人，在抵达目标后形成一团云。云团在 10 秒内造成持续伤害。 安裘斯保护并增益相邻的勇士。高魅力值的勇士会将此技能扩散到其他勇士身上。 任意勇士的每一个专长均会增强安裘斯的激励之歌技能。

Yeah, I can earn a few coins here and there. What can I say, people just love throwing coins at me. I live a decent life and so too do those around me. I'll give you a hint: it's done with magic. What do you mean you're out? I see plenty of wine over there! Common bagpipes with a goat skin bag. These bagpipes have blackwood pipes for a more uniform sound. The Rusty Pommel wasn't that seedy of a tavern, was it? Did I ever tell you about the time I turned into a spirit raven and met the Raven Queen? It's mostly better than box wine. Mostly. There really aren't a lot of wine options in Barovia. Simon! Can you fetch Dad some more wine? The best cure for a hangover is to keep drinking. Both creepy AND comfortable! A perfect drinking chair. This really was a great idea. I like drunk Strix. Chair Richten never had a chance. An old cog and a family signet ring, bound by a leather strap. This old hilt appears to have once had a crystal blade The initials 'S.V.Z' are engraved upon the pommel. Ezmerelda's final gift. It's not every day you stab your shadow and get shot back through time. This mandolin is out of tune. A well-tuned mandolin. I lost this during 'Bomb Voyage' trying to save my friends. Again. Paultin is a wise-cracking adventurer who is more at home at a tavern than anywhere else. He cares deeply for those he considers his friends and will leap into action if anyone hurts them. Simon attacks with a poisoned dart. Paultin attacks too, sometimes. Paultin swings the Sunsword, creating a shockwave that deals massive damage to all enemies. body.zh: 每有一位勇士与 相邻，即提升 % 队伍金币获得量 每位与保尔丁相邻的勇士均增加队伍的金币寻获。 每有一位勇士与保尔丁相邻，即提升不与保尔丁相邻的所有勇士 % 伤害 保尔丁使所有不与他相邻的盟友伤害提高，数值取决于与他相邻的勇士数量！ 阵型中每有一位华夫饼小队成员，即为所有华夫饼小队成员提升 % 伤害（乘算后强化 %） 阵型中每有一名 勇士，使 的伤害提升 %（乘算）。合计提升 % 保尔丁依靠维斯塔尼预言者的运气，强化他的金币寻获增益。 保尔丁追踪到更多神奇奥秘，进一步提高队伍的伤害。 如果 处于阵型边缘，则提升 % 神奇奥秘的效果 如果不是为我，那么就当是为了可怜的西蒙。 我们已经击倒了斯特拉德，我们可以搞定任何事！ 是的，我不管到哪里都可以挣点钱。 我能怎么说呢，人们就是喜欢往我身上扔钱。 我过着体面的生活，我周围的人也是如此。 我给你个提示：这与魔法有关。 什么叫你喝完了？我看到那边还有很多酒！ 很普通的风笛，存放在羊皮袋中。 此风笛的管子是用黑木制作的，所发出的笛声会更加齐整。 锈斑柄首这家酒馆还不赖吧？ 不知道我是否告诉过你我有一次变身成了魂鸦并且碰见了鸦后的经历？ 至少比盒装酒来得好一点。好一点点。 巴洛维亚人喝的酒来来去去就几种。 西蒙！可以给爹多打些酒来不？ 对付宿醉的最佳良药就是继续喝不要停。 感觉有点鸡皮疙瘩又有点舒舒坦坦的！ 坐上去喝酒最合适不过了。 真是个好主意。我就喜欢醉酒的斯崔克丝。 里奇滕做梦都得不到的椅子。 一条皮带串联着一个陈旧的齿轮和一枚家族图章戒指。 一个齿轮样子的机械玩意和一枚贵族图章戒指。 这些不只是是小饰品那么简单--它们可都是她的灵魂的一部分。 你回来了。这就足够了。 这个陈旧的刀柄上似乎曾经镶嵌过一把水晶刀刃。 刀柄上刻着“谢·冯·扎”三个字。 艾丝美拉达的最重馈赠。 捅自己的影子却反而被反击这种事真不是天天能见到的。 这个曼陀林琴已经弹奏不起来了。 精心调校过的曼陀林琴。 我又一次为了拯救朋友而在“轰炸之旅”途中丢失了它。 相比杰斯珀，我才能真正发挥出此乐器的能力。 保尔丁和他的“儿子”西蒙（又名杀戮机器）多年来一直作为华夫饼小队的成员进行冒险。保尔丁是一名聪明的冒险家，他在酒馆里比在其他地方更有家的感觉。他非常关心那些他认为是朋友的人，如果有人伤害他们，他会立即付诸行动。 西蒙使用剧毒飞镖发动攻击。有时保尔丁也会一起攻击。 保尔丁挥舞太阳之剑，制造一道震荡波，对所有敌人造成高额伤害。 保尔丁挥舞太阳之剑，对所有敌人造成高额伤害。伤害会根据敌人的当前怒气系数而增加。

body.en: Enemies hit by Baeloth's Chain Lightning drop % more gold when killed. Enemies killed by Champions in the column ahead of or behind Baeloth explode into magical paper confetti, dealing damage and slowing enemies near them by 50% for 10 seconds. The damage done ignores debuffs and is either half of the hit that killed them or one quarter of their max health, whichever is higher. This effect can chain if the explosion kills an enemy. Whenever kills an enemy Baeloth's Cause for Celebration is triggered Champions immediately in front or behind Baeloth kill enemies in an explosion of confetti that can damage nearby enemies. All Champions in the column in front or behind Baeloth do % more damage per Morbid Excitement stack. Morbid Excitement loses 10% of stacks every 10 seconds and stacks cap at .^Stacks are earned for the following:^- A favored foe is defeated: +1 Stack^- An enemy drops more gold due to Paid Partially with Pain: +1 Stack^- An enemy explodes in confetti due to Cause for Celebration: +4 Stacks^- A chain reaction kills an enemy due to Cause for Celebration: +6 Stacks^- A Champion in any column in front of Baeloth takes damage: +5 Stacks^- A Champion dies: +100 Stacks All Champions in the column in front or behind Baeloth do % more damage per Morbid Excitement stack. Morbid Excitement loses 10% of stacks every 10 seconds and stacks cap at .^Stacks are earned for the following:^- A favored foe is defeated: +1 Stack^- An enemy drops more gold due to Paid Partially with Pain: +1 Stack^- An enemy explodes in confetti due to Cause for Celebration: +2 Stacks^- A chain reaction kills an enemy due to Cause for Celebration: +3 Stacks^- A Champion in any column in front of Baeloth takes damage: +5 Stacks^- A Champion dies: +100 Stacks Increase the damage of by % Baeloth's Djinn servant, Najim, will bring any Champion that dies back to life at 1HP and make them immune to all damage for 30 seconds. For as long as the resurrected Champion lives, the party's damage is increased by %. This ability has a 60 second cooldown. Baeloth's Djinn servant, Najim, will bring any Champion that dies back to life at 1HP and make them immune to all damage for 20 seconds. For as long as the resurrected Champion lives, the party's damage is increased by %. This ability has a 60 second cooldown. Champions revived by Najim provide a large buff which lasts until they are killed again. Increase the Cause for Celebration related stacking values for Morbid Excitement by % and increase the damage bonus by % Baeloth focuses on turning enemies to confetti, and the excitement that brings him Increase the max stacks of Morbid Excitement by % Baeloth focuses on the excitement of battle, wringing even more benefit out of it. Champions resurrected by Najim are invulnerable for an additional 10 seconds and increase the pre stack damage bonus of resurrected Champions by % Baeloth focuses on his bond with Najim, granting even greater favor from the Djinn I shall find something far deadlier to trouble you with. Batter your enemies to bloody rubbish! No escape, no more tricks, no more performances. Your lives end here. I am a fair master, as long as my needs are served by being fair. How furious you must think I am! Unlike any you have seen before! Champions, I have created the entertainment spectacle of a generation! What this contest needs is some fresh faces! Najim, prepare a suitable gift for them. NAJIM! You've changed, you know. Nevermind magic, illusion, or lies; let's go with Plan A and kill those guys! The Black Pits is a great place for someone, namely me, to get rich. Might I make you an offer to join the Black Pits' team? Now appearing in the Black Pits...your worst nightmare! Did you know gold is highly conductive? Would you like a demonstration? It's so much easier to stand out when I surround myself with mundanity! The show. MUST. Go on. I hope you're satisfied. Look at my ragged raiment! We do wonderful work! I'm impressed. Perhaps you can deal with those persistent pixies. I have a speech to prepare! Always look your best. You never know when you're going to meet a god. I do enjoy messing with lesser spellcasters. Ulkoria, perhaps it's time for the adept to become the apprentice. Fight or flee, either way, you fall! Let me entertain you! Death delivered! In handy hand-held form! I will join you. So that you can feel safe. The skull sparkles when I smack someone's scalp. How scintillating! You wouldn't be interested in playing a little game, would you? Honestly, I'm huge in the Underdark. No one looks down when you command the crowd! Yes, yes. It flies. It also has a temper. Watch out. Fireworks, flaying, a flying carpet, and me. It's like my birthday all over again! Are you ready to spill blood in the arena? Well, it's a pit, and the sun is setting. Quiet down, doubters, it'll do. Franchise opportunities available. Witness the brilliant and bizarre battles in the Black Pits! It looks great, but... yes. It does look great, doesn't it. What were we talking about? Najim shall ensure that we are rewarded appropriately. Regrettably, the ring's removal is not a resource I retain. Najim? Are you even LISTENING? Baeloth Barrityl is the master of The Black Pits, the combat arena he claims is 'the best show in all the realms'. Baeloth captures hapless adventurers to fight to the death all for the sake of entertainment! When he's not commanding the attention of anyone near him, he's doing whatever he can to reinforce that he's one of the top five spellcasters in all the realms. Baeloth fires a bolt of lightning at a random enemy, which deals damage and arcs up to 4 times dealing, 20% less damage per arc. Baeloth fires a bolt of lightning at a random enemy, which deals damage and arcs up to 4 times dealing, 20% less damage per arc. Najim streaks across the field, damaging all enemies, pushing survivors back slightly, and setting Baeloth's excitement stacks to max. Najim streaks across the field, dealing massive damage to all enemies, pushing ones that survive back slightly, but more importantly increasing Baeloth's excitement stacks to max. body.zh: 被贝洛斯的连环闪电击中的敌人，在死亡时多掉落 % 金币 被贝洛斯前列和后列的勇士击杀的敌人，会在死亡时爆炸成魔法纸屑，对附近敌人造成伤害并在 10 秒内将其减速 50%。造成的伤害无视减益，数值为勇士击杀该敌人的那次攻击伤害，或是敌人最大生命值的四分之一，以较高者为准。如果爆炸的魔法纸屑杀死了一名敌人，则此效果可连续传播 每当 击杀敌人时，触发贝洛斯的“庆祝理由” 被贝洛斯正前方或正后方的勇士击杀的敌人会爆炸成为彩色纸屑，并伤害附近的敌人。 病态兴奋每堆叠一层，贝洛斯前列和后列的所有勇士提升 % 伤害。病态兴奋的堆叠层数最多 层，并且每 10 秒衰减 10%。^以下情况可堆叠病态兴奋层数：^- 击败一名偏好对手：+1 层^- 被痛苦偿还影响的敌人掉落了更多金币：+1 层^- 一名被庆祝理由影响的敌人爆炸成魔法纸屑：+4 层^- 庆祝理由的连锁反应杀死了一名敌人：+6 层- 贝洛斯前方任何一列的一位勇士受到伤害：+5 层^- 一位勇士死亡：+100 层 病态兴奋每堆叠一层，贝洛斯前列和后列的所有勇士提升 % 伤害。病态兴奋的堆叠层数最多 层，并且每 10 秒衰减 10%。^以下情况可堆叠病态兴奋层数：^- 击败一名偏好对手：+1 层^- 被痛苦偿还影响的敌人掉落了更多金币：+1 层^- 一名被庆祝理由影响的敌人爆炸成魔法纸屑：+2 层^- 庆祝理由的连锁反应杀死了一名敌人：+3 层- 贝洛斯前方任何一列的一位勇士受到伤害：+5 层^- 一位勇士死亡：+100 层 使 的伤害提高 % 贝洛斯的巨灵仆人纳吉姆能使死去的勇士以生命值为 1 的状态复活，并使其在 30 秒内免疫所有伤害。被复活的勇士存活期间，队伍的伤害提升 %。此技能有 60 秒冷却时间。 贝洛斯的巨灵仆人纳吉姆能使死去的勇士以生命值为 1 的状态复活，并使其在 20 秒内免疫所有伤害。被复活的勇士存活期间，队伍的伤害提升 %。此技能有 60 秒冷却时间。 被纳吉姆复活的勇士会提供一个巨大增益，直到他们再次死亡。 提升病态兴奋技能与庆祝理由相关的堆叠层数 % 并提升伤害加成 % 贝洛斯专注于将敌人变成彩色纸屑，以及由此带来的兴奋感 使病态兴奋的最大堆叠层数提升 % 贝洛斯专注于战斗的刺激，并从中榨取了更多利益。 被纳吉姆复活的英雄无敌时间额外增加 10 秒，并提升堆叠之前的伤害加成 % 贝洛斯专注于他与纳吉姆的纽带，获得巨灵带来的更多增益 我会找到更致命的东西，然后来麻烦你。 把你的敌人揍到血肉模糊！ 别想逃跑，别想玩更多花招，别想着更多表演。你们的生命在此结束。 我是一个公平的主人，只要公平地满足我的需求就行。 你必须得知道我有多么愤怒！ 和你以前见过的任何东西都不一样！ 勇士们，我创造了一代人的娱乐奇观！ 这个比赛需要的是一些新鲜面孔！ 纳吉姆，给他们准备一份合适的礼物。 纳吉姆！你变了，你知道的。 莫管这些魔法、谎言、与幻象；咱们就按计划干掉那些坏蛋！ 黑坑是个好地方，尤其是我，就靠那里致富。 我可以建议你们加入黑坑的队伍吗？ 现在出现在黑坑中的是......你最可怕的噩梦！ 你知道金子有很强的导电性吗？想不想看一下演示？ 当我置身尘俗之中时更容易脱颖而出！ 演出，必须，继续。 我希望你满意了。看看我破破烂烂的衣服！ 我们干得很棒！我很佩服。 也许你能对付那些顽固不化的皮克精。我要去准备一场演讲！ 永远保持最佳状态。你永远不知道什么时候会遇见神。 我确实很喜欢和低级咒术师打交道。 乌尔科莉亚，也许是时候让老手去当学徒了。 要么打，要么逃。不管哪样，你都会失败的！ 让我来娱乐你吧！ 死神诞生了！以方便手持的形式！ 我会加入你，那样你就有安全感了。 当我敲打别人的头皮时，那个骷髅就会发光。真闪耀啊！ 你应该没兴趣玩个小游戏，对吧？ 说真的，我在幽暗地域可是大人物。 当你发号施令时，谁都不准低头！ 没错，没错，它是会飞，但它也有脾气。小心点。 烟火、剥皮、一张飞毯还有我。这就像我又过了一次生日一样！ 你准备好血洒竞技场了吗？ 那是个坑，而且太阳也快要下山了。安静，怀疑者们，会成功的。 有特许经营的机会。 见证了在黑坑中发生的大大小小精彩和离奇的战斗！ 它看上去很棒，但是......是的，它看上去确实很棒，对吧。我们刚才在说什么来着？ 纳吉姆可一定得好好奖励我们。 很遗憾，脱戒指不在我的能力范畴之内。 纳吉姆？你到底有没有在听啊？ 贝洛斯·巴里提尔是黑坑的主人，他声称这个战斗竞技场是“所有国度中最好的演出”。贝洛斯会抓捕那些倒霉的冒险者，让他们为了娱乐而战斗到死。除了吸引身边所有人的注意力之外，他还会竭尽全力强化他在所有国度中五大咒术师之一的地位。 贝洛斯向一名随机敌人发射一发闪电束。闪电束造成伤害后还会弹跳 4 次，每次弹跳伤害降低 20%。 贝洛斯向一名随机敌人发射一发闪电束。闪电束造成伤害后还会弹跳 4 次，每次弹跳伤害降低 20%。 纳吉姆穿过战场，对所有敌人造成伤害。未被击杀的敌人会被稍微击退，同时将贝洛斯的兴奋层数叠满。 纳吉姆穿过战场，对所有敌人造成高额伤害，未被击杀的敌人会被稍微击退，但更重要的是，会将贝洛斯的兴奋层数叠满。 战斗的刺激会使贝洛斯兴奋起来。这种兴奋状态会传染，帮助其他勇士造成更多伤害。

title.zh: 戴斯蒙德 戴斯蒙德

body.en: Increases the damage of Champions adjacent to by %. synergizes with the Moon Phases reducing the attack cooldown of himself and adjacent champions. The closer to the Full Moon the more the cooldown is reduced. At the start of each Full Moon, 's Ultimate cooldown fully resets. Current Moon Phase: ^Next Moon Phase In ^Base Attack Cooldown Reduction: Desmond synergizes with the phases of the Moon. Increasing the base attack speed of Champions closer to the Full Moon. The dark side of the moon increases the effect of Noble Heart dependent on how close the New Moon is. Noble Heart Buff: % The moon cycle of Howl at the Moon is twice as fast, recharging 's ultimate attack more often. Desmond focuses on his synergy with the moon speeding up all phases, making his ultimate available more frequently. Additively increases the base attack cooldown reduction that 's Howl at the Moon provides by 0.5 seconds. In addition, the full moon of Howl at the Moon takes 30 seconds, while the new moon and crescent moons only take 10 seconds. Desmond focuses on his synergy with the Full Moon, speeding up his allies more frequently. Devotion in Dark Times gets an + % additive buff. In addition, the new moon of Howl at the Moon takes 30 seconds, while the full moon and gibbous moons only take 10 seconds. Desmond focuses on his synergy with the New Moon. Buffing his allies damage more frequently. Increase the effect of Noble Heart on Lycanthropes, Druids, and Black Dice Society Champions by %. increases the damage of all Champions by %, stacking multiplicatively, for each slot in the formation that contains a dead or undead Champion or is taken up by an escort character or object. Increases the damage of by % Desmond buffs all Champion damage based on the number of slots that are blocked by a dead champion or escort. I am what I am, and Koshmarr deserves more. We're not going to sit there and just take it! A pack runs together, hunts together, dies together. What are you waiting for? The deeper into the Shadowfell we go, the louder the call. Some call it a curse, I call it 'myself.' Even in the shadow, Selûne casts her light. My party is like my family. My dearest were taken from me. I will avenge them. There's something wild in all of us. Leave me to my thoughts. When I lead, you should follow. All are welcome in this pack. You don't need anything fancy. My father saw a lot of promise in me, but it's not the right sort of promise. When we found Voronika, I had to save her -- by imbuing my sword with her ghost. What the Mists have taken from me, I will repay them in turn. I spent long hours learning to fight. Fighting came naturally to me--more naturally than politics. You get the sword. I'll save my claws for a real threat. This isn't my destiny, is it? Sometimes it's best to strike from a distance. Depending on the prey, I'd rather have my space. My aim is flawless. When clawed things come out of the sky, it's better to shoot first and fast. This was a gift from my father. Feels ominous, getting this as a boy, then being bitten by a werewolf. It's my touchstone. Reminds me who I am and what I came from. The wolf is in me, and so is Koshmarr. You want a piece of me? I don't need this, but I can fight longer with it. The deeper we travel, the heavier my armor grows. If no one else will stand against this evil, I will. You never know what you'll need in the Mists. I'm ready for anything. Big enough a large flask in case someone starts talking politics. I've picked up a few surprises. Desmond stands an absolutely towering 5 foot 10 inches. He was inflicted with lycanthropy as a teenager on a hunt for food. While it's taken him a long time to do so, he's finally accepted his curse and savors any opportunity to unleash the beast inside if the situation arises... It often does. Desmond shoots the closest enemy with his hand crossbow, knocking them back a bit. Desmond shoots the closest enemy with his hand crossbow, knocking them back a bit. Desmond attacks the enemy with the most health 3 times in his werewolf form. Buffing Noble Heart. Desmond transforms into his Werewolf form and leaps at the enemy with the most hit points. He swipes with both claws, then bites them, then returns to formation and back to human form. Noble Heart gets a +300% increase for 30 seconds. body.zh: 所有与 相邻的勇士提升 % 伤害。 与月相同调，减少自己和相邻勇士的攻击冷却时间。满月越近，冷却时间减少越多。在每次满月开始时， 的杀招冷却时间完全重置。 当前月相： ^下次月相： ^基本攻击冷却时间减少： 戴斯蒙德与月相同调，为靠近满月的勇士提升基本攻击速度。 月之暗面会根据距离新月到来的时间增加贵族之心的效果。 贵族之心增益： % 对月咆哮的月相周期变化速度加倍， 的杀招攻击将更加频繁。 戴斯蒙德专注于在所有月相阶段提升他与月亮的同调速度，使他的杀招更频繁地出现。 提升 的对月咆哮提供的基本攻击冷却缩减 0.5 秒（加算）。此外，满月时对月咆哮需要 30 秒，而新月和弯月只需要 10 秒。 戴斯蒙德专注于他与满月的同调，更频繁地为盟友提升速度。 暗中奉献得到 + % 的额外加成。此外，新月时对月咆哮需要 30 秒，而满月和盈月只需要 10 秒。 戴斯蒙德专注于他与新月的同调，更频繁地加成盟友的伤害。 为兽化人、德鲁伊和黑骰子协会勇士提升贵族之心效果 %。 阵型中每有一个栏位包含已死亡勇士或亡灵勇士，或被护卫角色或物体占据， 令所有勇士的伤害提高 %（以乘算方式堆叠）。 使 的伤害提升 % 戴斯蒙德根据被死去的勇士或护卫队所占用的格子，增加所有勇士的伤害。 我就是我，科什马尔应该得到更多。 我们不能坐视不管！ 狼群一起奔跑，一起狩猎，一起死亡。 你在等什么呢？ 我们越深入堕影冥界，召唤的声音就越响亮。 有人称之为诅咒，我称之为“我自己”。 即使藏在阴影中，塞伦涅也能投射出她的光芒。 队友就像我的家人。 我最亲爱的人被夺走了，我要报仇。 我们所有人心中都有野性。 走开，让我自己继续悲伤吧。 我领导的时候，你就该跟随。 这个集体欢迎所有人加入。 你不需要任何花哨的东西。 我父亲在我身上看到了很多承诺，但这不是正确的承诺。 当我们找到沃罗妮卡时，我不得不拯救她--把她的幽魂注入我的剑中。 迷雾夺走了我的一切，我将以此报答他们。 我花了很长时间学习战斗。 战斗对我来说是自然而然的，比政治更自然。 你拿到剑了。我会用爪子来对付真正的威胁。 这不是我的命运，对吗？ 有时最好从远处攻击。 根据猎物的不同，我的选择也不同。 我的瞄准无懈可击。 当有爪的东西从天上飞过时，最好先快速射击。 这是来自我父亲的礼物。 这是件不祥之物。我小时候得到这个，然后被狼人咬了。 这是我的试金石。它能提醒我，我是谁，我来自哪里。 狼在我心里，科什马尔也是。 你想要拆了我吗？ 我不需要这个，但有了它，我可以战斗更长时间。 我们走得越远，我的盔甲就越重。 就算没有其他人反抗这种邪恶，我也会。 你永远不知道在迷雾中会需要什么。 我准备好了一切。 能装下一大瓶酒，以防有人开始谈论政治。 我得到了一些惊喜。 戴斯蒙德的身高达到了 5 英尺 10 英寸。他十几岁时在寻找食物时染上了兽化症。他为此困扰了很久，但最终接受了这个诅咒。一旦遇到必要情况，他会立即释放内心的野兽并享受这种乐趣......但他经常遇到这种“必要情况”。 戴斯蒙德用手弩射击离他最近的敌人，将敌人稍微击退。 戴斯蒙德用手弩射击离他最近的敌人，将敌人稍微击退。 戴斯蒙德在狼人形态下攻击生命值最高的敌人 3 次，并提升贵族之心的增益。 戴斯蒙德化身为狼人，扑向生命值最高的敌人。 它用双爪猛击并撕咬敌人，之后返回阵型中并恢复成人形。贵族之心的增益在 30 秒内提升 300%。

title.zh: 贾拉索 贾拉索·班瑞

body.en: Increases gold find by % for each Drow or Rogue Champion in the formation Jarlaxle increases your gold find based on the number of Drow or Rogue Champions in your formation. Increases the damage of by % for each Good or Neutral champion next to them Jarlaxle increases his own damage when he is adjacent to Good or Neutral Champions. Jarlaxle works from the shadows, further manipulating Good and Neutral allies to his own ends. Jarlaxle leads a crew of shady pirates, further increasing the gold find of Master of Piracy. Increases the damage of by % for each item equipped by other Champions in the formation I don't usually partake in tavern dalliances, honestly. Get close and you'll feel my blade! Keep your friends close, but keep your coin pouch closer. How fortunate that we caught you on your way to the bank. Finally I'll be able to replace all the boots I've ruined. No one survives in Menzoberranzan unless they can act the part. Strike while the iron is hot, or the baddie is monologuing. You thought my hobby was, what? Knitting? Look at those gaps in your armor. Perfect for my daggers. Is attacking from the shadows honorable? Of course not! Who cares? These looks could kill -- and they have. Sometimes the most devastating attacks are the ones they see coming. No cleric can help you now. It's going to take a lot more than that to defeat me! Good enough for the common folk, but I'll soon be upgrading, I assure you. You can't be very effective with an unbalanced sword, you know! There's nothing quite so elegant or majestic as a finely crafted rapier. When you need to put on a show, a rapier will often do the trick. It does the job, but not much more. Now that's a swashbuckling look! I've got a few more tricks up my sleeve. Or over my eye, rather. You can't hide from my magical eye... patch. It's not a real feather at all! Why would someone do this? A decent enough feather, I suppose. In a pinch. It's a pleasure to wear, though not for my enemies. You don't want to mess with this feather. A quick dip in an enchanted underdark pool aught to brighten this right up. A useful distraction if you want your foes to see your cloak and not yourself. It has some use, but it could be so much more. With this cloak, I am all but invisible. It once had magical powers, but now it's just an old piece of metal. Rub it three times and a genie pops out. Aha! Gotcha! So gullible. But what power, you ask? I'll never tell. If I know where my enemies will be, they're that much easier to hit. A simple accessory, but quite useful in the right situation. Remind me sometime to tell you the story of how I came into possession of these. Dirty dwarven metal, sure, but you can't deny the craftsmanship. A stylish addition to any outfit! Jarlaxle is a flamboyant, swashbuckling drow who leads Bregan D'aerthe, a band of drow outcasts and renegades from Menzoberranzan. Jarlaxle secretly controls the northern city of Luskan from the shadows by manipulating the five High Captains who rule the city. Jarlaxle attacks the furthest enemy. If it dies, he keeps on attacking, halving his damage each time. Jarlaxle summons the Bregan D'aerthe to attack enemies in the formation from afar with cannon fire. Jarlaxle summons the Bregan D'aerthe to attack enemies in the formation from afar with cannon fire. body.zh: 阵型中每有一位卓尔精灵或游荡者勇士，即提升金币获得量 % 贾拉索根据阵型中的卓尔精灵或游荡者勇士的数量来提高金币寻获。 每与一位善良或中立阵营的勇士相邻，即提升 % 伤害 与善良或中立勇士相邻时，贾拉索使自身伤害提高。 贾拉索暗中行事，进一步操纵善良与中立盟友以达成自己的目的。 贾拉索带领一群鬼祟的海盗，进一步提高海盗大师的金币寻获。 阵型中每有一名装备了 的其他勇士，即为 提升 % 伤害 老实说，在酒馆里我一般不管闲事。 靠近一点，你就能感受到我的利刃！ 让朋友离你近一点，但让钱袋离你更近一点。 多走运啊，我们正好在你去银行的路上抓住了你。 我终于能换掉所有被我毁掉的靴子了。 没人能在魔索布莱城生存下来，除非他们能演好自己的角色。 做事该趁热打铁，否则坏人会得逞。 你认为我的爱好是什么？织毛衣？ 瞧瞧你盔甲上的缺口。非常适合插入我的匕首。 暗中发动攻击光荣吗？当然不！但是谁在乎？ 它们看起来非常致命--事实也的确如此。 杀伤力最强的攻击有时只能目睹而无法躲避。 现在没有牧师能帮你了。 只靠这点本事可无法击败我！ 对于一般人来说这种质量是很不错了，但我很快就会换一把质量更上乘的。 不协调的剑就无法发挥出使用者的全副实力！ 精雕细琢的西洋剑，它所散发的庄重气势无可匹敌。 如果你的战斗有观众在围观的话，那么西洋剑恰恰是最好的选择。 能起到作用，仅此而已。 这才像是个霸气剑客的模样！ 我还有些手段没使出来呢。准确来说是我的眼罩还有大招。 你休想瞒过我的火眼金睛......眼罩。 这根本不是真的羽毛！怎么连这都有造假的？ 算是还不错的羽毛，将就用吧。 我戴上后很舒适，但我的敌人就不舒适了。 这羽毛可不是闹着玩的。 把它丢进幽暗地域的附魔水池中浸一下应该就可以恢复光泽了。 可以让敌人把注意力都集中在你的斗篷而非你的身上。 虽然还是有点用处，但是远远比不上全盛状态时的威力。 穿上它后就可以跟潜行告别了。 它曾经蕴含着魔力，但如今只是块废铜烂铁了。 摩擦戒指三下，精灵就会闪现。哈哈！上当了吧！真容易骗。 是否很好奇究竟有什么样的能力？我就不告诉你。 只要知道敌人的准确位置，那就可以百发百中了。 很简单的器具，但在关键时刻能起到奇效。 我改天再告诉你我是怎么得到这些玩意的。 虽然是使用肮脏的矮人金属铸造的，但是这做工的确无法挑剔。 跟任何穿着打扮都可以搭配得天衣无缝！ 贾拉索是个浮夸的、爱耍花招的卓尔精灵，他领导着卓尔无赖佣兵公会，这是一支来自魔索布莱城的卓尔精灵弃儿和叛徒所组成的公会。贾拉索通过操纵统治这座城市的五位高级队长，从暗处秘密控制了北部城市路斯坎。 贾拉索攻击距离最远的敌人。如果敌人死亡，他还会继续攻击其他敌人，但每次后续攻击伤害减半。 贾拉索召唤卓尔无赖佣兵公会，用火炮从远处攻击阵型中的敌人。 贾拉索召唤卓尔无赖佣兵公会，用火炮从远处攻击阵型中的敌人。

body.en: As a Champion of Zariel, Karlach can be used in any Zariel Patron adventure or variant, even if she would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions. Karlach increases the damage of all Champions (including herself) in her column and the column behind her by %. Karlach increases the damage of all Champions in her column and the column behind her. Your formation gains one Ceremorphosis stack due to the mind flayer tadpole in Karlach's brain. Karlach increases the health of all other Champions by % of her max health, plus % for each Ceremorphosis stack the formation has, stacking additively. Increases the Health of by When Karlach attacks or is attacked, she gains a Rage stack, capped at stacks. Karlach increases the effect of The Fury of Avernus by % for each Rage stack, stacking multiplicatively. Stacks are reduced by % when changing areas. Karlach further increases the effect of The Fury of Avernus each time she attacks or is attacked in an area. While Karlach has or more Rage stacks, she ignites on fire dealing second of BUD-based damage for each Rage stack to any enemy that attacks her. (Stacking additively) While Karlach has or more Rage stacks, she increases her damage by % for each Rage stack she has, stacking multiplicatively. Karlach's rage is filled with unmatched fury, increasing her damage. While Karlach has or more Rage stacks, she heals % of her max health every second. Karlach's unrelenting ferocity while raging sustains her, healing some of the damage she's taken each second. While Karlach has or more Rage stacks, she increases the effect of The Fury of Avernus by % for each stack of Ceremorphosis, stacking multiplicatively. Karlach embraces the mental connection she has with other Champions undergoing Ceremorphosis, increasing her support capabilities. Karlach increases the effect of The Fury of Avernus by % for each Zariel Patron variant you have completed, stacking multiplicatively. Think really carefully before you square up. I'll try not to knock you out so hard you can't tap out. It doesn't matter what happens to me; just get those people out of here! Line up, soldiers! We're going hunting. However many hits you think I can take - double that. I've felt the fires of the hells - this is nothing! COME ON! Ha! I was almost worried there for a second. Silly me. Feel that? Time to cook. Is that all you've got? HAHAHA! AAAARRRRGGGGHHHH!!! I've fought in the Blood War! YOU CAN'T TOUCH ME! This is going to hurt bad. I just want you to know that. C'mere, cutie. Oh... You're going to regret that! Screaming calms me down. You should try it, Soldier. I don't think I've ever felt more powerful. Avernus taught me everything there is to know about pain. Let me show you. Always bet on Mama K! Let's paint the town red with the blood of our enemies! ...Too much? Gods, it'll be good to have a cold drink again. You're having fun, aren't you? Killed a Barlgura with one of these. Good for eye-scooping. Clivey baby boo boo boy I love you. These'll help me blend in with the hordes. Fit for the temperaturally challenged. You don't want to know who I peeled this leather from. Trust me. I CAN FLY NOW?! Baby's first chopper. What it lacks in size, it makes up for by being better than nothing. Now that's what I call a greataxe! Let's let some blood. %$#& yes! One devil's gift is another Karlach's curse. Zariel said she killed the smith who made these. Always was paranoid. I know what to do with this! Or Dammon does, anyway. Look at that. It's almost beautiful. When in Avernus... The more I look at those six letters, the less they scare me. I'm elite and I was in a squad, what's confusing about that? Has a ring to it, doesn't it? Though I much prefer 'Cliffgate' myself. Hmm. If we find one with a bit more juice, we can rev things up. It's something, soldier, but this won't cut it. Let's kick things up a notch. Should I use all of these at once? No. Right? No. Maybe... Freshly escaped from Hell, Karlach is finally free of the Archdevil Zariel - but not from the infernal engine Zariel planted in her chest. With her first taste of freedom in ten years, Karlach is eager to find a fix for the engine that's burning hotter and hotter before it burns her out completely. But even more premiere in her mind? Exploring, finding like-minded travelers, falling in love (or lust)... and taking revenge on the man who sold her to Zariel all those years ago. Karlach attacks the closest enemies with a swing of her greataxe. Karlach increases her rage cap to 100 stacks and her Infernal Engine's damage by 100%. Karlach absorbs the energy of a soul coin, increasing her rage cap to 100 stacks and her Infernal Engine's BUD-based damage by 100% until completing the next boss area. Karlach increases the damage of all Champions in her column and the column behind her. Karlach further increases her main support buff each time she attacks or is attacked in an area. body.zh: 作为扎瑞尔的勇士，卡菈克将可用于任何扎瑞尔赞助者冒险或支线任务，即使以前由于支线任务或赞助者限制条件无法使用。 卡菈克可使她所在纵队和她之后的纵队中的所有勇士（包括其自身）的伤害提高 %。 卡菈克可使她所在纵队和她之后的纵队中的所有勇士的伤害提高。 卡菈克大脑中的夺心魔蝌蚪使你的阵型获得一层“蜕变”堆叠。卡菈克提高所有其他勇士的生命值，数值相当于她的最大生命值的 %，外加阵型拥有的“蜕变”堆叠层数乘以 %，以加算方式堆叠。 使 的生命值提升 卡菈克攻击或被攻击时会获得一层“激怒”堆叠，上限 层。每层“激怒”均使卡菈克的“阿弗纳斯之怒”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。变更区域时，堆叠层数减少 %。 在区域中时，卡菈克在自身攻击或被攻击时进一步提升“阿弗纳斯之怒”的效果。 卡菈克拥有 或更多层“激怒”堆叠时，她点燃火焰，对攻击自己的任何敌人造成 秒基于基础杀招伤害的伤害。（以加算方式堆叠） 卡菈克拥有 或更多层“激怒”堆叠时，她根据自身拥有的“激怒”堆叠层数，每层提升自己的伤害 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 卡菈克胸中满是无匹怒气，这提升了她的伤害。 卡菈克拥有 或更多层“激怒”堆叠时，她每秒恢复自身 % 生命值。 胸怀愤怒之时，卡菈克便狂暴无情，可每秒为自己治疗一些伤害。 卡菈克拥有 或更多层“激怒”堆叠时，她根据自身拥有的“蜕变”堆叠层数，每层提升“阿弗纳斯之怒”的效果 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 卡菈克投入与其他接受“蜕变”勇士的精神连系，提升自己的支援能力。 每完成一个扎瑞尔赞助者支线任务，均使卡菈克的“阿弗纳斯之怒”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 三思而后行 我会尽量不让你输得太惨。 我怎么样无所谓；把那些人带出去！ 列队，士兵们！我们要去打猎了。 你觉得我要吃下多少攻击才能被打趴——你加个倍还差不多。 我感受过地狱的火焰——这算不了什么！ 放马过来！ 哈！我还担心了那么一小下呢。我真够笨的。 感觉到了吗？料理时间到。 你就这点本事？哈哈哈！ 啊啊啊啊啊！！！ 我曾血战厮杀！你碰不到我的！ 这下会疼的要死的。我只是想要让你知道清楚。 过来啊，小可爱。 噢……你会后悔的！ 尖叫能让我平静。你不妨试试，士兵。 我从未感觉自己如此强大。 阿弗纳斯教会了我有关痛苦的一切。我来让你见识一下吧。 押 K 妈妈就对了！ Let's paint the town red with the blood of our enemies! ...Too much? 老天，能再喝到冷饮真是太好了。 你玩得挺开心的，对吧？ 用这样的东西杀了一只巴古拉魔。挖眼球挺方便。 宝贝克莱夫，哎哟哟，我好喜欢你啊。 这些能帮我混进人群。 适合温度不宜人的时候。 我从谁身上薅的这羽毛，你不会想要知道的。相信我。 我现在能飞了？！ 宝宝的人生首把斧头 虽然尺寸不够大，但总比什么都没的好。 这才叫巨斧嘛！来放点血吧。 %$#& 好耶！ 魔鬼的馈赠就是卡菈克的诅咒。 扎瑞尔说她杀掉了制作这些的匠人。总是那么偏执。 我知道该怎么处理这个！或者说，达蒙知道。 你们看。简直美极了。 在阿弗纳斯的时候…… 这三个字越看越不会让我感到可怕。 我是精英，我也在队伍里，这有什么难以理解的？ 挺琅琅上口的，不是吗？我自己的话更喜欢“悬崖之门”。 唔。要是找到个能量再多点的，我们就能加快点速度了。 士兵，这个虽然很重要，但也不够。 来让情况升升级吧。 我能一口气把这些都用掉吗？不行。对吧？不。也许…… 刚刚逃离地狱的卡菈克终于摆脱了大恶魔扎瑞尔，却没能逃离扎瑞尔埋藏在她胸腔里的地狱引擎。十年来第一次品尝到自由的滋味，卡菈克渴望彻底解决这个越来越灼热的引擎，以免被它焚烧殆尽。但她心中还有更重要的梦想。那就是探索世界，寻找志同道合的旅伴，坠入爱河（或沉迷欲望）……以及报复那个数年前将她卖给扎瑞尔的男人。 卡菈克挥起她的巨斧攻击最近的敌人。 卡菈克将“激怒”上限提升到 100 层叠加，同时将自己的“地狱引擎”的伤害提升 100%。 卡菈克吸收魂币的能量，将“激怒”上限提升到 100 层叠加，同时将自己“地狱引擎”基于基础杀招伤害的伤害提升 100%，直到完成下个首领区域为止。 卡菈克可使她所在纵队和她之后的纵队中的所有勇士的伤害提高。 在区域中时，卡菈克在自身攻击或被攻击时进一步提升自己的主要支援增益。

body.en: Commodore Krux can be used in any Light of Xaryxis campaign adventure or variant, even if he would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions. Commodore Krux increases the damage of all Champions in his column and the two rear-most columns of the formation by %. This does not apply twice if he's in one of the two rear-most columns. Commodore Krux increases the damage of all Champions in his column and the rear-most column of the formation by %. This does not apply twice if that is the same column. Commodore Krux buffs Champions who are in his column and the back column of the formation. Commodore Krux increases the damage bonus of All Hands On Deck! by % for each second the Champions are in the current area, stacking multiplicatively up to a maximum of stacks. Commodore Krux increases the health of all other Champions by % of his max health for each adventure, variant, and Patron variant you have completed in the Light of Xaryxis campaign, stacking additively. Any healing effect on those Champions is increased by the same amount. Increases the health of and the effect of healing on by Upon completing a new area, Commodore Krux raises a spyglass to his eye and spots an enemy from the next area. All enemies of that type become his Favored Foe (until another area is completed) and take % more damage from all sources. Commodore Krux is always looking ahead and chooses a Favored Foe from the next area when completing an area. Commodore Krux gains the Control role and he increases the effect of All Hands On Deck! by % and his base attack knocks back his targets a short distance. Commodore Krux focuses on buffing the party and the strength of his Flintlock Pistols. Commodore Krux increases the damage of Champions with a magic base attack by %. Champions in Formation Targeted: Commodore Krux focuses on buffing his magic-based allies. Each time any favored foe is defeated, Commodore Krux increases the damage of All Hands On Deck! by %, stacking additively up to times, until the area is changed. Commodore Krux keeps a keen eye on Favored Foes and further buffs Champions when one is defeated. Commodore Krux increases the effect of All Hands On Deck! by % for each adventure, variant, and Patron variant you have completed in the Light of Xaryxis campaign, stacking multiplicatively. I find listening to one's heart is the best course of action. We are stronger as a crew -- those scoundrels can not break that! I once trained with an ancient eladrin just to observe my surroundings. Haha! Just like my training! Trying to break through a giff's hide is a losing fight. Never stop -- never concede! Have at thee! Haha! A spot of tea never fails to calm the nerves. It's an honor to call you all my crew. This crew is like a well-oiled machine. Welcome to the crew! Load the cannons, ready your weapons, send them to the hells! Few can hide from my spyglass. I've sailed more of the astral sea than most can imagine. Wildspace changes you. You have to decide if it's for the better. Judge me not by my size. Ho oh! I'm a fiend with a bagpipe! There's quite a bit of time in Wildspace for reading. Ah yes, been a few years since I fit into this one. Smell that? Still smells like my old ship. Good memories. On the Second Wind I get to choose my own uniform! Haha! Nothing can stop me in this! I remember these being much sturdier... Oh, no, I was thinking of these. These were good weapons! I took these in a duel. No one lost, but they were too drunk to notice. Won these in a game at Infinity's. That celestial was not happy with me... Oh dear, it seems there's been a hole in this one... I swear there were more coins in here this morning It may be light, but thieves can't easily access it! I can carry most anything in this! There's nothing in it, but I could! At one point I sailed the seas and this was always with me. I acquired this on a trip to the Radiant Citadel. A normal spyglass just won't cut it in Wildspace. Only a fool would knowingly sail into Doomspace. And I'm that fool! This belonged to an old friend. Should I repair it? It's good to hear this ticking away once again. Warwyck broke this the last time I saw him... Few believe me when I tell them the story behind this tooth! Wore this one down to the threads it seems. Well, this WAS tailored. Found this one floating out in Wildspace. I'm sure it's fine. Wish I had this when I found that Tarrasque... Commodore Krux is a giff soldier who believes his glory days are behind him. Krux has spent the last few years working as a mercenary on and around the Rock of Bral, but lately the giff has been spending more time in his cups as new jobs have become fewer and farther between. Commodore Krux fires a pistol at a random target. Commodore Krux throws a grenade at the enemy with the most health which deals damage and knocks enemies back. Commodore Krux throws a grenade at the enemy with the most health, which explodes dealing ultimate damage to all enemies in a medium radius and knocking them all back a short distance. body.zh: 克鲁克斯准将可用于任何萨雷西斯之光战役冒险或支线任务，即使以前由于支线任务或赞助者限制条件无法使用。 克鲁克斯准将使同列和阵型最后两列所有勇士的伤害提高 %。如果他位于最后两列，则此效果不会生效两次。 克鲁克斯准将使同列和阵型最后一列所有勇士的伤害提高 %。如果他位于最后一列，则此效果不会生效两次。 克鲁克斯准将为同列和阵型后列的勇士提供增益。 克鲁克斯准将使“全员出动！”的伤害加成每秒提高 %，而且位于当前区域的勇士以乘算方式叠加，最多可叠加 次。 对于你在萨雷西斯之光战役中所完成的每个冒险、支线任务和赞助者支线任务，克鲁克斯准将会使所有其他勇士的生命值提高其最大生命值的 %，以加算方式叠加。这些勇士身上的任何治疗效果有相同幅度的提高。 提升 的生命值，对 的回复效果提升 在完成一个新区域时，克鲁克斯准将会举起他的望远镜，锁定下一个区域的一个敌人。该类型的所有敌人成为他的偏好对手（直到完成另一个区域为止）并且所有来源的伤害增加 %。 当完成一个区域时，克鲁克斯准将总是会向前看，并在下一个区域中选择一个偏好对手。 克鲁克斯准将获得控制者角色，使“全员出动！”的效果提高 %，而且他的基本攻击会将目标击退一小段距离。 克鲁克斯准将专注于强化队伍和他的燧发枪的力量。 克鲁克斯准将使使用魔法基本攻击的勇士伤害提高 %。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 克鲁克斯准将专注于强化他的魔法系盟友。 每次打败任何偏好对手，克鲁克斯准将会使“全员出动！”的伤害提高 %，以加算方式最多叠加 次，直到区域被改变为止。 克鲁克斯准将密切关注偏好对手，并且会在打败一个以后进一步强化勇士。 对于你在萨雷西斯之光战役中所完成的每个冒险、支线任务和赞助者支线任务，克鲁克斯准将会使“全员出动！”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式叠加。 我发现听从自己的心是最正确的做法。 团结使我们更强大--那些无赖休想得逞！ 我曾接受过远古雅灵的训练，并且学会了观察四周。 哈哈！和训练时一样！ 想要穿透吉夫人的毛皮，那你已经输了一半。 永不停止--永不认输！ 看招！哈哈！ 几口茶总能平复紧张情绪。 能称你为船员是我的荣幸。 这些船员就像上好润滑油的机器。 欢迎加入队伍！ 装填炮弹，准备好武器，把他们送入地狱！ 几乎没人能逃出我的望远镜。 我航行过的星界之海超出大多数人的想象。 蛮荒太空会改变你。但你必须决定是不是往好的方向。 不要以貌取人。 哦吼！我是一头吹风笛的炼狱生物！ 在蛮荒太空，你有大把时间用来看书。 啊，是啊。这件我穿了好多年了。 闻到了吗？还有我那艘老飞船的味道。美好的回忆啊。 在“复兴号”上，我必须选择属于自己的制服！ 哈哈！什么都无法阻拦我！ 在我印象中，它们结实多了...... 哦，不。我过去总想着它们。这些曾经都是难得的好武器。 我在决斗场上偷来的。没有一次失手，他们都醉得不省人事。 在不朽旅店玩游戏赢的。那个天界生物当时对我很不满...... 哦，亲爱的，这只钱夹上好像有个洞...... 我发誓今天早上还不止这些金币 它虽然轻，但小偷轻易拿不走它！ 它装得下我的大多数东西！虽然现在空空如也，但我知道它什么都能装！ 我一度用它在海上航行，它一直陪伴着我。 我是在前往光耀堡垒的途中得到它的。 普通望远镜在蛮荒太空中可不管用。 只有傻子才会故意航行到毁灭太空。而我就是这样的傻子！ 它是我一个老朋友的东西。我该把它修好吗？ 滴答滴答，再次听到这个声音的感觉真美妙。 上次见沃维克的时候，被他弄坏了...... 当我讲这颗牙背后的故事时，没几个人相信。 好像戴得都脱线了。 嗯，这一顶是定制的。 发现它时，它漂浮在蛮荒太空中。我肯定它是好的。 多希望在找到泰拉斯奎巨兽时，我也有这么一顶...... 克鲁克斯准将是一名吉夫士兵，他坚信属于他的荣耀终有一天会到来。克鲁克斯最近几年一直在布拉尔巨岩附近当雇佣兵，但这位吉夫人最近花大把时间买醉，因为新工作少得可怜。 克鲁克斯准将用手枪随机射击一个目标。 克鲁克斯准将向生命值最高的敌人投掷一颗手榴弹，对敌人造成伤害并将其击退。 克鲁克斯准将向生命值最高的敌人投掷一颗手榴弹；手榴弹在爆炸时会对中等范围内的所有敌人造成杀招伤害，并将其击退一小段距离。
