body.en: If Virgil qualifies for an adventure restriction based on his tags, age, ability scores, etc., may be used as well. keeps a soul trinket of the highest level boss defeated in each campaign (and the highest level boss defeated in all events) where he was present. increases the damage of all Champions in his column by % for each Soul Trinket level. Kent keeps a Soul Token from the highest level boss he helped defeat in each campaign. These tokens buff the party. Each time or the ghostly spirit from his ultimate attacks, he gains a Nostalgia stack that lasts until entering a new area. increases his damage by % for each Nostalgia stack, stacking multiplicatively and then applied multiplicatively. Buffs are applied to the post-stack value, and Nostalgia stacks are capped at stacks. Each time Kent or his ghostly companions attack he gains Nostalgia making him deal even more damage until changing areas. 's force of personality emboldens his companions. increases the damage of all Champions by your current Achievement bonus. increases the attack bonus of by % for each Rivals of Waterdeep Champion, stacking multiplicatively and applied multiplicatively. Kent focuses on improving his Tokens of the Departed Whenever attacks an enemy and doesn't kill it, it is affected by a virulent poison. The poison deals seconds worth of BUD to the enemy each second for seconds. Kent poisons his Rapier Not really my thing, but I'll try it... Have at thee! WAIT! I have a hat for this! Now you're in for it! DON'T STAIN MY CLOAK! Buy me a drink first! It's a bit macabre - but it's a vibe! You'll be surprised at how quickly they run out. This one is special. These ruins are SINGING! The stories they can tell us! That was MAGNIFICENT! YAAAAAAAAAAS! Sometimes I have to remember those we lost in order to be stronger. It's not my style, but I can make it work. I am, aren't I?! We are stronger together. What is this? It's kind of cool I guess. It spins... Eh, he knows I love him. He wasn't preserving the piece well enough anyway. A ring is kinda hokey, I guess, but...so are we. Just don't tell anyone. I have to fight with THIS? It's all about the finesse. I once saw a similar piece at a Talonite dig site! A blade worthy of the rest of my outfit! This earring is whispering to me... It's a tool I can use. Watch this! At least the 'Red Wizard' is useful now. I'm 100% sure this won't create any problems. Probably. It might be time to RUN, Virgil! Oh these vials? They... are... hair dye? Why yes, that's real leather! Oh, you meant IN the vial. Finally, boots for daytime AND nighttime! A momentous digging day deserves a relaxing end. I got Virgil a matching gown, he didn't like it though. I LOVE the lining color. Here, watch me spin! Selise is gonna kill me for this costume. EVERYTHING IS WRINKLED! I'm sure I have it here, somewhere! Why won't it close!? That'll do. For now. A former archaeologist turned adventurer, Kentucky 'Kent' Jones honed his skills exploring a temple of Talona, goddess of poison and plague. While his team didn't survive the temple's defenses, he returned home to the lakeside town of Caradoon. Still a flamboyant Tiefling, Kent carries a darkness that he does his best to keep hidden. But he doesn't bear the darkness alone. After returning to Caradoon, he met smart and PATIENT Aasimar, Virgil. Together they've flourished, even after accidentally poisoning the ground under a local tavern in an effort to get rid of a few rats and fleeing Caradoon only to meet up with Selise Astorio and join the Rivals. Kent strikes the closest enemy with his rapier. For 30 seconds, when Kent attacks, a ghostly spirit attacks an enemy dealing BUD damage. The weather changes to fog. For 30 seconds, whenever Kent attacks, a ghostly spirit is summoned and attacks an additional enemy if possible dealing BUD damage. Kent buffs all Champions based on the highest level boss he helped defeat in each Campaign. Kent gets nostalgic each time he or his spirit companions attack, helping him deal more damage until he moves on. Increases the damage of all Champions by % Increases the damage of all Male Champions by % Increases the damage of all Tiefling Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions with a CHA score of 13 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a CON score of 13 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation with a NEUTRAL alignment
body.zh: 如果维吉尔根据自己的标签、年龄、技能分数等通过冒险的限制，则 也可以一并使用。 持有自己出场的每场战役中击败的最高等级首领（以及所有活动中击败的最高等级首领）的灵魂吊坠。灵魂吊坠每个等级可提升 所在列中的所有勇士伤害 %。 在每场战役中，肯特会留下协助击败的最高等级首领的灵魂之证。这些证明可为探险队提供增益。 或其杀招攻击产生的幽魂攻击时，都会获得一层怀想堆叠，一直持续到进入新区域为止。每有一层怀想堆叠， 的伤害增加 %，堆叠和应用均为乘算。增益应用于堆叠后的值，且怀想堆叠上限为 层。 肯特及其幽魂伙伴每次攻击都会获得怀想，令肯特在改变区域前造成更多的伤害。 的个性力量令伙伴变得更加莽撞。 根据你的当前成就加成增加所有勇士的伤害。 阵型中的每个“深水城的竞争对手”勇士均使 的“ ”攻击加成提高 %，以乘算堆叠并应用。 肯特专注于改进自己的逝去之证 攻击敌人但未将敌人击杀时，该敌人会受到恶性毒药的影响。毒素对敌人造成等同 秒的基础杀招伤害，持续 秒。 肯特为自己的西洋剑淬上了毒 我不算喜欢，但我会试试看... 看招！ 等等！我有顶帽子专门弄这个的！ 现在你得付出代价！ 不要弄脏我的斗篷！ 先给我买份饮料来！ 有点可怕 - 但就是这种感觉！ 消耗速度之快，定会让你大为震惊。 这个是特别的。 这些遗迹在歌唱！它们可以告诉我们故事！ 真是太棒了！ 太·好·了！ 有时候，只有记住曾经失去的人才能使我们变得更强大。 虽然不是我的风格，但能凑合。 我就是，对吧？！ 人多力量大。 这是什么？ 还真是帅气呢。天旋地转... 呃，他知道我爱他。不过，他没有好好保存好这件东西呢。 戒指有点虚情假意吧，不过... 我们自己也是。千万别告诉任何人。 我得和这么个东西战斗？ 纤细灵巧为重。 我曾经在塔罗尼特的发掘点看到一件类似的！ 一把就够买我全身！ 这个耳环在对我低语... 这是我能使用的工具。看这个！ 至少这下“红袍法师”能有点用了。 我百分百肯定，这不会有问题的。也许吧。 该逃跑了，维吉尔！ 这些小瓶是？都... 都是... 染发剂？ 干嘛？那可是真皮的！噢，你说那小瓶里的东西啊。 终于有适合日夜穿着的靴子了！ 重要的发掘日应该以放松为结束。 我给维吉尔准备了合适的袍子，但他不喜欢。 我喜欢这内衬的颜色。来啊，看我转一下！ 赛丽斯会因为这件衣服杀了我的。 一切都皱巴巴的！ 我肯定是把它收藏在... 哪里来着！ 为什么关不上！？ 这样就行了。至少暂时如此。 前考古学家，现在是冒险者，肯塔基“肯特”琼斯在探索塔洛娜（毒药和瘟疫女神）的神殿时磨炼了自己的能力。尽管他所在的队伍未能在神殿的防御中幸存，但他却能安全回到自己的家乡 - 湖畔小镇卡拉敦。尽管还是个欢脱的提夫林，但肯特却背负着自己竭尽全力隐藏的黑暗面。但他并非独立承受。在回到卡拉敦后，肯特预见了智慧，更重要是拥有耐心的神裔 - 维吉尔。他们在一起，相互帮助，取得成绩 - 即便只是因为想要解决一些老鼠而意外将当地酒馆所在的土地变得有毒，从而逃离卡拉敦，一心只想去见赛丽斯·阿斯托里奥并加入对手团。 肯特用自己的西洋剑刺击最近的敌人。 30 秒内，肯特攻击时，一个幽魂攻击一名敌人，造成基础杀招伤害。 天气改变为雾天。30 秒内，肯特攻击时召唤一个幽魂，攻击额外一个敌人（如可能），造成基础杀招伤害。 基于自己在每场战役中协助击败的最高等级首领，肯特为所有勇士提供增益。 每次肯特自身或他的幽魂伙伴攻击时，肯特都会获得怀想，帮助他在摆脱过去之前造成更多伤害。

body.en: Increases the damage of Champions within two slots of Sentry by % Sentry buffs those near her, so make sure your main DPS is nearby. Echo accompanies Sentry in the formation. Echo has multiple effects based on whether Sentry wasn't, currently is, or was ever under attack in the current area. Sentry's companion, Echo, buffs the party based on whether or not Sentry has been attacked recently. Increases the chance of Echo Resolution triggering by % (additively). Guardian of Solwynn is now only active if Sentry is in the front-most column of the formation, but its effect is increased by % Sentry increases her buff to damage,but only from the front Sentry gains the Control role and her Divine Strike has a % chance to ensnare affected enemies in a circle of vines, stunning them for seconds. Sentry's base attacks gain a chance to ensnare affected enemies in a circle of vines, stunning them for a short time. Sentry increases her ability to buff nearby allies by a significant amount. Increases the health of all other Champions in the formation by % of Sentry's max health. Sentry contributes one stack to Aerois Synergy every time an enemy spawns, and for each second a boss has been alive. Their maximum number of stacks is 200 plus the highest area completed in the current run divided by 5 (rounded down). 10% of her contributed stacks are removed when changing areas. Guardian of Solwynn is increased by 10% times the total number of Aerois Synergy stacks. Increases the damage of Champions within two slots of Sentry by % if Sentry is in the front-most column of the formation. Increases the quest requirement reduction of Echo Resolution to 30%. Perhaps we should hit a bit harder next time. Trust me. You just put the plate up to your face. Doesn't it feel wonderful!? I've got a spare panel here somewhere... Echo, to my side! True power comes with friends at your side. I shall not misuse this power. I will not fail again. I can handle the drider. You should deal with the spellcaster. Is this how it's done? Do I look like a doll? I am far from my past, but exactly where I should be to assist. My new home will be protected. I'm on it! There is more where that came from. I... I can still feel a connection to The Prime Matrix. I can go further, I promise. Foes assail me, but my shield echoes my will: unyielding, unbroken. A good axe is a fine companion for the road ahead! Well forged, well weighted. Much easier to swing! A wonderful axe! To drive back evil's reaching grasp! I feel the might of Solwynn guide my hand! It feels like home again! I like to feel the texture of the tree. It feels more alive. It's taken a beating, but it's still solid. I defend the defenseless My city, my history, my goal, my future. Sometimes its hard to keep them still during battle. They help me feel more 'human'. Hold onto something! Aila helps me braid them. It matches my hair vines. Seems like the logical choice. Humans enjoy covering themselves in colorful fabric. Sometimes I hide warm plates under it. I cleaned it up after my resurrection. Oh! Hello there! This is Echo. They are here to help. You think this look is cool? Just wait. Power stores depleted slightly, but the results are. . . lovely. It holds the symbol of my city. What do you mean, 'it's for pants'? Wearing this makes me feel closer to home. I will fight to unlock the past until my last bolt rusts. Sentry, protector of the Kingdom of Solwynn, is an ancient relic on her plane. Long ago, a dark power obliterated Sentry's peaceful home, forcing her to power down until a new purpose could wake her. Now, with her ceremonial axe, and memories of Solwynn guiding her, Sentry devotes herself to protecting the friends fighting alongside her. Despite being thrust into a new world eons beyond the one she knew, Sentry defends the good of the world from the dark reaches of evil's grasp. She will not fail again. Sentry attacks the nearest enemy with her Battleaxe, which explodes with radiant light. Sentry charges into battle atop a transformed echo, dealing damage over time with her flame lance. Sentry charges into battle atop a transformed echo, dealing damage over time with her flame lance. Sentry buffs Champions within two slots of herself as long as she's in the front column of the formation. Sentry's companion, Echo, buffs the party in unique ways depending on its combat status throughout each area. body.zh: 距离哨兵 2 格内勇士的伤害提高 % 哨兵为靠近自己的勇士提供增益，所以务必让主力伤害输出靠近她。 回声会在阵型中陪伴哨兵。根据哨兵在当前区域内未受到攻击、当前正受到攻击或曾经受到攻击等不同情况，回声会产生各种不同的效果。 哨兵的伙伴回声会根据哨兵最近有没有受到攻击来强化队伍。 使回声决心的触发几率提高 %（以加算方式堆叠） 只有当哨兵处于阵型的最前列时，“索尔文的守护者”才会激活，但其效果提高 % 哨兵提高她的伤害增益效果，但只能在前排 哨兵获得控制者角色，她的神圣打击有 % 几率通过藤蔓圈诱捕受影响的敌人，使其眩晕 秒 哨兵的基本攻击有几率通过藤蔓圈诱捕受影响的敌人，使其在短时间内眩晕。 哨兵大幅提高她为附近盟友施加的增益。 提升阵型中其他所有勇士的生命值，数值相当于哨兵最大生命值的 % 每次刷新一名敌人，以及首领每存活一秒，哨兵为埃罗伊斯协同贡献一层堆叠。其最大堆叠层数为 200 加上当前关卡中完成的最高区域除以 5（向下舍入）。改变区域时，移除她所贡献堆叠的 10%。“索尔文的守护者”提高 10% 乘以埃罗伊斯协同的堆叠总层数。 如果哨兵处于阵型的最前列，则提升距离哨兵 2 格内勇士的伤害 % 使回声决心的任务要求降低 30% 也许下次我们下手应该重一点。 相信我，就把盘子举到你脸的高度。感觉是不是很奇妙？ 我在哪儿还放了一块备用的护甲片来着...... 回声，到我身侧！ 真正的力量来自你身边的朋友。 我不会滥用这种力量。 我不会再失败了。 我能处理这个蛛化精灵。你应该来处理这个咒术师。 是这样做的吗？我看起来像个洋娃娃吗？ 我已远离过去，但这正是我应该帮忙的地方。 我的新家将受到保护。 交给我吧！ 还有更多的来源。 我……我仍然能感觉到与原始矩阵的联系。 我还可以走得更远，我保证。 敌人攻击我，但我的盾牌回荡着我的意志：不屈不挠，坚不可摧。 优秀的斧头是出门远行必备的好伙伴！ 做工优良，体积轻盈。更适合挥砍！ 非常奇妙的斧头！可以将邪恶的触角砍掉！ 我感觉到索尔文的力量在驱使我的双手！感觉像回到了家一样！ 我喜欢感受树木的纹理。这样它才会更有生气。 虽然受到了重创，但依然很坚固。 我保护无法自保的人。 我的城市、我的历史、我的目标、我的未来。 在战斗中往往很难照顾得好自己的藤蔓。 这样会让我感觉更加的“人性化”。 快找东西抓紧！ 是艾拉帮我编织的。 跟我的青丝藤蔓的颜色很搭配。所以我选择了它。 人类都喜欢穿得花花绿绿的。 我偶尔会在长袍下穿些温暖的板甲。 我复活后有清洗过它。 啊！你好！ 这是埃侯。他们是来帮忙的。 你以为这样的装扮就很帅了？等着瞧吧。 库存能量稍微下降，但是成果......非常美丽。 它象征着我的城市。 你什么意思？什么叫用来“绑裤子”的？ 穿着它让我有种回到家的感觉。 为了解密过往，我愿意战斗到最后一枚螺丝生锈为止。 哨兵是索尔文王国的保护者，是她所在位面的一件古老遗物。很久以前，一股黑暗的力量摧毁了哨兵平静的家园并迫使她陷入沉眠，直到有新的目标将她唤醒。如今，哨兵带着她的仪式之斧和对索尔文的记忆，致力于保护与她并肩作战的朋友。尽管被推入一个超越她所认知世界的新时代，哨兵仍然捍卫着世界的美好，使其不受邪恶黑暗的控制。她不会再失败。 哨兵用她的战斧攻击距离最近的敌人，战斧上的热能之光会产生爆炸。 哨兵驾驭着转换形态的回声冲进战场，用她的烈焰长枪造成持续伤害。 哨兵驾驭着转换形态的回声冲进战场，用她的烈焰长枪造成持续伤害。 只要哨兵处于阵型前排，她就会为自己身边两格内的勇士提供增益。 哨兵的伙伴回声根据其在每个区域的战斗状态，为整个队伍提供独特的增益。

body.en: Skylla increases the damage of all Champions in the column in front of her by % for each Champion affected by this ability, stacking multiplicatively. Skylla increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of her, with the benefit increasing as the number of buffed Champions increases. When Skylla attacks an enemy but doesn't defeat it, she casts Faerie Fire on it. Champions deal % additional damage to enemies affected by Faerie Fire. Skylla casts Faerie Fire on foes she attacks and can't defeat, making them more vulnerable to subsequent attacks. Other Champions in the party have their ability scores switched: STR with CHA, DEX with INT, and CON with WIS. The effect of Whispers of Baba Yaga is increased by 100% each time the difference between the switched scores is 5 or more, stacking multiplicatively. Potential Stacks: The possibilities are nearly endless when you can reshape reality. Skylla increases the effect of Whispers of Baba Yaga by % for each evil Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Evil Champions: The League of Malevolence is a cabal of odious villains united in one purpose: the accumulation of power. Increases the effect of Whispers of Baba Yaga by % for each debuff that has been applied to an enemy in the current area, stacking multiplicatively and capping at . Skylla draws power from the lifeforce of her opponents. Whenever an enemy that is debuffed by Faerie Fire is defeated, Skylla gains a Shimmer stack. Skylla increases the effect of Whispers of Baba Yaga by % for each Shimmer stack she has, stacking additively. Shimmer stacks persist for the entire adventure and reset when you complete it. Skylla creates a twisting pattern of colors above the enemies for 15 seconds. All enemies take 5 seconds of BUD-based damage when hit by any Champion for the duration. Additionally, all enemies, including any that spawn, are Stunned for the duration or until they take damage, whichever is shorter. deals an extra 5 seconds of BUD-based damage Skylla's Faerie Fire remains green, but increases the effect of the debuff by %. Skylla increases the damage her opponents take when illuminated by her green Faerie Fire. Skylla's Faerie Fire turns blue. Champions attacking enemies affected by Faerie Fire have a % additional chance to deal a critical hit. Skylla's Faerie Fire turns blue, leaving foes vulnerable to critical hits. Skylla gains the Breaker role and her Faerie Fire turns violet. Enemies affected by Faerie Fire lose an additional armor or segmented health piece when they are attacked and at least 1 segment was broken. Skylla's Faerie Fire turns violet, revealing flaws in the armor of her opponents. Good servants may keep their free will. Is that not selfless? I promise power and riches to those who serve me well. Do you hear her? At the edges of your mind? When all the life has left you, only her laughter will remain. Granny expects me to be at my very best, to do my very worst. There you are... There is no escape. I watch. I yearn. I listen. I learn. I know. They burn. Just where am I supposed to find baboon's blood at this hour? Now the charm is firm and good. Time for some fun. The first cut is the deepest. I know. I'll have your heart, one way or another. My patron does not suffer fools. You'll make a fine servant. Now, say 'yes, mistress.' Good. It empties itself out if it disagrees with the recipe. Maiden's blood, mother's tears, and crone's bones. A fine brew, this will make. It spins ever and on until I say the magic words. A witch's best friend for traversing the night. Where shall I fly today? What spell could I expect to cast with this rubbish? A handful of foxfire blooms to reveal the unseen. Smoke and ash, fire and flash. I will craft for you a beautiful delusion. I have everything I need to make your short life as miserable as possible. These make no sense! No treats for you, Golmo! Mm, yes. I can make use of this. Well done, Golmo. It turns for my hands, and mine alone. Useful for imprisoning tiny creatures to bend to my will. These are suited only for an understudy. If I'm stepping onto the stage, I'll be stepping out in style. All eyes on me - or else. A fan is a must for a woman with secrets, and I have so many... I am no seamstress. These are dead to me. The style, colors, and cut are all subject to my whim. I channel the powers of mischief and murk. A gift from granny. It burns away unnecessary things. The evil magic user Skylla borrows her terrible power from none other than the infamous Arch-hag and Mother of Witches, Baba Yaga. An ally of convenience, Skylla lives only for the pursuit of power and acclaim, seeing even her fellow members of the League of Malevolence as tools to be used and discarded when it suits her needs. Skylla confounds her foes with magical trickery, wielding the unpredictable chaos of the Feywild to hypnotize and incapacitate those who stand between her and her goals. Skylla attacks a random enemy with her staff for one hit, and zaps another random enemy for 1 hit. Skylla casts Hypnotic Pattern, making enemies take more damage from attacks and briefly stunning them. Skylla casts Hypnotic Pattern, making enemies take additional BUD-based damage from attacks for the duration. Additionally, enemies are stunned until they take damage. body.zh: 每有一名勇士受这项技能影响，斯凯拉会使她前列所有勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 斯凯拉会提高她前列勇士的伤害，而且有越多的勇士受她的增益影响，其效果就越强。 当斯凯拉攻击一名敌人但没有将其击败时，她会对该敌人施放精灵之火。勇士们会对受精灵之火影响的敌人造成 % 的额外伤害。 斯凯拉会对她攻击但没能击败的敌人施加精灵之火，使其更容易受到后续攻击的伤害。 阵型中其他勇士的属性值互换：力量与魅力互换，敏捷与智力互换，体质与感知互换。每当互换的属性值差异大于等于 5 时，“雅加婆婆的低语”的效果提高 100%，以乘算方式堆叠。 潜在堆叠层数： 当你可以重塑现实时，可能性几乎是无穷无尽的。 阵型中每有一名邪恶勇士，斯凯拉会使“雅加婆婆的低语”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 邪恶勇士数量： 恶念联会是一群可恶的坏蛋组成的阴谋集团，他们聚在一起只有一个目的：聚敛权力。 每有一项减益被施加到当前区域的一名敌人身上，“雅加婆婆的低语”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 层。 斯凯拉会从她对手的生命力中汲取力量。 每当有一名受到精灵之火减益的敌人被击败，斯凯拉会获得一层“闪光”堆叠层数。斯凯拉每拥有一层“闪光”堆叠层数，她会使“雅加婆婆的低语”的效果提高 %，以加算方式堆叠。“闪光”堆叠层数在整个冒险过程会一直存在，直到你完成冒险时才会重置。 斯凯拉在敌人上方生成一个旋转的彩色图案，持续 15 秒。在此期间内，所有敌人在被任意勇士击中时，会受到等同于 5 秒基础杀招伤害的伤害。此外，所有敌人（包括任何刷新出来的敌人）会被眩晕，直到效果持续时间结束或者他们受到伤害为止，以先发生者为准。 会造成等同于 5 秒基础杀招伤害的额外伤害。 斯凯拉的精灵之火依然为绿色，但减益的效果提高 %。 当斯凯拉的敌人被她的绿色精灵之火照亮时，她会使他们受到的伤害提高。 斯凯拉的精灵之火变成蓝色。攻击受精灵之火影响的敌人的勇士们有 % 的额外几率打出暴击。 斯凯拉的精灵之火变成蓝色，使敌人更容易遭到暴击。 斯凯拉获得突破者角色定位，她的精灵之火变成蓝紫色。受精灵之火影响的敌人在被攻击并且有至少一段分段式生命值被打掉时，会额外损失一点护甲生命值或一段分段式生命值。 斯凯拉的精灵之火变成蓝紫色，使她对手护甲的弱点暴露出来。 好的奴才可以保留自己的自由意志。那难道不是一种无私吗？ 凡好好侍奉于我的人，我必赐予权力与财富。 你有听到她的声音吗？在你意识的边缘？ 当全部生命都离你而去，唯有她的笑声会留下。 奶奶希望我以最好的状态去做最坏的事。 你在这里啊…… 你逃不掉的。 我注视。我渴求。 我倾听。我学习。 我知道。他们在燃烧。 这么晚了，要我去哪里找狒狒血？ 现在魔咒稳妥无虞了。是时候去找点乐子了。 第一刀是最深的，我知道。 无论如何，我都会得到你的心。 我的守护神不会容忍愚者。 你会是一个好奴才的。来，说句“是，主人”给我听听。很好。 如果配方不合它的要求，它会自己把里面的东西倒掉。 少女的血、母亲的眼泪和老妪的骨头。这将炼出上好的药剂。 它会不停地旋转，直到我念出咒语为止。 女巫夜间出行最好的伙伴。我今天要飞去哪儿呢？ 我用这垃圾能施放出什么法术？ 一把狐火绽放，揭示出了看不见的事物。 烟与灰，火焰与闪光。我将为你编织一个美丽的幻象。 我有足够的东西来让你短暂的一生尽可能痛苦。 这根本没人看得懂！罚你不准吃零食，戈尔莫！ 嗯，好，我可以利用这个。好样的，戈尔莫。 它只有在我的手里才会转动。 适合用来囚禁小型生物，使它们屈从我的意志。 这靴子只配给替补角色穿。 如果我要登上舞台，那我就要风采尽显。 所有人的目光都得在我身上——否则有你们好受的。 对一个有秘密的女人来说，扇子是必不可少的，而我有这么多秘密…… 我不是裁缝，这些东西对我来说就跟死了一样。 这件长袍的样式、颜色和剪裁全都符合我的心意。 我传导着恶意与幽暗之力。 奶奶送我的礼物。它能烧掉多余之物。 邪恶魔法使用者斯凯拉的可怕力量来自于臭名昭著的大鬼婆和“女巫之母”——雅加婆婆。作为一个临时的盟友，斯凯拉眼里只有力量和别人对她的赞誉，甚至将“恶念联会”的同伴都视作有需要时可以利用和抛弃的工具。斯凯拉会以魔法诡术迷惑敌人，运用妖精荒野那难以捉摸的混沌之力来催眠那些阻碍她实现自己目标的敌人，使他们失去活动能力， 斯凯拉用她的法杖攻击一名随机敌人一次，再电击另一名随机敌人一次。 斯凯拉施放催眠图纹，使受到攻击的敌人承受更多伤害，并短暂眩晕他们。 斯凯拉施放催眠图纹，使受到攻击的敌人在效果持续期间额外承受基于基础杀招伤害的伤害。此外，敌人会被眩晕，直到他们受到伤害为止。

body.en: When Stoki attacks she gains a Focus Point for each enemy she hits. She increases the damage of all Champions with a base attack cooldown of 4.0s or faster by % for each Focus Point she has, stacking multiplicatively. Focus Points cap at and are reduced by 50% (rounded down) when changing areas. Focus Points: Stoki gains Focus Points when she attacks and works best with Champions that attack quickly. Enemies that have been attacked by Stoki at any point in the current area drop 100% more gold when killed for each Focus Point she has, stacking additively. Enemies that Stoki attacks drop additional gold when they are killed, based on Stoki's Focus Points. Stoki keeps track of the total Focus Points she has gained in the current adventure. If Stoki's Focus Points are capped for a given area, she still counts new ones towards this ability. Upon reaching certain milestones, the following effects activate: - 100 Focus Points: Encouragement - Champions adjacent to Stoki have their base attack cooldowns lowered by s.^- 1000 Focus Points: Flurry of Blows - For every 1000 levels Stoki has, she attacks an additional target with each attack. She prefers to attack different targets, but will attack the same target multiple times if she has already attacked everyone.^- 5000 Focus Points: Leadership - Champions adjacent to Stoki have a 0.45% chance to reset their base attack cooldown after attacking for each Focus Point she currently has. Caps at 90%.^- 12500 Focus Points: Overflow - When Stoki attacks an enemy that she already attacked, there is a % chance the enemy will be stunned for seconds.^- 25000 Focus Points: Explosion - If Stoki hits the same enemy two or more times with the same base attack, power radiates from the enemy, dealing seconds worth of BUD damage to itself and all other nearby enemies. Triggers with each extra hit. Encouragement - Champions adjacent to Stoki have their base attack cooldowns lowered by s. Flurry of Blows - For every 1000 levels Stoki has, she attacks an additional target with each attack. She prefers to attack different targets, but will attack the same target multiple times if she has already attacked everyone.^Bonus Attack Targets: Leadership - Champions adjacent to Stoki have a % chance to reset their base attack cooldown after attacking. Caps at 90%. Overflow - When Stoki attacks an enemy that she already attacked, there is a % chance the enemy will be stunned for seconds. Explosion - If Stoki hits the same enemy two or more times with the same base attack, power radiates from the enemy, dealing seconds worth of BUD damage to itself and all other nearby enemies. Triggers with each extra hit. Stoki additively increases the Focus Points cap of Focused Strike by 10 for each Champion in the formation whose base attack cooldown is 4.0s or lower. Stoki tracks the number of attacks her allies have performed in the past 10 seconds and increases the effect of Focused Strike by 15% for each one, stacking multiplicatively. Stoki counts on her fast attacking allies to get the job done quickly. Stoki counts the number of Champions in the formation with a DEX score of 16 or higher. For each such Champion, her base attack cooldown is decreased by 0.1 seconds, stacking additively, and the effect of Focused Strike is increased by 100%, stacking multiplicatively. Champions in Formation Targeted: Stoki is a star player when her nimble teammates set the pace. Stoki reduces the base attack cooldown of all Champions with a default base attack cooldown of 6.0 seconds or higher to 4.0 seconds so that they qualify for Frenzied Friends. Their damage is increased by 100% for each 0.1 seconds their base attack cooldown is reduced by this ability, stacking multiplicatively. Increases the damage of by %. Reduces the cooldown of 's Base Attack by seconds. Stoki sharpens the slowest to strike with speed, switching sluggish swings into swift sweeps. I'll never be selfish again. I will train you to sharpen your focus. Any money I earn goes to the monastery. Life brings us all a little luck. I've never been more sure of what's right in my life. My training began with one hundred strikes each dawn. Channel their ferocity. Offer no hesitation. Don't lose sight of what lies ahead. We can't afford to waste time on distractions. The monastery could do with some improvements. Even monks deserve a little luxury sometimes. Again! Faster! A precise blow to the right area can paralyze a foe. Twist the wrist just so to prolong the numbing effect. Release the energy when the moment is right. Patience... There is so much more to learn. I must continue my training. The monk's path is one of absolute dedication without end. A monk's training demands graceful movement. I will demonstrate. Fear the monk who has practiced one punch ten thousand times. I like cake too much to really be comfortable in this belt. The monks didn't let me bring much with me, except this. There's more to this belt than meets the eye. I'll never talk about the day I got this belt. Kind of defeats the purpose, doesn't it? I can't see! Wait, no, that's the point. The monks made me wear this during my training. A trophy from my time at the monastery. I'd rather not stand out, to be honest. A little worse for wear from years of unarmed combat. Forged near a Chultan volcano. I can really take my time to think things over. A hand-sown hand-me-down. Granted to all new disciples of the Even-Handed. Robes bearing the colors of the Order of the Even-Handed. I remember the day I earned the right to wear these robes... The soles are a bit tough, but otherwise they're functional. As comfortable for walking as they are for standing or sitting. Flashy, for a monk, but I'm still a gnome, you know. All but my most perceptive foes are ignorant to my approach. I've tried binding it back together, but it's not very sturdy. I've walked a long way with this staff. No matter how far you walk, you'll always end up back where you started. It is much easier to focus with this ancient staff. Stami Gackle was a fun-loving and reckless youth, but she fled her home when this carefree nature invited tragic loss into her life. She found shelter in Waterdeep with the monks of the Order of the Even-Handed, who gave her a new name and trained her in their ways. Now a capable adventurer, Stoki approaches problems with intense focus and careful consideration, having earned a reputation for being uncommonly stoic. However, Stoki's patient demeanor belies a warrior's ferocity, as she unleashes a rapid flurry of masterful blows to any foe who refuses to back down. Stoki leaps out and attacks random enemies with her fists. Stoki leaps around the screen attacking random enemies and causing damage over time. Stoki leaps out and attacks five random enemies with extremely powerful palm thrusts. Over the next 10 seconds, all affected enemies take massive damage over time. body.zh: 当斯托吉攻击时，她每击中一名敌人，就会获得 1 点专注点数。她每拥有 1 点专注点数，就会使所有基本攻击冷却时间为 4.0 秒或更短的勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。专注点数的上限为 点，并且在改变区域时会减少 50%（向下取整）。 专注点数： 斯托吉在攻击时会获得专注点数，并且她与攻速快的勇士配合得最好。 斯托吉每拥有 1 点专注点数，她任何时候在当前区域攻击过的敌人在被击杀时就会多掉落 100% 的金币，以加算方式堆叠。 根据斯托吉的专注点数，被她攻击过的敌人在被击杀时会掉落额外的金币。 斯托吉会记录她在当前冒险中获得的专注点数总数。如果斯托吉在某一特定区域的专注点数达到了上限，她仍会将新的点数计入这项技能。在达到一定的里程碑时，会激活以下效果： - 100 点专注点数：鼓舞——斯托吉相邻的勇士基本攻击冷却时间减少 秒。^- 1000 点专注点数：疾风连击——斯托吉每升 1000 级，她的每次攻击会额外攻击一个目标。她偏向攻击不同的目标，但如果所有敌人她都攻击过了，她会多次攻击同一个目标。^- 5000 点专注点数：领导力——斯托吉当前每拥有 1 点专注点数，她相邻的勇士就有 0.45% 的几率在攻击后重置他们的基本攻击冷却时间。上限为 90%。^- 12500 点专注点数：泛滥——当斯托吉攻击一个她已经攻击过的敌人时，有 % 的几率使该敌人眩晕 秒。^- 25000 点专注点数：爆炸——如果斯托吉用相同的基本攻击击中同一个敌人两次或两次以上，能量会从该敌人身上放射出去，对其自身和所有其他附近的敌人造成相当于 秒基础杀招伤害的伤害。每次额外击中都会触发。 鼓舞——斯托吉相邻的勇士基本攻击冷却时间减少 秒。 疾风连击——斯托吉每升 1000 级，她的每次攻击会额外攻击一个目标。她偏向攻击不同的目标，但如果所有敌人她都攻击过了，她会多次攻击同一个目标。^额外攻击目标： 领导力——斯托吉相邻的勇士有 % 的几率在攻击后重置他们的基本攻击冷却时间。上限为 90%。 泛滥——当斯托吉攻击一个她已经攻击过的敌人时，有 % 的几率使该敌人眩晕 秒。 爆炸——如果斯托吉用相同的基本攻击击中同一个敌人两次或两次以上，能量会从该敌人身上放射出去，对其自身和所有其他附近的敌人造成相当于 秒基础杀招伤害的伤害。每次额外击中都会触发。 阵型中每有一位勇士的基本攻击冷却时间为 4.0 秒或更短，斯托吉会使“专注打击”的专注点数上限增加 10 点，以加算方式堆叠。 斯托吉会记录她的盟友在过去的 10 秒内攻击的次数，盟友们每攻击一次，她会使“专注打击”的效果增加 15%，以乘算方式堆叠。 斯托吉依靠她快速攻击的盟友迅速完成任务。 斯托吉会统计阵型中敏捷大于等于 16 的勇士的数量。每有一名这样的勇士，她的基本攻击冷却时间就减少 0.1 秒，以加算方式堆叠，并且“专注打击”的效果增加 100%，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 当斯托吉敏捷的队友掌握进攻节奏时，她是一名明星选手。 斯托吉会使所有基本攻击冷却时间为 6.0 秒或更久的勇士的基本攻击冷却时间缩短为 4.0 秒，以便他们符合“狂热好友”的条件。他们的基本攻击冷却时间每被此技能缩短 0.1 秒，他们的伤害就提高 100%，以乘算方式堆叠。 使 的伤害提升 %。 使 的基本攻击冷却时间缩短 秒。 斯托吉会提高攻击最慢的人的攻击速度，使缓慢的挥击变成迅猛的扫击。 我再也不会自私了。 我会训练你，让你的注意力更集中。 我赚的所有钱都给了修道院。 生活能给我们所有人带来一点运气。 我从未如此确定，我生命里什么是对的。 我的训练从每天黎明一百次击打开始。 释放它们的凶猛，不要有丝毫犹豫。 眼睛要始终盯着前方。 我们可不能把时间浪费在让人分心的事情上。 修道院需要修缮一下。 即使是武僧，有时也该小小奢侈一把。 再来！再快一点！ 对准正确区域来一记精准打击可以麻痹敌人。 扭动手腕以延长麻木的效果。 在合适的时机释放能量。要有耐心…… 要学的东西还有很多，我必须继续我的训练。 武僧之路是一条没有尽头的绝对奉献之路。 武僧的训练必须动作优雅。我来示范一下。 Fear the monk who has practiced one punch ten thousand times. 我太爱吃蛋糕了，穿这腰带一点都不舒服。 出门时僧侣们也没给我准备什么东西，就只有这个玩意。 这腰带不可貌相呀。 我永远不会告诉人这条腰带的来历。 这似乎有点多此一举了，不是吗？ 糟了，我什么也看不见！等一下，蒙眼布本来就是这个作用呀。 每次训练时僧侣都会让我戴上它。 这是我在修道院时获得的奖励。 俗话说得好，财不露白。 经历多年的徒手战斗，难免有点磨损了。 这是在楚尔特某座火山附近铸造而成的。 让我有更充分的时间去思考人生。 二手的手缝长袍。 授予所有公平者新学徒之物。 以公平者教会的颜色为主题的长袍。 我还记得当初晋级获得此长袍的那天...... 鞋底有点粗糙，但还是可以穿的。 无论是坐下、行走、还是站立，都一样的舒适。 对于僧侣来说是华丽了一点，但我可还是一位侏儒唷。 哪怕是耳听八方的敌人也难以察觉我的脚步声。 我曾经试图把它缝合回去，但是却不太牢固。 我曾经拄着它行走过很多地方。 无论走多远的路，最终都会回到出发点。 这根古老的法杖让我更容易保持专注。 丝塔米·贾克尔是一个爱玩且鲁莽的年轻人，但在她这无牵无挂的个性给她的生活带来了悲剧性的损失之后，她逃离了她的家乡。她在深水城得到了公平者教会武僧的庇护，他们给她取了新的名字，并以他们的方式训练她。现在，斯托吉已经成为了一名能干的冒险者，她在处理问题时总是高度专注且深思熟虑，她也因其非同寻常的坚忍而声名远扬。然而，斯托吉坚忍的外表下隐藏着战士的凶猛，对于任何不肯退却的敌人，她会发动一连串迅猛的打击。 斯托吉跳起并用拳头攻击随机敌人。 斯托吉在屏幕中跳来跳去，攻击随机敌人并造成持续伤害。 斯托吉跳来跳去并用极强力的掌击攻击 5 名随机敌人。在接下来的 10 秒内，所有受影响的敌人将受到高额持续伤害。

body.en: Ishi always attacks 0.25 seconds faster than the fastest member of the formation, or every 6 seconds if nobody else is in the formation. Ishi's damage is increased by % for each non-human in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Ishi's damage is increased by having non-humans in the formation. Stack your formation with other species to buff her! Ishi increases the party's gold find by % for each non-human Champion, stacking multiplicatively. Ishi increases the party's gold find when she's with lots of non-humans. Ishi's damage is increased by % for each Aasimar, Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Halfling, and Half-Elf Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Relevant Champions: Ishi's damage is increased for each Champion in the formation that comes from a traditional heroic template. Ishi's damage is increased by % for each Dragonborn, Goliath, Orc, Tiefling, and Half-Orc Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Relevant Champions: Ishi's damage is increased for each Champion in the formation that is feared by the old and traditional. Ishi's damage is increased by % for each Champion in the formation that is not a Standard species, stacking multiplicatively. Standard species are Aasimar, Dragonborn, Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goliath, Halfling, Human, Orc, Tiefling, Half-Orc, and Half-Elf. Relevant Champions: Ishi's damage is increased for each Champion in the formation that is of a species that is not commonly seen as an adventurer. Ishi increases the effect of Let's Find Some Treasure by % for every seconds it has been since Ishi attacked but did not kill an enemy, stacking multiplicatively up to times. Ishi keeps track of the number of attacks she has made in the last minute. She increases her damage by % for each attack, stacking multiplicatively. Every day Ishi gains Duel To The Death stacks. When Ishi has an available Duel To The Death stack, and gets the killing blow on a boss that drops a loot sack, there is a % chance that she will consume a Duel To The Death stack and claim a piece of that boss's equipment as her own, granting item levels to a piece of her equipment at random. Ishi can store up to Duel To The Death stacks at once. Ishi fights well for an ADVENTURER, not just a kobold! Ishi never lets go of anything! Ishi is a good supporter. Very selfless. Ishi is an excellent leader! You want MORE gold!? Ishi helps! You like gold? Ishi has gold! Ishi loves sharing! A monster is just a friend Ishi hasn't met yet. Ishi thinks monsters are people too! We're stronger together! Let's show humans what we can do! Humans always throw out the best stuff. Ishi knows treasure is EVERYWHERE. Ishi knows where to look. One stab, two stabs, three stabs, four... Ishi has friends in MANY places. Want to meet them? Five stabs, six stabs, seven stabs, MORE! Ishi believes in the power of friendship. Ishi show you. Ishi has MANY friends, and always making more! Ishi is very smart. Ishi reads books. Sometimes. Blade? Check. Handle? Check. I'm good. I won it at a game of Three-Dragon Ante. With this rapier, I'll look super awesome and everyone will take me seriously. Right? First in means first to the glory! See, the air flows right through. It's breezy! I found it in a bin behind the Yawning Portal. It fits me better this way. I got lucky when I won this cape, but they don't need to know that! I look like an adventurer already! If I hold my head at this angle, it looks totally normal! I want to be flashy, but I don't have enough gold. They'll see me coming when I wear this regal hat! It's from an old friend. You may have heard of him. See, you just have to imagine the RTU between the A and the S. It got ripped. You see, this one time we found a ring. . . I keep this near me, just in case I need to call on Artus Cimber. Come on Nub-Ub. He didn't really mean you were dinner tonight. Doesn't he look fierce! This is Nub-Ub. It means little pig in Kobold. This mouse is a bit too lucky, even for me. Does he have a higher calling? Rations are better when they are moist. Oh. Sure it's holy. Yep. Just wait till I leave to test it out. Don't mind the lint. It adds flavor. Littlefox likes it, and that's all that matters to me. Ishi Snaggletooth hails from a warren of Kobolds living in the sewers under Baldur's Gate. Always the type to be more curious than careful, she accidentally stowed away on a ship headed to Port Nyanzaru. There, she met her dear friend, the Firbolg Littlefox. Often shunned by humans, Ishi hopes to prove herself as a true hero however she can. Ishi's biggest claim to fame is the defeat of the known swordsman, Hershel Von Saberburg, and since that day she's touted herself as a renowned duelist to anyone that'll listen to her. Ishi attacks the front-most enemy a quarter second faster than anyone else. Ishi attacks the front-most enemy. She always attacks 0.25 seconds faster than the fastest member of the formation, or every 6 seconds if she is the only Champion For 30 seconds, Ishi's damage is increased by 100% for each non-human in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. For 30 seconds, Ishi's damage is increased by 100% for each non-human in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. The duration extends when Ishi lands the killing blow on a boss. Ishi's damage is increased for each non-human Champion in the formation. Ishi increase's the party's gold find for each non-human Champion adjacent to her. Increases the damage of all Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Female Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Kobold Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a CON score of 11 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a INT score of 11 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation with a GOOD alignment
body.zh: 伊希的攻击速度总是比阵型中最快的成员还要快 0.25 秒。如果阵型中没有其他勇士，则她每 6 秒发动一次攻击。 阵型中每有一位非人类勇士，伊希的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中的非人类勇士会提高伊希的伤害。将其他种族的勇士编入阵型，以强化她的力量！ 阵型中每有一位非人类勇士，伊希会使探险队的金币寻获量提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 当伊希与很多非人类勇士在一起时，她会增加队伍的金币寻获量。 阵型中每有一个神裔、矮人、精灵、侏儒、半身人和半精灵勇士，伊希的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 相关勇士： 阵型中每有一位出自传统英雄模板的勇士，伊希的伤害会提高。 阵型中每有一个龙裔、巨人、兽人、提夫林和半兽人勇士，伊希的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 相关勇士： 阵型中每有一位老派传统人士惧怕的勇士，伊希的伤害会提高。 阵型中每有一个不是标准种族的勇士，伊希的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。标准种族是指神裔、龙裔、矮人、精灵、侏儒、巨人、半身人、人类、兽人、提夫林、半兽人和半精灵。 相关勇士： 阵型中每有一位冒险中不常见种族的勇士，伊希的伤害会提高。 在伊希发动攻击但没有击杀敌人后，每隔 秒，伊希会使“寻找宝藏吧”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 次。 伊希会记录她在过去一分钟内攻击的次数。每有一次攻击，她会使她的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 每天伊希会获得 层“决斗至死”层数。当伊希有可用的“决斗至死”层数，并且秒杀了一个会掉落战利品口袋的首领时，她有 % 的几率消耗一层“决斗至死”层数，将该首领的一件装备据为己有，并随机赋予她的一件装备 物品等级。伊希一次最多可以储存 层“决斗至死”层数。 即使作为冒险者而不只是狗头人，伊希的战斗力也很强！ 伊希从不放弃任何事！ 伊希是很棒的支援者，非常无私。 伊希是位卓越的首领！ 你想要更多金子吗！？伊希可以帮你！ 你喜欢黄金？伊希有黄金！伊希喜欢分享！ 怪物不过是伊希还没结识的朋友。 伊希认为怪物也是人！ 团结就是力量！让人类瞧瞧我们的本事吧！ 人类总是把最好的东西丢掉。 伊希知道宝藏无处不在。伊希知道要去哪里找。 一刀、两刀、三刀、四…… 伊希在很多地方都有朋友。想见见他们吗？ 五刀、六刀、七刀，再来！ 伊希相信友谊的力量。伊希展示给你看。 伊希有很多朋友，而且还一直在结交更多的朋友！ 伊希非常聪明。伊希有读书的，有时候会读。 刀刃？有。刀柄？有。行，没问题。 这是我在某次三龙牌局中赢回来的。 只要举起这把西洋剑，大家就会被我的凌厉气势所慑服。对吧？ 先出手者得先机！ 瞧，冷风能够通过披风直吹后背。多么的清爽！ 这是我在裂隙传送门后面的垃圾桶里找到的。 这个好像比较合身。 当初我全凭着运气才赢得到这件披肩的，不过这种事没必要告诉大家！ 整个人顿时有了一股冒险者的气势！ 只要我的头维持在这个倾斜的角度，那搭配这顶帽子看起来就不会别扭了！ 我想要打扮得精致一点，但是身上的金币不够。 戴上这顶宫廷帽子，肯定会吸引到大家的注意力！ 这是某位老朋友的，你或许也认识他。 瞧，“阿”跟“斯”之间的那个字你得自己猜。因为被撕破了所以看不见。 这是某次我们发现了一枚戒指...... 我一直把它带在身上，以防万一须要向阿图斯·西姆贝尔求助。 不要怕阿布。他并不是说要把你做成晚餐。 阿布是不是很有气势？ 这位是阿布，它的名字在狗头人语中意味着小猪。 这老鼠是开了挂吗？难道它是有什么隐藏的身份？ 潮湿的干粮更加美味。 噢，很神圣的样子。待会我就尝尝看。 不必在意那些棉绒，就当作是为汤加料吧。 小狐狸最爱喝了，其他的我都不在乎。 伊希·碎齿来自博德之门下水道中的狗头人巢穴。好奇心大于谨慎的她，意外偷渡到了一艘前往南扎路港的船上。在那里她遇到了她亲密的朋友：名叫小狐狸的隐逸巨人。人类经常对伊希避而远之，而她希望通过自己的努力，来证明自己是一个真正的英雄。伊希最出名的成就，就是打败了著名的剑客赫谢尔·冯·赛博伯格。从那天起，她会向任何愿意听她说话的人吹嘘自己是个著名的决斗者。 伊希会以比任何人都快四分之一秒的速度攻击最前方的敌人。 伊希攻击最前方的敌人，她总是比阵型中最快的成员还要快 0.25 秒。如果她是唯一的勇士，则每 6 秒发动一次攻击。 阵型中每有一位非人类勇士，伊希的伤害提高 100%，以乘算方式堆叠，持续 30 秒。 阵型中每有一位非人类勇士，伊希的伤害提高 100%，以乘算方式堆叠，持续 30 秒。当伊希秒杀了一个首领，持续时间会延长。 阵型中每有一位非人类勇士，伊希的伤害都会获得提升。 伊希每与一位非人类勇士相邻，即提升队伍的金币获得量。

body.en: Whenever Briv comes under attack metal shoots out of his pores and covers him in strong armor. While armored, Briv takes % less damage and gains stacks of Steelbones whenever he is hit by an enemy attack. Briv stores power whenever he takes damage and uses it to buff the party and Sprint forward. Briv increases the damage of all Champions behind him by % for each stack of Steelbones he has gained. Increases the Damage of by % Briv has a chance of sprinting forward quickly on steel-springs after completing a new area. This action consumes % of his Sprint stacks, and requires at least stacks to occur. When you reset the adventure, all stacks of Steelbones that Briv has gained convert into stacks of Sprint. Unused Sprint stacks persist through resets.^ Briv sprints forward quickly on steel-springs after completing a new area, skipping the next areas entirely; Briv has a % chance to skip the next areas instead. This action consumes % of his Sprint stacks, and requires at least stacks to occur.^ Briv sprints forward quickly on steel-springs after completing a new area, skipping the next area entirely; Briv has a % to skip the next areas instead. This action consumes % of his Sprint stacks, and requires at least stacks to occur.^ Briv has a % chance of sprinting forward quickly on steel-springs after completing a new area, skipping the next area entirely. This action consumes % of his Sprint stacks, and requires at least stacks to occur.^ Briv's pet flumph Phlo appears next to Briv and telepathically stores healing power whenever Briv is hit. After hits or seconds, whichever comes first, Phlo heals all Champions in the party for % of the damage Briv took during that time.^ Briv's pet flumph, Phlo, tracks the damage that Briv takes and then heals the party using the tracked amount. Briv increases the max health of all other Champions by % of his max health. Unnatural Haste uses 20% less Sprint stacks whenever it procs (3.2% of stacks instead of 4% of stacks). With more efficient use of his metal reserves, Briv can Sprint further on each run. A lifetime of training allows Briv to buff his companions even further. Briv's companion Phlo heals the party a larger percentage of the damage Briv takes. Mine allies needeth assistance! A half-orc champion leading the charge in glory. HA! Mine power is unmatched! Mine blood floweth with the strength of mine enemies! Who needeth a shield? We hath dealt with worse! Thou wantest a fight? A fight ye shall have! I shall take mine time. Thou canst not deceive me! I am always ready to do battle! Everyone follow me - it's the only assured victory. Have at thee! Mine mighty legs could go farther, but there is wisdom in restraint. Mine mighty footfalls shalt resoundeth throughout all the land! A true warrior leapeth only when he knoweth where he shall land. Mine durability rivaleth even Baatorian green steel! ' tis mine now! Briv smiled as he raised it high above his head and shouted: 'Huzzah'! Thou dost need a savage paladin! If you see someone atop a griffon with this sword in hand, you should probably run. Here friend. Consume and groweth stout like me. ' tis meat! Eat up, mine friends! It shall increase thine constitution. Or killeth thee... Perhaps I should go first. 'tis neither owl, nor bear. 'tis most wondrous! Sweat? Nay. 'tis the steel of the Netherese! The steel floweth from mine pores when I needeth it for protection. A remnant of oppression, yet a talisman of mine own power. 'tis hard to reconcile. Briv is one with the armor. The armor is one with Briv. If thou canst pull a wagon, thou canst pull a Briv! Yah! Stand fast steed. Thou may perish, but the stories they shall tell of thine demise! Diplomacy sometimes requireth a griffon abduction. Dragon Rider. Check! Mine bucket list now lieth fallow. ' tis bigger on the inside. Oh! 'tis just a pouch! I keep mine goblin trinkets inside. Dost not all bags yell when opened? Oh. I shall remove the Hobgoblin. ' tis mine own secret, not thine! I seeketh less talk and more action. The Order 'tis as close to a family as I have had. Before now. Mine spit has magical properties. Mine challenges have led me to mine purpose. Relentlessly brave but markedly uncouth, Briv Steelmarrow is a stalwart champion of the weak, innocent, downtrodden, and oppressed. Centuries ago, a cabal of Netherese mages experimented on Briv's clan, gifting him with a magical metal inside his bones that he can pull through his skin and shape for attack or defense. Once a bloodthirsty raider, Briv sought atonement by joining the Order of the Lost Cause, an elite group of knights that travel across Faerûn, taking on quests that only fools would pursue. Briv cleaves a random enemy with his greatsword. Each enemy hit has a 20% chance of being taunted, switching its target to Briv. Briv cleaves a random enemy with his greatsword. Each enemy hit has a 20% chance of being taunted, switching its target to Briv. Briv forces all of his remaining Netherese Metal out of his body, damaging enemies that it passes through. Briv forces all of his remaining Netherese Metal out of his body, shooting it out in an arc in front of him and damaging all enemies that it passes through. He then draws it all back into himself, dealing double damage to enemies that it hits on its way back. Whenever Briv comes under attack metal shoots out of his pores and covers him in strong armor. Hits he takes while armored increase Champion damage. Briv has a chance of sprinting forward quickly on steel-springs after completing a new area, skipping the next area entirely. body.zh: 布里夫受到攻击时，会从毛孔中释放出金属，化作坚硬的护甲对他进行保护。处于装甲状态时，布里夫受到的伤害减少 %，并且在每次被敌人击中时会堆叠钢骨状态 布里夫每次受到伤害时都会储存能量，并用来强化队伍及向前冲刺。 布里夫每获得一层钢骨堆叠层数，就为处于他身后的所有勇士提高 % 的伤害 使 的伤害提高 % 在完成一个新区域后，布里夫有几率使用钢丝弹簧迅速向前冲刺。此动作将消耗他冲刺堆叠层数的 % ，并且至少需要 层堆叠才能发动。当你重置冒险时，布里夫获得的所有钢骨层数都会转化为冲刺层数。未使用的冲刺层数重置冒险后会保留。^ 在完成一个新区域后，布里夫会使用钢丝弹簧迅速向前冲刺，彻底跳过下 个区域；布里夫有 % 几率跳过下 个区域。此动作将消耗他冲刺堆叠层数的 % ，并且至少需要 层堆叠才能发动。^ 在完成一个新区域后，布里夫会使用钢丝弹簧迅速向前冲刺，彻底跳过下一个区域；布里夫有 % 几率跳过下 个区域。此动作将消耗他冲刺堆叠层数的 % ，并且至少需要 层堆叠才能发动。^ 在完成一个新区域后，布里夫有 % 几率使用钢丝弹簧迅速向前冲刺，彻底跳过下一个区域。此动作将消耗他冲刺堆叠层数的 % ，并且至少需要 层堆叠才能发动。^ 布里夫的宠物毛绒弗洛出现在布里夫身边，并利用心灵感应在布里夫被攻击时为其储存治愈能量。在布里夫被攻击 次或经过 秒后（以先满足条件者为准），弗洛为队伍中的所有英雄回复布里夫当时所受到伤害的 %^ 布里夫的宠物毛绒弗洛追踪布里夫受到的伤害，然后根据追踪到的数值治疗队伍。 布里夫提升其他所有勇士的最大生命值，数值相当于他自身最大生命值的 % 异常加速发动时，使用的冲刺堆叠层数减少 20%（使用 3.2% 堆叠层数代替 4% 堆叠层数） 布里夫更高效地利用他的金属储备，在每个关卡中冲刺得更远。 坚持不懈的训练让布里夫可以进一步强化他的伙伴。 布里夫的伙伴弗洛根据布里夫承受的伤害治疗队伍的比例提高。 我的盟友需要帮忙！ 一个半兽人勇士，为了荣耀带头冲锋。 哈！ 我的力量，无可匹敌！ 我的鲜血，因敌人的力量而澎湃！ 谁需要盾牌？ 我们经历过更糟的！ 你要战？那便战吧！ 我会慢慢来。 你骗不了我！我时刻都做好了战斗准备！ 所有人跟我来--只有这样才能赢。 看招！ 我强健的双腿本可以走得更远，但克制是有智慧的表现。 我巨大的脚步声将响彻大地！ 真正的战士只有在他知道他会在哪儿落地的情况下才会跳跃。 我的耐用程度甚至不逊于巴托青钢！ 现在是我的了！ 布里夫笑着把剑高举到头上喊道：“好哇”！ 你们需要的是一位拯救你们的圣武士！ 要是碰见手中握着此剑骑乘一头狮鹫的人出现，你或许该逃跑了。 拿去吧朋友。多吃肉就会成长到我这样结实。 这是肉！快吃吧，我的朋友们！ 它要么会为你补充营养。要么会要了你的命......或许还是我先来吧。 此物非枭亦非熊。此乃神物也！ 流汗？非也。此乃耐瑟之钢！ 当我需要保护时，我的毛孔就会流出钢铁。 这既是受压迫留下来的残留物，同时也是我的护身符。真的很难调和。 布里夫与护甲合一。护甲与布里夫同在。 你要是拉不动马车，那就拉不动布里夫！耶！ 坚持住马儿。你或许会阵亡，但你牺牲的故事将会流传千古！ 有时候外交交涉会涉及到拐带狮鹫。 龙骑士。有！我的人生目标达成了。 里头的空间似乎更大。 哦！这只是个小包而已！我都是用来收藏地精小饰品的。 你们的包包打开时不会发出叫声的吗？哦我知道了。我忘了把大地精放出来。 这是我的私人秘密，不是你的！ 我主张少说话多行动。 在此之前，骑士团是我所拥有的最亲近的家庭了。 我的吐息是有魔力的。 生命中的挑战引领我找到了我人生的目标。 布里夫·钢髓勇敢无畏，但又不苟言笑。他是弱者、无辜者和被压迫者的坚定靠山。几个世纪前，一群耐瑟瑞尔法师在布里夫的部族进行了实验，在他的骨骼中赋予了他一种神奇金属。他可以通过皮肤拉出这种金属，用于攻击或防御。布里夫曾是一个嗜血的劫掠者，通过加入“失落事业骑士团”来寻求救赎。这是一个由骑士组成的精英团体，他们穿越费伦，接受那些只有傻瓜才会做的任务。 布里夫用他的大剑顺劈一名随机敌人。被命中的敌人有 20% 几率被嘲讽，将其攻击目标切换为布里夫。 布里夫用他的大剑顺劈一名随机敌人。被命中的敌人有 20% 几率被嘲讽，将其攻击目标切换为布里夫。 布里夫将剩余的耐瑟钢逼出体外，对穿过的所有敌人造成伤害。 布里夫将剩余的耐瑟钢逼出体外，向自身前方的弧形范围发射，对穿过的所有敌人造成伤害。随后他会将耐瑟钢再吸回体内，对返回时命中的敌人造成双倍伤害。 每当布里夫受到攻击时，会从毛孔中释放出金属，化作坚硬的护甲对他进行保护。处于护甲状态时受到攻击会提升勇士的伤害。 在完成一个新区域后，布里夫有几率使用钢丝弹簧迅速向前冲刺，彻底跳过下一个区域。

body.en: Increases Dhadius' damage and the damage of Champions with 12 or more intelligence within 2 slots of Dhadius by % for each Champion in the formation affected by this ability, stacking multiplicatively. Increases Dhadius' damage and the damage of Champions with 14 or more intelligence within 2 slots of Dhadius by % for each Champion in the formation affected by this ability, stacking multiplicatively. Dhadius increases the damage of himself and intelligent Champions near him Enemies hit by a Chromatic Orb are debuffed based on the orb's type (acid, frost, or fire). Each debuff increases the damage of subsequent orbs of the same type by %, stacking multiplicatively. Enemies can have up to debuffs of each type; debuffs do not expire. Dhadius's damage increases the more times enemies are hit by the same color of orb Dhadius keeps track of the total number of sets of all three orb types he has cast in the current area. Dhadius increases the effect of Skill Empowerment by % for each set, stacking multiplicatively and capping at stacks. The effect of Skill Empowerment is increased by % for each Champion in the formation with a Magic base attack, stacking multiplicatively. Number of Magic Attackers: Dhadius will show the other magic users in the formation a thing or two about being a wizard. The effect of Skill Empowerment is increased by % for each Champion in the formation that does not have a Magic base attack, stacking multiplicatively. Number of Non-Magic Attackers: Dhadius has become the best magic user in the formation... by ensuring that there are no other magic users in the formation. Chromatic Orbs now deal % more damage in an area. Dhadius empowers his chromatic orbs to explode and deal more damage. Increases the effect of Skill Empowerment by % Skill Empowerment increases the damage of intelligent Champions by even more. Dhadius reduces the required Intelligence of Skill Empowerment to 12 and higher. Dhadius decides to lower his standards... Just this once. Adept? That's an insult to great Dhadius! Elementalist? More like elemental master! Who names these things? Selfless! Of course! And they call me an ego maniac? Leader? Yes. Yes, I suppose I am. A great one, at that. Only the most intelligent can be my students. I'll tell you when practice is done! A smarter fighter is a victorious fighter! I read that in an ancient tome once. You wouldn't have read it... Why change what's already worked? You might want to put your smoke goggles on for this. I guess both magic and non-magic are good... Just get the job done! I trust you can win a fight. Even if you're not all that smart. An embarrassment to belts everywhere. A belt for someone who spends too much time reading and not enough time being amazing. Adequate for a wizard from the coast, perhaps, but not someone as great as Dhadius! I certainly am that. A bracer for a lesser mage. I object to wearing it, honestly. Provides some deflection, I suppose. Not that I need it. Empowers my already formidable magical abilities. Well, if you say so. It'll do until I can get back into my usual wardrobe. It's not mine, I'm just borrowing it. Velvet is the hallmark of impressive wizards, you know. I am respected, aren't I? In the hands of an amazing wizard such as myself, even a simple ring can be powerful. It may not look like much - or be much, for that matter - but it's mine, so it's impressive. Just a single touch can turn a man to ice. Or make them somewhat chilly, at least. Not that I have to prove myself to anyone. Nothing a little ingenuity can't fix. If your staff isn't glowing, you're not wizarding right. Shining like the statue of me in the Luskan harbour will be. Once I get my due. Are you sure 'legendary' is the right word? It seems too simple to me. The Arcane Brotherhood's symbol should never be displayed so dimly. It's a little difficult to handle. Shocks you when you touch it. A wonderful symbol of the Brotherhood. I certainly wouldn't want to assume a rank, but that sounds about right. Dhadius is a mage of legendary status and acclaim (at least, in his own mind), who sees everyone else as intellectual worms. Being an egomaniac, he seeks out esoteric lore and rare magical secrets so he may know things that the 'common fools' do not. Dhadius hails from Luskan in the north, where he is a member of the Arcane Brotherhood, an infamous group of wizards. He joined them only recently and hasn't been taken as seriously by the others as he thinks he should be. He's determined to let it be known far and wide that he is a wizard to be respected and feared. Dhadius tosses a Chromatic orb with a random element at the nearest enemy. Dhadius summons a storm of Magic Missiles. Dhadius summons a storm of Magic Missiles - one for every enemy, plus a few extras for good measure. Dhadius casts a Skill Empowerment spell but rolls poorly, allowing nearby Champions to also increase their damage if they have an intelligence stat of 14 or higher Dhadius increases the damage of each successive orb of the same element by 50% Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Male Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Human Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a CHA score of 11 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions with a INT score of 15 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Magic Champion in the formation
body.zh: 根据阵型中受此技能影响的勇士人数，每名提升戴迪亚斯和其周围 2 栏位距离内所有之力大于等于 12 的勇士的伤害 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 根据阵型中受此技能影响的勇士人数，每名提升戴迪亚斯和其周围 2 栏位距离内所有之力大于等于 14 的勇士的伤害 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 戴迪亚斯提升自身和附近的智力勇士的伤害 被繁彩球击中你的敌人根据球体类型（酸液、冰冻或火焰）受到减益。每种减益提升手续同类球体的伤害 %，以乘算方式堆叠。敌人可承受各类减益最高 层；减益将会一直持续。 戴迪亚斯的伤害随敌人被同色球体击中的次数而提升 戴迪亚斯追踪当前区域内自己施放的全部三种类型球体组合的总数。每有一组，戴迪亚斯提升“技巧强化”的效果 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最高可达 层。 阵型中每有一位魔法基本攻击的勇士，均使“技巧强化”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 魔法攻击者数量： 戴迪亚斯为阵型中的魔法使用者展示担当法师的技法。 阵型中每有一位没有魔法基本攻击的勇士，均使“技巧强化”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 非魔法攻击者数量： 确保阵型中没有其他魔法使用者之后……戴迪亚斯成为了阵型里的最强魔法使用者。 繁彩球现在在同区域内造成额外 % 伤害。 戴迪亚斯强化繁彩球进行爆炸，并造成额外伤害。 “技巧强化”的效果提升： % 技巧强化使高智力勇士提高更多伤害。 戴迪亚斯将“技巧强化”的智力要求降低为 12 或更高。 戴迪亚斯决定降低自己的标准……但仅限这次。 熟练？这是在侮辱伟大的戴迪亚斯！ 元素使？准确地说是元素大师！这都是谁取的名字？ 无私！当然了！他们居然叫我利己主义者？ 首领？是的，是的，我想我是。我是伟大的领袖。 只有最聪明的人才能做我的学生。 等练习结束了我会告诉你的！ 更聪明的战士就是会胜利的战士！ 我在古书里面读到过。你没读过的…… 为什么要改变已经好用的东西？ 你可能会想要戴上防烟镜。 我觉得魔法和非魔法都不错…… 总之能完成任务就行！ 我相信你可以赢的 - 就算你的脑子不是那么灵光。 这简直是腰带界的耻辱。 这是给所有长时间阅读而荒废了生活的书呆子用的腰带。 也许适合来自海岸的法师，但明显不适合像戴迪亚斯这样伟大的人物！ 那我的确是。 低级法师所佩戴的护腕。老实说，我很抗拒使用它。 可以格挡一定强度的攻击。虽然我并不需要这样的保护。 能够进一步强化我的强劲施法能力。 呃，你要这么夸奖我也没办法。 等我找回我的装备后就马上换掉它。 这不是我的，我只是借用而已。 丝绒装备可说是顶级法师的特征之一。 我就是备受推崇的法师，对吧？ 在我等强大法师的手中，哪怕是简简单单的戒指也能发挥出强大的威力。 虽然看起来不咋地，但这是属于我的戒指，所以也一样非常优秀。 轻轻一触就能将人冻成冰。虽然夸张了一点，但至少会让对方颤栗好一阵子。 虽然我并不需要向任何人证明自己。 只要动动脑筋，没有任何东西是修不好的。 你的法杖要是不会发光，那你就不是一位好法师。 犹如我未来矗立在路斯坎港的巨大雕像一般闪闪发亮。会有这么一天的。 你确定这法杖当得起传奇这个词吗？看起来很普通的样子啊。 奥术兄弟会的圣徽不应该如此暗淡无光的。 有点难以佩戴。一触碰到它就会被电击。 奥术兄弟会的奇妙圣徽 虽然我不太在意身份阶级，但这头衔听起来没毛病。 戴迪亚斯是一位具有传奇地位和声誉的法师（至少他自己这样认为），其他人在他眼里都是有智力的蠕虫。作为一个自大狂，他一直寻找深奥的传说和罕见的魔法秘密，从而能知道那些“普通傻瓜”不知道的东西。戴迪亚斯来自北方的路斯坎，在那里他是奥术兄弟会的成员，这是一个臭名昭著的法师团体。他最近才加入他们，还没有像他希望的那样被其他人重视。他决心要让大家知道，他是一个值得尊重和敬畏的法师。 戴迪亚斯向距离最近的敌人丢出一个随机元素的繁彩球。 戴迪亚斯召唤出一场魔法飞弹风暴。 戴迪亚斯召唤出一场魔法飞弹风暴--每个敌人至少会挨上一发，除此之外还能多出好几发。 戴迪亚斯施放一次技巧强化法术但运气不佳，只能提高附近智力属性大于等于 14 的勇士的伤害。 戴迪亚斯成功施放的每个相同元素彩球的伤害提高 50%。

title.zh: 卡利克斯 卡利克斯

body.en: While Kalix is in the front column of any party, your active party's damage is increased by %. This means this ability affects your active party even if Kalix is not in your active party (as long as they're in the front-most column of their party). While Kalix is in the front column of any party, your active party's damage is increased, even if Kalix is in a background party! Kalix telepathically increases the damage of all Champions not adjacent to him by %. Kalix gains an Ally stack for each Champion in the formation that is not a Standard species. He increases the effect of Mindlink by % for each Ally stack, stacking multiplicatively. Standard species are Aasimar, Dragonborn, Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goliath, Halfling, Human, Orc, Tiefling, Half-Orc, and Half-Elf. Kalix buffs Champions not next to him, and these buffs increase based on the number of Champions that are not a Standard species. Enemies that attempt to choose Kalix as a target do not, and instead choose to attack another Champion, assuming another valid target exists. The effect of Mindlink is increased by % each time this triggers, stacking multiplicatively up to times and losing % of stacks when changing areas. Enemies that attempt to choose Kalix as a target do not, and instead choose to attack another Champion, assuming another valid target exists. The effect of Mindlink is increased by % each time this triggers, stacking multiplicatively up to times and resetting when changing areas. Humanoids are Kalix's favorite foe. All Champions deal % additional damage against Kalix's favored foes. does % more damage against Kalix's Favored Foes The most represented species in your formation grant additional Ally stacks for Unorthodox Alliance (even if it is not a Standard species). In the case of a tie, Champions from all tied species grant an additional Ally stack. Most Represented Species: Kalix aligns himself with one well represented species, making his telepathic bond with his allies even stronger. The maximum stacks of Chameleon Carapace are doubled, and 50% of the current stacks are not reset when you change areas. The maximum stacks of Chameleon Carapace are doubled, and 50% of the current stacks are not reset when you change areas. Kalix improves his camouflage skills, making him a more dangerous threat when he is frequently attacked. Kalix gains the Speed role and each time a monster spawns that is not his favored foe, one or more of his favored foes simultaneously spawn. The effect of The Deadliest Prey is also increased by 400%. Kalix concentrates on his hunting abilities, quickly tracking down his favored foes and making them more vulnerable to damage. The clutch is all. My first lesson. I have not forgotten. Are you predator, or prey? Join me. Learn. The hunt welcomes all. I see into your mind. I sense your weakness. I know your strength. I need not speak your tongue to know your ways. Thoughts are like blades. They can be sharpened. Prove to me your prowess, and I shall call you kin. To become unseen is to become their undoing. They never see it coming. They are all prey. I permit them to prove me wrong. I have tested them many times. All have failed. They think themselves above us all. I will bring them low. I will break them into pieces. I will scatter their remains. A lack of anatomy is a false shield. I will destroy them, utterly. Hunting is an art. Death, a spectacle. Are you not entertained? I am their end. I am inevitable. The clutch is all. The clutch IS all. The clutch is ALL. No matter their form, they all bleed the same. Your end approaches. Bear witness. Suitable for practice, not for a true challenge. Obsidian of low quality is acceptable for a hunt of the same. A Calishite fool once hunted me for revenge. I made this from her steel. This word means Blade Eye. It is a reminder to always look sharp. Childish ephemera, but this shape is pleasing to me. I found this on the first day of my exile. It sings so sweetly in my mind. The mark of the Celestial Lotus. I will know its words. I will sing its song. I am its keeper. I am worthy. It will find another when I am gone. There is no power here, but that too is worth knowing. Simple crystal stimulates curiosity. This is useful for new journeys. Ruby for skill, fortune, vengeance. Sapphire for the mind, magic, and mourning. Amethyst for logic. Rainbow obsidian for power. For intention. For the kill. It is an insult to be given this. It means leave and never return. Water is life. All who wander the Shaar know this. The flesh of the dire horse is a delicacy among my kind. You must try it. Now. I made this. I charted the Shaar. Every shadow, every step. I know this land. I do not remember this kill. Perhaps another will refresh my memory. Do not mindlink with me until I've had my morning hunt. They thought they were safe. There is no such thing. They were beautiful to behold. Magnificent. I brought them a suitable end. The young train with these. My first weapon, for my first hunt. To hold the gythka is an honor. To learn it, a promise. To master it, a life. To hunt a sultan of Calimshan, this was my payment, and his demise. This word means Pathless. It hurt me once. Now it is mine to wield. By wood, river, cavern, and vale, nomads of the Shaar spread the tale of Kalix the Exile. Gifted in combat from a young age, this thri-kreen warrior amassed a collection of trophies, garnering acclaim from the others of his tribe--the Krakk't. However, the hunter was never satisfied. He dreamed of quarry none would dare. At the Hill of Memories, during the yearly gathering, Kalix attacked the emissaries of the other tribes. None could deny his prowess. For this act, he was banished and forced to wander the world, searching for purpose. Now Kalix offers his services to all who promise a worthy hunt, and woe unto any foe he marks as his prey. Kalix throws a Chatkcha at the closest enemy, dealing 1 hit. Kalix throws a Chatkcha at the closest enemy, dealing 1 hit. Kalix makes 5 attacks against random enemies, dealing ultimate damage and stunning them. Kalix makes 5 attacks against random enemies, dealing ultimate damage and stunning them for 5 seconds due to his paralyzing poison. body.zh: 当卡利克斯处于任何探险队的最前列时，你当前探险队的伤害增加 %。这意味着即使卡利克斯不在你当前的探险队中，这项技能也会影响你当前的探险队（只要卡利克斯处于其所在探险队的最前列）。 当卡利克斯处于任何探险队的最前列时，你当前探险队的伤害会增加，即使卡利克斯在后台探险队中也能触发此效果！ 卡利克斯会通过心灵感应，使所有不与他相邻的勇士的伤害提高 %。 阵型中每有一名不是标准种族的勇士，卡利克斯获得一层“盟友”层数。每拥有一层“盟友”层数，他会使“心灵连接”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。标准种族是指神裔、龙裔、矮人、精灵、侏儒、巨人、半身人、人类、兽人、提夫林、半兽人和半精灵。 卡利克斯会增益不与他相邻的勇士，而且这些增益会根据非标准种族勇士的数量而提升。 尝试选择卡利克斯为目标的敌人现在不会攻击他，而是改为攻击另一勇士（假定存在另一有效目标）。此效果每次触发时，“心灵连接”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 层；变更区域后，堆叠的层数损失 %。 尝试选择卡利克斯为目标的敌人现在不会攻击他，而是改为攻击另一勇士（假定存在另一有效目标）。此效果每次触发时，“心灵连接”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 层；变更区域后，堆叠的层数重置。 类人生物是卡利克斯偏好的对手。所有勇士会对卡利克斯的偏好对手造成额外 % 的伤害。 会对卡利克斯的偏好对手造成额外 % 的伤害 你阵型中最具代表性的种族会为“异端联盟”带来额外的“盟友”层数（即便该种族不是标准种族）。如果有并列的情况，那么所有并列最具代表性种族的勇士都会带来额外的“盟友”层数。 最具代表性种族： 卡利克斯与一个极具代表性的种族结盟，使得他与盟友的心灵感应纽带变得更强。 “变色龙甲壳”的最大层数增加一倍，且变更区域后，当前层数的 50% 不会重置。 The maximum stacks of Chameleon Carapace are doubled, and 50% of the current stacks are not reset when you change areas. 卡利克斯提升他的伪装技能，使他在经常受到攻击时成为更危险的威胁。 卡利克斯获得速度角色，且每当刷新一个不是他偏好对手的怪物时，会同时刷新一个或多个他的偏好对手。同时“最致命的猎物”的效果提升 400%。 卡利克斯专注于他的猎杀技能，快速追踪他的偏好对手，使他们更容易受到伤害。 族群就是一切。这是我学的第一课，我没有忘记。 你是捕猎者还是猎物？来和我一起，学习吧。狩猎欢迎所有人。 我能看透你的内心。我能感觉到你的软弱。我知道你的实力。 无需与你言语，我便能洞悉你的处事之道。 思想就跟刀刃一样，是可以打磨锋利的。 向我证明你的勇猛，那样我就认你为自己人。 不被他们看见，就能要了他们的命。 他们绝对不会料到的。 他们全都是猎物。我允许他们证明我说错了。 我考验过他们很多次了。全都没及格。 他们自以为高我们所有人一等。我会把他们拉下来的。 我会把它们打得粉碎。我会四处抛洒它们的残骸。 没有骨头并非真正的护盾。我会彻底消灭他们的。 狩猎是一门艺术。死亡是一场精彩的表演。你不为此感到愉悦吗？ 我是他们的结局。我就是劫数。 族群就是一切。族群就是一切。族群就是一切。 不管它们是何形态，它们都一样会流血。 你的末日快到了。好好看着吧。 适合拿来练习，但不适合用来对付难啃的骨头。 对付简单的猎物，用差一点的黑曜石也是可以的。 有个来自卡林珊的蠢货曾想找我寻仇。我用她的钢做成了这东西。 这个词的意思是刀锋之眼。这提醒你任何时候都要保持警惕。 虽然是昙花一现的幼稚之物，但这个形状让我感到愉悦。 我在流亡的第一天发现了这朵花。它在我心里温柔地唱着歌。 这是天界莲花的印记。我将理解它的话语，我将歌唱它的歌谣。 我是它的守护者。我配得上这份职责。当我离去时，它会找到另一位守护者。 这东西没有什么力量，但也值得去了解。 简单的水晶会激发好奇心。这对新的旅程很有帮助。 红宝石代表着技艺、好运和复仇。蓝宝石代表着心灵、魔法和哀悼。 紫水晶代表着逻辑。彩虹黑曜石代表力量、意图、和杀戮。 别人给你这个是对你的侮辱。这是让你离开并且永远别回来。 水就是生命。所有在夏亚游荡之人都清楚这点。 恐马的肉是我们族人的美味佳肴。你一定得尝尝。来吧。 这是我做的。我绘制了夏亚的地图。每一道阴影，每一步路。我了解这片土地。 我不记得猎杀这个猎物时的情景了。也许猎杀另一个猎物会让我回想起来。 在我晨猎完之前，不要和我心灵连接。 他们以为他们很安全。压根就没有安全这一说。 它们看起来很美，美到令人惊叹。我给了它们一个合适的结局。 年轻人用这东西来训练。这是我的第一件武器，我第一次狩猎就是用的这个。 持有螳螂戟是一种荣誉，学习它是一种承诺，精通它是一辈子的事。 这是我猎杀一个卡林珊苏丹的报酬，还有他的死也是。 这个词是“无路可走”的意思。它曾经让我受过伤害。可现在它已经为我所用了。 在树木、河流、洞穴和溪谷之间，夏亚的流浪者们传颂着流亡者卡利克斯的故事。这位从小便拥有战斗天赋的螳螂人战士积攒了许多战利品，也赢得了他所在部落克拉克特其他人的赞誉。然而，这名猎手从未感到满足。他梦想猎杀无人敢猎取的猎物。在记忆之丘的年度聚会上，卡利克斯袭击了其他部落的使者。无人能否认他的勇猛，但由于这一行为，他被流放了，被迫在世界各地流浪，寻找自己的目标。现在，谁能保证让他猎杀到值得追逐的猎物，他就为谁效力，而但凡被他视作猎物的敌人都在劫难逃。 卡利克斯向最近的敌人投掷一枚螳螂镖，造成 1 次打击。 卡利克斯向最近的敌人投掷一枚螳螂镖，造成 1 次打击。 卡利克斯对随机敌人发动 5 次攻击，造成杀招伤害，并使他们眩晕。 卡利克斯对随机敌人发动 5 次攻击，造成杀招伤害，并且他的麻痹毒素会使他们眩晕 5 秒。

body.en: Increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of by % Calliope inspires those in front of her to do more damage. Place her behind your most damaging Champions. Grants temporary hit-points to damaged Champions within 2 slots of , with a second cooldown per Champion. (Can only grant up to % of a Champion's max HP in shield) Calliope protects those near her when they are damaged. Place her within two slots of your front-line to ensure her song reaches them. Calliope focuses her efforts on increasing the damage of those in front of her. Calliope focuses her efforts on increasing the effectiveness of her damage shields. Well, if I have to be. I can lead a great sea shanty, at least. Uhhhh. I think you have me confused with someone else. Somebody need temporary hit points? They'll never get through my shields! You looked like you might need help. Where the heck has this been hiding!? The trick is to never let them scratch you. The tail is whatever, but look at these ears! I finally look on the outside how I feel on the inside! Why didn't anyone tell me books could be so freaking exciting!? It doesn't have to be fancy, but it will be messy. You don't want to be on the receiving end of this. It nearly doesn't fit in my lute! You really have to jam it in there, but it hurts when it comes out. It sounds terrible, so what'll you give me to stop playing? I've heard better, but it's a good focus for my songs and spells. Sturdy instruments are key to constant paydays. Hey, are you even listening to me? Argh! That's it...! It's a little scratchy, but it keeps me warm. Your average bard's cloak. Good for blending into crowds... of bards. The only way this thing comes flying off in combat is if I'm feeling especially fabulous. You wouldn't think a bright red cloak could be stealthy, but here we are. Comfortable, but not much help in combat. You could deflect a dull sword with these, if you're quick enough, which I am. Some of the best wrist-based protection a girl can ask for. I know what you're thinking: aren't all bracers fingerless? Yeah, well... Shut up. You can't see it, but this thing is barely holding together. It's holding knick-knacks from dozens of passed out pirates. They won't miss 'em. Touch the gem in the wrong way and boom! Hope you weren't too attached to that hand. I've seen plenty of the world, but I'm more than happy to see more of it. It's a little irritating, but it's stylish. A pleasure to wear - it's like a blanket for my eye! A sturdy accessory that aids in my night time adventures. Oh, you want to know what my magical eyepatch does? Get in line, sailor. Calliope was raised on a pirate ship, and yes, that's an excuse for her sometimes volatile behavior and colorful language. She'll sing you a song, but you better listen or she'll smash you with her lute. Calliope can't resist the lure of adventure or making new enemies, but it's her friends who serve as the family she never had. Calliope lets loose a string of insulting melodies, hitting the two closest enemies. Calliope lets loose a piercing crossbow bolt and shields all members of the party. Calliope points her lute at a random enemy and lets loose a hidden crossbow bolt. It tears through all enemies in a line. After attacking, she engages her damage shield on all members of your party. body.zh: 处于 前列的勇士提升 % 伤害 卡莉欧碧鼓舞前方的勇士造成更多伤害。将她放置在杀伤力最强的勇士后面。 赋予 附近 2 格内受到伤害的勇士 临时生命值，此技能对每名勇士在 内仅生效一次。（带有生命值护盾的勇士最多获得最大生命值 % 的临时生命值） 卡莉欧碧在身边的盟友受到伤害时提供保护。将她放置在前线的两格范围内，以确保她的歌声可以覆盖盟友。 卡莉欧碧专注于提高前方勇士的伤害。 卡莉欧碧专注于提高其伤害护盾的效果。 好吧，如果不得不这样的话。 至少我可以领唱一首美妙的海员号子。 呃，我觉得你把我和别人搞混了。 有人需要临时的生命值吗？ 他们别想跨过我的盾！ 看上去你好像需要帮忙。 这东西一直藏在哪儿呢！？ 诀窍就是永远不要让它们抓伤你。 尾巴无所谓，但看看这些耳朵！ 我的外表终于和我的内心一样了！ 为什么之前没有人告诉过我书本可以这么让人兴奋！？ 虽然外表不华丽，但能确保敌人华丽丽地倒下。 没有人想要成为它的标靶。 几乎放不进我的鲁特琴里！ 必须用力把它按进去，但是穿出来时会非常疼痛。 太难听了，那么问题来了你愿意付出什么样的代价以换取我停止演奏呢？ 虽然算不上天籁的旋律，但还是可以帮助我集中精神吟唱和施法。 靠谱的乐器是保证收入的关键。 喂，你究竟有没有用心在听？可恶！忍无可忍了......！ 虽然有点磨皮肤，但的确很保暖。 很常见的吟游诗人斗篷。适合不着痕迹地混入一群......吟游诗人当中。 在战斗中这玩意真是百分百不会从身上掉下来。 你或许认为鲜红色斗篷不适合潜行，但事实摆在眼前。 很舒适，但是在战斗中起不到保护作用。 这护腕可以格挡钝剑的斩击，前提是你的身手要足够敏捷，好比我这个样子的。 这算是适合女生佩戴的最优质护腕了。 我知道你在想什么：护腕不都是没有指套的吗？好了......你可以闭嘴了。 或许你看不出来，但这玩意随时会碎成一地。 里头装着一群昏迷的海盗身上的小饰品。反正他们也用不上。 要是不小心碰错了哪颗宝石就会砰的一声爆炸！希望你做好跟那只手道别的心理准备。 我到过世上很多地方，但还有更多的地方我想去参观。 虽然有点难受，但是也很有个性。 戴上很舒适--就像给眼睛盖了被单！ 这是我夜行冒险时必不可少的可靠装备。 哦，你想知道我这个魔法眼罩有什么神奇之处？排队吧，想知道的人多的是呢。 卡莉欧碧在一艘海盗船上长大，是的，这也是她有时行为不稳，以及语言五花八门的借口。她会给你唱歌，但你最好认真听，否则她会用她的鲁特琴敲你。卡莉欧碧无法抗拒冒险的诱惑，也总是会树立新的敌人，而她的朋友对她而言，就是她从未有过的家人。 卡莉欧碧弹奏出一段令人气愤的旋律，攻击距离最近的两名敌人。 卡莉欧碧释放一支穿透性箭矢，并为所有队伍成员提供护盾。 卡莉欧碧将鲁特琴指向一名随机敌人，并释放出一支隐藏的箭矢，箭矢会穿透一条直线的所有敌人。攻击完成后，她还会为所有队伍成员提供伤害护盾。

body.en: Kyre increases the damage of all Champions adjacent to them by %. Kyre increases the damage of adjacent Champions. Kyre's normal attacks have a % chance to stun their targets target for seconds. This chance is multiplicatively reduced by 25% each time they stun an enemy with this ability, but resets back to full when changing areas. Each time any Champion in the formation attacks a stunned enemy, Kyre gains a Radiance stack. Kyre increases the effect of Radiant Soul by % for each Radiance stack, stacking multiplicatively up to stacks and resetting when changing areas. Kyre has a chance to stun enemies, and their buff increases each time any Champion attacks a stunned enemy. Champions that attack a stunned enemy have a % additively increased chance to critically hit that enemy and deal % more critical damage. Increases the effect of Radiant Soul by % for each Champion in the formation with the Control role, stacking multiplicatively. Control Champions: Kyre is ever calm in the face of danger, trusting in their techniques and those of their allies. Increases the effect of Radiant Soul by % for each Champion with a Dexterity of 16 or higher in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. DEX 16+ Champions: Kyre fights best with agile allies who can keep pace with their relentless training regiment. Increases the effect of Radiant Soul by % for each Good Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. In addition, Champions adjacent to Kyre gain the Good tag. This does not affect their other alignment tags, and doesn't affect whether they are eligible for the adventure. Qualifying Champions: Kyre's spirit burns with righteous might, inspiring their allies to greater heroics. I've got a lot of love to give. I wish you could see yourself as I see you. There is beauty in you. The light of life and love shall never fall to darkness. This, I vow. It starts with learning to believe in yourself. Believe in others as you would have them believe in you. Be as a beacon in this world, projecting hope for all to see. I've practiced this spiral thrust maneuver ten thousand times. Know yourself. Know what needs to be done. Know to never hesitate. Be yourself, fiercely and without fear! Embrace the power within you! May our blows strike true. May this light cleanse the evil before us. My order knows the body inside and out. I'll show you where to strike. May this light cleanse the evil before us. Indomitable light dwells within all. Train with me. Become your greatest self. No more holding back! It feels good to put on muscle again! Feel the burn! It's what my parents gave the monks who took me in. It was all they had. I've restored it as best I could. It's not worth much, but it's precious to me. Where I'm from the wilderness is dark, cold, and full of terror. My parents sacrificed everything for me. I will make the best of this life. The inscription is my name. It means 'flawless' in elvish. No, I'm not vain! I wear it to remind myself that nothing is perfect, and that's okay. This world has plenty of flaws, and so what? It's still worth fighting for. Real beauty comes from within, and shows your true face to the world. They're not magical, but they look nice, right? Lady Firehair teaches us to love ourselves, each other, and all things. For special occasions, like a wedding. That's always a day worth waiting for. My ultimate accessory for self-expression, however I feel each day! These were so bad that I started to make my own clothing. I craft these myself! Do you want a pair? Good soles for good souls, ha! Needlework is tedious, but good for focusing the mind to stay sharp. It's stunning, I know. Here, I'll prove it! Hold still. I collect keys. Still not sure what this one goes to... This one? I earned myself a room at the Keep on the Borderlands. A memento from my time in Akharin Sangar. I learned much there. I saw horrors in Phandalin, but light always prevails over darkness. They're all my original designs. I'm still working out what to call this piece. I call it 'set adrift amidst stormclouds.' That's all I remember of that time. This is 'fiery passion for the world.' True devotion is a flame bound in silk. The 'warm light of the sun slays darkness.' That's my calling. Will you join me? An unnamed child was born to Damaran refugees fleeing the fall of Bloodstone City at the hands of the Warlock Knights of Vaasa, and orphaned when their parents succumbed to a lingering curse. Taken in by wandering elven monks of Sune, the child grew up in the Waterdhavian Monastery of the Sun, surrounded by compassion, discipline, and the pure light of unconditional love. They excelled in body, mind, and spirit, finding peace in exercise, meditation, and crafts, yet always yearned for more - to someday go beyond the monastery walls. Upon coming of age, Kyre chose their own name and at last set out on a pilgrimage across Faerûn to bring light to the dark places where it's needed most. Kyre attacks the toughest enemy for 1 hit. Kyre attacks the enemy with the most remaining health with a searing bolt of magical radiance, dealing 1 hit. Kyre creates an energy wave, dealing 1 ultimate hit to affected enemies. Kyre creates a wave of radiant light and fire, dealing 1 ultimate hit to enemies it envelops. body.zh: 凯尔会使所有与其相邻勇士的伤害提高 %。 凯尔会提高相邻勇士的伤害。 凯尔的普通攻击有 % 的几率使其 目标 目标 眩晕 秒。每当凯尔用此技能眩晕一名敌人，此几率会降低 25%，以乘算方式堆叠，但切换区域后会重置为初始值。 每当阵型中的任意勇士攻击一名被眩晕的敌人，凯尔获得一层“光辉”堆叠层数。每有一层“光辉”堆叠层数，凯尔会使“光耀之魂”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 层，并且在区域切换时重置。 凯尔有一定几率眩晕敌人，并且每当任意勇士攻击一名被眩晕的敌人，凯尔的增益会进一步提升。 攻击一名被眩晕敌人的勇士有 % 的几率（以加算方式堆叠）对该敌人造成暴击，并额外造成 % 的暴击伤害。 阵型中每有一位拥有控制角色定位的勇士，“光耀之魂”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 控制勇士数量： 凯尔面对危险时总是很冷静，十分信赖自己的武艺和盟友。 阵型中每有一位敏捷大于等于 16 的勇士，“光耀之魂”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 敏捷 16 的勇士数量： 凯尔与能跟上其极高强度训练节奏的敏捷盟友并肩作战时表现最佳。 阵型中每有一位善良勇士，“光耀之魂”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。另外，与凯尔相邻的勇士获得善良标签。这不会影响他们的其他阵营标签，也不会影响他们是否有资格参加冒险。 满足条件的勇士数量： 凯尔的精神燃烧着正义的力量，激励着其盟友做出更伟大的英勇之举。 我有很多的爱可以给予他人。 我希望你能像我看待你一样看待你自己。你身上有着一种美。 生命与爱的光芒绝不会被黑暗吞噬，我就此发誓。 首先要学会相信自己。 就像你希望别人相信你一样，你也要相信别人。 做这个世界的灯塔，投射希望，让所有人看见。 这个螺旋突刺的动作我已经练过一万遍了。 了解你自己。清楚需要做的事。明白永远不要犹豫。 坚定无畏地做你自己！拥抱你内在的力量！ 愿我们每击必中。 愿此光芒净化我们前方的邪恶。 我所属的法师团对人体了如指掌。我来教你们该往哪里下手。 愿此光芒净化我们前方的邪恶。 不屈的光芒存在于每个人的心中。和我一起修行，成为最好的自己吧。 不再克制了！ 再次增肌的感觉真棒！感受这肌肉的灼烧感吧！ 这是我父母交给收留我的僧侣的东西。那是他们仅有的东西。 我尽了最大的努力来修复它。它虽然不值什么钱，但对我来说非常珍贵。 我长大的那片荒野黑暗、寒冷，充满恐怖。 我的父母为了我牺牲了一切。我一定要过好我这一生。 这上面的铭文是我的名字。它在精灵语中的意思是“完美无瑕”。不，我才不是自负呢！ 我戴着它来提醒自己，没有什么是完美的，不完美也没关系。 这个世界有很多缺陷，那又怎么样？它依然值得我们为之战斗。 真正的美源自内在，并向世界展现你的真面目。 它们并没有魔力，但是很好看，对吧？ 火发夫人教诲我们要爱自己，爱他人，爱世间万物。 适合在一些特殊的场合佩戴，比如婚礼。那永远是个值得等待的日子。 这是我自我表达的终极配饰，无论我每天的感觉如何！ 这拖鞋实在烂到不行了，我不得不开始自己做衣服了。 这是我自己做的！你要不要也来一双？正所谓，好马配好鞍嘛！ 针线活很乏味，但那有助于集中注意力，保持警惕。 它非常漂亮，我知道。来，我证明给你看！别动。 我喜欢收集钥匙。我到现在都还不确定这是开哪把锁的…… 这把？我为自己在边境要塞争取到了一个房间。 这是我在阿卡林桑加尔那段时光的一件纪念品。我在那里学到了很多东西。 我在范达林目睹过许多恐怖的事物，但光明总会战胜黑暗。 这些全都是我的原创设计。我还在构思给这个取什么名字。 我给它取名叫“在暴风雨云中漂流”。那是我对那段时光的全部记忆。 这个叫“对世界的炽热之情”。真正的奉献是被丝绸束缚着的火焰。 这个叫“太阳的暖光斩灭黑暗”。那是我的使命。你愿意和我一道吗？ 血石城在瓦萨邪术师骑士的铁蹄下沦陷，在从中逃难的达马拉难民中诞生了一个没有名字的孩子。由于父母死于一场延续不止的诅咒，这个孩子成为了孤儿。后来，这个孩子被伺奉淑娜的游方精灵武僧收留，在深水城的太阳修道院里，在怜悯、管教以及无条件之爱的纯洁光辉笼罩下慢慢长大。这个孩子在身、心、灵方面皆表现出色，并在锻炼、冥想以及制作手工艺品中寻得了内心的平静，然而其心中始终怀有更深的渴望——有朝一日走出修道院的高墙。成年之时，凯尔为自己取了名字，并终于踏上了穿越费伦的朝圣之旅，将光明带去最需要它的黑暗之地。 凯尔攻击最强硬的敌人，造成 1 次命中。 凯尔用一道灼热的魔法光辉箭矢攻击剩余生命值最多的敌人，造成 1 次命中。 凯尔制造一道能量波，对被波及的敌人造成 1 次杀招命中。 凯尔制造一道由耀眼的光辉与火焰交织而成的能量波，对被波及的敌人造成 1 次杀招命中。

body.en: gains one stack of glee each time she kills an enemy. For each stack of glee, her damage is increased by %, stacking multiplicatively. Glee has a 25% chance to lose one stack whenever a Champion other than gets a kill. Prudence delights in killing her enemies, each kill increases her damage (to a max). Increase the base damage bonus of 's Glee ability by % for each Good aligned Champion in the formation, stacking additively and then applying multiplicatively. Good Champions in the formation further increase her damage bonus. Increase the max stacks of 's Glee by for each Neutral or Evil Champion in the formation (additively). When attacks, there is a % chance that her base attack cooldown will be immediately reset. Prudence focuses on her Eldritch blast granting her a chance for multiple attacks. When attacks, there is a % chance that her ultimate attack cooldown will be immediately reset. Ultimate Damage is increased by %. Prudence focuses on her connection with Hadar, increasing the chance she can call them back. Every time attacks an enemy but does not kill it she gains a stack of frustration. Frustration stacks increase her damage by %, stacking multiplicatively. The maximum number of Frustration stacks is equal to the number of Champions adjacent to . Frustration stacks are reduced by 1 each time gets a kill. The effect of Glee is increased by % for each non-DPS Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Non-DPS Champions: Prudence prefers to be the only one causing chaos. The effect of Glee is increased by % for each Champion in the formation who is a Tiefling or Dragonborn, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Prudence performs best when surrounded by her fellow outcasts. The effect of Glee is increased by % for each member of the Oxventures Guild in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Oxventures Guild Champions: Prudence prefers the company of her guildmates. Frisky! Attack! Get 'em, The Darkness! Take THAT! ... Whatever you are! Don't assume that I can't multitask. Let's try a broader approach! I mean. You're welcome. What? They were in our way! Ha ha! You're dead! Ask questions FIRST? What sort of outfit is this? I. Said. DIE. Killing other people makes me feel so alive! You guys are the best accomplices a murderous girl could ask for. You're never alone with a book. Especially these books. Aren't they adorable? I found them in the library! They're mine now. Mind your fingers! They're its favorite. Who's a precious book baby? You are! Yes you are! It's not a spellbook, it's a super-dark book of... secrets. I live for Cthulhu's secrets. I told you not to open it! Now we've got to clean this all up. It's where I keep all my best spells. The ones that make you go ewwww. Oi! Who threw that dagger at me?! Look at all the dents! Serving you eldritch elegance all day long. You're welcome. I've learned much from Cthulhu. Don't talk to me before I've had my coffee. It's got a kick to it. Whose blood? Does it matter? From a fresh batch. Even more deadly. We could talk about this, or we could deal with the guards. Your choice. He kept wanting me to take Zargon the Returner as my patron. Ugh. The Great Old One guides me. If you stare at it long enough, you'll end up with an eldritch blast to the face. It'll work in a pinch. Why haven't these become a thing yet!? I came dressed to transgress. I may have collected some from my victims. It's a mystery. The least ethical of the Oxventure crew, Prudence is a grumpy, power-hungry Tiefling Warlock. Cthulhu is Prudence's chosen warlock patron and stand-in father figure, and she does The Great Old One proud by waking up and choosing violence every single day. When she's not doing murders, Prudence enjoys a good book. Well, not a good book. An evil book. She has two in particular with her at all times in the monstrous forms of her beloved bitey book babies, Frisky and The Darkness. Prudence delights in anything creepy, gory and/or openly evil but has a soft spot for her fellow Oxventurers, who are the only folks this former hermit has any patience for. Either that or she hasn't found space in her busy murdering schedule to murder them yet. One or more beams of crackling green shoots towards the nearest enemies, dealing damage. One or more beams of crackling green shoots towards the nearest enemies, dealing damage. Prudence opens a gateway to the dark between the stars, damaging and pulling enemies to it. Prudence opens a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region infested with unknown horrors. An area of blackness and bitter cold appears on the ground slightly in front of the formation. Tentacles erupt out of it, pulling all enemies together. body.zh: 每次击杀敌人都会获得一层“欢欣”。每层“欢欣”可使其伤害提高 %，且效果呈乘法叠加。“欢欣”在 以外的其他英雄获得击杀时，有 25% 的几率失去一层。 普鲁登斯因击杀敌人而感到愉悦，每次击杀都会提升她的伤害（至最高）。 每有一名善阵营英雄在阵容中， 的“欢欣”技能的基础伤害加成将增加 %，这些加成先进行累加，再进行乘法运算。 阵型中善良阵营的勇士会进一步提升她的伤害加成。 阵型中每位中立或邪恶勇士均会使 的“欢欣”技能的最大堆叠层数提高 层（加算）。 攻击时，有 % 几率立即重置基本攻击冷却时间。 普鲁登斯专注于她的魔能爆弹，使她有几率施展多重攻击。 当 攻击时，有 % 的几率立即重置她的杀招攻击冷却时间，并使 的杀招伤害提高 %。 普鲁登斯专注于与哈达的联系，提升她将其召回的几率。 每当 攻击敌人但未造成击杀，她将获得 1 层“沮丧”堆叠。“沮丧”堆叠会使她的伤害提高 %（乘算）。“沮丧”堆叠的最大层数等同于与 相邻的勇士数量。 每取得一次击杀，“沮丧”减少 1 层。 队伍中每有一名非输出型英雄，欢欣效果将提高 %，且该效果按乘法叠加。 非输出型英雄： 普鲁登斯更喜欢成为唯一一个制造混乱的人。 每当阵型中有一名提夫林或龙裔英雄时，《欢歌》的效果将增加 %，且效果呈乘法叠加。 符合资格的冠军： 当普鲁登斯身处一群被社会排斥的同伴之中时，她才能发挥出最佳状态。 对于编队中的每位“Oxventures”公会成员，其“欢愉”效果将增加 %，且该效果呈乘法叠加。 Oxventures 公会冠军： 普鲁登斯更喜欢和公会成员们在一起。 嬉嬉！攻击！ 上啊，暗暗！ 尝尝这个！......你这个鬼东西！ 别以为我不能同时处理多项任务。 我们来尝试一种更广泛的方法吧！ 我是说。不用客气。 什么？他们挡了我们的路！ 哈哈！你死了！ 先问问题？这是什么衣服？ 我。说了。去死。 杀死别人让我感觉自己活得真痛快！ 你们真是那个杀人狂女孩能找到的最好的帮凶了。 有书就不会孤单。尤其是这种书。 它们是不是很可爱？这是我在图书馆里找到的！现在它们是我的了。 小心你的手指！那是它的最爱。 谁是可爱的书宝宝？是你啊！是的，就是你！ 它不是法术书，而是一本超级黑暗的......秘密之书。 我为克苏鲁的秘密而生。 我都跟你说了不许打开！这下我们得来个大扫除了。 我最优秀的咒语都在这里面。能让你“呼”的一下就消失的那些。 喂！刚才砸到我的那把匕首是谁扔的？！ 快看看这些凹痕！ 能让你一整天都优雅地使用魔能。不用客气。 我从克苏鲁那里学到了很多。 在我喝完咖啡之前，别跟我说话。 它的味道很冲。 谁的血？这很重要吗？ 新鲜出炉。更加致命。 我们可以聊这个，也可以去处理掉那些守卫。随你选。 他一直想让我选回归者扎尔贡做我的守护神。呃。 旧日支配者指引着我。 如果盯着它看上足够长的时间，就会挨上一发魔能爆弹。 在危急关头还是能派上用场的。 为什么竟然还有这种东西！？ 我的穿着就是踰越。 有一些是从被我干掉的人那里搜刮来的。这是个谜。 作为公牛冒险公会最缺德的成员，普鲁登斯是一位暴躁、渴望力量的提夫林邪术师。克苏鲁是普鲁登斯选择的邪术师守护者，也是她想象中的父亲替代者。她日行一恶，只为让这位旧日支配者感到骄傲。不杀人的时候，普鲁登斯也喜欢好书。好吧，也不算是好书。应该说是邪书。有两本怪物形态的书一直跟随在她的左右，它们分别是“嬉嬉”与“暗暗”。普鲁登斯喜欢一切诡异、血腥和明显邪恶的东西，她也喜欢公牛冒险公会的同伴们，他们是这位原来的隐士唯一能够忍耐得了的人。可能如此，也可能只是因为她还没在忙碌的杀人日程表上为他们腾出空间来。 向最近的敌人发射一道或多道噼啪作响的绿色光束，造成伤害。 向最近的敌人发射一道或多道噼啪作响的绿色光束，造成伤害。 普鲁登斯打开了一扇通往群星之暗的大门，对敌人造成伤害并将敌人拉向它。 普鲁登斯打开了一扇通往群星之暗的大门，这是一个充满未知恐怖的地区。阵型前方的地面上出现了一片漆黑而严寒的区域。触手从里面喷发出来，把所有的敌人聚集在一起。
