Livin' or dead, it matters none! I serve ME KING! Wait for me to get outa the way before ye throw tha fireball! Complain all you want -- it's helping! I didn't bathe for three weeks before the battle! That's what helped us win! Ye should smell it. It smells like BATTLE! Now you know what it means to be a Gutbuster! Always room for more spikes! More blades are the answer. Tear them apart! Think they got the point? Gutbusters! Are you ready?! What do ye mean 'too much sweat'!? Don't talk nonsense! Tha rust adds a bit o' kick ta tha sting o' tha spikes! Come back when ye got more spikes. No! Still needs more spikes. Lower tha shoulder, roll 'em over! Dwarven tales is etched around it in Dethek. With each strike o' tha hammer in Mithral Hall, we honor Moradin. Dwarven celebrations is always in need o' additional vessels. Tha cap keeps me beard out o' tha drink! Smart. 'Tis all in tha wrists! Leave 'em in yer beard overnight and ye smell as great as a mithral mine! Humans use 'em fer diggin', right? Ingredients: Blood o' me enemies, natural extracts, and a drop o' garlic. If it falls off, it's still a formidable weapon! Why would ye wash it? Tha grease helps ye don it quick! Me king needs no introduction, but I often give him a spiky one. When a dwarf enters tha bloodrage, stand clear. It cures what ails ye. Use in case o' poisonin', battles, rowdy celebrations, or rough mornings. Carried at all times by tha Gutbusters o' Mithral Hall. Tha Gutbuster Brigade watch out fer each other. This vial does tha rest. Rumblebelly loves his scrimshaw carvings. This one's quite nice! Definitely not fer eatin'. Trust me. She ain't o' tha dwarves, but she's all right in me book. One o' tha most precious gifts me king has bestowed upon me. Despite a reputation as a loud, gruff, and stinky dwarf who hates bathing, Thibbledorf Pwent is a loyal and beloved member of Clan Battlehammer. Known as 'Pwent' to his friends, he leads the Gutbusters of Mithral Hall, a dwarven battlerager squad focused on direct combat with little regard for their own safety. He wears armor completely covered in spikes to help rend the flesh of his enemies, and in the midst of battle Pwent often falls into a bloodrage, doing anything to protect his allies. While not an official member of the Companions of the Hall, Pwent will always aid his King when possible -- even beyond death... Pwent lowers his head and rushes to a random enemy, using his armor as a weapon to cut & injure the enemy. Pwent dashes quickly around the area rounding up all available enemies, and then stuns, damages, and inflicts a bleed effect on them. Pwent dashes quickly around the area rounding up all available enemies, and then stuns, damages, and inflicts a bleed effect on them. Pwent is not the cleanest dwarf. He slows the attacks of those around him, but increases the amount of damage those slowed Champions do. Don't talk nonsense! 那些锈迹正好可以给被击中的敌人加点菜！ 等你拥有更多尖刺时再回来找我吧。 不行！还需要更多的尖刺。 蹲下身子，滚动过来吧！ 矮人族的故事以矮人语符文铭刻在壶身上。 秘银厅的一切都是以摩拉丁的名字铸造的。 任何矮人族节庆都是离不开酒瓶和酒壶的。 这帽子能避免胡子触碰到酒水！太妙了。 一切尽靠腕力！ 把它放在胡须中一整夜，整个人顿时会比秘银矿更加的香喷喷！ 这东西是人类用来挖矿的，对不对？ 材料：敌人的血液、天然的草药、以及一点大蒜。 尖角要是掉落了，也可以当作武器使用！ 为何要清洗头盔？那些油脂能帮助头盔更顺利地捅入敌人的身体。 我的国王不需要介绍，但我经常给他带刺的招呼。 见到矮人进入暴走状态时，最近退避三舍。 它能治好你的病。 可治疗中毒、战斗、群殴、碰撞所造成的伤势。 秘银厅的破腹旅一直随身携带的物品。 破腹旅向来会互相保护自家兄弟。如果受伤了此瓶药水能解决一切问题。 馋鬼最喜欢玩骨饰雕刻。这一个做得尤为不错！ 这个不是拿来吃的。相信我。 她虽然不是矮人，但却很符合矮人的性格。 这是国王赏赐给我的诸多礼物中最珍贵的一个了。 虽然作为一个吵闹、粗暴又讨厌洗澡的臭矮人而闻名，第伯多夫·普旺特仍是战锤氏族忠诚而受人爱戴的成员。他被朋友们称为“普旺特”，领导着秘银厅的“破腹旅”。这是一支专注于直接战斗的矮人战斗队伍，几乎从不考虑自身安全。他穿着全身覆盖尖刺的盔甲，以撕裂敌人的肉体。在战斗中，普旺特经常陷入血泊之中，他会不惜一切代价保护他的盟友。虽然不是秘银五侠的正式成员，但普旺特总是在可能的情况下帮助他的王，甚至超越死亡...... 普旺特低头冲向一名随机敌人，使用护甲作为武器来切割和伤害敌人。 普旺特在区域内快速冲刺将所有剩余敌人围住，然后对他们造成眩晕、伤害和流血效果。 普旺特在区域内快速冲刺将所有剩余敌人围住，然后对他们造成眩晕、伤害和流血效果。 普旺特算不上是最正派的矮人。他会降低周围勇士的攻击速度，但提升他们造成的伤害量。

The messenger guild taught me to stand against any obstruction! I'll take the lead. For now. Everyone deserves to be healthy. My healing radiates outward. My prayers have been answered. A dark power grows. H'esper is watching... Someone is watching out for us. I see what was and is and will be. I found this near the Valley of Storms. I can see the potential. I've been taking up whittling. H'esper encouraged me to find new paths. It led me to my friends. A reminder of what I've lost. A symbol of what I'm yet to gain. Useful if you want to make things blurry. One arm, one wing, and one rusty spyglass! Ready as I'll ever be! Hey, I can see my house from here! A gift from the Guild. I feel the wind whenever I use it. Best used when trying to go unnoticed. My old Messenger Guild cloak now covers my injuries Dependable, adaptable, and, most importantly, warm. You never know when you're talking to royalty. I've always had a knack for cartography. I didn't strap them once... It took me 2 days to find them all. The rain stays off, the ink stays on! I'm not sure what my path is, but I am sure it's in this case. I can almost track my journey with this! Almost. She was in the Messenger Guild too! Messengers use this to travel. I use it to survive. This will always lead me back to my friends. It's new, it's itchy... I don't like it. It messes up my feathers! This one makes me look cool, right? Right? I've lost a lot on my journey. I've learned a lot, too. Qillek is timid, meek and nervous, being a comparably young character in the party and thrown into a world he doesn't understand with no wing to fly him out of a bad situation. His charisma, wit, and superiority ripped away when flying through the Valley of the Storms, taking his left wing and arm away but introducing him to H'esper, who gave him dark visions to push him forward. Inside him is an envious amount of courage and a stable sense of logic when things get dire, which has led other party members to consider him their leader. He doesn't agree with the idea, but he's not ready to let his friends down. Qillek attacks the frontmost monsters with a flurry of feathers. Qillek rains purple feathers from above, calming all attacking monsters. Do druids use wands? Sure they do. This is one of them! I wish it made an X at the end instead. Nat and I found it! Isn't it great?! Jarlaxle named the toy after I found it. Bruenor didn't think it was funny. It doesn't walk, but if you lean it juuuuust right, it can stand on it's own! The statues are my friends. No, really! It's a collectible! The kids would put them together, then sell them for spending money. I've spent a lot of time getting lost in the symbol of our great city. It's JUST like the ones the Watch wear! A nice lady gave it to me. Said her name was... Did anyone catch her name? Fascinated by magic at a young age when he lived in an orphanage, but lacking any ability or proficiency, Xander is not terribly good at much of anything, though something about his adorable clumsiness and childlike wonder anytime magic is being used nearby has been known to inspire those around him. Until recently, he was living on the streets of Waterdeep, scraping together just enough to survive. Now, he is a faithful member of your party, always ready to leap into the fray, even if he doesn't really seem to be able to hit much of anything. Xander backstabs a random opponent. Unfortunately, he doesn't always exactly hit them. Xander summons a friendly neighborhood stone giant. Xander uses his miniature statue to summon one of Waterdeep's giant walking statues. A giant stone foot smashes all enemies from above, dealing massive damage. body.zh: 秒杀敌人时，或任何队友击杀被分心所影响的敌人时，即有 % 几率使该敌人提供双倍任务进度 秒杀敌人时，即有 % 几率使该敌人提供双倍任务进度 攻击敌人并且未命中时，敌人即被标记，并在任何队员将其击杀时触发幸运一击 山德尔将他杀死（或未命中）的部分敌人计作额外的任务进度。 处于 后列的所有勇士提升 % 伤害 山德尔使他身后的盟友伤害提高。将他放置在最厉害的伤害输出者前方。 每有一位术士、邪术师或法师勇士与 相邻，即提升 的效果 % 山德尔的命中率降低。谁会想要这个技能？ 山德尔更加主动，强化他的旁门左道增益。 只有团结一致，我们才能生存。 为了深水城和北方！ 街头生活很艰难，但我还是活了下来。 我可以告诉你，谁会帮我们，谁会躲开我们。 知道吗，我曾经在深水城的街头卖艺。 做工非常精细！ 这是我在裂隙传送门附近找到的。肯定是魔法装备！ 要是轻抚匕首上的宝石，肯定能够强化它的威力。 哇...... 我出生时身边就有它了。 你有没有见过这个标记？我觉得它跟我很有关系。 每次在不同的城区时它就会微微发暖。我还没弄明白是怎么回事。 让我瞧瞧！这跟我的戒指竟然是一套的！快继续找！ 里面大部分的东西我都不认识。 这是我用来清除脚趾上的秽物的，你瞧？ 我的所有陷阱工具都存放在这里头。瞧，焕然一新的。因为我从未使用过！ 这个好像是用来拔牙的。咦？嗯哩唻哈！ 这是我在亡者之城中找到的。詹克斯却说那只是很普通的一根树枝。 德鲁伊也有使用魔法棒的吗？那是当然有的。你瞧这不就是嘛！ 可惜顶端并非交叉形状的。 这是我和纳特找到的！是不是很厉害的样子？！ 我找到这个玩偶后，贾拉索就给它取了这个名字。不过布鲁诺似乎有点不爽。 它虽然不会行走，但只要摆放的倾斜角度正确的话，它是可以竖立起来的！ 那些雕像都是我的好朋友。我是说真的！ 这是个收藏品！ 孩子们会收藏各种各样的小饰品然后出售以换取零花钱。 我常常会看着咱们这繁华城市的象征一个人发呆。 这跟守望者们佩戴的徽章简直是一模一样！ 这是某位姑娘送给我的。她名叫......咦，你们谁记得她叫什么名字来着？ 在很小的时候，住在孤儿院的他就对魔法着迷。但由于缺乏任何技能和练习，山德尔对很多事情都不太擅长。他笨拙得可爱，并且附近有人使用魔法时会有孩子般的好奇心。连他身边的人也会被他的这种性格所鼓舞。直到最近，他还生活在深水城的街头，勉强维持生计。现在他是你队伍中忠实的一员，随时准备跃入战场，尽管他似乎并不能打中什么。 山德尔背刺一名随机敌人。不幸的是，他并非每次都能准确命中目标。 山德尔召唤一个友好的邻居石巨人。 山德尔用他的小雕像召唤深水城的一座巨型石雕像。巨大的石脚会从上方碾压所有敌人，造成高额伤害。

body.en: The aberrant spirit in 's brain telepathically reaches out to the other Champions. For each positional formation ability affecting , she increases the damage of all Champions with the role by %, stacking multiplicatively. Valentine buffs all DPS Champions based on the number of positional formation abilities affecting her duplicates any positional formation abilities that are affecting her to Champions in the formation with the role. If the receiving Champion already has the formation ability, the formation ability is instead boosted by %. This happens after Artemis' Observation ability. Valentine duplicates positional formation abilities affecting her on DPS Champions. This happens after Artemis' Observation ability. increases the formation's gold find by % for each positional formation ability affecting her, stacking multiplicatively. 's pre-stack damage increase is increased by %. Valentine focuses on helping other Champions deal as much damage as possible If is affected by 's ability, its effect is increased by %. Valentine focuses on being a great friend to Tatyana 's total gold find is increased by %. Valentine focuses on the business side of things Haven't I sacrificed enough? Let me explain how this is going to work. It's good to know where to spend your coin. Sometimes good things come of bad circumstances. Don't mind the little voice in your head. I had to put in an appearance. Don't you want to be stronger? With an aberrant spirit, you're never really alone. I make this look amazing. What good is coin if you don't spend it? I've glimpsed what lurks beyond the shadows. What do you think happens when your little blade hits my darkness? I'll take that, thank you. Huh. Well, at least I still look good in black. Yes, yes, gather around. How cute. It reminds me of Tregrum. With fewer tentacles and less otherworldly power. Charming. I wonder what they think of these in Darkon. I saw it blink. This is Stewart. Are you saying you DON'T have a brain in a jar? Stewart doesn't want to talk to you. Now he can go wherever I go. I don't want Tatyana to get hungry. I keep Tatyana's favorite snacks on hand. Our bond was forged a long time ago. Tatyana has long been like a sister to me -- and now she's exactly that. Pearls are very eye-catching. It goes with everything. I never leave home without them. You don't need to look at what the pearls are covering. My existence may be dark, but I'm always put together. A blood red lip goes with every dread domain. These look even better when I levitate. Nothing says power and control of otherworldly energy like a classic black dress. Voronika was always happiest in nature. She always said she wanted what was best for Koshmarr. Voronika looked so lovely on her wedding day. Her death was only the beginning. Valentine comes from a life of leisure. Once a social butterfly, nightlife connoisseur, and princess of the shady family business but that life ended in sudden tragedy. Through the mysterious will of Bluetspur, Valentine was given a second chance at life, though no miracle comes without consequence. Now she wanders the domains of dread with her companion Tatyana, in search of purpose and power. Valentine attacks a random enemy with a mental magic attack, which deals damage and has a chance to stun them. Valentine attacks a random enemy with a mental magic attack for one hit and enemies have a 50% chance that they are stunned for 2 seconds. Valentine targets the nearest enemy and those around it dealing damage and stunning them. While stunned they take additional damage. Inky black tentacles erupt from Valentine's mouth and hands targeting the closest enemy and those around it dealing damage and stunning them for 4-8 seconds. While stunned they take an additional 1000% damage from all sources. Valentine buffs all DPS Champions based on the number of positional formation abilities affecting Valentine. Valentine duplicates positional formation abilities targetting her to DPS Champions, she does this after Artemis has Observed them. body.zh: 大脑中的异常灵魂通过心灵感应传递给其他勇士。每个影响 的位置阵型技能都会让她使所有 角色的勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 瓦伦汀根据影响她的位置阵型技能的数量来强化所有伤害输出勇士。 将影响她的任何位置阵型技能复制给阵型中的 角色勇士。如果获得技能的勇士已拥有该阵型技能，则此阵型技能强化 %这发生在阿尔忒弥斯的观察技能之后。 瓦伦汀将影响她的位置阵型技能复制给伤害输出勇士。这发生在阿尔忒弥斯的观察技能之后。 每个影响 的位置阵型技能都让她使阵型的金币寻获数量提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 的叠加前伤害提高效果提高 %。 瓦伦汀专注于帮助其他勇士尽量造成更多伤害 如果 受到 的 技能影响，则其效果提高 %。 瓦伦汀专注于担任塔季扬娜的好朋友 的总金币寻获量提高 %。 瓦伦汀专注于商业方面 我牺牲的还不够吗？ 我来解释一下原理。 你最好知道自己把钱花在哪里。 有时候祸兮福所倚。 不要介意你脑子里的小声音。 我得露个面。 你不想变得更强吗？ 异常灵魂让你永远不孤单。 我让它看起来很棒。 不花钱还赚钱干什么？ 我窥见了隐藏在暗影背后的东西。 当你的小刀击中我的黑暗时，你觉得会发生什么？ 我要了，谢谢。 哈，嗯，至少我穿黑色还是很好看。 对，对，大家围过来。 超可爱。 它让我想起特雷格鲁姆。除去触手和奇异的力量。 真迷人。我想知道达孔的人是怎么看待它们的。 我看到它在眨眼。 这是斯图尔特。 你竟然说你没有罐中脑袋？ 斯图尔特不想和你说话。 现在他可以跟我去任何地方了。 我不想让塔季扬娜挨饿。 我随身携带塔季扬娜最喜欢的零食。 我们的交往由来已久。 塔季扬娜一直像我的妹妹一样--现在她就是我的妹妹。 珍珠非常抢眼。 百搭单品。 我出门必戴。 你不必觊觎珍珠下面的风景。 我的存在可能代表黑暗，但我从不疏于打扮。 血色红嘴唇适配所有恐惧领域。 当我漂浮时看起来更美。 没有什么比经典的黑色礼服更能体现力量，以及对超凡能量的掌控了。 沃罗妮卡天性喜乐。 她总说她想让科什马尔得到最好的。 沃罗妮卡结婚那天看起来漂亮极了。 她的死亡只是开端。 瓦伦汀来自富足悠闲的生活环境。她曾经是一只社交花蝴蝶、夜生活鉴赏家，以及灰色家族产业的小公主，但这样的生活突然以悲剧落幕。借助布鲁兹波的神秘意志，瓦伦汀获得了第二次生命机会，但所有奇迹都要付出代价。如今，她和伙伴塔季扬娜游荡在恐惧领域中，旨在寻找目标和力量。 瓦伦汀使用精神魔法攻击一名随机敌人，造成伤害并有几率使其眩晕。 瓦伦汀使用精神魔法攻击一名随机敌人，造成一次伤害并有 50% 几率使其眩晕 2 秒。 瓦伦汀瞄准最近的敌人及其周围的敌人，造成伤害并使其眩晕。眩晕期间，他们受到额外伤害。 瓦伦汀的嘴巴和双手中伸出黑色触须，瞄准最近的敌人及其周围的敌人，造成伤害并使其眩晕 4-8 秒。眩晕期间，他们额外受到 1000% 所有来源的伤害。 瓦伦汀根据影响瓦伦汀的位置阵型技能的数量来强化所有伤害输出勇士。 瓦伦汀将以她为目标的位置阵型技能复制给伤害输出勇士（在阿尔忒弥斯观察过他们之后实行）。

Heals allies that are under % health for health per second for seconds. Viconia heals Champions that have been gravely injured. When a non-boss enemy is killed there is a % chance that Viconia will seize control of its lifeless body and turn it against its former allies for seconds, stopping their movement. While it is re-animated, it deals % of your BUD to nearby enemies each second. There can be up to re-animated enemies at a time. Viconia has a chance to animate dead enemies and turn them against their friends. Increase the effect of Cleric of Shar by % for each column away from the back-most column she is, stacking multiplicatively. Viconia prefers to support from the front. Cleric of Shar now affects Neutral (Good/Evil axis) champions instead of Evil ones. Heroes of Baldur's Gate are still covered under this new plan. Viconia prefers the presence of Neutral Champions. Increase the chance for Animate Dead to trigger by %. Viconia focuses on reanimating the dead. Whenever a non-boss, non-static, non-undead enemy spawns there is a % chance that it spawns as an undead version of itself while also retaining its original tags. Sacrifice is the edict of Shar. I have to do everything myself. May Shar pass you over...and give her power to me. Everything may end, by Shar's blessing, but you end first. I suppose we can call each other...acquaintances. I have more use for you than the god of the dead does. Oh, give it here, I'll show you how it's done. Zombies have their uses. Hordes of undead? I don't see a problem. Take comfort in the security of Shar's inevitability. Have you succeeded? Have your brought the Weapon? My vitality is yet another thing lost in the pursuit of the Lady of Loss' goals. Stand, fool. I do not permit you to die. Yet. It will have to do. An unused weapon has yet to fulfill its promise. The only one who'll guard my back is me, and I prefer it that way. Avert your eyes, swine, or I'll acquaint you with my weapon. I'm not fool enough to dismiss Lolth...but she's not fool enough to dismiss Shar. Everything becomes nothing. Why not seize what you can in the meantime? Be glad I do not still follow Lolth; if I did, your death would be much slower. There is no power greater than the void of Shar. You'll see. You don't need to know my past. Only that Shar has lifted me from it. I wear my allegiance with pride. I'd rather know you were against me from the start. Sometimes life has its little rewards. I think you'll find my eyes are up here. Below the crystal full of evocation magic. I have all manner of potions and poisons at my disposal. I know who I am--but you don't need to know I was here. A sip of this, and you could crush anyone who sought to hold you down. I will say this for spiders: they always come right back. I admire that. I don't need to be close to you to know I want to destroy you. It does make a nice 'thwack' when it hits. This stone has your name on it, I believe. I'll burn a hole right through you. I prefer privacy as I go about my business. You don't need to look at me. Purple and black are very much my colors. Wrapped in Shar's purpose, I feel comfort and certainty. Viconia DeVir is a devout cleric of Shar, the goddess of darkness and loss. Viconia was cast out of Menzoberranzan and house DeVir after refusing to sacrifice a child to the spider goddess Lolth. Don't mistake her for a champion of good, however. Viconia has lived a dangerous and difficult life, and she joins the Champions at the behest of two old 'friends', Baeloth & Minsc. She may not approve of how the Champions work, but she's here and ready to assist, so long as the quest, and the payout pleases her. Viconia slings a stone at a random enemy. Viconia slings a stone at a random enemy. Viconia summons darkness that damages all enemies and increases the odds of triggering Animate Dead. Viconia summons a cloying miasma of cold and greasy darkness that damages all enemies and increases the odds of any enemies killed by it triggering Animate Dead by 50%. body.zh: 使中立（以善良/邪恶划分时）勇士和属于“博德之门的英雄们”的勇士的伤害提高 %。 使邪恶勇士和属于“博德之门的英雄们”的勇士的伤害提高 %。 每秒为生命值低于 % 的盟友治疗 点生命值，持续 秒。 维康妮亚会治疗受到严重创伤的勇士。 每当有非首领敌人被击杀时，有 % 几率维康妮亚会夺取其失去生命的躯体的控制权，并用它来拖延原来的同伙，阻止他们移动，持续 秒。被复活后，它每秒会对周围敌人造成等同于你基础杀招伤害 % 的伤害。一次最多可以存在 个复活的敌人。 维康妮亚有几率复活死去的敌人，指挥它们来对付曾经的友军。 她与最后列的距离每增加一列，莎尔的牧师的效果提高 %（乘算）。 维康妮亚喜欢从前方提供支援。 莎尔的牧师现在会影响中立（以善良/邪恶划分时）勇士而非邪恶勇士。针对“博德之门的英雄们”的效果不变。 维康妮亚喜欢阵型中有中立勇士。 使操纵死尸的触发几率提高 %。 维康妮亚专注于复活亡灵。 每当一个非首领、非静态、非亡灵的敌人刷新时，都有 % 的几率以自身的亡灵版本刷新，同时保留其原始标签。 使中立（以善良/邪恶划分时）勇士和属于“博德之门的英雄们”的勇士的伤害提高 %。 使邪恶勇士和属于“博德之门的英雄们”的勇士的伤害提高 %。 牺牲是莎尔的敕令。 什么都得我自己来干。 希望莎尔把你带走......然后赐予我她的力量。 万物皆有终结，但有了莎尔的祝福，你将成为第一个被终结者。 我觉得我们应该算得上是......熟人。 相比起死亡之神，我拿你们有更多的用处。 哦，交给我吧，我来展示该怎么做。 僵尸自有其用途。 成群结队的亡灵？我不认为这是个问题。 在莎尔注定的命运中获得安慰。 你成功了吗？你带来武器了吗？ 我的生命力是为了追求失去之女的目标而失去的又一样东西。 站起来，蠢货，我不准你死。还没到时候。 只能先将就用了。 一件用旧的武器还是能满足它存在的目的。 唯一能护住我背后的只有我自己，我也喜欢这样。 别看了，卑鄙的家伙，否则就尝尝我的武器吧。 我不会蠢到拒绝罗丝......但她也不会蠢到拒绝莎尔。 一切都化为虚无。这个时候，为什么不抓住你能抓住的一切呢？ 你应该高兴我没有继续信仰罗丝；否则的话，你的死亡会缓慢得多。 没有比莎尔的虚空更强大的力量了。你待会就会知道了。 你不需要知道我的过去。总之，是莎尔把我从过去带到了现在。 我很自豪地宣誓效忠。我宁愿你从一开始就是我的敌人。 有时候生命其本身就是一种回报。 我想你应该能看到我的眼睛就在这上面。就在充满召唤魔法的水晶下面。 我有各式各样的药剂和毒药可供使用。 我知道我是谁--但你不需要知道我在这里。 喝上一小口，你就能干掉所有想把你按住的人。 这句话是送给蜘蛛的：它们总是能马上就回来。我很钦佩这一点。 我不需要跟你很亲近就能知道我要毁了你。 打中东西的时候“啪”的一声很好听。 我觉得，这块石头上有你的名字。 我要在你身上烧穿一个洞。 我做事的时候喜欢更私密一点。 你不需要看我。 紫色和黑色是最适合我的颜色。 有了莎尔的指引，我感到舒适和自信。 维康妮亚·德维尔是信奉黑暗与失去之女神--莎尔的虔诚牧师。因为拒绝向蜘蛛女神罗丝献祭一名孩童，维康妮亚被逐出魔索布莱城和德维尔家族。但是，千万不要因此而认为她就是一名善良的勇士。维康妮亚一直过着危险而艰难的生活，随后在两位老“朋友”--贝洛斯和明斯克--的要求下加入了勇士们。她也许并不认同勇士们的行事方式，但只要大家的目的一致，且结果能让她满意，她还是愿意提供协助。 维康妮亚向一名随机敌人投掷石块。 维康妮亚向一名随机敌人投掷石块。 维康妮亚召唤黑暗，伤害所有敌人并提高触发操纵死尸的几率。 维康尼亚召唤一股寒冷、油腻而黑暗的恐怖瘴气。它会伤害所有的敌人，在它杀死任何敌人后，增加触发操纵死尸的几率 50%。 维康妮亚复活死去的敌人，并指挥它们攻击原来的同伙 维康妮亚治疗受到严重创伤的勇士

body.en: Windfall can be used in any Vecna: Eve of Ruin campaign adventure or variant, even if she would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions. Windfall increases the damage of all Champions in the column(s) with the most slots by %. If multiple columns are tied for the most slots, then each of them are affected. Windfall increases the damage of all Champions in the longest column(s). When Windfall attacks and defeats an enemy, she gains a Raise stack. Otherwise, she gains a Call stack. Gold find is increased by % for each Raise stack, stacking multiplicatively. Windfall's damage and The Long Game are both increased by % for each Call stack, stacking multiplicatively. Both are capped at 25 stacks and reset upon changing areas. Windfall tries to avoid attacking enemies that don't drop gold or count for quest progress. Her normal attacks light her target on fire, dealing seconds of BUD-based damage to the enemy every second for seconds. Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a greedy red dragon. Windfall gains the Control role and she prefers to attack stunned enemies. Her normal attacks are charged with lightning, striking out at up to two other random enemies, dealing seconds of BUD-based damage to them, and stunning all enemies damaged for 3 seconds. Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a shocking blue dragon. Windfall prefers to attack the farthest target. Her normal attacks exude a small cloud of poisonous gas around the target for 10 seconds. Enemies in the gas cloud take seconds of BUD-based damage every second while they are in the area. Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a noxious green dragon. Windfall gains the Breaker role and she prefers to attack armored or hits-based enemies. Her normal attacks coat the target in Acid, dealing seconds of BUD-based damage and all successful attacks against those targets break an additional piece of armored or segmented health. Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a vile black dragon. Windfall gains the Control role and she prefers to attack slowed enemies. Her normal attacks create a medium cloud of icy air for 5 seconds around the target. Enemies in the cloud take second of BUD-based damage every second while they are in the area and are slowed by 50%. Windfall's attacks take on the aspect of a chilling white dragon. Unlocks Windfall's Stunning Scintillation Ultimate Attack Windfall increases the effect of The Long Game by % for each adventure, variant, and Patron variant you have completed in the Vecna: Eve of Ruin campaign, stacking multiplicatively. Windfall increases the effect of The Long Game for each adventure, variant, and Patron variant you have completed in the Vecna: Eve of Ruin campaign. Start a fight in my bar, and I'll be the one who finishes it. You have no idea what these hands can do. Try me. Pffft hahaha! Selfless!? ME!? Gods, that's hilarious. You're funny. We all serve a greater purpose. I know mine. Now, do as I say. Hey! Welcome to the Red Belvedere! We have SO much to show you! Oh sweetie, you thought I was your friend? Aww, that is so sad. If you're going to play the game, you have to learn to play it right. Know when to hold, when to fold, when to walk away, and when to run. Meeting me is literally the best thing to ever happen to you. It is done, my queen. I'm going back to hell for a drink and a spa day. There are so many colorful ways to die. Let's begin. I've lost count of the number of lives I've taken with this blade. I'll leave you crying every day once I'm gone. Not sorry. When you grow up on the street, you learn to cut or be cut. The Cult of the Dragon took me in. Through them, I found my queen. I outgrew the cult, and took to Avernus to worship my queen directly. She rewarded me with this on the day I opened the Red Belvedere. I took this from a dying man. Taught myself how to play. It was easy. A little tune and a wink is all it takes to make most fools do whatever I want. It's such a burden to be cursed with this much talent, beauty, and luck. The dirge it plays is the last sound you'll ever hear. Shall I? The more you have, the more you want. Win a thousand of these and I'll let you into the VIP area. Maybe. A gift from one of my many admirers. I fed them to a dragon. Tasked with a crusade to save the multiverse. What a pain. Gross. Remind me to have someone flay the bartender. Enough of this and your mouth goes numb. Aw, can't talk? Good. Coagulated bottled bliss. Spicy and sweet. Just like me, right? Don't answer. My favorite. This stuff gives you wings. No, literally. Drink up. We sell these in our gift shop, for anyone stupid enough to buy. Tell a soul I sleep with this and no one will ever hear from you again. If you want to be let into Dragon's Pride, you'll need to impress me. All that I do is for your glory, my queen. It's all I had to keep me warm, until I learned how to get what I want. Song and dance are for children. Performance is an art. Watch and learn. Jealous? Of course you are. I look exactly the way you wish you could. Tailored just for me, and blessed by my queen. Stunning, I know. A dedicated champion of Tiamat, Windfall has been granted phenomenal power by her master. She is the proprietor of the Red Belvedere, a monument to Tiamat and a remnant of Avernus's original existence as a bucolic paradise designed to tempt mortals. Its edifice was destroyed in the carnage of the Blood War, but Windfall rebuilt the casino and rededicated it to the Dragon Queen as a celebration of her god's greed and vanity. Windfall is ostentatious and charismatic, making small talk with regular patrons and jovially welcoming new faces to the casino. She once plotted to assemble the Rod of Seven Parts to create a gift for her cruel goddess, but has instead joined the Champions at Tiamat's behest. Windfall attacks a random enemy for 1 hit. Windfall deals 1 ultimate hit to all enemies, stunning them before slowing them. Windfall's blinding coat erupts in a scintillating flash, dealing 1 ultimate hit to all enemies, stunning and then slowing them. body.zh: 温德福尔将可用于任何维克那：毁灭前夕战役冒险或支线任务，即使以前由于支线任务或赞助者限制条件无法使用。 温德福尔会使栏位数量最多的列中所有勇士的伤害提升 %。如果有多列栏位数量并列最多，则这些列中的所有英雄都会受到影响。 温德福尔提高阵型中最长一列的（并列也可生效）所有勇士的伤害。 温德福尔攻击并击败敌人时，会获得一层“加注”，否则获得一层“跟注”。每有一层“加注”，金币获取量提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每有一层“跟注”，温德福尔的伤害和“漫长赌局”效果都提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。“加注”和“跟注”最多叠加至 25 层，并且在更换区域时重置。 温德福尔会避免攻击不掉落金币也不会计入任务进度的敌人。她的普通攻击会点燃目标，在 秒内，每秒对敌人造成持续 秒的基于基础杀招伤害的伤害。 温德福尔的攻击带有贪婪红龙的特质。 温德福尔获得“控制”角色定位，并且会优先攻击被眩晕的敌人。她的普通攻击带有闪电能量，最多可以随机攻击另外两名敌人，造成持续 秒的基于基础杀招伤害的伤害，并使所有受到伤害的敌人眩晕 3 秒。 温德福尔的攻击带有震撼蓝龙的特质。 温德福尔会优先攻击最远的目标。她的普通攻击会在目标周围产生一小团有毒气体，持续 10 秒。处于毒气云内的敌人在该区域内时，每秒会受到持续 秒的基于基础杀招伤害的伤害。 温德福尔的攻击带有恶毒绿龙的特质。 温德福尔获得“突破者”角色定位，并且会优先攻击有护甲或基于命中的敌人。她的普通攻击会为目标涂上酸液，造成持续 秒的基于基础杀招伤害的伤害，并且所有命中这些目标的攻击都会额外破坏一块护甲或一段生命条。 温德福尔的攻击带有邪恶黑龙的特质。 温德福尔获得“控制”角色定位，并且会优先攻击被减速的敌人。她的普通攻击会在目标周围产生一团中等大小的冰气云，持续 5 秒。处于该云内的敌人在该区域内时，每秒会受到持续 秒的基于基础杀招伤害的伤害，并且会被减速 50%。 温德福尔的攻击带有凌冽白龙的特质。 解锁温德福尔的杀招“致晕光芒” 对于你在维克那：毁灭前夕战役中所完成的每个冒险、支线任务和赞助者支线任务，温德福尔会使“漫长赌局”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 对于你在维克那：毁灭前夕战役中所完成的每个冒险、支线任务和赞助者支线任务，温德福尔会使“漫长赌局”的效果提高 %。 在我的酒吧里挑起事端，最后收拾局面的也会是我。 你根本不知道这双手能做些什么，来试试啊。 噗哈哈哈！无私？我？天呐，太搞笑了。你可真有趣。 我们都为了更伟大的目标而战。我知道我的目标是什么。现在，照我说的做。 嘿！欢迎来到绯红望台。我们有好多东西要展示给你看呢！ 哦，亲爱的，你以为我是你的朋友？哎呀，真让人难过。 如果你要玩这个游戏，就得学会怎么玩得好。 懂得何时坚持，何时放弃，何时转身离开，以及何时拔腿就跑。 能遇到我，绝对是你这辈子遇到的最棒的事。 事情办妥了，我的女王。我要回地狱喝上一杯，再享受一天水疗。 死法多种多样，花里胡哨。我们开始吧。 我早已记不清这把剑下有多少亡魂了。 等我走了，有你天天哭的时候。我一点也不感到抱歉。 在街头长大，要么学会捅人，要么就等着被捅。 龙巫教收留了我。通过他们，我找到了我的女王。 我不再满足于龙巫教，于是前往阿弗纳斯直接敬奉我的女王。 我的绯红望台开张那天，她把这把剑赏赐给了我。 我从一位濒死之人那里拿到了这个。自学了怎么吹奏。很简单。 只要吹上一段小曲，再抛个媚眼，就能让大多数蠢货乖乖照我的话做。 如此多的才华、美貌和运气于一身，还真是一种负担啊。 它弹奏的挽歌将是你听到的最后声音。要我来一曲吗？ 拥有的越多，想要得就越多。 要是你能赢到一千枚这种硬币，我或许会让你进入贵宾区哦。 这是一位仰慕者送我的礼物。我把那个人喂给了一条龙。 被委以拯救多元宇宙的重任，真是麻烦。 真难喝。提醒我找人扒了那个调酒师的皮。 喝多了这个，你的嘴就会麻木。噢，说不出话了？很好。 装在瓶子里的凝固的极乐滋味。又辣又甜，就像我一样，对吧？别回答。 我的最爱。这玩意儿能让你长出翅膀。不，说真的。喝吧。 我们在礼品店里把这些卖给那些蠢到会买的人。 要是你敢告诉别人我抱着这个睡觉，你就别想再在世上露脸了。 如果你想进入“龙之骄傲”，你得先让我刮目相看才行。 我所做的一切都是为了您的荣耀，我的女王。 在我学会如何得到我想要的东西之前，这是我仅有的用来保暖的东西。 唱歌跳舞那是小孩子才做的事。表演可是一门艺术。看着，学着点。 嫉妒了？你当然会嫉妒。我看起来就是你梦寐以求想要成为的样子。 专门为我量身定制的，还受到了我女王的祝福。很惊艳吧，我知道的。 温德福尔是提亚马特虔诚不二的拥护者，她的主人赋予了她非凡的力量。她是“绯红望台”的所有者，这座建筑不仅是提亚马特的纪念碑，更是阿弗纳斯曾经作为诱惑凡人的田园仙境的遗迹。它在血战的大屠杀中被摧毁，但温德福尔重建了这座赌场，并将它重新献给了龙女王，以此颂扬她神明的贪婪与虚荣。温法尔为人张扬炫耀，却又魅力四射，她会和常客闲聊，还会愉快地欢迎新面孔来到赌场。她曾谋划集齐“七节权杖”，为她残忍的女神献上一份厚礼，但如今却遵照提亚马特的命令加入了勇士们的行列。 温德福尔攻击一个随机敌人 1 次。 温德福尔对所有敌人造成 1 次杀招攻击，先将敌人眩晕，然后减速。 温德福尔耀眼的外表闪耀出夺目的光芒，对所有敌人造成 1 次杀招攻击，先将敌人眩晕，然后减速。

body.en: can be used in any Wild Beyond the Witchlight campaign adventure or variant, even if she would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions. increases the damage of all Neutral (Good/Evil axis) Champions by %. Evandra buffs Neutral Champions on the Good / Evil axis. Try using Lawful and Chaotic Neutral Champions with her. When 's health is brought to zero, she loses her left arm but returns to full health. Her arm regrows after moving to a new area. While missing her arm, she increases the damage bonus of by % for each second she had her arm in the current area, stacking additively and being applied multiplicatively. The first time Evandra would otherwise die in an area, she merely loses an arm and returns to full health. Increases the formation's gold find by %. Every time a Champion attacks but does not defeat an enemy, increase this bonus by %, stacking additively up to times and applying multiplicatively. This bonus resets when an enemy is defeated. Total Gold Find Bonus: % increases the health of all other Champions by % of her max health, and healing effects on all Champions is increased by %. increases the damage bonus of by % for each Female or Nonbinary Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively and applied multiplicatively. Female or Nonbinary Champions: Evandra focuses on her connection with Female and Nonbinary Champions increases the damage bonus of by % for each Fighter, Barbarian, Ranger, or Paladin Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively and applied multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Evandra focuses on her connection with battle-hardened Champions increases the damage bonus of by % for each Champion with a total ability score of 78 or less in the formation, stacking multiplicatively, and all Awful Ones Champions can be used in Witchlight adventures. Qualified Champions: Evandra focuses on her connection with her Awful Ones affiliation Unlocks 's Ultimate Attack Oh, this is what selflessness is? I hate it. Everyone listen up! You all suck. Do better! HA! It's going to take more than six stab wounds to take me down! Why are all of you always unconscious? Oh, come on! You've gotta do better than that to hit me! Calm? I'm always calm. Now excuse me while I stab someone. You want HOW MUCH for this?! Look, a non-suspicious bag of gold laying on the path! Don't have a sword? Just hit them with whatever is around! Plans are so much easier to make without 'good' alignments. Unfortunately, this IS my circus and these ARE my monkeys. Don't worry -- happens all the time. Easy fix with the right Cleric. They've gotta have gold on them. They were bandits! Oh yeah, now this is what I'm talking about! I remember everything! Including how much Antrius still owes me. Ladies, gentlemen, and all fey creatures -- welcome! Give me back my arm or I'll ram it up your -- I can still rip off arms, and they AREN'T full of stuffing! Classy, sassy, and about to kick your -- Of course it's fake - do you know how much stuff like this costs? Made this one myself. There are only a few holes and burn marks on it. It may look like it was adorable, but it nearly took my arm off! ...again. Bandits are very surprised when this comes to life and bites their throats. Those guys were already dead when we found them in the alley. Can you believe this was just lying around in a house we broke into? Oh, I could totally strangle someone with this cape! Won this at a jousting tourney. No thanks to Dargle-bark. I checked this out in Stormwood. They didn't even ask for collateral! These bandits were strange. 'No, we're guards!' Barely fought back. I've cut off SO many heads with this baby. This sword was forged to kill me, but I killed them first! Easy fight, really. Nixie stole this at some point. No idea what it is, but it looks kinda cool. Got this off Mogdar during a battle of strength. He says he didn't agree to it. Dargle-bark as a bearowl is really annoying - so I took this to shut him up. Pulled this off an eldritch beast after I fell through a portal. No big deal. Found this on a dead guard. Don't ask what else I found... Got this on discount after threatening the merchant's family. Lorienne blessed this horn to heal me in battle! But it only heals 1 hp... This horn never runs out of ale! I don't remember two tendays after getting it! No big deal. I'll just get Vlithryn to fix it. Vlithryn didn't fix it... She just screeched and walked away. Very rude. I've beaten so many guards with this. Really gets the anger out. Got a wizard to make it stop decaying because it looks cool on my belt. Rough and tumble, and ready for action, half-elven Fighter Evandra brings the muscle. Evandra ran away from home when her father discovered that she had been training in strength and combat. He tried to force her into an arranged marriage with an elven nobleman, but Evandra rejected this on both principle and taste. She decided instead to become an adventurer, free from her father's judgment. Evandra moves up next to the closest enemy and swings her sword, dealing 1 hit to all nearby enemies. Evandra disarms a mechanical guard. She uses the guard's arm as a weapon for the next 15 seconds and gains some additional effects for the duration A mechanical guard charges toward the party. Evandra moves up, attacks the guard, and instantly "disarms" it and defeats it. Evandra uses the guard's arm as a weapon for the next 15 seconds instead of her sword. For the duration, Evandra's attack deals an additional 3 seconds of BUD damage, her normal attack speed cooldown is faster by 2 seconds, and Freedom's Fury is increased by 100% for the duration. Evandra buffs Neutral Champions (on the Good/Evil axis). This is further buffed by many of her abilities. The first time Evandra would normally perish in an area she merely loses an arm and restores her health to full. Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Male Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Half-Elf Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions with a CON score of 11 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a STR score of 15 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Neutral Champions by %
body.zh: 可用于任何女巫之光的荒野之旅战役冒险或支线任务，即使以前由于支线任务或赞助者限制条件无法使用。 使所有中立（以善良/邪恶划分时）勇士的伤害提高 %。 伊万德拉强化中立勇士（以善良/邪恶划分）。尽量使用守序和混乱中立勇士与她同行。 当 的生命值为零时，她将失去左臂，但恢复全部生命值。移动到新区域后，她的手臂会长回来。当她失去手臂时，在当前区域内的手臂完好的每一秒均使她的 伤害加成提高 %，以加算方式堆叠并以乘算方式应用。 伊万德拉第一次在某个区域原本会死亡时，她并不会死去，而是会失去一只手臂并恢复到满血状态。 使阵型的金币寻获量提高 %。每次勇士发动攻击但没有击败敌人时，此加成提高 %，以加算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 层，以乘算方式生效。当敌人被击败时，此加成重置。 总金币寻获加成： % 提高所有其他勇士的生命值，数值相当于她最大生命值的 %，并且针对所有勇士的治疗效果提高 %。 阵型中每有一位女性或非二元性别勇士，即使 的 伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠并以乘算方式应用。 女性或非二元性别勇士： 伊万德拉专注于她与女性和非二元性别勇士的羁绊 阵型中每有一位战士、野蛮人、巡林客或圣武士勇士，即使 的 伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠并以乘算方式应用。 满足资格勇士： 伊万德拉专注于她与沙场老兵勇士的羁绊 阵型中每有一位总属性值低于等于 78 的勇士， 均使 的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。所有恶人勇士都可以在女巫之光冒险中使用，即使他们不符合基础限制条件。 满足资格勇士： 伊万德拉专注于她与恶人从属组织勇士的羁绊 解锁 的 杀招攻击 哦，这就是所谓的无私吗？太讨厌了。 大家听好了！你们都很差劲。给我卖力点！ 哈！若想放倒我，至少需要捅我六刀！ 为什么你们总是昏迷不醒？ 哦，来吧！要想打中我，你得加把劲儿才行！ 从容？我向来从容。失陪一下，我要去捅人了。 你要多少钱？！ 看，路上有袋一点都不可疑的金币！ 没有剑怎么办？随手抄起什么家伙就上！ 抛弃“善良”准则后，制定计划就容易多了。 很不幸，这是我的马戏团，这些都是我的猴子。 别担心，这种事经常发生。靠谱牧师可以轻松修复。 他们身上一定有金币。因为他们是土匪！ 没错，正合我意！ 我什么都记得！包括安裘斯还欠我多少钱。 女士们，先生们，还有各位精类生物--欢迎光临！ 把手臂还给我，否则我就把它塞进你的-- 我还是能把人的胳膊生拽下来，那可不是什么毛绒玩具啥的！ 优雅，活泼，马上就要踢你的—— 毛皮当然是假的--你知道真的要多少钱吗？ 我亲手做的。上面只有少数几个洞和烧伤痕迹。 看起来也许很可爱，但它差点把我的胳膊扯下来......不止一次。 这玩意儿活过来咬断土匪们的喉咙时，他们惊讶极了。 我们在巷子里发现那些家伙的时候，他们已经死了。 这套盔甲恰好出现在我们闯入的一栋房子里，你敢信吗？ 嘿，我完全可以用这件斗篷勒死某个人！ 我在比武大会上赢来的。与达格吠无关。 我在斯托姆伍德租借的。他们连抵押品都没要！ 那些土匪很奇怪。他们说：“别，我们是守卫！”然后几乎束手就擒。 我用这把宝贝割下过很多头颅。 这把剑专为杀死我而锻造，但我抢先反杀了！简直易如反掌。 妮茜不知啥时候偷来的。不确定它是什么，但看起来有点酷。 比力气获胜后从莫达尔身上赢来的。虽然他号称自己没同意比赛。 作为一只熊鸮，达格吠真的很烦人--所以我用这个让他闭嘴。 我掉进某个传送门之后，从一头魔能野兽身上扯下来的。小事一桩。 在某个死去的守卫身上发现的。别问我还找到了什么...... 威胁商人全家之后，我以低价买到了它。 罗琳祝福过这个号角，可以在战斗中治愈我！但它只能治疗 1 点生命值...... 这个号角里的麦酒永远喝不完！获得它之后，我失忆了二十天！ 小事一桩。我会让维列瑟琳修复的。 维列瑟琳没有修复好......她只是尖叫着跑开了。太失礼了吧。 我用它殴打过很多守卫。非常适合发泄愤怒。 可以当个酷炫的腰带装饰，所以我找法师终止了它的腐烂。 半精灵战士伊万德拉，肌肉发达，动若脱兔，蓄势待发。被父亲发现她一直在进行力量和战斗训练后，伊万德拉选择离家出走。父亲曾试图包办她与一位精灵贵族的婚姻，但无论出于原则还是品味，伊万德拉都表示拒绝。不仅如此，她甚至决意成为一名冒险者，从而摆脱父亲的掌控。 伊万德拉移动到距离最近的敌人身边并挥舞长剑，对附近所有敌人造成 1 次伤害。 伊万德拉肢解一名机械守卫。接下来的 15 秒内，她使用守卫的手臂作为武器，并在此期间内获得一些额外效果 一名机械守卫向探险队发起冲锋。伊万德拉上前攻击守卫，并立即“肢解”和击败对方。接下来的 15 秒内，伊万德拉使用守卫的手臂作为武器，以替换她的长剑。持续期间内，伊万德拉的攻击额外造成 3 秒基础杀招伤害，她的普通攻击速度冷却速度加快 2 秒，“自由之怒”的持续时间延长 100%。 伊万德拉强化中立勇士（以善良/邪恶划分）。她的许多技能都会进一步强化此特典。 伊万德拉第一次在某个区域正常死亡时，她只会失去一条手臂并恢复全部生命值。

body.en: When Alyndra is in the formation, all Champions from the Heroes of the Planes affiliation may be used, even if a Patron, Variant, or other restriction would say otherwise. Alyndra increases the damage of adjacent Champions by %. Alyndra increases the damage of adjacent Champions. Alyndra glances into the future. The next unique Champions to use their ultimate abilities gain the Portent buff for seconds, which increases their base damage by % and reduces their base attack cooldown by 0.5 sec. If an affected Champion uses their ultimate ability again before the Portent buff expires, their Portent buff duration is refreshed. For each Champion in the formation affected by Portent, Alyndra's Circle of Divination is increased by %, stacking multiplicatively. Griff, Alyndra's owl companion, sits on Alyndra's shoulder and judges enemies as they spawn. They have a % chance to judge normal enemies as unworthy, and a 100% chance to judge bosses as unworthy. For each unworthy normal enemy that spawns, Circle of Divination is increased by %, stacking multiplicatively. If a boss has spawned in the current area, Circle of Divination is increased by an additional %. Griff can judge up to normal enemies per area, and the stacks reset when changing areas. Knowledge should always be shared. Well I am the only responsible one here... Something's not right. We should look into it. What did you do now, Avren? Knowing what's going to happen and being prepared for it are different things. It's the idea of a thing, the heart of intention. With friends by your side, you always have a crew. I see beyond the present moment, into the next, and the next. Perhaps there is no past, no future. There is only the infinite now. I have found you wanting. Remember, you are blessed! ... unlike some people. I have seen all, and I have judged all. Sometimes my visions are stronger. So much to do... Sometimes my visions are longer. So much to see... To know the future is a heavy burden, but I shall bear it. I have at times plied my trade for simple coin. The blade been passed through many generations. Do you have a specific story you'd like me to tell? The runes spell logic in elvish. I have forseen this moment. It's really more of a journal of our travels at this stage. Oghma has blessed me with knowledge. Is it a mace case, or a case mace? It is both. A millenium of knowledge resides within. I will always remember flying through the forest together on a parliament of giant owls. I worry this between my fingers whenever I feel lost. A piece of the centerstone from the Chondalwood, the ancestral home of Clan Monkeymouse. So long as you have a piece of home with you, you're always there. I hold this near my heart. Griff keeps nipping at the string. It makes it quite scratchy. Time is a line, except when it's a circle. My family is complicated, but friendship is simple, isn't it? Made of Netherese Steel, it takes up a 3x3 square. Someone MUST keep track of these adventures! This unbreakable pen is stronger than any sword. When you have parents like mine, it pays to do more research. Knowledge is power. body.zh: 当艾琳朵拉处于阵型中时，所有来自位面英雄从属组织的勇士都皆可加入，即便赞助者、支线任务或其他限制条件原本不允许如此。 艾琳朵拉使相邻勇士的伤害提高 % 艾琳朵拉会提高相邻勇士的伤害。 艾琳朵拉可窥视未来。接下来使用杀招技能的 位不同勇士将获得“预兆”增益，持续 秒，期间基础伤害提升 %，基本攻击冷却时间缩短 0.5 秒。如果受影响勇士在预兆增益消失之前再次使用杀招技能，则预兆增益的持续时间刷新。 阵型中每有一位受到“预兆”影响的勇士，艾琳朵拉的“占卜之环”效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 艾琳朵拉的猫头鹰伙伴格里夫蹲在她肩头，在敌人刷新时审判它们。普通敌人有 % 几率被判定为无价值，首领敌人则为 100% 几率。每刷新一名无价值普通敌人，“占卜之环”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。若当前区域刷新一个首领，“占卜之环”的效果额外提升 %。格里夫在每个区域最多可审判 个普通敌人，在变更区域时重置堆叠。 艾琳朵拉的猫头鹰伙伴格里夫在敌人刷新时进行审判。每审判一名敌人均使占卜之环的效果提升。 “预兆”现在会作用于接下来使用杀招技能的 位勇士，而非 位，且效果提升 %。 艾琳朵拉展望更远的未来，使更多勇士获得预兆增益。 格里夫使用“审判表情”将敌人判定为无价值的几率加倍，增益效果提升 %，且在变更区域时保留一半堆叠。 艾琳朵拉专注于强化格里夫，提高它们的审判效果。 如果对一位勇士使用“预兆”时，该勇士已被某个“位面英雄”勇士的技能所影响，则该技能将提升威力。 阿夫伦：已经接受“预兆”的勇士，获得的“镜像”技能效果提升 %^弗里：每有一位同时接受了“预兆”和“悠达拉好运”的勇士，“他们真倒霉”的技能效果提升 %^佩内洛普：楚因加面具：每有一位被“楚因加面具”影响的接受“预兆”的勇士，“物尽其用”符咒的效果提升 %（以乘算方式堆叠）^布里夫：“耐瑟钢”对受“预兆”影响的勇士的效果提高 %^奥尔基拉：每有一个同时受“预兆”和“次级复原术”影响的勇士，“元素火焰”的效果提高 %（以乘算方式堆叠）^威德尔：“吸血鬼之视”对受“预兆”影响的勇士的效果提高 % 使弗里的“他们真倒霉”技能的效果提高 % 使佩内洛普的“楚因加面具：物尽其用符咒”技能的效果提高 % 使奥尔基拉的“元素火焰”技能的效果提高 % 艾琳朵拉会增强她最喜爱的伙伴们的技能：阿夫伦、布里夫、弗里、奥尔基拉、佩内洛普和威德尔。 知识就该用来分享。 这里就只有我一个这么有责任感...... 有点不对劲。必须调查一下。 阿夫伦，你这次又闯了什么祸？ 知道接下来会发生什么，和为此做好准备是两码事。 这是事物的本质，是意图的核心。 有朋友在身边，你就永远有一群伙伴。 我能看见现在之后的那一刻，再之后的一刻。 也许并没有过去，也没有未来。只有无尽的当下。 我认为你不够格。 记住，你可是逢凶化吉的人！ ......可不像某些人啊。 我已见万物，亦已审万物。 有时候我的预言会更强烈。要做的事情太多了…… 有时候我的预言会更持久。要看的东西太多了…… 预知未来是一种沉重的负担，但我愿背负它。 有时候，我也会为了几枚金币出卖我的技艺。 这把剑已经传了很多代了。 有没有具体哪个故事是你想我讲的？ 用精灵语拼写的“逻辑”字样符咒。 我已经预见到了这一刻。 到了这个阶段，它更像是我们旅行的日志。 欧格马赐予了我知识。 这是一个权杖盒子，还是盒子权杖呢？两者都有。 其中蕴含着一千年的知识。 我会永远记得一起骑着一群巨型猫头鹰飞越森林的情景。 每当我感到迷茫的时候，我就会把它放在手指间摇晃。 来自猴鼠族的祖籍琼达尔森林的一块中心石。 只要你身上带着一样家乡的东西，你的家就一直都在。我把这个放在我心口的位置。 格里夫一直啃着那根绳子。这让绳子变得相当粗糙。 时间是一条直线，除非它是一个圆。 我的家庭很复杂，但友谊很简单，不是吗？ 这将过去与未来串联在一起。 对话泡泡里写着：“吼吼吼吼！” 我那时是一只霸王龙，而佩内洛普是一头恐狼。那是一个典型的星期二。 这已经是布里夫最好的水平了。 由耐瑟钢制成，占地面积3x3。 总得有人把这些冒险经历记录下来！ 这支牢不可破的笔比任何刀剑都更有力。 如果你的父母跟我的一样，那么多做些研究是值得的。 知识就是力量。 阿琳德拉·亚历山德拉·加拉纳希尔·萨尔巴兰德拥有许多称号：瑞姆·斯皮罗的“知识守护者”、猴鼠氏族的“血脉书记官”、“忘却之女”、“命运改写者”、“奇幻与魅惑的骑士”……以及阿夫伦与索菲厄斯那满怀歉意的后代。 艾琳朵拉刺激一名随机敌人的心灵，造成伤害并使其在 3 秒内减速 50%。 艾琳朵拉进入一名随机敌人的内心，造成伤害并使其在 3 秒内减速 50%。 艾琳朵拉会提高接下来两位使用杀招的勇士的伤害与攻击速度。 艾琳朵拉会提高接下来两位使用杀招的勇士的伤害与攻击速度。如果勇士在增益消失之前再次使用杀招，则持续时间刷新。

My enemies will rue the day they met me. The fate of Kir Sabal is in my hands. I feel a special bond with you. My people follow me. Will you? Take flight, friends! I can be quite persuasive. Icewind Dale needs protectors! I'll provide air cover. My ancestors watch over us. We must stand together now, for the fate of all. The tip isn't as fragile as it looks. This necklace has seen combat, but is still holding together well. It must be lucky! This fine necklace obviously belonged to a powerful Aarakocra at some point in the past. A shiny armlet with what looks like a small citrine or amber set in it. A beautiful golden armlet set with a shining fire opal. body.zh: 人类勇士提升 % 伤害。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 艾萨拉与队伍中的人类勇士结成友谊纽带，使其伤害提高。 艾萨拉与人类勇士结成友谊纽带，专注于使其成为主要伤害输出者。 矮人与精灵（包括卓尔精灵）勇士提升 % 伤害。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 艾萨拉与队伍中的矮人及精灵勇士（包括卓尔精灵和雅灵）结成友谊纽带，使其伤害提高。 艾萨拉与矮人及精灵勇士（包括卓尔精灵）结成友谊纽带，专注于使其成为主要伤害输出者。 翼爪鸟人、半人马、龙裔、隐逸巨人、蜥蜴人、牛头人、半羊人、提夫林、龟人以及梭螺鱼人勇士提升 % 伤害。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 艾萨拉与队伍中的翼爪鸟人、半人马、龙裔、隐逸巨人、蜥蜴人、牛头人、半羊人、提夫林、龟人以及梭螺鱼人勇士结成友谊纽带，使其伤害提高。 艾萨拉与翼爪鸟人、龙裔、隐逸巨人、蜥蜴人、牛头人、提夫林以及龟人勇士结成友谊纽带，专注于使其成为主要伤害输出者。 队伍中任何适用纽带技能的种族，都会为艾萨拉的相应纽带提升效力 %（单独计算）。另外，如果艾萨拉的某种纽带至少与 4 名勇士建立联系，则提升此纽带效果 队伍成员遭受攻击时，艾萨拉飞离地面，并每 5 秒提升 % 自身伤害。能够以乘算方式堆叠最多 20 层 使半精灵、半兽人和半身人勇士的伤害提高 %。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 艾萨拉与队伍中的半精灵，半兽人和半身人勇士结成友谊纽带，使其伤害提高。 艾萨拉与半精灵，半兽人和半身人勇士结成友谊纽带，专注于使其成为主要伤害输出者。 使神裔、狂蛙人、变形怪、元素裔、吉夫人、吉斯人、巨人、兔人、卡拉史塔人、爬虫人、斑猫人、螳螂人、机关人、魔冢与蛇人勇士的伤害提高 %。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 艾萨拉与队伍中的神裔、狂蛙人、变形怪、元素裔、吉夫人、吉斯人、巨人、兔人、卡拉史塔人、爬虫人、斑猫人、机关人及蛇人勇士结成友谊纽带，使其伤害提高。 艾萨拉与神裔、元素裔、吉斯人、巨人、爬虫人、斑猫人、机关人及蛇人勇士结成友谊纽带，专注于使其成为主要伤害输出者。 使呆宝和小个子勇士的伤害提高 %。 （小个子勇士是指仙女、侏儒、地精、半身人、坎德人、狗头人和等离子体勇士。） 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 艾萨拉与你探险队中的所有仙女、侏儒、地精、半身人、坎德人、狗头人、呆宝和等离子体勇士结成友谊纽带，使他们的伤害提高。 艾萨拉与你的仙女、侏儒、地精、半身人、坎德人、狗头人、呆宝和等离子体勇士结成了友谊纽带。 专注于让他们成为你的主要伤害输出者吧。 我的敌人将为遇到我而后悔。 克萨巴尔的命运就在我的手中。 我感到和你有种特殊的联系。 我的人民会追随我，你会吗？ 快跑吧，朋友！ 我可以相当能言善辩。 冰风谷需要守护者！ 我会提供空中掩护。 我们的祖先守护着我们。现在，为了所有人的命运，我们必须团结一致。 矛头没有想象中的那么脆弱。 这是由克萨巴尔最优秀的翼爪鸟人匠人所铸造而成的。 由克萨巴尔的法师们附魔过的长矛。 我守护了楚尔特的天空这么多年还是第一次见到如此精良的长矛。 此法珠能够让你感觉到微风拂面。 此法珠能够让你感到身边凉风习习。 此法珠能够让你感到身边狂风大作，寸步难移。 此法珠能够让没有经过训练的人瞬间被暴风卷起。 此长袍明显长时间使用过。 此长袍非常合身，而且会在你飞行时随风飘扬。 印画着鲜艳色彩的黄金云朵图案的黄金长袍。 这长袍似乎拥有自己的思维，即使在无风时也会围着你自行旋转。 用来存放法术器材和小饰品的简易小袋子。 比单袋小袋子多一倍的容纳空间！ 我猜测这是某位翼爪鸟人牧师或祭祀心爱的小袋。 这个袋子里存放着几乎所有法术所需用到的材料。 克萨巴尔的翼爪鸟人居民常佩戴的项链。 此项链经历过多次战斗，但依然相对完好无损。真是幸运星！ 这条项链明显曾经属于某位强大的翼爪鸟人英雄的。 这条项链的精湛做工足以让其他项链相形见绌。 简易的护臂，目前可以凑合着用。 其前任主人明显很珍爱它。 这个闪亮的护臂上镶嵌着一颗黄水晶或琥珀宝石。 美轮美奂的黄金护臂，上头镶嵌着一颗闪闪发亮的火蛋白石。 身为克萨巴尔的长老，艾萨拉是一位严厉而可敬的翼爪鸟人法师，她维护着她的族群和奥穆王室的安全。 艾萨拉释放出魔法飞弹弹幕，攻击随机目标。 艾萨拉击退所有敌人，并对随机目标施放一个大火球。 艾萨拉跳到空中，挥动翅膀将所有敌人推离队伍。随后悬停在空中并召唤一个大火球，攻击一名随机敌人和小范围内的其他所有敌人。

body.en: is eligible to start in all adventures, even if the Patron, Variant, or other restrictions would say otherwise. increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation that is years or younger, stacking multiplicatively. If the sum of the youngest Champions' ages is years or less, the bonus is increased by % (post-stack). Dungeon Master buffs the damage of all champions based on the number of Champions under 20 in the formation adds temporary hit points to the entire party upon entering an area when is present. Dungeon Master grants Temporary Hit Points to everyone in the party everytime he chooses to join the formation for an area. Upon entering a new Area, there is a % chance that does not appear in the formation and is replaced by a frightened Uni the Unicorn. While is away, the formation's gold find is increased by %. If you return to a previously completed area, is always with the formation. The chance doesn't join the formation in Disappearing Act is increased to 75%, and gold find amount is also increased by %. Dungeon Master is pulled away more frequently The chance doesn't join the formation in Disappearing Act is decreased to 25%, and the temporary hit points gained by Words of Encouragement are increased by %. Dungeon Master stays close to the Champions Dungeon Master uses his powers to plane shift in Champions that are not normally eligible for the adventure. Preference is given to bench seats with no eligible Champion. Dungeon Master will not select his own seat. Preference is given to bench seats with no eligible Champion. The Champion can not be from 's seat. Current Guest Star: has been chosen!^(Seat ) With each brave deed, you grow more worthy. The life of a Dungeon Master is not an easy one. I have much to tell you and little time! You carry the way within you. Evil deeds return to their source. You will find both safety and danger ahead. I believe in you. The choice, my children, is yours. Not so fast, young ones. Coins are precious! Is it magic or fate? I'll never tell. Ah, time flows yet again. A Dungeon Master appears when they mean to! It is not yet your time. More adventure awaits! You are only as old as you feel, adventurers! In this fantastical world, you could be anything! ...And yet, so many humans. Hm. What you wear tells the world who you are. Red is the color of magic on some worlds. These are a dungeon master's robes! My robes have ascended as I have! Many simple items can hide powerful magic. You should not worry about this -- you should worry about what dangers lie ahead! Am I never without it? Or is it never without me? There are strange forces at work...but this time they're my strange forces! Jewelry and armor in one. I am well protected. My powers are what I need them to be. These rubies once belonged to a fearsome enemy of mine. A hero must accept the chance of failure. Randomness is the nature of this land -- though a hero can make that an advantage. You will need all of these tools, but some more than others. Luck is what you make of it, adventurers. Enter a world of adventure! Take this -- you'll need it. What seems threatening may be a true ally, what seems friendly may be a threat. I have taught you all I know. Now find the power within you! It seems a relic from another world. What could this be if placed in the right hands? What fun! Perhaps more than you planned on, but not more than you can handle, adventurers! He is Dungeon Master, your guide in the realm of Dungeons & Dragons! Dungeon Master fires white rays at a random enemy. Dungeon Master fires 1 or more white rays at a random enemy. Dungeon Master waves his hands, and the Ultimate ability with the longest remaining cooldown immediately recharges. Dungeon Master waves his hands, and the Ultimate ability with the longest remaining cooldown immediately recharges. The cooldown for this Ultimate is set to the time the recharged Ultimate had left. Dungeon Master increases the damage of all Champions in the formation for half of the time his Ultimate is cooling down. Dungeon Master buffs the damage of all Champions based on the number of Champions under 20 in the formation. Dungeon Master can be used in any adventure regardless of restrictions, he can also bring a Special Guest Star with them. body.zh: 即使不满足赞助者、支线任务或其他限制的要求， 仍有资格开始所有探险。 阵型中每有一位 岁或以下的勇士，所有勇士的伤害都会提高 %，并以乘算方式叠加。如果 位最年轻的勇士年龄之和为 岁或更小，则伤害提高 %（叠加后）。 地下城主根据阵型中 20 岁以下的勇士数量，来提高所有勇士的伤害。 当 在队伍中并进入一个新区域时， 将为整个队伍增加 点临时生命值。 地下城主每次在一个区域中加入阵型时，都会为所有队伍成员提供临时生命值。 进入一个新区域时，独角兽“独角”有 % 的几率代替 出现在阵型中。 离开时，阵型的金币寻获量提高 %。如果你回到之前完成的区域， 将始终处于阵型中。 在消失行为中不加入阵型的几率提高到 75%，金币寻获量增加 %。 地下城主被拉走的频率更高 在消失行为中不加入阵型的几率降低至 25%，鼓励之词获得的临时生命值提高 %。 地下城主与勇士保持紧密联系 地下城主用他的力量对通常没有资格参加冒险的勇士进行异界传送。转移时将优先考虑没有勇士可以参战的出战栏位。地下城主不会选择他自己的栏位。 当前客座明星：第 栏位（代表勇士： ） 第 栏位已被选中！ 用他的力量将一位没有资格参加冒险的随机勇士进行位面转移。转移时将优先考虑没有勇士可以参战的出战栏位。勇士不能来自 的出战栏位。 当前客座明星： 已被选中^（第 栏位） 随着每一次勇敢的行动，你会变得更有价值。 地下城主的生活并不轻松。 我有很多事情要告诉你，但时间不多！ 你心中有一条路。 恶行会追根溯源。 你会发现前方既安全又危险。 我相信你。 孩子们，选择在你们手中。 别这么急，年轻人。钱币是很宝贵的！ 这是魔法还是命运？我永远都分不清。 啊，时间又再一次流动了。 地下城主在想要出现的时候就会出现！ 你还不能死。还有更多冒险在等着你！ 冒险者们，心态决定年龄！ 在这个奇幻世界里，你想成为什么都行！ ……可却有那么多人类。唔。 你的穿着向世界宣布了你的身份。 红色在某些世界代表魔法。 这是地下城主的长袍！ 我的袍子与我共同飞升！ 许多简单的物品可以隐藏强大的魔法。 你不应该担心这个--你应该担心前面有什么危险! 我从来没有离开过它吗？还是它从来没有离开过我？ 有奇怪的力量在起作用......但这次是我的奇怪力量! 珠宝和盔甲合二为一。 我受到了很好的保护。 我需要什么样的能量，就有什么样的能量。 这些红宝石曾经属于我一个可怕的敌人。 英雄必须接受失败的可能性。 随机性是这片土地的本质--尽管英雄可以从中获得优势。 你将需要所有这些工具，但有些工具比其他工具更重要。 冒险家们，运气是你们自己创造的。 进入一个冒险的世界！ 带上这个--你会需要它的。 看起来有威胁的可能是真正的盟友，看起来友好的东西可能存在威胁。 我已经把我所知道的都教给你了。现在，找到你内心的力量吧！ 它似乎是另一个世界的怪物。 如果让合适的人来使用，它会发挥多大作用？ 太好玩了！ 也许比你计划的要多，但不会超过你的承受能力，冒险家们！ 他就是地下城主，你在《龙与地下城》国度中的向导！ 地下城主向一名随机敌人发射白色射线。 地下城主向一名随机敌人发射 1 道或更多白色射线。 地下城主挥舞手臂，使当前剩余冷却时间最长的杀招技能立即获得充能。 地下城主挥舞手臂，使当前剩余冷却时间最长的杀招技能立即获得充能。此杀招的冷却时间等于被充能杀招的剩余冷却时间。地下城主提高阵型中所有勇士的伤害，持续时间为其杀招冷却时间的一半。 地下城主根据阵型中 20 岁以下勇士（包括他自己）的数量，来提高所有勇士（包括他自己）的伤害。 地下城主可以在所有冒险中使用，不受任何限制，他还可以带上一位特别客座明星一起参战。

body.en: increases the damage of all Champions in her column by %. Fen increases the damage of Champions in her column. When is in the formation in any party, patron challenge progress made by all parties is increased by %. Fen increases the amount of progress credited in Patron Challenges for all parties. reduces the normal attack speed of all Warlocks in the formation by for each point of Wisdom an adjacent Champion has above . imbues her blade with eldritch energy, increasing the effect of by % and causing her normal attack to deal an additional 5 seconds of BUD based damage with each hit. Fen focuses on her eldritch blade, increasing her support and dealing additional damage. embraces her Dhampir heritage and increases her damage by %. Fen focuses on her Dhampir heritage, dealing much more damage. increases the effect of Mischievous, but Dangerous by % for each Champion in the formation that is either a Black Dice Society affiliation member or has a WIS of 15+, stacking multiplicatively. We're family. I've got you. I do what I must to protect those I care about. I punched the Caller into oblivion -- do you really want to try me? Are we allowing fangs? Or no? You have no idea who you're dealing with. Some say it's a curse; I say it's what I am. Don't mess with my friends. This is going to be bad. If we put our heads together, we can overcome! You have no idea who you're messing with. There's a drop of blood in the center of this diamond. My remaining connection to Isolde. Everything I've done has been for her. This art signifies our love more than a ring ever could. I've had this since I lived down in the Underdark. I tore off all the badges I didn't agree with. Everyone needs a sturdy coat that repels mist. Style, substance, and plenty of pockets. They may be worn, but they'll still kick a hole in a zombie. I've traveled all through the mists in these. Go ahead. Let's see what you're made of. You never know when you need to be ready for a fight. When you can't afford to just bash through the door. I've been at this a while. Deep breath, steady hands. You don't need to know what these are for. The Underdark is full of monsters. I learned the sword early. The Mists are full of surprises, many of them stabbable. Vengeance cuts both ways...but mostly toward my enemies. I had a score to settle with the Caller. Bearing Nepenthe is worth it. Bringing your own provisions into the mists is a good choice. I'm absolutely certain THIS ONE is beef. I'm parched. Tasty, but tricky. Fen is a Drow Dhampir Warlock with a touch of mischief and sneakiness. She's loyal to those she cares for, a fearsome opponent for those who have earned her hate. Above all else, everything she's done has been for Isolde's freedom. Now she needs a new purpose to fight for, and maybe she can find it among the Society. Fen darts out to the closest enemy and slashes with her longsword, hitting all nearby enemies. Fen sprouts wings and charges, dealing damage to all enemies and knocking them back. Fen transforms into her dread form. She sprouts wings, leaps into the air, and charges directly across the area, dealing one hit of ultimate damage to all enemies she passes and knocking them back a short distance. Fen increases the damage of all Champions in her Column Fen increases the progress rewarded for Patron Challenges provided from parties that she is in. body.zh: 使她纵队中所有勇士的伤害提高 %。 芬提高同列勇士的伤害。 当 处于任意探险队的阵型中时，所有探险队的赞助者挑战进度增加 %。 芬会提高所有探险队在赞助者挑战中获得的进度。 相邻勇士的感知每比 高 1 点， 均使阵型内所有邪术师的普通攻击速度降低 。 为自己的剑注入魔能，使 的效果提高 %，并使她的普通攻击每次命中时额外造成 5 秒基础杀招伤害。 芬专注于她的魔能剑，提高她的支援能力并造成额外伤害。 发挥她的半吸血鬼血统，使自身伤害提高 %。 芬专注于她的半吸血鬼血统，造成更多伤害。 阵型中的每位黑骰子协会从属组织成员，或感知为 15+ 的勇士，均使 的“顽皮但危险”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 我们是亲人，放心交给我吧。 我会竭尽所能保护我所关心的人。 我把召唤者打得神志不清--你确定要挑战我吗？ 可以用牙咬吗？不行？ 你根本不知道自己在和谁打交道。 有人说这是诅咒，我说这就是我。 别惹我的朋友。 结果会很糟糕。 朋友齐心，其利断金！ 你根本不知道自己在和谁在闹。 这颗钻石的中心有一滴血。 我和伊索德残留的纽带。 我所做的一切都是为了她。 这件艺术品比戒指更能彰显我们的爱。 自从我居住在幽暗地域，就一直穿着它。 我撕掉了所有道不同不相为谋的徽章。 每个人都需要一件耐用的防雾外套。 时髦又厚实，还有大量的口袋。 虽然已经磨损，但依然能够在僵尸身上踢出一个洞。 我穿着它们踏遍迷雾。 去吧，让我们瞧瞧你的本事。 你永远不知道什么时候需要备战。 当你不能破门而入的时候。 我已经用过一段时间了。 深呼吸，稳住手。 你不需要知道这些是干什么的。 幽暗地域遍布怪物。我很早就学会了用剑。 迷雾中充满惊喜，其中很多都值得捅上一剑。 复仇的伤害是双向的......但主要针对我的敌人。 我与召唤者有账要算，值得携带忘忧药。 自带食物进入迷雾是个不错的选择。 我绝对肯定这是牛肉。 我渴了。 味道不错，但有蹊跷。 芬是个半吸血鬼卓尔精灵邪术师，性格略带狡黠和鬼祟。她对朋友如春天般温暖，对敌人像严冬一样残酷无情。最重要的是，她所做的一切都是为了伊索德的自由。现如今，她需要一个新的目标来为之奋斗。或许，她可以在协会中找到它。 芬飞身冲向最近的敌人，并用长剑发动顺劈，击中附近的所有敌人。 芬张开翅膀发起冲锋，对所有敌人造成伤害并将其击退。 芬转变为恐惧形态。她生出翅膀跃入半空，直接冲向整片区域，对所有经过的敌人造成杀招伤害，并将其击退一小段距离。 芬使同列所有勇士的伤害提高 芬提高她所在探险队提供的赞助者挑战奖励的进度。

body.en: Kas is Undead and counts as "dead" for the purposes of effects that care about dead Champions, but "alive" for all other purposes. Via his abilities, Kas may cause one or more other Champions in the formation to become his Vampire Spawns, which are also Undead. Kas increases his damage by % for each Evil Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Kas increases his damage for each Evil Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Every time an area is completed, Kas gains Pawn stacks equal to the number of Champions in the formation that are not one of his Vampire Spawns. Each Pawn stack increases the effect of Born Into Evil by %, stacking multiplicatively. ^Non Vampire Spawn Champions: When an Undead Champion in the formation attacks, they regain Hit Points. When a Champion that is not already Undead dies, they immediately resurrect at full health as a Vampire Spawn, counting as Undead for the rest of the adventure. The effect of Born Into Evil is increased by % for each Undead Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. When a Champion that isn't Undead is defeated, Kas brings them back as an Undead Vampire Spawn. Undead Champions also heal with every attack. Kas increases the effect of Life Drain by % and Evil Champions attack faster as their base attack cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds. Champions in Formation Targeted: Kas' Evil nature improves the healing abilities of his thralls. Kas' damage against Boss enemies is increased by %, and the effect of Born Into Evil is increased by % for each Undead Champion in the formation. Champions in Formation Targeted: Betraying those in charge is second nature for someone like Kas. Increases the effect of Born Into Evil by %. In addition, Champions adjacent to Kas gain the Evil tag. This does not affect their other alignment tags, and doesn't affect whether they are eligible for the adventure. When in doubt, choose the evil path. Unlocks Kas' Rise, Fallen Soldier! Ultimate Attack I do not brawl in taverns - I feast on mortal fools. As my fangs sink into your neck - I want you to remember your life one last time. The Darkness made me who I am. It molded me into the man I am today. On its own, it grows. With many, it flourishes. Mortals still serve some purposes. Some mortals are more devoted than others. Take what you need from these mortals - life and all. What is a man? Drink. And you will live forever. To do my bidding and to be my jackals when I want to feed. I am the vengeance in your heart. I am the rage in your veins. The voice... it's clearer now... it... it wants your death. ARGH! HOW DARE YOU! I will consume you in my rage! I've practiced the blade for centuries. You are nothing before me. I would burn this world to ash for the sake of my revenge. I will take their lives. I shall drink their very souls. Their fate is sealed. Ah, such a rich vintage, with notes of fey. I must have more. Only a handful of mortals may say that they've earned my esteem. I've lost touch with my true self for too long. No more. In death, they offered me a new life. I would have been a fool to deny them. I can feel their influence on the fringes of my mind... ...they need me to spread darkness across the multiverse. And I will. I will be the heart of darkness within the light of hope. I still remember the feeling of the blade slicing his neck. The look of terror on his decapitated head. The sight of his lifeless body collapsed. How good the rage felt as the monster realized he had lost. I once proudly rode under this banner. The symbol strikes fear into the hearts of countless across the multiverse. I do not care of its power - this will never be used against me again. Sometimes I feel as if he can still see me through it... No longer will I hide in the shadows. My name will be feared once again. Those fools suspect nothing... ...soon they will bring me everything I need. Soon, my friend, you will be free. How many did I kill with one of these? Not just on the battlefield... ...but in the towns and cities Vecna claimed in his conquest. Into this blade, I pour my anger, my rage, and my vengeance. It urged me to kill him. Haunted me with the thoughts of his death. The Dark Power granted me leave from Tovag.... ...but I cannot exist far from its soil. I found this just after Tovag was created. Do the Dark Power mock me? A gift from Darkon so I may learn about my new form of dread... Once the Lieutenant of Vecna, Kas betrayed his former master in a fight resulting in the dreaded artifacts, the Hand and Eye of Vecna. Kas is a vampire, legendary swordfighter, and ruthless warlord, and he is driven primarily by one thing: his hatred for Vecna. Kas attacks the closest enemy and other nearby foes with a sweep of his sword. Kas moves up to the closest enemy and swings his sword, dealing one hit to all enemies in a small area. Kas summons two specters that deal ultimate damage each second for 15 seconds. Kas summons two specters that move towards enemies, dealing ultimate damage each second for 15 seconds. body.zh: 对于影响死亡勇士的效果，凯斯为亡灵，并被视为“死亡”，对于所有其他效果则被视为“存活”。通过他的技能，凯斯可能使阵型中的一名或多名其他勇士变成他的吸血鬼衍体，这些吸血鬼衍体也会变成亡灵。 阵型中的每位邪恶阵营勇士均使凯斯的伤害提高 % %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中的每位邪恶阵营勇士均使凯斯的伤害提高，以乘算方式堆叠。 每完成一个区域，凯斯就会获得棋子堆叠层数，其数量相当于阵型中的非凯斯吸血鬼衍体勇士数量。每层棋子堆叠层数均使生而为恶的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。^非吸血鬼衍体勇士： 当阵型中的一位亡灵勇士攻击时，重新获得 点生命值。 当一名未成为亡灵的勇士死亡时，会立即以满血状态复活为吸血鬼衍体，并在接下来的冒险中被视为亡灵。阵型中的每位亡灵勇士均使生而为恶的效果提高 % ，以乘算方式堆叠。 当一名非亡灵勇士被击败时，凯斯会将他们复活为亡灵吸血鬼衍体。亡灵勇士每次攻击时也会恢复生命值。 凯斯使生命汲取的效果提高 ，并使邪恶阵营勇士攻击速度更快，基本攻击冷却时间缩短 0.5 秒。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 凯斯的邪恶本性能够增强他奴仆的治疗能力。 阵型中的每位亡灵勇士均使凯斯对首领敌人造成的伤害提高 %，并使生而为恶的效果提高 %。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 对于凯斯这样的人来说，背叛上位者是本能反应。 使生而为恶的效果提高 %。另外，与凯斯相邻的勇士获得邪恶标签。这不会影响他们的其他阵营标签，也不会影响他们是否有资格参加冒险。 拿不定主意时，就选择邪恶之路。 解锁凯斯的“崛起吧，阵亡将士！”杀招攻击 我不在酒馆里打架，我会尽情享用凡人的食物。 当我的尖牙扎进你的脖子时，我希望你最后一次回忆你的人生。 是黑暗造就了我，是它把我塑造成我现在的样子。 独自存在时，它会壮大。有众多共存时，它会变得猖獗。 凡人还是有些用途的。 有些凡人比其他人更虔诚。 从这些凡人身上取走你需要的东西吧——生命和其他的一切。 什么是人？ 喝吧，喝了你就会永生了。 听从我的命令，当我要吃东西的时候成为我手下的豺狼。 我是你心中的复仇。我是你血管里的愤怒。 那声音……现在变清晰了……它……它想要你死。 啊！你好大的胆子！我会在怒火中吞噬你！ 我练了几个世纪的剑。在我面前，你什么也不是。 为了复仇，我愿将这个世界化为灰烬。 我将取走他们的性命。我要喝下他们的灵魂。他们的命运已经注定了。 啊，如此醇厚的佳酿，还带有精类生物的风味。我得多来点。 只有极少数的凡人可以说自己赢得了我的尊重。 我疏远我真正的自我太久了。以后不会这样了。 在死亡中，他们给了我新的生命。我要是拒绝他们就是傻瓜了。 我能感觉到他们的影响游走在我意识的边缘…… ……他们要我在整个多元宇宙散播黑暗。我会的。 我将成为希望之光中的黑暗之心。 我依然记得利刃割破他脖子的感觉。 他被砍下的头颅上的惊恐神情。 看到他毫无生气的躯体，我感到万念俱灰。 当怪物意识到自己输了的时候，他的愤怒是多么美妙啊。 我曾骄傲地在这面旗帜下驰骋。 这个徽记让多元宇宙里的无数人由心底里感到恐惧。 我不在乎它的力量，它永远不会再被用来对付我了。 有时候我感觉他依然能通过它看见我…… 我不会再躲藏在暗影之中了。我的名字将再次被人敬畏。 那些傻瓜一点都不怀疑…… ……很快他们就会把我需要的一切拿来给我。 我的朋友，你很快就可以自由了。 我用这东西杀过多少人？不仅仅是在战场上…… ……还有在维克那征服的过程中夺下的城镇之中。 我在这把剑上倾注了我的怒气、怒火和复仇。 它催促我杀了他，让我不断想起他的死。 黑暗力量允许我离开托瓦…… ……但我无法在远离它的土地上生存。 我在托瓦被创造出来后不久找到了这个。黑暗力量在嘲笑我吗？ 一份来自达孔的礼物，让我可以了解我新的恐惧形态…… 凯斯曾是维克那的副官，但在一场战斗中背叛了他的前主人，导致了可怕的神器——维克那之手和法眼的诞生。凯斯是一名吸血鬼、传奇剑士，也是一位冷酷无情的军阀，他唯一的驱动力就是对维克那的仇恨。 凯斯用剑横扫攻击最近的敌人和附近的其他敌人。 凯斯移动到距离最近的敌人身边并挥舞长剑，对小范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击。 凯斯召唤两个幽灵，每秒造成杀招伤害，持续 15 秒。 凯斯召唤两个幽灵朝敌人飘去，每秒造成杀招伤害，持续 15 秒。

body.en: Krond can equip a single Cantrip Feat at a time, adding that spell to his base attack. Krond's Cantrips are Fire Bolt, Shocking Grasp, and Thunderclap, with each getting stronger Feat versions at Rare and eventually Epic. When you acquire the stronger versions of the Feats, they will replace the lower-level versions. Krond increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Good Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Krond increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Evil Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Krond increases the damage of all Champions based on the number of Evil Champions. A specialization expands this to include those with high Strength, Constitution, or Intelligence. Krond increases the effect of Unsung Alliance by % for each Champion in the formation with a STR score of 16 or higher, stacking multiplicatively. Strong Champions: Krond's brute force is amplified when allied with warriors of unparalleled might. Krond increases the effect of Unsung Alliance by % for each Champion in the formation with a CON score of 16 or higher, stacking multiplicatively. Fit Champions: Krond thrives when his allies are forged in the crucible of hardship and pain. Krond increases the effect of Unsung Alliance by % for each Champion in the formation with an INT score of 16 or higher, stacking multiplicatively. Smart Champions: In the company of strategic allies, Krond's keen intellect transforms chaos into calculated triumph. Krond increases the effect of Unsung Alliance by % for each point of STR over 16 on every Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Krond increases the effect of Unsung Alliance by % for each point of CON over 16 on every Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Krond increases the effect of Unsung Alliance by % for each point of INT over 16 on every Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Krond further increases his damage bonus based on how high his companions' chosen ability scores are - higher scores provide greater boosts. Krond gains the Debuff role and enemies damaged by Krond take an additional % damage from all of his subsequent attacks, including any Cantrip spells. Krond's arcane skill weakens his foes, making every subsequent blow cut deeper. Krond increases the effect of Unsung Alliance by % when he is not the formation's BUD-setting Champion. Active: {No}#FF0000 Active: {Yes}#00FF00 Krond guides the party from the shadows, empowering his allies to deal more damage. Krond's Cantrip Feats now deal damage equal to seconds of BUD-based damage for each % of Krond's base damage that they normally deal. Krond's deadly magic transforms his simple cantrips into explosive magical attacks. Sometimes two halves make more than a whole. My might and magic will destroy you. Striking, isn't it? My mother would appreciate this about me. The goblins that killed my mother shall not live long! Watch over me, mother and father. I shall lead them as you would have done. A vrock demon's stunning screech is a vile cacophony you never forget. I shall demonstrate. I was inspired to study how a dao genie's magic can burst apart the very earth. I survived the thunderous bellow of the legendary tarrasque. Now I wield that ruin for my own. The charged tendrils of shambling mounds were worth the danger for my studies. I trained with storm giants in a castle above the clouds to learn the secrets of their mighty thunderbolts. Few can survive the lightning strike of a rampaging kraken. I did. Let's see how you fare. Flameskulls make for poor teachers. I learned what I could before smashing it to pieces. I sparred for a tenday with a salamander inferno master. Let me show you what I learned. An ancient red dragon was among my finest masters. I slew her and took her flame for my own. They say great minds think alike. I think of revenge. What of you? You all have proven yourselves worthy of my respect. Together, we will crush ANY opposition! Too long have I been forgotten! Strength and guile will see us through this. My parents taught me much, but above all is this: one needs allies to survive in this world. My mother's influence will never leave me. Hatred clouded my mind and guided my hands for too long. Now I choose a better path. Whatever our cause, we fight for it together. A basic amulet given to all orc children. Obviously magical - it radiates heat. An amulet of warding constructed by our community's sage. My father's amulet; worn in battle dozens, perhaps hundreds of time. A simple belt; better to wear this than to have your pants fall down. Softness isn't often a quality I admire, but I make an exception for this belt. A wizard's belt, but still useful to a warrior such as myself. This belt belonged to my mother; it saw her safely through countless dangers. So much is missing; someone who learns history from this book is bound to repeat it. There are important lessons in all of our pasts. A detailed history of half-orc culture, written by myself. A detailed encyclopedia of orcs and their customs - my mother's life's work. It cracked when I hit a Stone Golem so hard that it shattered. Heavy to carry around, but worth it in battle. A warrior needs every advantage to catch his enemy off guard. My bonded warhammer has served me well throughout the years. I should probably get this replaced. Yes, I knit. What's your problem with that? A fine scarf, though not very warrior-ly. A memento from my time training as an Eldritch Knight. Adequate for a child perhaps, but I hope to find a new pair soon enough. Hardened leather can surprisingly deflect even strong and sharp attacks. A good shoulder charge never hurt anyone; perhaps just my enemies. If magic fails me, these pauldrons will see me through. Krond was born of a union between an academic human wizard and a mighty orc fighter who led a nomadic orc community. Raised as a fearsome warrior and arcane scholar, he studied these arts with equal passion. Krond's parents tragically lost their lives protecting their family and friends during an enemy raid. This moment changed Krond, and he swore revenge upon the world. Taking up an ancestral warhammer called Unity, Krond set out to make things right, one way or another. Krond leaps out and attacks the front-most target with his bonded warhammer. If you have a Cantrip Feat equipped, he then casts the given Cantrip. Krond teleports to a random enemy and causes massive area damage. Krond throws down his warhammer and leaps up into the air, teleporting to a random enemy and causing massive area damage by slamming down to the ground and casting Shatter when he appears. Increases the damage of all Champions by % Increases the damage of all Male Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Half-Orc Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a STR score of 15 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion with a INT score of 15 or higher in the formation Increases the damage of all Chaotic Champions by %
body.zh: 克朗一次只能装备一个戏法专长，并将该法术加入他的基本攻击中。克朗的可用戏法包括：火焰箭、电爪术和雷鸣术，每个都有非凡品质和最终史诗品质的强化专长版本。当你获得更强版本的专长时，它将替代低等级版本。 阵型中每有一位善良阵营的勇士，克朗就提高所有勇士的伤害 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中每有一位邪恶阵营的勇士，克朗就提高所有勇士的伤害 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 克朗根据阵型中邪恶勇士的数量来提升所有勇士的伤害。如果学习某项专精，可将此效果扩展到包括那些拥有高力量、体质或智力的勇士。 阵型中每有一位力量值高于或等于 16 的勇士，克朗使无名联盟的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 力量型勇士： 当克朗与无比强大的战士结盟时，他的蛮力会得到增强。 阵型中每有一位体质高于或等于 16 的勇士，克朗使无名联盟的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 体质型勇士： 当克朗的盟友在艰难困苦的熔炉中锤炼出来时，他便能蓬勃发展。 阵型中每有一位智力高于或等于 16 的勇士，克朗使无名联盟的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 智力型勇士： 在富有谋略的盟友陪伴下，克朗敏锐的智慧能将混乱转化为精心谋划的胜利。 阵型中每位勇士的力量每高于 16 一点，克朗即提高“无名联盟”的效果 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中每位勇士的体质每高于 16 一点，克朗即提高“无名联盟”的效果 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中每位勇士的智力每高于 16 一点，克朗即提高“无名联盟”的效果 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 克朗会根据他同伴所选技能值的高低进一步提升他的伤害加成——技能值越高，加成越大。 克朗获得“减益”角色定位。被克伦德造成伤害的敌人后续遭到克伦德攻击（包括任何戏法法术）时，会额外受到 % 的伤害。 克朗的奥术技能会削弱敌人，使后续的每一次攻击都更加致命。 如果克朗不是阵型的基础杀招伤害设置勇士，克朗即提高“无名联盟”的效果 %，以乘算方式叠加。 激活状态： {Yes}#00FF00 激活状态： {No}#FF0000 克朗在暗中引导队伍，赋予盟友更强的伤害输出能力。 克隆德的“小法术”专长现在每造成其正常基础伤害的 %，就会造成相当于 秒 BUD 伤害的伤害。 克朗致命的魔法能将他简单的戏法转化为具有爆炸性的魔法攻击。 有的时候，三个臭皮匠，胜过诸葛亮。 我的力量和魔法将摧毁你。 很震撼，不是吗？ 我的母亲会喜欢我这一点。 杀害我母亲的地精，绝对活不长！ 父母啊，请守护着我。我会像你们那样带领他们前行。 弗洛魔那令人震惊的可怖尖叫令你永远无法遗忘。我来给你演示一下。 我受到启发，研究了道魔精灵的魔法如何能炸开大地。 我从传说中泰拉斯奎巨兽那雷鸣般的咆哮中幸存下来。现在我将那毁灭之力为己所用。 那些蔓生怪长着带电的触须，为了我的研究，冒这个险也值得。 我在云层之上的城堡中与风暴巨人一起训练，学习他们强大的雷电奥秘。 很少有人能在横冲直撞的海怪的闪电攻击下幸存。我做到了。来看看你能撑多久。 燃焰之颅可不是什么好老师。我在把它砸成碎片之前尽可能地学了一招。 我与一名火蜥蜴炼狱大师切磋了十天。给你展示一下我学到的东西吧。 一位古老的红龙曾是我最出色的导师之一。我杀了她，并将她的火焰据为己有。 人们说英雄所见略同。我想的是复仇，你们呢？ 你们都已证明自己值得我尊重。 齐心协力，我们将击溃一切阻碍！ 我已经被遗忘得太久了！ 力量和诡计会帮我们渡过难关。 父母教给我很多东西，但最重要的莫过于这一点：要想在这个世界上生存下去，就需要盟友。 我母亲的影响永远伴随着我。 我的心智和行动受仇恨蒙蔽太久了。现在我将选择一条更好的路。 不管我们的目标是什么，我们都会共同为之而战。 所有兽人孩童都得到过的基础护身符。 明显散发着热能的魔法物品。 这是我们族群的贤者制作的辟邪护身符。 这是我父亲的护身符，它经历过大大小小数以百次的战斗了吧。 简易的腰带；戴着它总比任由裤子滑落来得好。 我一般不喜欢柔软的事物，但这条腰带是个例外。 这是法师用的腰带，但对我这位战士来说也是有用处的。 这腰带是属于我母亲的；它帮助她渡过了无数次的难关。 缺失了太多内容；从这本书学习历史的人绝对会重蹈覆辙。 我们能够从历史中学习到珍贵的经验。 这是对半兽人文化的详细记载，是由我本人撰写的。 这是对兽人和其传统文化的详细记载，是我母亲的毕生作品。 某次我用它来一锤击碎石魔像时把它也弄破裂了。 虽然很沉重，但是在战斗中很实用。 战士就是需要出其不意才能攻其不备。 我的战锤伙伴多年来一直陪伴着我。 我大概应该把这个换掉。 是的，我会织毛衣。你对这有什么意见吗？ 一条很漂亮的围巾，虽然不太像战士会戴的那种。 这是我接受“异界骑士”训练时留下的纪念品。 孩童使用还差不多，我得尽快找到替代品了。 硬化皮革很适合格挡钝击和刺击。 用肩膀冲击是对的，反正不会伤及无辜；除了受冲击的敌人是个例外。 哪怕失去魔法，我也能仰赖这双肩甲。 克朗的母亲是一位学识渊博的人类法师，父亲则是一位曾统领游牧兽人部落的强悍兽人战士。自幼，他便被当作一名令人胆寒的战士与精通奥术的学者来培养，对战斗技艺与奥术学问抱有同等的热忱。在一次敌人的突袭中，他的父母为了保护家人和朋友不幸丧生。这一悲惨瞬间彻底改变了他的人生轨迹，他发誓要向这个世界复仇。随后，他拿起一把名为“团结”的祖传战锤，决心用尽一切办法，向世界讨回一个公道。 克朗跳起并用他的战锤攻击最前方的目标。如果装备了戏法专长，他随后会施展该戏法。 克朗传送到一个随机敌人处，并造成大量范围伤害。 克朗扔下他的战锤并跃入空中，传送到一个随机敌人处，猛地砸向地面并在出现时施展“粉碎”技能，造成大量范围伤害。

body.en: Every 5 seconds, Krull applies a draconic plague to the next enemy to spawn. The plagues gain a stack every 3 seconds, increasing their power and capping at 10 stacks. Plagues can also be applied by Krull's base attack.^ Krull occasionally infects the next enemy to spawn with a Draconic Plague which can increase their damage taken, gold dropped, or make them trigger AOE damage. When an enemy with a Draconic Plague dies there is a % chance that its plague(s) will transfer to another enemy. It's possible for an enemy to gain multiple copies of the same plague when this occurs, which will stack multiplicatively. Krull focuses his research on pilfering more gold from plagued foes. Krull focuses his research on inflicting more pain on plagued foes. Krull focuses his research on increasing the traitorous tendencies of plagued foes. Krull increases the damage of all Evil Champions in the formation by %, reduced by % for each Good Champion in the formation. Krull increases the damage of all evil Champions, but reduces the bonus for each good Champion in the formation. Krull increases the damage of Arkhan the Cruel by %, reduced by % (multiplicatively) for each slot away from Krull greater than one. Increase the effect of by % for each Dark Order member adjacent to . If I must. Inspiration comes from many sources, including fear. My life may be forfeit, but I still need funds for my experiments. What's that behind your ear? It's a blade. Keep your wits about you. Treat others as if you could turn them into gold. Then do so. They had it coming. Strike at the raised bits and watch them crumble. They can't retaliate if they can't move! Companionship will be their undoing. Unicorn horns were the key all along. I must help my master control the Hand of Vecna. Strike while the iron is hot. The burning helps. Why fight over this silly metal when you can create it! Arkhan bested me, so he has my service. For now. Their skills were lacking. These came from two who were seeking my master. They no longer matter. Arkhan bested me, but spared my life for an oath of servitude. Screams replaced by crippling fumes. Excellent. Subject #466: Successful bone devil tail attachment. Subject stayed sane for 2 days. Plague 42: Relieving pain by popping boils spiked mortality of the exposed by 400% Consider vampiric components to increase bloodlust. Remember to lock door. Arkhan gained my servitude, but I gained access TO A GOD. You have such... interesting eyes. I said a FRESH tongue, this one is hours old! The more magical the source, the more delicious the concoction. Have you ground up a unicorn horn? It rips at your soul in a way that... tickles me. She empowers my master; the one known simply as: 'The Cruel'. Show them your god, then make them regret standing in her way. Do not underestimate the dragon queen's rage. My master can withstand any torture, so long as he can learn to control the hand. They said it couldn't be done, but my mutilation is now complete. My shell's prayers have evolved as my eyes have been opened by my master. I knew I was bested when Arkhan's strikes started shearing off pieces of my shell. I reconstituted it, but it was painful. If you don't know, I can't tell you. The first rule of the Dark Order is... well, I have to kill you now. It helps to keep a watchful eye on our subjects. With Arkhan, myself, and Torogar, the Dark Order is now complete. Krull is a death-cleric of Tiamat who swore allegiance to Arkhan the Cruel after being bested by him in combat. He's Arkhan's alchemist, his experimenter, his torturer... Always surrounded by the dead, Krull wears a white painted face mask that makes him look undead in an effort to confuse and strike fear in his opponents. Krull attacks a random enemy with his Maul. Krull summons four corrupted ghouls that rush towards the nearest enemies and explode. Krull summons four corrupted ghouls that rush towards the nearest enemies and explode, damaging all nearby enemies and leaving behind pools of necrotic goo that last for 30 seconds. Krull greatly increases the damage of all evil champions, but by less if there are any do-gooders around. body.zh: 每过 5 秒，克鲁尔对下一个即将刷新的敌人施放龙语瘟疫，巨龙瘟疫每 3 秒堆叠一层并提升威力，堆叠层数最多 10 层。克鲁尔的基本攻击也会附带瘟疫^ 克鲁尔偶尔使下一个刷新的敌人感染龙语瘟疫，提高其受到的伤害、金币掉落，或使其触发范围伤害。 当一名带有龙语瘟疫的敌人死亡时，有 几率将瘟疫转移到另一名敌人身上。这种情况下，同一名敌人有可能多次感染瘟疫（几率以乘算方式堆叠） 克鲁尔的研究专注于从感染瘟疫的敌人身上窃取更多金币。 克鲁尔的研究专注于使感染瘟疫的敌人受到更多伤害。 克鲁尔的研究专注于提高感染瘟疫敌人的背叛倾向。 克鲁尔使阵型中所有邪恶阵营勇士的伤害提高 %，但阵型中的每位善良阵营勇士都会使加成降低 % 克鲁尔使所有邪恶勇士的伤害提高，但阵型中的每位善良勇士都会使加成降低。 克鲁尔使残暴者阿克汉的伤害提高 %。阿克汉与克鲁尔距离一格以上时，每增加一格则降低此加成 %（乘算） 每有一位黑暗教团成员与 相邻， 的效果即提升 %。 如果我必须这样的话。 灵感的来源很多，包括恐惧。 我的性命可能会被没收，但我还是需要资金来做实验。 你耳朵后面是什么？是把利刃，保持冷静。 对待他人，要像你能把他们变成金子一样。然后再这样做。 他们罪有应得。 敲打升起的部分，然后看着它们粉碎。 如果他们动不了，就没办法报复了！ 友情将成为他们失败的原因。 独角兽的角一直都是关键。 我必须帮我的主人控制维克那之手。 做事该趁热打铁。燃烧般的痛感会起到作用。 既然你能创造出这种愚蠢的东西，为什么还要为它争斗呢！ 阿克汉打败了我，所以他得到了我的效忠。暂时而已。 还是缺乏了些技巧。 这曾经是属于在寻找我主人的两个家伙的。他们不会再打扰任何人了。 阿克汉打败了我，但是为了换取我的效忠他饶了我一命。 利用削弱香气来取代哀嚎声。太棒了。 466号对象：成功移除了骨魔尾巴。对象维持了2天的清醒状态。 42号疫病：通过泡沸水减轻伤痛的方式会提高病患者的死亡率高达400% 考虑采用吸血鬼成分来增加嗜血程度。记得要锁门。 阿克汉收获了我的效忠，而我则收获了接触到神祇的机会。 你的眼睛好......独特。 我要的是新鲜的舌头，这一个一看就知道割下来好几个小时了！ 材料的来源越具有魔力，所泡制出来的调制品就越美味。 你有磨滑过独角兽的兽角吗？不知为何会让我感觉......很欢乐的样子。 她是我主人的老大，只知道她的称号是“残酷者”。 让他们见识下你的神明吧，然后再让他们后悔跟祂作对。 不要低估龙后的怒火。 我的主人为了学会掌控那只手，愿意承受世间一切的折磨。 人人都说这是不可能的，但我终于完成断肢了。 在主人的开化下，我硬壳上的祷文已经产生进化了。 当我的硬壳逐渐被击碎时，我就知道我被阿克汉打败了。 我把它重组起来了，但是过程真的很痛苦。 你要是看不懂，我就无法告诉你。 黑暗教团的首条规则就是......嗯，现在我得干掉你。 必须时刻警惕着我们的属下。 有了阿克汉、我、以及托罗加，黑暗教团总算是完美了。 克鲁尔是提亚马特的死亡牧师。在战斗中被残暴者阿克汉击败后，他发誓效忠于阿克汉。他是阿克汉的炼金术士、实验品和拷问者......克鲁尔总是被死者所环绕，他戴着白色的面具，使其看起来像个亡灵，以迷惑对手并使其产生恐惧。 克鲁尔用他的双手锤攻击一名随机敌人。 克鲁尔召唤四只腐化的食尸鬼，冲向距离最近的敌人并爆炸。 克鲁尔召唤四只腐化的食尸鬼，冲向距离最近的敌人并爆炸，对附近的所有敌人造成伤害。同时留下一滩腐败粘液，持续 30 秒。 克鲁尔大幅提高所有邪恶阵营勇士的伤害，但如果他们周围有善良阵营的队友，则效果减弱。
