body.en: Makos deals % more damage. When lands the killing blow on an Enemy, they drop % more Gold. Makos' dark pact with his fiendish patron results in monsters killed by him dropping more gold. Enemies that Makos lands the killing blow on drop additional gold. Increase the damage of Champions not adjacent to by % Makos' dark pact allows him to bless those who are not next to him, causing them to do more damage. Champions that are not adjacent to Makos deal additional damage. Make sure he's not adjacent to other damage dealers to increase their damage. Increase the effect of Dark Luck by % for each Evil or Warlock Champion in the formation Increase the effect of Dark Blessing by % if is not on the edge of the formation Who's your pact with, then? Power never comes without a cost. Flights of fancy, or true heroics. They all end the same way. We must defeat those who will take advantage! The dead have no need of their coin. Those who enter into a pact with Arikas will find riches and pain. Leader or not, we're all dead if we don't deal with the lich. My powers increase. I call upon the Flames of Phlegethos! A few sparks are a beginning, but they're certainly not an end. We're going to need to do better than this. Where there's smoke... This ought to draw their attention. There's something a little off about this dagger. Yeah, this dagger is clearly evil. But it does my bidding, so it's not all bad. Allows me to focus my fiendish magic. I'll do whatever it takes to achieve my goals. Holds enough components for a few hours of intense spellcasting. There's a hidden compartment in the back for even more components. Finding black leather dye is extremely difficult. Luckily, I know a Fiend or two. Demon hide is especially rare. They generally don't like to give it up. They... they tore my cape! The nerve! I'm really still quite evil, once you get to know me. Magnificent, much like myself! Don't worry, they weren't very nice souls to begin with. This has no real value to me. I've grown so far beyond its meager power. A simple robe for a simple warlock. I've already outgrown it. Finally, a robe worthy of my great power. The ends justify the means. I'll do whatever it takes. You can't make an omelette without burning a few belts. For some reason, my patron seems to like it when I wear black. A rare gift from my patron, Arikas. It serves me well. An exquisite belt for those of us with fiendish tastes. Makos grew up on the streets with a desire to rise above it all. He knows that his innate connection to infernal power is his key to achieving his goals, no matter the cost. A beam of green crackling energy streaks towards a random enemy. A sphere of negative energy ripples out from a random enemy. A sphere of negative energy ripples out from a random enemy, causing that enemy and all other enemies near it to take heavy damage. body.zh: 使马科斯的伤害提高 %。当 击杀敌人时，额外掉落 % 金币。 马科斯与炼狱生物守护者的黑暗契约使他杀死的怪物掉落更多金币。 死于马科斯之手的敌人掉落额外金币。 不与 相邻的勇士提升 % 伤害 马科斯的黑暗契约使他能够祝福不与他相邻的人，提高其造成的伤害。 不与马科斯相邻的勇士造成额外伤害。确保他不与其他伤害输出者相邻，以提高其伤害。 阵型中每位邪恶阵营或邪术师勇士，均使厄运的技能效果提高 % 如果 未处于阵型边缘，则黑暗祝福的效果提升 % 那么你和谁签了契约呢？ 力量从来都是要付出代价的。 奇妙的幻想，或真正的英雄主义，它们都以同样的方式结束。 我们必须打败那些步步紧逼的人！ 死人就不需要硬币了。 与阿里卡斯签订契约者将会得到财富和痛苦。 不管是不是首领，如果不对付巫妖我们都得死。 我的力量在增强。 我召唤弗莱格索斯之焰！ 星星之火可以燎原。 这样的威力远远不足够。 有烟雾的地方就有...... 这应该能够吸引到他们的注意力了。 这把匕首有点不对劲。 对，此匕首邪得很。但是它服从我的命令，所以算是亦正亦邪。 它可以帮助我引导恶魔法术。 我不惜代价也要达成目标。 可以容纳施法数个小时的法术成分。 袋子后侧有个隐蔽的口袋可供容纳更多的法术成分。 黑色颜料是很难找到的。所幸的是，我认识一些炼狱生物。 恶魔皮革是极其罕见的。因为它们从不会轻易认栽。 他们......他们撕破了我的披肩！真是好大的胆子！ 你要是深入认识我的话，就会发现我还是挺邪恶的。 非常的高贵，就跟我一样！ 放心吧，这些灵魂生前都不是好人。 对我没有实用价值。我的能力早已超越它的级别。 一般邪术师穿的一般般的长袍。我早就告别那种水平了。 终于找到一件配得上我实力的长袍了。 为达目的，我可以不择手段。 不烧腰带焉得煎鸡蛋。 不知为何，我的守护神特别喜欢我黑色的穿着。 这是我的守护神阿里卡斯送给我的罕见礼物。非常的实用。 这是专门为我们这些口味独特的人打造的稀有腰带。 马科斯在街头长大，他渴望超脱这一切。他知道自己和地狱力量之间与生俱来的联系是实现自己目标的关键，无论付出什么代价。 发射一束绿色的能量命中一名随机敌人。 从一名随机敌人身上爆发出一个负极能量球。 从一名随机敌人身上爆发出一个负极能量球，使该敌人及附近的所有其他敌人受到高额伤害。

Sure, that works. Who, me? Who knows if you're going to be alive when I return? This isn't my first adventure, you know. I'll have what they're having. I'll start as soon as you pay me. Sure, I'll help -- but you better be collecting gold for me! Don't pretend like you've never taken a blade from an alley rat... I wonder how many this blade has cut down? Sharp, well-balanced, and deadly. Oh the scimitar? That too. What do you mean, backup? I am the backup! Useful when you need to tie an opponent down. Every adventurer started somewhere. You should start with a solid belt. Green is the color of profit. The trees have started to fight back! With... arrows! Goblins are so gullible. If it has a bowstring, I can work with it. Strike while the iron's hot, and the bows are strung! Omin makes me wield this whenever I'm meeting a new client. What's the point of asking questions? Shoot first. Any port in the storm, right? Acquisitions Incorporated wants to talk to you. With bonus piercing damage! Acid damage too, depending on what you're drinking. I'll have what they're having. I was fletching arrows from a young age. It's time for the forest to bite back. Warning: It. Goes. Boom. The sharper the tip, the better. It's important for me to be able to work from the safety of the trees. I can't fight with arrows sticking out of me! Always use your environment to your advantage. I am a champion of nature, a hero to some, and ALWAYS paid in advance. The ranger Môrgæn is a renowned tracker and hunter, able to pinpoint-target foes at any range, then vanish into the woods with no one the wiser. Her legendary ability with the longbow and the custom arrows she crafts instills fear into the hearts of her many enemies -- and more than a few of her coworkers. Famously, she is the only member of Acquisitions Incorporated known to be paid in advance, lest a missed invoice lead to dire repercussions. Môrgæn shoots an arrow at a random target, then quickly follows up with a second arrow. Môrgæn shoots an arrow at a random target, then quickly follows up with a second arrow. This arrow always targets the same enemy, even if that enemy is killed by the first arrow. Môrgæn shoots a customized arrow from her quiver, with one of 3 random effects. Môrgæn pulls a customized arrow from her quiver at random, and fires this more powerful arrow towards a random enemy. Môrgæn collects a portion of the gold dropped by monsters but then buffs the formation partially based on the gold collected. Môrgæn loves adventuring with Gold Finding Champions (because who doesn't). 巡林客莫尔甘是著名的追踪者和猎手，能在任何范围准确点杀敌人，然后悄然消失在树林里。她使用长弓和特制箭矢的传奇能力，使许多敌人以及一些同事心生恐惧。最出名的是，她是艾奎兹玄有限责任公司唯一会预先付款的成员，因为公司不想错过付款时间而导致可怕的后果。 莫尔甘向随机目标射出一箭，然后迅速射出第二箭。 莫尔甘向随机目标射出一箭，然后迅速射出第二箭。两支箭始终会射向同一敌人，即使该敌人已经被第一箭击杀。 Bard Champions: Birdsong focuses her song on Bards When attacks she makes one bonus attack against a random boss enemy, dealing of BUD-based damage. Battle is like a dance, and I am the musician. The tempo of battle excites me. Take away my blades and I'll show you what these claws can do. I do not just sing for myself. My song inspires everyone! I'll lead, if you don't mind. It's just like a dance. I can feel the beat of the battle. Take off your boots and I'll show you! Can you hear the rhythm? Listen to the footfalls. They march in step. Prepare yourselves. We can be a pack together! Your actions have proven your worth! The song sings of triumph. Just keep it going! These limbs don't move fast enough in my opinon. A broadened perspective inspires the heart to greater heights. I've been sharpening my claws for days! I'll just barf it up in a bit, don't worry. Once more for the people in the back! Agent Birdsong, ready. Time for the final act. I have seen much in my time with the Champions. Shall I tell you of our adventures? Sturdy but heavy, enough to inflict damage with some moderate effort. Sharper and lighter than an iron sword. This blade sings the songs of battle. It never needs to be sharpened, much like my wit! Simple bracers fashioned from discarded cloth. These wraps provide moderate defense, but primarily help brace my arm in battle. A stable bracer that aids in both attack and defense. If you look hard enough, you can find music in everything. Produces a rusty, clanging sound. Good enough to keep tempo in battle. They may not aid in stealth, but my songs are much more potent. Empowers my allies against the darkness and the dead. Rings true and proud as I wade though battle. A bit out of tune, but it's cheap. This magical instrument creates a unique and empowering sound. The golden frets create a sound which can be heard over great distances. An instrument as finely crafted as one could ever hope to own. It would not help if my pants fell down during battle. An alligator thought it could best me in combat. Obviously it did not. A raptor's hide -- if you can take one down -- is extremely durable. Who says you can't be fashionable in battle? A little worse for wear, but it's better than nothing. Made in native Chultan fashion, with a few extra Chult-specific dangers in mind. With raptor-like scales fashioned from silver, this tunic provides excellent defense and mobility. Lighter than it appears, this armor both looks good and provides unparalleled defense. Birdsong, a cunning young Tabaxi bard, learned to defend herself while enslaved by the Yuan-ti. Proficient in playing the lute, Birdsong discovered her potential as a bard when witnessing the effect her songs had on other slaves. After her escape, she became one of the greatest minstrels of Chult. She promised herself to, one day, get revenge on the Yuan-ti who destroyed her village. Birdsong leaps out with a cat's grace and attacks the nearest enemies with her sword. Birdsong leaps from enemy to enemy, dealing damage and stunning them. Birdsong leaps from enemy to enemy 5 times, dealing damage and stunning them for 5 seconds. Enemies she attacks during her ultimate take 200% extra damage from all Champions for 15 seconds. body.zh: 距离鸟歌 3 格内勇士的伤害提高 %，包括鸟歌自己。 距离 2 格内勇士的伤害提高 %，包括鸟歌自己。 鸟歌为距离自己两格以内的勇士提供增益。使用她作为主要伤害输出，或者把你的主要伤害输出放在她附近。 的效果对善良阵营勇士提高 %。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 鸟歌的歌声专注于善良阵营勇士 的效果对中立阵营（善良/邪恶划分）勇士提高 %。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 鸟歌的歌声专注于中立阵营勇士 的效果对邪恶阵营勇士提高 %。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 鸟歌的歌声专注于邪恶阵营勇士 无从属组织勇士影响 的每个位置阵型技能均使 的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 鸟歌受到无从属组织勇士增益的时候表现最佳。 每当受 影响的勇士对敌人造成致命一击时， 的效果提高 %。此效果最多可堆叠 层，每次击杀一层。以乘算方式堆叠。改变区域时重置层数。 在每个区域开始时， 的“高潮迭起”堆叠层数等同于阵型中守序勇士的数量。 守序勇士： 鸟歌的歌声专注于守序阵营勇士 在每个区域开始时， 的“高潮迭起”堆叠层数等同于阵型中女性勇士的数量。 女性勇士： 鸟歌的歌声专注于女性勇士 在每个区域开始时， 的“高潮迭起”堆叠层数等同于阵型中吟游诗人勇士的数量。 吟游诗人勇士： 鸟歌的歌声专注于吟游诗人 当 攻击时，她对一名随机首领敌人发动一次额外攻击，造成 基础杀招伤害。 战斗就像跳舞，而我就是乐师。 战斗的节奏让我兴奋。 把我的刀拿走，我让你见识一下这些爪子的威力。 我不只是为自己而歌唱。 我的歌声能鼓舞所有人！ 如果你不介意的话，我来带头。这和跳舞没两样。 我能感觉到战斗的节奏。脱下你的靴子，我让你瞧瞧！ 你能听到这旋律吗？ 听听这脚步声吧。他们齐步前进，你们要做好准备了。 我们可以组成兽群！ 你用行动证明了你的价值！ 唱起胜利的歌。 继续，不要停！ 在我看来，这些肢体不够灵活。 开阔的视野能让心灵上升到更高的境界。 我已经磨爪子好几天了！ 我一会儿就吐出来，别担心。 为后面的人再唱一次！ 特工鸟歌，准备就绪！是时候上演最后一幕了。 我和勇士队打交道的这些年见识过不少风风雨雨。 要不要我给你讲讲我们的冒险经历？ 虽沉重但坚固，只要用点力量就可以发挥出相当的威力。 比铁剑更轻盈更锋利。 此剑会发出战斗旋律的声音。 此剑永远不需要磨砺，就像我的智慧一样！ 采用碎布料缝制而成的简易护腕。 这些裹手布只能提供微弱的防御，主要是用在战斗中加固我的双臂。 对攻守两方面都有所助益的牢固护腕。 只要心中有歌，从任何事物中都能听出乐声。 会发出沉闷的叮当声。有助于维持战斗时的节奏。 虽然无助于潜行，但是我的乐声比潜行更加致命。 可以强化队友们对抗黑暗与亡灵。 每次我战斗时它都会发出纯粹悦耳的铃铛声。 稍微有点跑调，但胜在价格便宜。 此乐器能产生出一种振奋人心的独特声音。 黄金的音品所产生的声音能够传播到很远的地方。 这种质量的鲁特琴是所有人都梦寐以求的。 要是在战斗中裤子突然滑落那就完蛋了。 某只短吻鳄自以为我好欺负。结果很明显。 这是迅猛龙的毛皮--很难对付--但确实非常耐用。 谁说战斗时就不能讲究时髦了？ 虽然使用得有点磨损了，但有总好过没有。 传统的楚尔特风格，而且针对某些楚尔特本土的危险做了改良。 此护甲上布满了采用白银打造而成的仿照龙鳞，既提供优秀的防御又十分的轻便。 此护甲比外表看起来更加的轻盈，既不牺牲外观又能提供优秀的防御。 鸟歌，一个狡黠的年轻斑猫人吟游诗人，在被蛇人奴役时学会了保护自己。鸟歌精通弹奏鲁特琴，当看到她的歌声对其他奴隶产生的影响时，她发现了自己作为吟游诗人的潜力。在逃脱奴役后，她成为了楚尔特最伟大的吟游诗人。她向自己发誓，有朝一日要向摧毁她村庄的蛇人复仇。 鸟歌以猫般的优雅跃出，用她的剑攻击距离最近的敌人。 鸟歌从一名敌人跳向另一名敌人，造成伤害并眩晕他们。 鸟歌从一名敌人跳向另一名敌人 5 次，造成伤害并使其眩晕 5 秒。所有勇士对鸟歌杀招期间受到她攻击的敌人额外造成 200% 的伤害，持续 15 秒。

body.en: Shaka attempts to solve a celestial puzzle with the potential for great rewards. Four random slots in the formation are assigned a random tag. For each Champion in those slots that match the slot's tag, Shaka increases the damage of all Champions by %, stacking multiplicatively. A fifth slot is chosen but remains locked with an unknown tag until a specialization is chosen. Shaka solves a random puzzle on each adventure, buffing all Champions Shaka adds temporary health to the entire party when changing areas, and refreshes them every 10 seconds. The amount of hit points is increased by % for each A Celestial Puzzle slot that is filled properly, stacking additively. Total Temporary Health: Shaka grants temporary hit points to all Champions as they change areas. Shaka increases the base effect of A Celestial Puzzle by % for each properly filled puzzle slot he's adjacent to, stacking multiplicatively. Shaka focuses on hampering the attacks of enemies. Shaka focuses on destroying newly spawned enemies. Increases the effect of Celestial Resistance by % The base effect of A Celestial Puzzle is increased by % for each other Rivals of Waterdeep Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. The locked Celestial Puzzle slot in the formation is assigned the tag and can be matched to further buff the party. Shaka focuses on an easy solution to the puzzle. The locked Celestial Puzzle slot in the formation is assigned the tag and can be matched to further buff the party. The base effect of A Celestial Puzzle is increased by %. Shaka looks to solve a more difficult version of the puzzle. The locked Celestial Puzzle slot in the formation is assigned the tag and can be matched to further buff the party. The base effect of A Celestial Puzzle is increased by %. Shaka is interested in solving the most difficult version of the puzzle. The locked Celestial Puzzle slot remains locked, and instead Celestial Resistance is increased by %. Shaka likes the puzzle just how it is. I don't know if I'd call me that, but you can if you want! Can't you see the solution!? You never know when your home will be teleported to the Nine Hells. Once you see the threads connecting all the pieces, it's a piece of cake. She was there when I needed someone to trust in Avernus. With all of us together, we should be able to solve this once and for all! Stay right there! Don't move. On the edge of death, your choices narrow. Ah now, this one's a challenge! This one will really throw them. The answer you get may not be the answer you need. There is far more to this than you might think. How else can you solve a maze? Be careful. I shot myself in the foot with this once. It's a long story. You don't mess with someone with a crossbow on their back. Look! No. Over there! Hang on... Watch the bolt. It might be a bit too extravagant to carry around Waterdeep. Growing up as a tiefling means knowing when you're in trouble. I lost my patron once. It wasn't great. Neither was he, if I'm being honest. I think it's broken. Unrelated; does anyone have a bandage? I picked it up in Avernus. Not really sure why it's so fancy. Ooooh... This one is a tough one! It gives Brian the brain something to enjoy when he isn't mind blasting. It'll look great in Trollskull! I made it with my parents when I was a kid. Whether we're in weird forests or the Nine Hells, you gotta be comfortable. Yeah, my last patron would have hated this outfit. New Patron: New Shaka! A gift from my Celestial patron, Kagoya. It reminds me of some of our weird adventures. I keep it close to my heart. Oh, that glow? Don't worry about that. Also, don't touch. It holds an image of my family. It covers my horns. I'm basically invisible, right? Keeps my head cool, and my horns covered! Huh? Sorry, I was lost in thought. As a member of Rivals of Waterdeep, Shaka is always looking for the latest adventure and the latest puzzle. His party has encountered mysteries and foes throughout Waterdeep, Candlekeep, Icewind Dale, and Avernus. Their base of operations is located in the Trollskull Manor in Waterdeep where a brain in a jar named Brian stands watch. A beam of crackling green shoots towards an enemy, dealing damage. A beam of crackling green shoots towards an enemy, dealing damage. All enemies are pushed back and a wall of light appears in front of the formation for 15 seconds. All enemies are pushed back slightly and then a wall of light appears slightly in front of the formation for 15 seconds. Enemies that pass through the wall of light take damage, are stunned for 5 seconds, and gain a white glow which causes them to miss with 75% of all attacks for 30 seconds. body.zh: 沙卡尝试解决一个天神谜题，意图从中获取奖励。阵型中的四个随机格子会被各自分配一个随机标记。格子中每有一位符合标记的勇士，沙卡就会提升所有勇士的伤害 %，以乘算方式堆叠。在专精选定前，第五栏位被选定但以位置标签保持锁定。 沙卡在每次冒险中解决一个随机谜题，使所有勇士得到强化 在改变区域时，沙卡赋予所有队伍成员 临时生命值，同时每 10 秒刷新整支队伍。每有一个天神谜题的格子被正确填充，生命值提升 ，并以加算方式叠加。 总临时生命值： 沙卡在改变区域时使所有勇士获得临时的生命值。 每有一个妥善填上的谜题格子与沙卡相邻，天神谜题的基本效果就会提升 %，并以乘算方式叠加。 沙卡专注于阻挡敌人的攻击。 沙卡专注于消灭新出现的敌人。 天界抗力的效果提升 % 阵型中每有一位其他的“深水城的竞争对手”勇士，“天神谜题”的基本效果即增加 %。以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中出现的锁定“天神谜题”栏位会获得 标签，将其正确填充可进一步增益队伍。 沙卡专注于寻找谜题的简单解法。 阵型中出现的锁定“天神谜题”栏位会获得 标签，将其正确填充可进一步增益队伍。“天神谜题”的基本效果增加 %。 沙卡期待解决更困难版本的谜题。 阵型中出现的锁定“天神谜题”栏位会获得 标签，将其正确填充可进一步增益队伍。“天神谜题”的基本效果增加 %。 沙卡兴趣满满，要解决最困难版本的谜题。 未解锁天神谜题栏位保持未解锁，取而代之的是“天界抗力”提升 %。 沙卡就是喜欢这个谜题的样子。 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 天界抗力的效果提升 % 提升“天神谜题”的基本效果 % 我以前待在深水城对手团时学习到了很多知识。 我可不会这么自夸，但你要这样称呼我也行！ 你这都看不出答案吗？ 哪怕下一刻你自己的家被传送到九层地狱也要做好准备。 只要你看清楚连接所有碎片的线，就一切都简单了。 我在阿弗纳斯无依无靠时碰上了她。 大家同心协力，定能彻底解决！ 你就站在那里！不要动。 在死亡边缘，你的选择很有限。 哎呀，这可真有难度！ 真正难翻众人的谜题。 你获得的答案可能并非你需要。 个中深意，远超你想。 不然还要怎么去解决迷宫呢？ 小心。我有一次用这东西射中了我的脚。那件事说来话长。 你可别去惹一个背着十字弩的人。 你看！不，那边！等等......看着那弩箭。 带着它在深水城到处晃悠可能有点太招摇了。 作为一个提夫林，从小到大的经历让我知道什么时候有麻烦。 我曾失去过一次我的赞助者。那可糟糕了。老实说，他也一样。 我想它破了。不相干；有谁有绷带吗？ 这是我在阿弗纳斯捡的。我也不太清楚它为什么这么精致。 噢......这个挺难的！ 当布莱恩不兴奋时，这会给他的大脑一点享受。 这要是在巨魔头骨里一定会很好看！ 这是我小时候和我父母一起做的。 不管我们是身处诡异的森林还是九层地狱，你都得舒服才行。 没错，我上一个赞助者肯定会讨厌这身衣服的。 新的赞助者：新的沙卡！ 我的天神赞助者鹿屋送的礼物。 这让我想起我们的一些奇怪冒险。 我把它放在心口的位置，贴身保存。 噢，那些光吗？不用担心。还有，别碰。 里面放着一张我家人的画像。 它可以遮住我的角。 我基本上是隐形的，对吧？ 让我的头保持凉爽，还能遮住我的角！ 哈？对不起，我刚才想事情想到出神了。 作为深水城对手团的一员，沙卡总是在寻找最新的冒险和谜题。他的队伍在整个深水城、烛堡、冰风谷和阿弗纳斯都遇到过谜团和敌人。他们的行动基地位于深水城的巨魔头骨庄园，那里有个装在罐子里的大脑，名叫布莱恩，观察着一切。 向一名敌人发射一道绿色爆裂光束，造成伤害。 向一名敌人发射一道绿色爆裂光束，造成伤害。 所有敌人被击退，同时一面光墙出现在阵型前方，持续 15 秒。 所有敌人被稍微击退，同时一面光墙出现在阵型前方不远处，持续 15 秒。穿越光墙的敌人会受到伤害，并会被眩晕 5 秒。这些敌人脚下会出现一道炫目的白光。脚下有白光的敌人，全部攻击有 75% 几率落空，持续 30 秒。

body.en: Volo can be used in any Grand Tour of the Sword Coast campaign adventure or variant, even if he would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions. Volo increases the damage of all Champions in the two columns in front of him by %. Volo increases the damage of Champions in the two columns in front of him. Place him behind your damage dealers. Volo increases the effect of Volo's Guide to Combat by % for each Guide and/or Collection Quest completed, stacking multiplicatively. Volo gets more effective based on the number of guide and/or collection quests you've completed. Complete more quests to power him up! Volo counts each type of enemy encountered in the current adventure. Volo increases the effect of Volo's Guide to Combat by % for each enemy type encountered, stacking multiplicatively. Encountered Monster Types: Unlocks Volo's Guide to Writing Wrongs Ultimate Attack If a Champion in the column in front of Volo is defeated, the formation immediately retreats to the previous area. Upon returning to the area of their near defeat, the effect of Volo's Guide to Combat is increased by % in that area. Active Area: Volo gains the Hunter role and Undead become his Favored Foe. The effect of Volo's Guide to Combat is increased by % for each Champion in the formation with the Hunter role, stacking multiplicatively. Hunter Champions: Volo writes his manuscript on fighting undead while consulting with other Champions hunting their favored foes. The effect of Volo's Guide to Combat is increased by % for each Ceremorphosis stack the formation has, stacking multiplicatively. Ceremorphosis Stacks: Volo carefully studies the formation's Ceremorphosis-infected population, enhancing his own abilities. The effect of Volo's Guide to Combat is increased by % for each Champion in the formation with a Magic base attack, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Volo works with his fellow "wizards" and other magically inclined Champions. I am the very model of altruism, my friend! What I do, I do for us all. My very presence provides a certain sense of sudden capability! The trick is to keep hitting them until they can no longer hit you back. That one's trousers have a loose thread. A keen observation, yes? I've had an epiphany! If I raise my voice, more willing ears might hear me! Expand your horizons, bolster your ranks, seek gainful employment... Amass a menagerie of helpful creatures, forge the finest arms... And, finally, be sure to boast of your achievements for all the world to see! The origins of the fearsome owlbear are a subject of debate among scholars. In truth, owlbears are neither natural nor the result of magic gone awry. I believe a swift, strategic withdrawal is in order. No time to dilly-dally! No matter the circumstances, the estimable Volo remains ready! Behold my physique! Yes, I do maintain a regiment of calisthenics. I've simply the worst headache today. Bah! I'm certain it's nothing serious. You ask why Elminster is so concerned with my wellbeing? He's a true fan, of course! Why else? Why, I dare to posit that the noble owlbear is, in fact, a creation of the gods themselves! Want to know a dark secret? Ask a hag. The trick lies in getting truth out of her. Drat. Another one. You would not believe how many of these I go through. Not a snug fit, but it will do for some comfort during my daily ruminations. Aha! An acceptable adornment. It does lend an air of refinement, doesn't it? Finally! A crown fit for my brow. A reflection of my very soul, no doubt! That dull, old thing? Why, I hardly recognize it. Perhaps it may open letters? An elegant edge, to be sure. One I hope to never find cause to use! More for show than anything, but it does help to keep the ruffians at bay. Scoff if you must, but I dare say I hold in my hand the mightiest of blades! A far cry from the genuine article, but he is a handsome devil, is he not? Once stolen, but later returned. There is, perhaps, some honor among thieves. Shall I tell you of a remarkable and historic property in Waterdeep? Take this. A far superior relic than that old jelly you were chained to. Was this a treatise on goblin poetry, a recipe book, or a sordid romance novel? You have in your hands the foremost and most up-to-date guide to the city. No matter your destination, Volothamp Geddarm shall be your humble guide! Would you believe a particularly artistic hydra created this incredible cover? Even the Sage of Shadowdale falls prey to a lack of imagination, it would seem. My editor provided a revision for Candlekeep, but I prefer the original. The little blighters burrow into the brain through the ocular cavity! Ghastly... My latest work, made manifest at last! Unlike its subject matter, of course. I've no interest in sullying my research with implements of inferior quality. Yes, I do believe these resources shall suffice for my general needs. For now. Ah, the secretion of the elusive rocktopus! A valuable asset, indeed! Kraken ink! I shall ensure that every drop furthers the cause of knowledge! Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm is a flamboyant world traveler, self-proclaimed expert, and author of such works as Volo's Guide to Monsters. Known for his bombastic personality and flair for storytelling, Volo has a knack for turning facts into tall tales. Though he's quick to avoid personal danger, he's fiercely loyal to his friends - just don't expect him to cover the tab. Volo writes a scathing note, dealing a deep magical cut to the nearest enemy. Volo causes his buffed allies to deal additional BUD-based damage for 15 seconds. Volo takes out a book and quill and writes for 15 seconds, causing his buffed allies to deal additional BUD-based damage for the duration. Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Male Champions by % Increases the damage of all Human Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions with a CHA score of 11 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Champions with a INT score of 13 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation with a CHAOTIC alignment
body.zh: 瓦罗可用于任何剑湾之旅战役冒险或支线任务，即使以前由于支线任务或赞助者限制条件无法使用。 瓦罗会使他前面两列所有勇士的伤害提高 %。 瓦罗会提高他前面两列勇士的伤害。将他放置在你的伤害输出身后。 瓦罗每完成一次指南和/或收集任务，“瓦罗的战斗指南”效果增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 瓦罗的效果会随着你完成的指南任务和/或收集任务的数量增加而增加。完成更多的任务来强化他！ 瓦罗会计算当前冒险中遇到的每一种敌人。每遇到一种敌人，瓦罗就会使“瓦罗的战斗指南”的效果增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 遭遇怪物种类： 解锁瓦罗的错误写作指南杀招 如果处于瓦罗前列的勇士被击败，阵型将立即撤退到上一个的区域。当回到他们近乎失败的区域时，“瓦罗的战斗指南”效果在该区域增加 %。 激活区域： 瓦罗获得了猎人角色，亡灵成为了他的偏好对手。阵型中每有一位猎人角色勇士，均使“瓦罗的战斗指南”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 猎人勇士： 瓦罗在与其他勇士讨论如何对抗他们各自偏好的敌人时，撰写了关于对抗亡灵的手稿。 阵型中每堆叠一层蜕变，均使“瓦罗的战斗指南”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 蜕变堆叠： 瓦罗仔细研究了阵型中受蜕变影响的人群，从而增强自己的技能。 阵型中每有一位魔法基本攻击的勇士，均使“瓦罗的战斗指南”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 瓦罗与他的“法师”同伴以及其他擅长魔法的勇士一起工作。 我就是利他主义的典范，我的朋友！我所做的一切，都是为了我们所有人。 我的存在本身就能让人瞬间充满力量！ 诀窍就是不断地攻击他们，直到他们再也无法还手为止。 那家伙的裤子上有一根松动的线头。眼光很敏锐，对吧？ 我顿悟了！如果我提高嗓门，或许会有更多愿意倾听的人听到我！ 开拓视野，壮大队伍，谋求高薪…… 搜罗一群有用的生物，打造最精良的武器…… 最后，一定要向全世界炫耀你的成就！ 关于可怕的枭熊的起源，学者们一直存在争议。 事实上，枭熊既不是自然产生的，也不是魔法失控的结果。 我相信，迅速而有策略地撤退是明智之举。没有时间磨磨蹭蹭了！ 无论环境如何，可敬的瓦罗始终准备就绪！ 瞧瞧我的体格！是的，我确实在坚持做一套体操训练。 我今天真是头疼得要命。呸！我确定没什么大碍。 你问我为什么艾尔明斯特如此关心我的安危？当然因为他是我的忠实粉丝！不然还能为什么？ 我敢说高贵的枭熊实际上是众神亲自创造的！ Want to know a dark secret? Ask a hag. The trick lies in getting truth out of her. 该死，又一顶。你一定不会相信我有过多少顶这样的帽子了。 虽然不太合适，但在我每天沉思时，它能带来些许舒适。 啊哈！这件装饰品还可以。它增添了一丝优雅，对吧？ 终于找到了！一顶和我的额头相称的王冠。这无疑是我灵魂的映衬！ 那无聊的旧玩意？我几乎都认不出它来了。它或许能用来拆信吧？ 这确实是一把优雅的利刃。但我希望永远不会有要用它的理由！ 更多是用来展示的，但确实能吓退流氓恶棍。 你要笑就笑吧，但我敢说，我手里握着最厉害的剑！ 与真品相去甚远，但他是个帅气的魔鬼，对吧？ 这画曾经被偷走过，但又被还了回来。或许，小偷也是有荣誉感的。 我是否要告诉你位于深水城的一处非凡且历史悠久的房产？ 这个你拿着。这是一件比你曾拴着的原先那只眼睛好得多的圣物。 这是有关地精诗歌的论文，食谱，还是龌蹉的言情小说？ 你手里拿着的是这座城市最好最新的指南。 不管你的目的地是哪里，瓦罗谭普·哲达都是你谦卑的向导！ 你能相信吗？这令人叹为观止的封面是一条极具艺术天赋的多头蛇蜥创作的。 看来，就连阴影谷的贤者也难逃想象力匮乏的困扰。 我的编辑为烛堡提供了一本修订本，但我还是更喜欢原版。 这些小烦人精会通过眼窝钻进大脑！太恐怖了…… 我的最新作品，终于呈现在世人面前了！当然了，不像这本书的主题，依然不肯现身。 我没兴趣用劣质的工具败坏我的研究。 嗯，我相信这些资源足以满足我的一般需求了。至少暂时如此。 啊，神出鬼没的岩章鱼的分泌物！这的确是一件宝贝啊！ 海怪墨水！我得确保每一滴都用于推动知识的进步！ “瓦罗”瓦罗谭普·哲达是一位风度翩翩的世界旅行家、自封的专家，以及《瓦罗的怪物指南》等作品的作者。他以夸张的个性和讲故事的天赋而闻名，瓦罗擅长将事实变成离奇的故事。尽管他总是考虑自身面临的风险，但他对朋友非常忠诚——只是别指望他会付账。 瓦罗写了一个用词严厉的字条，给最近的敌人造成了深深的魔法创伤。 瓦罗使他的增益型盟友造成额外的基础杀招伤害，持续 15 秒。 瓦罗拿出一本书，用羽毛笔写了 15 秒钟，使他的增益型盟友在持续期间造成额外的基础杀招伤害。

body.en: Uriah increases the damage of all Champions in his column and the column behind him by %. Brother Uriah increases the damage of Champons in his column and the column behind. Brother Uriah heals all Champions within two slots for health per second. This effect is increased by % for each formation slot containing a dead or undead Champion or an escort, stacking additively and applying multiplicatively. Total Heal Amount: Brother Uriah heals all Champions within 2 slots of him. Brother Uriah's Flock are Black Dice Society affiliation members. Brother Uriah increases the effect of Doomed in Darkon by % for each Flock member in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. After normal attacks by Champions in the formation, Azalin Rex takes over Brother Uriah for seconds. While controlled by Azalin Rex, Brother Uriah increases the damage dealt by Champions who are part of his Flock by %. Additionally, Brother Uriah turns evil while under the control of Azalin Rex. Time Remaining: second(s) Attack Count: / Uriah reads from the Book of Exalted Deeds and gains the Hunter role, making Undead and Fiends his Favored Foes and all Champions deal % more damage to them. Additionally, Good Champions also count as members of Brother Uriah's Flock. New Flock Members: Brother Uriah fights his evil connection, helping champions defeat the Undead and Fiends. Azalin reads from the Book of Vile Darkness, increasing the effect of In the Grip of Azalin Rex by % and increasing its base duration by seconds. Additionally, Evil Champions also count as members of Brother Uriah's Flock. New Flock Members: Brother Uriah embraces his evil connection, helping evil champions deal even more damage. Every second that Brother Uriah is In The Grip of Azalin Rex, the effect of Doomed in Darkon is increased by %, stacking additively. These stacks persist between adventures. My sorrows for your troubles. Um, I'm not positive that you, ah, have the right fellow. Perhaps, we should consider reconvening at some other location? We must, I suppose, find our courage and press onward. In all things Ezra's guidance provides. My goddess holds secrets I could never have fathomed. I commend myself to the pure hands of Ezra. Are those crows watching us? So many... Do you know what a group of ravens is called? Why do you think that is? I remain, I'm afraid, within the darklord's foul reach. What plans he has for me I cannot say, only that they must be dire. The dead will rise and do Azalin's bidding, er, my bidding. A good book makes for a faithful companion, I find. They say that knowledge is power. For some tomes, this is meant as literal. We must keep our minds sharp to stay a step ahead of our foes. I feel fit as a fiddle! ...One that is only somewhat out of tune. The body is a temple. I must take care to tend to mine as such. A fine and fetching cap. I only take it out for special occasions. Notice anything new? You don't think it's too, ah, flashy, do you? I was bequeathed this mace by the Church of Ezra. I don't want to get it dirty! Sometimes just holding a weapon is enough to get your point across. Ezra bless my mace, but also, um, let's see if we can just talk things out. When I hold it, I know Ezra is near. Then I summon her blessings from FAR back. Our Guardian of the Mists makes certain we come to no harm. ...provided we observe her proscriptions, of course. The belladonna of Ezra signifies healing. What else would it be? I cannot fault the goddess for her power, nor blame her for her deceptions. The carnival is a delightful distraction. The company was, well, quite more distracting. In the darkness of our adventures, meeting Nahara stands out brightly as a star. I wish beyond all to travel by her side, to care for one another until we fall. 'Til death do us part' takes on a different sort of meaning in our case... There's nothing like raising your voice in song to strengthen the spirit! Let us turn to page 42 for 'Our Great Lady, Preserve Us From the Skin Thieves.' I have found much comfort in this book. The power is unmatched. And it comes with a halo! To be technical, all toes found in baked goods, are suspicious. This toe is most definitely like my own...it was another clone of Azalin's, poor devil. In my dreams, I see the moon dragon. Just some art to express my esteem for the greatest vampire hunter in the mists. Brother Uriah Macawber is a native of Ravenloft, born in the dread domain of Darkon under the iron rule of Azalin Rex. After a horrifying childhood encounter at the Carnival with the demonic entity known as The Caller, Uriah would embrace the worship of the goddess Ezra, Lady of the Mists, offering protection from the forces of darkness to all those in need. Upon joining with the other future members of The Black Dice Society at the infamous House of Lament, Uriah would go on to find true love with his teammate, the undead Aasimar, Nahara... and would eventually discover the dark truth of both the nature of his deity and his mysterious connection to his former liege, the lich-king Azalin Rex. Uriah points at a random enemy and deals damage, preferring enemies that are already damaged. Brother Uriah creates a wall of magical blades that damages enemies for 10 seconds. Brother Uriah creates a wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades of magical energy and sends them flying across the area. The blades come to a stop a short distance in front of the formation forming a barrier that lasts for 10 seconds. Each time an enemy passes through the barrier, they take ultimate damage. Brother Uriah buffs the damage of Champions in his column and the column behind Occasionally, Azalin Rex takes over Brother Uriah, boosting the damage of Nahara and evil Champions. body.zh: 乌利亚使同列和后列勇士的伤害提高 %。 乌利亚修士提高同列和后列勇士的伤害。 乌利亚修士治疗距离他两格以内的所有勇士，每秒使他们恢复 点生命值。 阵型中每有一个格子包含已死亡勇士、亡灵勇士或护卫，此效果提升 %，以加算方式堆叠并以乘算方式生效。 总治疗量： 乌利亚修士治疗距离他 2 个栏位内的所有勇士。 乌利亚修士的教徒是“黑骰子协会”从属组织的成员。 阵型中每有一位乌利亚修士的教徒，他会使“达孔劫难”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中的勇士进行 次普通攻击后，亚扎林·雷克斯会控制乌利亚修士 秒。 在被亚扎林·雷克斯控制期间，乌利亚修士会使身为他教众的勇士伤害提高 %。 此外，在被亚扎林·雷克斯控制期间，乌利亚修士会变为邪恶。 剩余时间： 秒 攻击次数： / 乌利亚修士阅读《崇善之书》并获得猎人角色定位，将亡灵和炼狱生物视为他的偏好对手，所有勇士对它们额外造成 % 的伤害。 此外，善良勇士也被视作乌利亚修士的教众。 新教众： 乌利亚修士抵抗他的邪恶纽带，帮助勇士击败亡灵和炼狱生物。 亚扎林阅读《邪恶之书》，使“亚扎林·雷克斯之握”的效果提升 %，其基础持续时间延长 秒。 此外，邪恶勇士也被视作乌利亚修士的教众。 新教众： 乌利亚修士拥抱他的邪恶纽带，帮助邪恶勇士造成更高伤害。 乌利亚修士处于“亚扎林·雷克斯之握”的每一秒，“达孔劫难”的效果提升 %，以加算方式堆叠。 这些堆叠在冒险之间保持不变。 我为你的烦恼感到遗憾。 呃，我不确定你的同伴足够靠谱。 也许，我们应该考虑去其他地方集会？ 我们可能必须鼓起勇气，继续前进。 伊丝拉指引一切。 我的女神掌握着我永远无法理解的秘密。 我将自己奉献给伊丝拉的纯洁双手。 那些乌鸦是在盯着我们吗？ 数量这么多…… 你知道一群乌鸦叫什么吗？ 你知道为什么这么叫吗？ 恐怕我仍处于黑暗领主的邪恶掌控之中。 我无法确定他对我有什么计划，只能说肯定很可怕。 亡者将会崛起，听从亚扎林的......呃，我的命令。 我发现好书是忠实的伴侣。 俗话说，知识就是力量。 对一些大部头来说，这就是字面上的意思。 我们必须保持头脑清醒，唯有这样才能始终领先敌人一步。 我感觉身体棒极了！ ……就是有点小毛病。 身体就是一座神殿。 我必须像对待神殿一样细心照料我的身体。 一顶精致迷人的帽子。 我只在特殊场合才戴上它。 注意到新东西了吗？ 你不觉得它，呃，太浮夸了吗？ 我是伊丝拉教会传授给我的钉头锤。我不想弄脏它！ 有时候，手持武器就足以证明你的想法。 伊丝拉保佑我的钉头锤，但话说回来，试试我们能否成功沟通。 当我握住它时，能感觉伊丝拉就在身边。然后我从遥远的彼方将她的祝福召唤回来。 我们的迷雾守护者确保我们不会受到伤害。 ......当然，前提是我们遵守她的禁令。 伊丝拉的颠茄象征着治愈。不然呢？ 我不能怪罪女神的力量，也不能责备她的欺骗。 嘉年华是令人愉快的消遣。我的同伴则更令人分心。 在我们黑暗的冒险中，遇见纳哈拉就像星星一样耀眼。 我最大的愿望就是与她一起旅行，互相关怀直到死亡。 “直到死亡把我们分开”在我们身上代表着另一种含义...... 没有比大声歌唱更能提振精神的了！ 让我们翻到第 42 页，歌唱“我们伟大的女神，保佑我们免受窃肤贼的侵害” 我在这本书中找到了很多安慰。 它的力量无与伦比，还自带光环！ 老实说，在烘焙食品中发现的所有脚趾都很可疑。 这只脚趾跟我自己的一模一样......它肯定属于亚扎林的另一个复制体，可怜的魔鬼。 在梦中，我看到了月亮龙。 这只是一些艺术品，用于表达我对迷雾中最伟大的吸血鬼猎人的敬意。 乌利亚修士是鸦阁魔域的本地居民，出生在亚扎林·雷克斯铁腕统治下的恐惧领域达孔。自从幼年时期，在嘉年华上与被称为“召唤者”的邪恶人物的一次可怕遭遇后，乌利亚开启了对迷雾女神伊丝拉的崇拜，为所有需要帮助的人提供抵御黑暗的力量。在臭名昭著的哀悼之家与黑骰子协会的其他未来成员汇合后，乌利亚继续与他的队友亡灵神裔纳哈拉一起寻找真爱......并最终发现自身的神性本质，以及他与前主宰，巫妖王亚扎林·雷克斯之间存在神秘纽带的黑暗真相。 乌利亚指向一名随机敌人并造成伤害，偏好已经受到伤害的敌人。 乌利亚修士创造一道魔法刀墙，伤害敌人 10 秒。 乌利亚修士创造一面由旋转的锋利魔法能量刀构成的墙，并使其在区域内飞掠。刀在阵型前方近距离处停下，形成持续 10 秒的屏障。每当敌人通过屏障时，都会受到杀招伤害。 乌利亚修士提高同列和后列勇士的伤害 亚扎林·雷克斯有时会控制乌利亚修士，提高纳哈拉和邪恶勇士的伤害。

body.en: Lazaapz's posse members are dwarves and Small Champions. (Small Champions are fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold, and plasmoid Champions.) Lazaapz increases the damage of her posse by % for each posse member in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Lazaapz works best with small species (fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold and plasmoid). The more the merrier. Lazaapz has a set of Artificer Power Armor. She starts each area with stacks of Power Armor. Damage taken by Lazaapz is decreased by a percentage equal to her current Power Armor stacks, but the armor consumes 1 stack of Power Armor each time she would take damage. Can not be decreased below 0. Lazaapz's armor prevents her from taking some damage, and she has a Contingency Plan to repair her armor after it becomes too damaged to continue. Lazaapz increases the max health of all other Champions by % of her base max health and healing effects on all Champions are increased by %. When Lazaapz's Power Armor stacks reach 0, her armor sends out a massive shockwave, dealing seconds of BUD damage to all enemies and pushing them back to the far side of the screen. Lazaapz then drops her shield and retreats to behind the formation, her armor shuts down, and she begins to repair it, taking seconds for each time the armor has shut down in the current area (including this time). Upon finishing her work, she leaps back to her original location, knocking back any enemies that she encounters on her way, grabbing her shield, and refilling her Power Armor stacks to full. Lazaapz's posse now also includes Champions with a melee base attack and is buffed by % (post-stack). Qualified Champions: Nothing beats a sharp blade and a sturdy fist. Lazaapz calls for some melee muscle. Lazaapz's posse now also includes Evil Champions and is buffed by % (post-stack). Qualified Champions: A little villainy goes a long way. Lazaapz draws in the morally flexible to form her cabal. Lazaapz's posse now also includes Champions with the Control role and is buffed by % (post-stack). Qualified Champions: Patience is a weapon. Lazaapz brings in the crowd-control crew to lock things down. Lazaapz infuses the equipment of other Champions in the formation with her Artificer powers. Infused equipment has its item level increased by . The equipment slot that is affected is equal to each Champions' exact distance from Lazaapz, so for example adjacent Champions (1 slot away) have their slot 1 equipment infused, while Champions 2 slots away have their slot 2 equipment infused, and so on. Lazaapz gains the Debuff role and increases Power Armor's max stacks by . Lazaapz fires her gauntlet in a line each time she loses Power Armor stacks. Enemies hit take seconds of BUD damage, gain a debuff, and are knocked back. The debuff causes enemies to take % extra damage from all sources, and stacks multiplicatively up to 5 times. Lazaapz adapts her armor to be a guardian, intending to be in the front line of conflict. The effect of Fury of the Small is increased by % for each missing stack of Power Armor, stacking multiplicatively, and when an enemy is defeated Lazaapz regains one stack of Power Armor. She cannot exceed her maximum stacks this way. Lazaapz adapts her armor to be an infiltrator, making her excel at more subtle undertakings. Sure. Except I knew I'd survive. There's no way they out smash me. Guaranteed. Not your average goblin, eh? I used to have to travel all over Sharn. The suit is ready for anything Bolt on another sheet of plate and you're ready to go. I can see Wulfgar's bald spot! Don't tell him. My strength doesn't come from my suit. It comes from my refusal to give up. You shouldn't underestimate people smaller than you! A true artificer knows how to get the most out of their equipment! Keep them back! I need to do some quick repairs! If I'm going down, I'm taking all of you with me! Hand me that piece of junk! I can make it better! I love meeting new people and finding out what we both hate. Every time I destroy something I don't like, I feel better! Put me in a cave with a box of scraps and I can build almost anything! The Mark Two has a shortened delay between launches. More BOOMS, faster! The Mark Three was a breakthrough in breaking through things. BIGGER BOOMS! HEY, YOU! YEAH, YOU! YOU LOOK STUPID! Let's GO! I feel GREAT! I could break stuff all DAY! I'll never understand why anyone would throw away a perfectly good rusted screwdriver. It took a few years, but I finally have all the essentials. Where are those bolts? I should really organize this. These dragonmarked people sure have nice tools. HEY! Can I have this? Upgraded the manual release bolt. I don't need that breaking off again. v16's molten core was a step too far. I know that now. Those House Cannith blueprints were invaluable; those artificers sure know their stuff. Grappling arm? Check. Buzz Saw? CHECK. Now to test this thing out... I had an automaton in here. Bob! This isn't funny. You never know what you'll need until you need it. In hindsight, I should have packed more dragonshards. Smuggling is much easier with hidden pouches. Time to start pushing back. 'Borrowed' a better forge to increase the carbon percentage. OK. Now watch their faces when I cast light! I added them to shift my center of gravity. The fact that they look AWESOME is a bonus! Test 1: let's see if this thing can take a punch from a warforged... Test 14: ...as it turns out, warforged can punch pretty hard. Here's hoping some higher-grade steel helps. Test 91: Materials found in Tradefair District dumpster much higher quality than parts found in Lower City. Test 226: Adding Adamantine well worth the added cost. I didn't think that would work anyway. Oh good. We're back to blowing out the crystal again. I finished it just before I zapped here. Just be sure to replace the crystal every couple months and you won't have to worry about exploding. Born in The Cogs beneath Sharn's Lower City, Lazaapz's remarkable intellect elevated her to the Tradefair district, where her mechanical genius became highly sought after by the Dragonmarked Houses. Lazaapz's first invention was a functional mechanical arm to replace the one she was born without; now she leads an elite team of engineers in cutting edge research and development. Following the discovery of a mysterious Eldritch Machine, Lazaapz was brought in by House Cannith to ascertain the purpose of the device. Shortly after, both Lazaapz and the machine disappeared, never to be seen again. Lazaapz attacks and stuns the nearest enemy. Every fifth attack, she uses her Grappling Fist to pull an enemy closer to her instead. For a short duration, Lazaapz increases her equipment buff and deals ultimate damage. For a short duration, Lazaapz increases her equipment buff and deals ultimate damage with her attacks. Lazaapz increases the damage of small Champions, such as gnomes, goblins, halflings, and kobolds, based on the number of such Champions in the formation. Lazaapz's armor powers up while she's not under attack, and then unleashes her fury once enemies are foolish enough to attack her. body.zh: 拉扎普的同伙是矮人和小个子勇士。 （小个子勇士是指仙女、侏儒、地精、半身人、坎德人、狗头人和等离子体勇士。） 阵型中每有一名拉扎普的同伙，她会使她同伙的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 拉扎普最适合与小个子种族（仙女、侏儒、地精、半身人、坎德人、狗头人和等离子体）配合。 人多力量大。 拉扎普拥有一组机关术士能量护甲。她在每个区域开始时拥有 层能量护甲。拉扎普承受的伤害将减少，比例等同于当前能量护甲堆叠层数，但她每次受到伤害时，会消耗 1 层能量护甲。层数不会降到 0 以下。 拉扎普的护甲能使她免受部分伤害，而且她还有应急预案，可在护甲损坏到无法继续使用时进行修理。 拉扎普会增加所有其他勇士的最大生命值，数值相当于她基础最大生命值的 %，并且对所有勇士的治疗效果提高 %。 当拉扎普的能量护甲层数降至 0 时，护甲会释放出一道强力震荡波，对所有敌人造成等同于 秒基础杀招伤害的伤害，并将其击退至屏幕另一端。随后，拉扎普会放下护盾，撤退至阵型后方，她的护甲关闭，并开始修复。每次护甲在当前区域关闭（包括本次），需花费 秒进行修复。修复完成后，她会跃回原来的位置，击退途中的所有敌人，拿起她的盾牌，并将能量护甲层数补充至满值。 拉扎普的同伙现在也包括以近战为基本攻击的勇士，并且会获得 % 的增益（堆叠后）。 满足条件的勇士数量： 锋利的刀刃和有力的拳头能击败一切。拉扎普会叫来一些近战高手。 拉扎普的同伙现在也包括邪恶阵营的勇士，并且会获得 % 的增益（堆叠后）。 满足条件的勇士数量： 勿以恶小而为之。拉扎普吸引来一些不太注重道德的人组成她的阴谋集团。 拉扎普的同伙现在也包括拥有控制角色定位的勇士，并且会获得 % 的增益（堆叠后）。 满足条件的勇士数量： 耐心是一种武器。拉扎普叫来群体控制小队控制局面。 拉扎普会将她的机关术士能量注入阵型中其他勇士的装备中。被注入了能量的装备物品等级会提升 。具体哪个装备栏位会受到影响取决于每位勇士与拉扎普相隔的距离。比如，相邻的勇士（相隔 1 格）被注入能量的是栏位 1 的装备，而相隔 2 格的勇士被注入能量的是栏位 2 的装备，以此类推。 拉扎普获得“减益”角色定位，并将能量护甲的最大堆叠层数增加 层。每当拉扎普失去 层能量护甲时，她会沿直线发射她的护手。被命中的敌人会受到等同于 秒基础杀招伤害的伤害，获得一个减益，并被击退。该减益使敌人受到的所有伤害提高 %，且以乘算方式堆叠，最多 5 层。 拉扎普把她的护甲改装成守护者，打算战斗在最前线。 每缺少一层能量护甲，小人族之怒的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每当敌人被击败时，拉扎普恢复一层能量护甲。通过此方式获得的能量护甲不会超过其最大层数。 拉扎普把她的护甲改装成潜行者，这使得她非常擅长执行更隐秘的任务。 必须的。虽然我之前就知道我能活下来。 他们不可能打得过我，必然如此。 不是你的普通地精，是吧？ 我曾经不得不走遍整个萨恩。这套衣服能应对一切。 再用螺栓固定上一块钢板，就可以开始使用了。 我能看到沃夫加的秃头！别告诉他。 我的力量并非来自于我的衣服，而是来源于我绝不放弃。 你不应该低估比你矮小的人！ 真正的工匠知道如何把设备的性能发挥到极致！ 挡住他们！我得赶紧修一下！ 如果我要完蛋了，那就大家一起完蛋！ 把那破烂递给我！我能把它变得更好！ 我喜欢结识新朋友，并发现我们共同讨厌什么。 每当我毁掉一件我不喜欢的东西，心情就会好起来！ 把我关在山洞里，给我一箱废料，我几乎能造出任何东西！ 二代型号发射间隔更短。爆炸更多、更快！ 三代型号在打破东西方面打破了技术壁垒。爆炸更大！ 喂，你！对，就你！你一脸蠢样！ 上啊！我感觉好极了！我可以一整天都砸东西！ 真搞不明白为何会有人丢弃还能使用的生锈螺丝起子。 虽然花了好几年，但终究集齐了所有的必备装备。 螺栓都放哪去了？真的该好好整理下了。 这些龙纹后裔的工具很不错嘛。咦！这个可以送我吗？ 升级了手动释放螺栓。我可不想它再断了。 v16的熔融核心确实有些过头了。我现在明白了。 那些卡尼思家族的蓝图价值连城；那些工匠确实技艺精湛。 抓钩臂？有。圆锯？有。现在该试用一下这玩意儿了…… 这里头有我的一个机器人。鲍勃！不要闹。 备用的东西从来都是多多益善的。 后知后觉一说，早知道就多带些龙晶。 有隐蔽口袋的背包真是走私的良伴。 是时候往回修改下了。 “借用”了更优质的熔炉来提高含碳率。 弄好了。待会我施展照明术时仔细留意他们的面容！ 我添加了尖刺以转移头盔的重心。所产生的炫酷外观纯粹是附带效果！ 1次测试：先试试这玩意能否抵挡得住机关人...... 14次测试：不出所料，机关人的拳击非常强悍。希望使用更高级的钢铁能够增加防御力。 91次测试：从交易会城区的垃圾堆中找到的材料远比在下城所找到的零件更高质量。 226次测试：添加精金绝对是物有所值的。 反正我本来就不觉得那行得通。 哦，太好了。我们又要开始吹制水晶了。 我刚传送过来之前就看完了。 只要记得每隔几个月更换一次晶体，就不用担心会爆炸了。 拉扎普兹出生于沙恩下城区下的“齿轮区”，凭借非凡的智慧，她跻身贸易博览会区，其机械天赋也因此备受“龙印家族”的青睐。 拉扎普兹的首项发明是一条功能完备的机械手臂，用来替代她天生缺失的那只手臂；如今，她正带领一支精英工程师团队从事前沿的研发工作。 在发现一台神秘的“异界机械”后，卡尼思家族邀请拉扎普兹前来查明该装置的用途。不久之后，拉扎普兹与那台机械一同消失，从此杳无音讯。 拉扎普攻击并眩晕距离最近的敌人。每第五次攻击，她会改为用抓钩飞拳将一名敌人拉到身边。 在短时间内，拉扎普会提升她的装备增益，并造成杀招伤害。 在短时间内，拉扎普会提升她的装备增益，并用攻击造成杀招伤害。 拉扎普根据阵型中小个子勇士的数量，提升所有这些勇士的伤害，小个子种族包括侏儒、地精、半身人和狗头人等。 拉扎普没有受到攻击时，她的护甲会获得充能，然后向那些攻击她的蠢货释放她的狂怒。

body.en: Astarion counts as "undead" for the purposes of effects that care about dead Champions (Desmond, Kas), but "alive" for all other purposes. Astarion increases the damage of all Champions at the top of each column by %. Astarion looks to the top of the formation to deal the most damage. Astarion increases the damage of all champions on either the top or the bottom of each column, based on your choice. Astarion increases the damage of all Champions at the bottom of each column by % Astarion looks to the bottom of the formation to deal the most damage. Astarion increases the damage of all champions on either the top or the bottom of each column, based on your choice. Your formation gains one Ceremorphosis stack due to the mind flayer tadpole in Astarion's brain. Astarion increases the effect of Outflank by % for each Ceremorphosis stack, stacking multiplicatively. Astarion increases the gold find of the formation by % multiplied by the total age of all Champions in the formation. If The Dark Urge is in the formation, the effect of this ability is increased by %. Astarion increases the gold find of the formation by % multiplied by the total age of all Champions in the formation. After using his Sanguine Hunger ultimate, Astarion's Outflank is increased by %. This effect can stack (multiplicatively) up to times, with stacks resetting when changing areas. If Astarion is buffed by his own Outflank ability, when he uses his Sanguine Hunger Ultimate attack, he reduces the active ultimate cooldown of all other Champions in the formation by %. Astarion reduces ultimate cooldowns of other Champions when he uses his ultimate if he is buffed by his own Outflank ability. Astarion increases the gold find of the party by % for each gold find Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Astarion schemes with other gold find Champions in the formation to "obtain" even more gold. Astarion increases the damage bonus of his Outflank specialization by % for each Champion in the formation that is a Rogue, Wizard, or Absolute Adversaries affiliation member, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Astarion works best with fellow rogues, wizards, and Absolute Adversaries affiliation members. Increases the bonus BUD-based damage Astarion's Sneak Attack deals to seconds worth. Astarion focuses on dealing more damage when he attacks an enemy who has been recently attacked by an ally. Just stick with me, darling. We'll use the shadows to conceal us. Yes, I came back to help. But we're not doing your awful plan. Oh, what's this? It seems they left their coin purse behind. Pity. Some would call that luck. I call it 'who cares, so long as I get the gold.' Sometimes I still remember how it felt to be mortal. It's... strange. I can feel it -- that curse -- moving my blood instead of my heart. Have you ever felt a worm twitch in your brain? It's interesting which items suddenly become valuable after a century or so. Vampires don't make money -- their familiars make it for them. Mmm, such an exquisite taste. I think I'll have it all. Surely there's nothing for you to fear in the mists. Certainly not a knife. Darkness feels like a comforting embrace. Want to know how it feels? If it gives me the power to kill Cazador, I'll take it. Fine, I'll lead - but all of you need to be more stealthy! Darling, anything is better than rats. Straight from the neck is preferred, but goblets are used in mortal company. I may never be free of this. I may as well learn to live with it. Forever. I found this in a gutter. It may look disgusting, but it's deadly. ...to rats. It won't take down an owlbear, but perhaps a kobold? If the wind is right... Don't ask where these came from, you don't want to know. Showy AND deadly? Oh it's perfect, darling! The others don't need to know I have this. It's for my own ...research. These have been fascinating. I think I'm getting closer to something... Could it work? It shouldn't be possible. None of this should be possible... If this goes the way I hope -- I'll never have to fear the sun again. This is one of my few possessions now that I serve Cazador... This used to be accurate. Now it feels more like an ancient painting than a map. I've been told these will never break. I'll put that to the test. No one will question my nobility now. Or they shouldn't for the coin I paid. Well, that was... disgusting. It may not be dignified, but needs must. Someday I'll see my face again. You're lucky enough to see it every day. Did you ever hate something so much, you just couldn't part with it? Better than a sling, that's for sure. I'm much better with these than I expected. I'll have to get them enchanted... Yes, this is mine. No, you don't need to know where I got it. They'll lose the blood regardless. This just happens to save it for me. I picked up this little treasure with the coin I made from OnlyFangs. Well, it was good while it lasted. Tav gave this to me and said it would suit me well. They were right. Stabbing your enemies gets much easier when you can simply appear behind them. Astarion prowled the night as a vampire spawn for centuries, serving a sadistic master until he was snatched away. Now he can walk in the light and has the chance at a new life, but how long can he keep his past buried? Astarion attacks a random target, dealing massive damage if the enemy was recently attacked. Astarion viciously attacks the enemy with the most health and heals to full health. Astarion viciously attacks the enemy with the most health with a vampiric bite and heals to full health. body.zh: 对于影响已死亡勇士（戴斯蒙德、凯斯）的效果，阿斯代伦算作“亡灵”，对于所有其他效果则算作“存活”。 阿斯代伦使每列顶端的所有勇士伤害提高 %。 阿斯代伦关照阵型顶端以造成最大伤害。 根据你的选择，阿斯代伦使每列顶端或底部的所有勇士伤害提高。 阿斯代伦使每列底部的所有勇士伤害提高 %。 阿斯代伦关照阵型底部以造成最大伤害。 根据你的选择，阿斯代伦使每列顶端或底部的所有勇士伤害提高。 阿斯代伦大脑中的夺心魔蝌蚪使你的阵型获得一层“蜕变”堆叠。每层“蜕变”均使阿斯代伦的“压制”效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阿斯代伦使阵型的金币寻获量提高，数值为 % 乘以阵型中所有勇士的总年龄。如果邪念位于阵型中，则此技能的效果提高 %。 阿斯代伦使阵型的金币寻获量提高，数值为 % 乘以阵型中所有勇士的总年龄。 使用“渴血症”杀招后，阿斯代伦的“压制”效果提高 %。此效果最多可堆叠 层（乘算），在变更区域时重置堆叠。 如果阿斯代伦得到自身“压制”技能的强化，在使用“渴血症”杀招攻击时，他可以使阵型内所有其他勇士激活的杀招冷却时间减少 %。 如果阿斯代伦得到自身“压制”技能的强化，在使用他的杀招时，可以使所有其他勇士的杀招冷却时间减少。 对于阵型中的每位金币寻获勇士，阿斯代伦均使队伍的金币寻获量提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 阿斯代伦与阵型中的其他金币寻获型勇士合作，以“获取”更多金币。 阵型中每有一位游荡者、法师或绝对敌手从属组织成员，阿斯代伦均使其“压制”专精的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 阿斯代伦与游荡者同行、法师和绝对敌手从属组织的成员配合最佳。 使阿斯代伦的“偷袭”造成的基础杀招伤害加成提高至 秒当量。 阿斯代伦专注于对刚受到过盟友攻击的敌人造成更多伤害。 亲爱的，跟紧我。我们要隐藏在暗影中。 嗯哼，我回来帮忙了。但我们不会执行你的糟糕计划。 哦，这是什么？他们好像把钱包丢了。真可怜。 有人说这是运气。要我说，这是“无所谓，只要我能拿到金币。” 有时我还记得凡人时的感觉。很......奇怪。 我能感觉到--是诅咒让我的血液流淌，而非心脏。 你是否有过虫子在脑海中抽搐的感觉？ 经过一个世纪左右的时间后，有些物品会突然变得价值连城，真有趣。 吸血鬼不理俗务，魔宠负责赚钱养家。 嗯，多么甜美的味道啊。我决定全部喝下。 迷雾中肯定没有需要害怕的东西。反正不会有刀。 黑暗就像令人心安的拥抱。你想体验一下吗？ 如果这能给我杀死卡扎多尔的力量，我会接受。 好吧，我来带头——但你们所有人都必须更加隐蔽！ 亲爱的，什么都比老鼠好。 最好是直接就着脖子吸，但和凡人在一起时还是用高脚杯吧。 I may never be free of this. I may as well learn to live with it. Forever. 我在水沟里发现了这个。看起来可能很恶心，但非常致命......对老鼠来说。 虽然无法打晕枭熊，但也许能干掉狗头人？如果风向合适的话...... 别问它们是从哪里来的，你不想知道。 华丽且致命？哦，太完美了，亲爱的！ 别告诉其他人我有这个。我自己的......研究要用。 真有意思。我觉得我即将有所发现了...... 这能行？应该不可能。这一切都不可能...... 如果按我的希望发展，我就再也不用害怕太阳了。 效忠于卡扎多尔之后，这是我为数不多的财产之一...... 以前是准确的。现在它更像是一幅古画，而不是地图。 据说它们永远不会损坏。我得测试一下的。 现在没有人会质疑我的高贵出身了。至少看在我的金币面子上。 唔，挺......恶心的。 也许不体面，但必不可少。 总有一天，我会再次看到自己的脸。而你很幸运，每天都能看到我。 你有没有极度厌恶过某件东西，以至于无法割舍？ 肯定比弹弓好。 我对自己预想的要擅长用剑。我得附魔一下...... 没错，这是我的。不，你不需要知道我是从哪里得到的。 反正他们总会流血。这样正好留给我。 我用我在“OnlyFangs”赚到的金币买了这个小宝贝。 唔，它没失效前还是很好用的。 塔夫给我的，说它很适合我。说的没错。 如果可以直接出现在敌人身后时，刺杀他们就会容易很多。 阿斯代伦作为一个吸血鬼衍体，在夜间游荡了数个世纪，被迫侍奉着他那虐待成性的主人，直到解脱。如今的他能够在日光下行走，并获得了新生的机会，但他能将自己的过去掩埋多久？ 阿斯代伦攻击一名随机目标，如果该敌人刚刚遭受攻击，则造成大量伤害。 阿斯代伦凶残地攻击生命值最高的敌人，并使自己生命值全满。 阿斯代伦通过吸血鬼噬咬凶残地攻击生命值最高的敌人，并使自己生命值全满。

Ellywick increases the damage of Champions in the column behind her, with further buffs depending on what cards she pulls from her Deck of Many Things! Gold Find is increased by % Ellywick draws a random card from the Deck of Many Things after every 25th enemy kill or after 60 seconds, whichever comes first. She can hold up to 5 cards at once and most duplicate card effects stack multiplicatively. Cards are discarded when she uses her ultimate ability, Call Of The Feywild. Ellywick pulls a card from her Deck of Many Things for every 25 enemies defeated or after 60 seconds, changing her buffs for each card drawn. Ellywick unlocks her ultimate ability and, when she uses it, discards her current hand of cards. There is an instant effect based on each card discarded: Knight - All enemies currently spawned take 500% more damage from all attacks (stacks multiplicatively)^Moon - Instantly drop 10% of the gold from all currently spawned enemies (stacks multiplicatively)^Fates - Champions gain temporary hit points for 50% of their max health (stacks additively)^Flames - All currently spawned enemies move 50% slower and deal 50% less damage (stacks multiplicatively)^Gems - The next X bosses you fight have their max health reduced by 50% (X = # of cards) Additively increases the odds of Knight cards being drawn by 20% (additively reducing the odds of each other card by 5%) Ellywick focuses on supporting her allies by increasing the odds of drawing Knight cards from her Deck of Many Things. Additively increases the odds of Moon cards being drawn by 20% (additively reducing the odds of each other card by 5%) Ellywick focuses on her Gold Find abilities by increasing the odds of drawing Moon cards from her Deck of Many Things. Additively increases the odds of Gem cards being drawn by 20% (additively reducing the odds of each other card by 5%) Ellywick focuses on acquiring Gems by increasing the odds of drawing Gem cards from her Deck of Many Things. Ellywick counts the total number of cards she has drawn in the adventure. body.zh: 为处于她后方一列的勇士提高 % 伤害。 艾利薇会提高处于她后列勇士的伤害，并根据她从万象无常牌中抽取的卡牌提供进一步的增益！ 金币寻获量提高 % 每击杀 25 个敌人或每 60 秒（以先满足条件者为准），艾利薇会从万象无常牌中随机抽一张卡牌。她一次最多可以抽 5 张卡牌，大多数重复的卡牌效果以乘算方式堆叠。当她使用杀招技能“妖精荒野的呼唤”时，卡牌会被丢弃。 艾利薇每击倒 25 名敌人或每隔 60 秒从她的万象无常牌中抽取一张卡牌，每抽取一张牌便改变她的增益。 艾利薇解锁她的杀招技能，当她使用杀招时，她会丢弃她当前的手牌。每张被丢弃的卡牌都有即时效果： 骑士 - 所有当前刷新的敌人受到的所有攻击伤害增加 500%（以乘算方式堆叠）^月亮 - 所有当前刷新的敌人立即掉落 10% 金币（以乘算方式堆叠）^命运 - 勇士们获得相当于其最大生命值 50% 的临时生命值（以加算方式堆叠）^火焰 - 所有当前刷新的敌人移动速度降低 50%，造成的伤害降低 50%（以乘算方式堆叠）^宝石 - 你接下来迎战的 X 个首领的最大生命值减少 50%（X = 卡牌数） 使骑士牌被抽到的概率提高 20%，以加算方式堆叠（使所有其他牌被抽到的概率降低 5%，以加算方式堆叠） 艾利薇通过提高她从她的万象无常牌中抽到骑士牌的概率来专注于支援她的盟友。 使月亮牌被抽到的概率提高 20%，以加算方式堆叠（使所有其他牌被抽到的概率降低 5%，以加算方式堆叠） 艾利薇通过提高她从她的万象无常牌中抽到月亮牌的概率来专注于她的金币寻获技能。 使宝石牌被抽到的概率提高 20%，以加算方式堆叠（使所有其他牌被抽到的概率降低 5%，以加算方式堆叠） 艾利薇通过提高她从她的万象无常牌中抽到宝石牌的概率来专注于获取宝石。 艾利薇会计算她在冒险中抽取的卡牌总数。她每抽取一张卡牌，她就使“强力追随者”的效果增加 3%，以乘算方式堆叠，上限为 1000 张卡牌。 那些孩子比这件事更重要。出发吧。 欢迎来到妖精荒野！ 不是每个嘉年华都会在深水城逗留的。 你们找到我是好事，勇士们。 妖精荒野的勇士们，到我身边来！ 不用担心，我在嘉年华上有几个朋友能帮忙。 它的音乐让我迷醉，显得一切都很棒。 找到金子捡起来...... 有时候我觉得卡牌是有自己的思想的…… 星夜女神直视命运，选择改写她的故事。 这是多元宇宙中最伟大最优美的乐曲…… 你的善举将得到奖赏。 当心月行者的愤怒。 无论后果如何，你做出的选择是否正确还不明确。 均贫富。 这副牌组是因为爱和勇气而制作的。永远要记住这点。 费野拥有你连做梦都未曾想象过的色彩。 我做它是为了让詹克斯学习演奏。它跟我的旧鲁特琴看起来一个样！ 最老的那一架我还藏着呢。 这是妖精荒野的两位女王赐给我的礼物。 请叫德金不要碰它。 这是女巫之光嘉年华上的道具。 它能把问题讲清楚。 它划破空气时会发出吟唱。 它来自另一个位面，但我还不想谈这个话题。 相信我，真的很不走运。 万象无常牌是一个危险的游戏。但我走运了。 又多了一群帮忙治愈森林的朋友！ 我的梦想实现了！现在所有人都知道我的音乐了！ 仅供逃跑的时候使用。 你去过拉夫尼卡吗？ 一位亲密朋友送的礼物。 为下次夏日女王召见时准备的。 它就挂在我的衣领下面。 我们一起经历过很精彩的冒险！ 他的话有点多！ 跟她说话......总是让我......昏昏入睡。 有人有点心吗？ 想试试吗，休马恩？ 我留着这个是为了提醒自己，多元宇宙中美仍然是存在的。 腐烂会慢慢扩散。 艾利薇·乱弦曾创作出相当令人感动的音乐，以至于曾经受邀前往妖精荒野，还为夏日女王和空气与黑暗女王进行过演奏。两位女王都十分感动，赐给这位吟游诗人一件乐器--晨雾。乱弦与妖精荒野的关系让她和她的青蛙伙伴格罗阿克来到了女巫之光嘉年华，在这里，她会传颂关于妖精位面的传说与歌谣。 艾利薇弹奏吉他，发出音乐能量，攻击最多 3 个随机敌人。 艾利薇弹奏吉他，发出音乐能量，攻击最多 3 个随机敌人。 艾利薇丢弃她当前的手牌，六只来自妖精荒野的生物四处奔跑，对敌人造成伤害。 艾利薇丢弃她当前的手牌，六只来自妖精荒野的生物跑向艾利薇，并对沿途的敌人造成伤害，然后跑开，再次对沿途的敌人造成伤害。 艾利薇为处于她后方一列的勇士提供伤害增益，此效果会根据骑士堆叠层数而增加。

title.zh: 布朗温 布朗温·恩杜尔

body.en: Barrowin increases the damage of Champions behind her by % for each Champion in the formation who has an equal or higher base attack cooldown, stacking multiplicatively. Barrowin causes Champions behind her to do additional damage based on the number of Champions in the formation with equal or higher attack speed than her. Barrowin has a number of Vigilance stacks equal to the number of Champions in the formation that are either lawful or dwarves. She increases the health of other Champions in the formation by % of her max health for each Vigilance stack. Increases the Health of by Barrowin heals Champions in her column, including herself, for health per second for each stack of Vigilance she has. After Barrowin attacks, her next Healing Word also applies a temporary health bonus of the same amount. Barrowin heals Champions in the same column as her. Place her in a column that takes a lot of damage! Barrowin attacks seconds faster for each stack of Vigilance she has. Additionally, when a Champion that is eligible for Healing Word is hit by an enemy, Barrowin attacks 1 second faster for her next two attacks. Barrowin remembers the largest number of enemies she's had to tank at once in the current area. Blessed Hammer is increased by % multiplied by that number. Barrowin's Blessed Hammer is buffed by % Barrowin's Blessed Hammer is more effective, causing her allies to do even more damage. Barrowin's Healing Word is buffed by % Barrowin's Healing Word is more effective, causing her to heal and shield for even more. Barrowin's Blessed Hammer base effect is additively increased by % for each Vigilance stack she has. Barrowin focuses on lawful and dwarf Champions, boosting Blessed Hammer based on the number of Vigilance stacks she has. The light illuminates you, friend. Gorm's light shines upon us all. You need heals? Get over here, then! Feel the blessing of Gorm course through you. You think yourself weak? Think again! I can stand with the best of them! You'd think my hammer slow. You'd be mistaken. It's a prayer to Gorm Gulthyn. Undurr Ground. Get it? Clan Undurr does not back down! I used to do these calculations at home all the time! Rally under the banner of Clan Undurr! Don't go dying on me now. Plenty of work to do. Still sturdy enough to cause damage, if ye know what yer doin'. A hammer's just a chunk o' iron 'til it's in the hands of a proper warrior. The last thing me enemies see before Gorm takes 'em. A beacon of hope for all who see its mighty swing. Enemies not included, of course. A sad thing, but it's nice to have somethin' to follow. As durable as the Order of the Gauntlet itself. Brings a tear to me eye seein' it flap in the wind. The Order is my home now. I shall follow them to the end o' time. Even the craggiest chunk of brass can have great meaning. There was a time that I dinnae know what this symbol meant. In me time of need, Gorm has been a shining beacon of hope. Gorm Gulthyn himself has chosen me as his emissary, of this I am sure. Protects me waist and me legs! A little on the heavy side, though. Yer gonna need a strong blow to get through this. I was thinkin' one day, what haven't I plated in gold yet? Then I looked down. It is my solemn duty to aid those in need and defend those who cannae defend themselves. I'm one tough dwarf to crack. Ye can never have enough gold on yer armor, ye know. A masterfully crafted breastplate, if I ever saw one. Perhaps a little over the top, yea, but if it causes just one enemy to pause, it's done its job. The old helm of my beloved, Storn Skulldark. Granted to me by the Order of the Gauntlet when I joined their ranks. Dinnae worry about me, it's reinforced with good dwarven steel. Granted only to the Order's most devout and effective followers. A proud daughter of Clan Undurr and a devout follower of Gorm Gulthyn, the dwarven god of vigilance and duty. She spent fifteen years in the city of Ironmaster, in Icewind Dale, overseeing and protecting her family's investment in the city's lucrative mining operations. However, she saw little action and feared that her talents were being squandered. She has recently found a home within a budding organization called the Order of the Gauntlet, which vigilantly guards against the rise of evil in all its forms. Barrowin smashes the nearest enemy with her mighty warhammer. Barrowin infuses herself with holy energy, shielding and buffing her attack cooldown. Barrowin infuses herself with holy energy, shielding allies in her column and decreasing her own attack cooldown by 2 seconds. Barrowin causes adjacent Champions to do additional damage whenever she attacks. Barrowin heals Champions in the same column as her whenever she attacks. body.zh: 阵型中每位基本攻击冷却时间多于等于布朗温的勇士，均使她身后勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 依据阵型中攻击速度高于等于自己的勇士数量，布朗温使位于她身后的勇士造成额外伤害。 布朗温的“警戒”堆叠层数相当于阵型中的守序或矮人勇士数量。每层“警戒”均使阵型中其他勇士的生命值提高她的最大生命值的 %。 使 的生命值提高 每层“警戒”堆叠均使布朗温每秒为同列勇士（包括她自己）治疗 点生命值。布朗温攻击后，她的下一个“治愈真言”也会施加等量的临时生命值加成。 布朗温治疗与她同纵队的勇士。将她放置在承受大量伤害的纵队里！ 每层“警戒”堆叠均使布朗温的攻击速度加快 秒。此外，当一名能作为“治愈真言”施放对象的勇士被敌人击中时，布朗温的下两次攻击速度提升 1 秒。 布朗温铭记她在当前区域应对的最大敌人数量。“祝福之锤”按此数值以乘数强化 %。 布朗温的“祝福之锤”强化 % 布朗温的祝福之锤效果加强，使她的盟友造成更高伤害。 布朗温的“治愈真言”强化 % 布朗温的治愈真言效果加强，使她提供更有效的治疗和护盾。 每层“警戒”堆叠均使布朗温的“祝福之锤”基础效果以加算方式强化 %。 布朗温专注于守序和矮人勇士，依据她堆叠的“警戒”层数来强化祝福之锤。 光明照耀着你，朋友。 贡姆的圣光照耀着我们所有人。 你需要治疗？赶紧过来！ 感受贡姆的祝福穿过你的身体。 你觉得自己很弱？再想想！ 我能比肩他们中的最强者！ 你要是觉得我的铁锤速度慢，那你就错了。 这是对贡姆·古辛的祈祷。 翁铎在地下。听明白了吗？ 翁铎部落永不退缩！ 我以前一直在家里做这些计算！ 在恩杜尔家族的旗帜下集结！ 先别急着断气。还有大把活儿要干呢。 只要技术熟稔，依然可以发挥出它的威力。 在普通人手中锤子就只是一坨废铁，在战士手中它才是真正的大杀器。 在回归贡姆怀抱前它将是定格在我敌人眼中的最后画面。 所有见识过它的威力的人都会感到热血沸腾。当然，被它击中的敌人除外。 真可惜了，不过有旗子总好过没有。 就跟铁手教团一样老当益壮。 看着它随风飘扬我顿时热泪盈眶。 教团现在是我的家了。我会追随着它到时间尽头。 哪怕是最不起眼的一坨黄铜都可以拥有不凡的象征意义。 我曾经对这个圣徽非常陌生。 在我最无助的时刻，贡姆成了我黑夜中的明灯。 贡姆·古辛选中了我作为祂的使者。我非常确定。 可以保护我的腰和腿。虽然是有点过于沉重。 唯有非一般力度的攻击才能击穿此腰带。 有一次我忽然想到自己身上怎么就没有半点镀金装备，然后我就低头瞄了一下。 拯救落难和无助的人是我的庄重的使命。 我是非一般坚硬的矮人。 没有人会排斥自己身上护甲的含金量。 绝对称得上是大师级质量的胸甲。 虽说是有点过量了，但是数量如此惊人的宝石绝对会让战场上的敌人看傻眼，哪怕只换来一刹那的机也值得了。 这是我的好朋友斯托恩·颅暗使用过的头盔。 这是在我加入铁手教团时获赠的装备。 不必担心，这头盔是采用优良的矮人钢铁打造的。 只有教团中最虔诚最杰出的追随者才有资格佩戴此头盔。 她是恩杜尔家族的骄傲，也是矮人的警戒和职责之神贡姆·葛辛的虔诚信徒。她在冰风谷的精铁城待了 15 年，监督并保护她家族在该城利润丰厚的采矿投资。然而她在那里没有用武之地，因此开始担心自己的才能会被浪费。她最近加入了一个新成立的组织，这个组织被称为铁手教团，他们警惕地防范着各种形式的邪恶崛起。 布朗温用她的强力战锤猛击距离最近的敌人。 布朗温为自己注入神圣能量，获得护盾并降低攻击冷却时间。 布朗温为自己注入神圣能量，为她所在列的同伴提供护盾，并使自己的攻击冷却时间降低 2 秒。 每当布朗温攻击时，使相邻的勇士能造成额外伤害。 每当布朗温攻击时，治疗与她同列的勇士。

title.zh: 范·里希顿 鲁道夫·范·里希顿

body.en: As a sworn enemy of Strahd, Van Richten can be used in any Strahd Patron adventure or variant, even if he would not normally be available to be used due to variant or patron restrictions. Van Richten increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of him, and this buff increases in strength as undead foes are defeated. Van Richten increases the damage of Champions in the column in front of him by %. When a non-Undead non-Boss enemy is killed, there is a % chance that Strahd will resurrect it as an Undead version of the same enemy. The enemy reappears where it died after second and can drop an additional quest item or count as a second kill for quest progress when killed. Does not trigger in Boss areas. Undead enemies are Van Richten's favored foe. When one of his favored foes is killed, Van Richten gains a Triumph stack. Slayer Training is increased by % for each Triumph stack he has, stacking multiplicatively. Triumph stacks cap at and reset when a boss area is completed. Van Richten increases the effect of Slayer Training by % for each Cleric, Wizard, Sorcerer, or Warlock in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Van Richten works with other spellcasters to defeat evil. Van Richten increases the effect of Slayer Training by % for each Champion in the formation with an Intelligence score of 14 or higher, stacking multiplicatively. INT 14+ Champions: The famous author draws upon the knowledge of others in his quest to eliminate harmful undead from the world. Van Richten increases the effect of Slayer Training by % for each Hunter Champion and each Debuff Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Champions with both roles count twice. Potential Stacks: Rudolph associates with other hunters and individuals that know how to exploit an enemy's weakness. If no enemies have been defeated for seconds, Van Richten's ghost son Erasmus appears. Whenever Van Richten attacks, Erasmus quickly moves to the target he will attack and curses all enemies in a small area, causing all attacks against them to deal % more damage. This is increased by % for each Triumph stack Van Richten has, stacking multiplicatively. Erasmus disappears when changing areas. Van Richten's ghostly son Erasmus watches over him, and he arrives to increase damage against enemies when his father is in trouble. Van Richten raises his hand, which projects radiant light towards the enemies. All enemies take an ultimate hit, are knocked back a short distance, and slowed by 50% for 5 seconds. Enemies that are his favored foe take 400% more damage from this ultimate. Van Richten gains the Healing role. Every second, Van Richten heals the most damaged Champion in the formation for % of his own max health. Van Richten uses his divine gifts to heal other Champions. In non-boss areas, when Van Richten attacks one of his favored foes and does not defeat it, he Dismisses it to its home plane and he gains Triumph stacks. Enemies dismissed in this way do not drop gold nor count toward quest progress. Van Richten exiles his foul enemies to the shadowfell or another foul home. Van Richten casts Sanctuary on all Champions in the front column of the formation that do not have the Tanking role. Monsters prefer to attack Champions that aren't under the effect of Sanctuary first when possible. Enemies that attempt to choose as a target instead choose to attack another Champion, assuming another valid target exists. Van Richten protects his allies from attack. I do what I must for the greater good, no matter the pain I must suffer. Many have followed in my legacy. They are all Van Richtens in my eyes. If you choose to walk this path, you will know no peace. However... The strife you must endure bestows peace to innocent lives. What a terrible night to have a curse. Such victories are short-lived, but they do provide motivation. The corruption will leave an area for a time, if one excises enough of it. Sometimes I feel as if my dear son is still with me, somehow. Were it possible, I would tell him that I love him, and cherish his memory. Every foe felled ensures that my son's death was not in vain. Newly risen? Then you must not yet know who I am. Time for a brief introduction. You do not frighten me, monster. On the contrary, you should be afraid. My true foe has many names. 'The Devil,' for one. Well, even devils may die. I'm no spring chicken, but I do maintain a regimen of calisthenics. I have faith that my students will carry on my work long after I am gone. The balance is off. The grip is wrong. Bah! I cannot work with this! Only a short-lived fool believes an old man incapable of defending himself. An elegant weapon, for inelegant foes. The worst monsters deserve the most agonizing ends. I insist. Where did I leave that blasted thing? And in what form? Hm... You may have met me once or twice, but not as I appear before you now. Let them assume they have power over me. Let them assume they are safe. Each quarrel carries searing radiance to burn away evil. I should restock soon, and check in on the twins and Beatrice. Natural remedies for supernatural problems. I've studied the affliction. There is only one cure. Holy water and spell scrolls. No matter what awaits me, I am always prepared. Years of monster hunting have not been kind to it. I should clean this. I must do all I can to prevent further tragedy. Ingrid, Erasmus, forgive me... My title was earned, I assure you. Now tell me your ailment and be quick. It glows ever more brightly when sorrow shrouds my heart. This one comes and goes as it pleases. Where are you off to this time? This mischievous scamp delights the children. Innkeepers, less so. Despite what you may have heard, her diet of apples does not deter me. This one is well-trained. Harmless to the living. A ruinous force to the dead. I present cold and bare facts to arm my readers. Unlike a certain hack. Not all lycanthropes are evil, mind you. However, all are dangerous. I taught Ezmerelda - Pardon me. I taught Ez everything I know. I am the foremost expert on the subject matter. It is not a boast. It is fact. Once a mere doctor from the dread domain of Darkon, Rudolph van Richten was forced down a haunted and tragic path of revenge after losing his wife and son to the cruelty of monsters. Now, as a legendary vampire hunter, he stands undaunted against the evils that dwell within the mists. Van Richten has trained a myriad of successors to his legacy throughout the years, including fellow Champion, Ez. Van Richten slashes the nearest enemy with his Silver Sword Cane. Van Richten leaps out and slashes the nearest enemy with his Silver Sword Cane, dealing one hit. Deals an additional 5 seconds of BUD-based damage to Van Richten's Favored Foes. Van Richten repels all foes a short distance, dealing 1 ultimate hit and slowing them. Van Richten repels all foes a short distance, dealing 1 ultimate hit and slowing them. Damage is greater against his favored foes. Increases the damage of all Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Male Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Human Champion in the formation Increases the damage of all Champions with a INT score of 13 or higher by % Increases the damage of all Lawful Champions by % Increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Melee Champion in the formation
body.zh: 作为斯特拉德的死敌，范·里希顿可用于任何斯特拉德赞助者冒险或支线任务，即使通常情况下他会因支线任务或赞助者限制而无法上场。 范·里希顿会提高他前方一列勇士的伤害，并且每有一名亡灵敌人被击败，这项增益都会变得更强。 范·里希顿会使其前方一列中的勇士伤害提高 %。 当一个非亡灵、非首领的敌人被击杀时，有 % 的几率斯特拉德会将其复活为相同敌人的亡灵版本。 该敌人会在 秒后重新出现在其死亡的位置，被再次击杀时会额外掉落 1 个任务物品，或在任务进度中计为第二次击杀。 此效果在首领区域不会触发。 亡灵敌人是范·里希顿的偏好对手。 当一个偏好对手被击杀时，范·里希顿获得 1 层“凯旋”。 他每拥有 1 层“凯旋”，“屠魔者训练”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 “凯旋”的层数上限为 ，并会在完成首领区域后重置。 阵型中每有一位牧师、法师、术士或邪术师，范·里希顿会使“屠魔者训练”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足条件的勇士数量： 范·里希顿会与其他施法者联手击败邪恶。 阵型中每有一位智力大于等于 14 的勇士，范·里希顿会使“屠魔者训练”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 智力 14+ 的勇士数量： 这位知名的作家在消灭世间有害亡灵的征途中广泛借鉴了他人的知识。 阵型中每有一位猎手勇士和减益勇士，范·里希顿会使“屠魔者训练”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 同时拥有两种角色定位的勇士计算两次。 可获得的堆叠层数： 鲁道夫会与其他猎人以及懂得利用敌人弱点的人为伍。 若在 秒内没有任何敌人被击败，范·里希顿的幽灵之子伊拉斯姆斯将现身。 每当范·里希顿发动攻击时，伊拉斯姆斯会迅速移动到他攻击的目标处，并诅咒一小片区域内的所有敌人，使所有针对他们的攻击伤害提高 %。 范·里希顿每拥有 1 层“凯旋”，该效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 切换区域时，伊拉斯姆斯会消失。 范·里希顿的幽魂之子伊拉斯姆斯会守护着他，当他的父亲陷入困境时，他会现身并提高对敌人的伤害。 范·里希顿抬起手，向敌人投射出耀眼的光芒。 所有敌人受到一次杀招打击，被击退一小段距离，并减速 50%，持续 5 秒。 若敌人是他的偏好对手，这次杀招打击会使其承受额外 400% 的伤害。 范·里希顿获得治疗角色定位。 每秒范·里希顿会为阵型中受伤最重的勇士恢复生命值，数值为他自身最大生命值的 %。 范·里希顿运用他神赐的天赋为其他勇士疗伤。 在非首领区域中，当范·里希顿攻击一个他的偏好对手但未能将其击败时，他会将其遣返至其原生位面，并获得 层“凯旋”堆叠。 以这种方式被遣返的敌人不会掉落金币，也不会计入任务进度。 范·里希顿将那些卑劣的敌人放逐至堕影冥界，或它们其他同样污秽的老巢。 范·里希顿会为阵型前排中所有不具备坦克角色定位的勇士施放“庇护所”效果。 在可能的情况下，怪物会优先攻击未受“庇护所”效果影响的勇士。 试图将 选为目标的敌人会改为攻击另一位勇士，前提是存在其他有效目标。 范·里希顿保护他的盟友免受攻击。 为了大家的利益，无论要承受怎样的痛苦，我都会去做我必须做的事。 许多人都继承了我的衣钵。 在我眼里，他们都是范·里希顿。 如果你选择走上这条路，就别想再有安宁。 不过…… 你必须承受的苦难，会为无辜之人带来安宁。 在这样的夜晚遭受诅咒可不妙啊。 这样的胜利转瞬即逝，但确实能让人更有干劲。 只要清除掉足够多的腐化，某个区域的腐化之力就会暂时退散。 有时候我觉得，我的宝贝儿子还在以某种方式陪在我身边。 如果可以的话，我真想告诉他我爱他，并会珍藏他留给我的回忆。 每击倒一个敌人，都能证明我儿子没有白白牺牲。 刚刚苏醒？ 那你肯定还不知道我是谁。 是时候简单介绍一下我自己了。 怪物，你吓不着我。 相反，该害怕的是你。 我真正的仇敌有很多名称。 比如说，“魔鬼”。 哼，哪怕魔鬼也是会死的。 我已经不年轻了，但我一直在坚持做自重训练。 我相信即使在我离开很久后，我的学生们也会继续我的事业。 平衡不行，握感也不对。 呸！ 这玩意儿我没法用！ 只有短命的蠢货才会以为老头子没办法保护自己。 优雅的武器，专治不优雅的敌人。 最邪恶的怪物，就该迎来最痛苦的结局。 我坚持这一点。 我把那该死的玩意儿放哪儿了？ 它是什么形态来着？ 唔…… 你也许见过我一两次，但绝不是我现在这副模样。 就让他们以为自己能拿捏我。 就让他们以为自己很安全。 每支弩矢都带着灼热的圣光，可焚灭邪恶。 我得尽快补给一下，顺便去看看那对双胞胎和比阿特丽斯。 解决超自然问题的自然疗法。 我研究过这种病症。 只有一种治法。 圣水和法术卷轴。 不管前方有什么在等着我，我都时刻做好准备。 多年猎魔岁月的洗礼让它变得黯淡无光。 我得把它擦干净。 我必须竭尽所能阻止更多悲剧发生。 英格丽德，伊拉斯姆斯，原谅我…… 我向你保证，我的头衔是我凭本事挣来的。 现在，快说说你哪里不舒服。 当悲伤笼罩我心时，它会愈发明亮地发光。 这家伙想来就来，想走就走。 这次你又要跑哪儿去？ 这小捣蛋鬼把孩子们逗得很开心。 不过，旅店老板可不怎么开心。 不管你听说过什么，她天天吃苹果可赶不走我。 这家伙训练有素。 对活人无害。 对亡者却能造成毁灭性的打击。 我会呈现冰冷且赤裸裸的事实，让我的读者有所准备。 不像某个三流写手。 注意，并非所有兽化人都是邪恶的。 但它们全都很危险。 我向艾丝美拉达——抱歉， 我向艾茨传授了我所知道的一切。 在这方面，我就是最权威的专家。 这可不是我自夸。 这是事实。 鲁道夫·范·里希顿原本只是达孔恐惧领域的一名医生，在妻儿惨遭怪物残害后，他被迫踏上了一条鬼影重重的悲惨复仇之路。 如今，身为传奇吸血鬼猎手的他无畏地对抗着潜伏在迷雾之中的邪恶。 这些年来，范·里希顿培养了无数继承自己衣钵的后继者，其中包括同为勇士的艾茨。 范·里希顿会用白银剑杖斩击最近的敌人。 范·里希顿飞身跃出，用白银剑杖斩击最近的敌人，造成 1 次打击。 对范·里希顿的偏好敌人额外造成持续 5 秒的基础杀招伤害。 范·里希顿将所有敌人击退一小段距离，造成 1 次杀招打击并使他们减速。 范·里希顿将所有敌人击退一小段距离，造成 1 次杀招打击并使他们减速。 对其偏好敌人造成的伤害更高。
