body.en: Rust increases the damage of all Champions by % for each Champion in the formation with the Gold Find role or the Oxventurers Guild affiliation, stacking multiplicatively. Rust increases the damage of all Champions, and those benefits increase for each Gold Find Champion or Oxventurers Guild affiliation member in the formation. Rust increases your gold find by %. Assuming Rust does not already have one, he has a % chance to find a shiny gold piece after any kill that drops gold. Each time Rust finds a shiny gold piece he gains a Riches stack. Rust increases the effect of Hello, Friends by % for each Riches stack he has, stacking multiplicatively. Rust loses his shiny gold piece whenever you use his ultimate ability. Riches stacks are capped at the highest area unlocked divided by 5, rounded up. Shiny Gold Piece: Rust has a chance of finding his One Gold Piece whenever an enemy is defeated which increases his damage buff. By using his ultimate, he'll drop his gold piece and give you another chance to increase his buff even further! Rust increases the damage of all Champions by % for each order of magnitude of your Gold Find percentage, stacking multiplicatively. When Rust uses his ultimate, all other Champions with the Gold Find role or Oxventurers Guild affiliation have their remaining ultimate cooldowns reduced by %. Rust's flamboyant nature inspires his friends to also attempt fantastic feats of daring-do. Rust increases the cap of One Gold Piece's Riches stacks by % for each Champion in the formation with the Gold Find role or Oxventurers Guild affiliation, stacking multiplicatively. Champions in Formation Targeted: Rust becomes more obsessed with his one gold piece, increasing the benefits he grants when he gains and loses it. Whenever Rust uses his ultimate ability, the weather changes to "raining gold", causing gold coins to rain from the sky. You gain gold equal to % of a monster kill (including your gold find modifier) in the current area every second. Rust's fixation on gold becomes real when it literally starts raining gold each time he is fired out of a cannon. Whenever Rust is holding a shiny gold piece, he increases the effect of Hello, Friends by %. Whenever Rust is NOT holding a shiny gold piece, he increases the effect of Rust For Hire by %. If we fling ourselves at the enemy, what can they do? This seems like a good idea! The more the merrier! You seem like cool people, yes? I mean, they hired me to do a job. It can't be bad! I like this plan! I like that ship! I like your boots! Look at all this! This has to be at least one gold piece! I will help anyone for...one gold piece! Look at this guy! Flashing one gold piece around! I will help you...for one gold piece. What is all this? Oh, hello friends! Why would I need more than this? I can't even imagine that! First I had nothing and now I have all I need! What do you mean more than one? Why would you need more than that?! One coin... Tw... Oh, come on, I know this! Give me a moment... You see? This is what the sea does. Destroys everything. Like most things, you should keep your sword dry. Except if it is stabbing someone. It is very effective at stabbing. With this pointy end here. This is beautiful! It must be worth almost one gold piece! Wait, you have one gold piece? I can't think of anything better. I don't think you can afford my price. All the riches I could ever need. Looks cool, right? Truth be told, I don't know how to use this. This was a beautiful gift from a pirate I know. Oh there are so many things happening here! That's the stuff. Oh wait, no, this is the stuff! Sometimes you just want to lap whiskey from a wine glass. Hello, Friend! Would you like a drink? This came with the pistols. Oh look, the picture Corazon drew is in the pocket! My pistols look fancy riding in this. There is a pocket for everything! My pistols, this fish, one gold piece, that bottle... I took this off someone I killed. I think it sets off my ears. Very important--it keeps me dry. It's best to use ALL the feathers. Rust on the Harbour is a former pirate who gave up a life at sea because it was far too wet. Now trying life as an adventurer on land, he'll lend his roguish skills to anyone who can give him that which his heart desires most: one gold piece. Rust shoots a random enemy with his pistols. Rust shoots a random enemy with his pistols. Rust climbs into a cannon and fires himself at the enemies, dealing damage in a large area. Rust loads himself into a cannon and fires himself toward the enemies, dealing damage in a large area upon landing. If Rust has a shiny gold piece, he drops it while flying through the air. body.zh: 阵型中每有一位金币寻获角色或“公牛冒险公会”从属组织的勇士，拉斯特会使所有勇士的伤害增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 拉斯特会提升所有勇士的伤害，并且阵型中每有一位金币寻获勇士或“公牛冒险公会”从属组织成员，加成效果会进一步增加。 拉斯特会使你的金币寻获量提高 % 假如拉斯特目前没有闪亮金币，那他有 % 的几率在击杀任意会掉落金币的敌人后获得一枚闪亮金币。每次拉斯特找到一枚闪亮金币，他会获得一层“财富”堆叠。拉斯特拥有的每层“财富”堆叠会使“你们好啊，朋友们”的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每当你使用拉斯特的杀招技能，他都会丢失他的闪亮金币。“财富”的堆叠上限为已解锁的最高区域除以 5（向上取整）。 闪亮金币： 每当有敌人被击败时，拉斯特都有机会找到他的一枚金币，它会提高他的伤害增益。使用他的杀招会使他弄丢他的金币，你便又有机会进一步提高他的增益！ 你的金币获取量百分比每提高一个数量级，拉斯特会使所有勇士的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 当拉斯特使用他的杀招时，所有其他金币寻获角色或“公牛冒险公会”从属组织的勇士剩余杀招冷却时间减少 %。 拉斯特爱炫耀的个性激发了他的朋友也去尝试一些大胆的壮举。 阵型中每有一位金币寻获角色或“公牛冒险公会”从属组织的勇士，拉斯特会令“一枚金币的财富”堆叠层数上限提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 拉斯特变得更加痴迷他的一枚金币，这提高了他得到和失去它时提供的增益效果。 每当拉斯特使用他的杀招技能，天气会转变为“下金币雨”，会有金币从天而降。每秒钟，你获得相当于在当前区域击杀一个怪物所获金币（包括你的金币寻获量提升） %的金币。 拉斯特对金币的痴迷变成了现实，每次他被装进大炮发射出去时，都会真的下起金币雨。 每当拉斯特手持闪亮金币时，他会令“你们好啊，朋友们”的效果提高 %。每当拉斯特没有闪亮金币时，他会令“雇佣兵拉斯特”的效果提高 %。 如果我们扑向敌人，他们还能怎么办？ 这似乎是个好主意！ 越多越好！ 你们似乎是很酷的人，对吧？ 我是说，他们雇我来完成任务。能有什么坏事呢！ 我喜欢这个计划！我喜欢那艘船！我喜欢你的靴子！ 快看看这些！这至少是一枚金币！ 我愿意帮助任何人，只要有......一枚金币！ 瞧瞧这家伙！四处炫耀一枚金币！ 我会帮助你们......只要有一枚金币。 这是什么回事？ 噢，你们好啊，朋友们！ 我还要比这更多的东西干啥？我难以想象！ 刚开始我一无所有，而现在我拥有了我需要的一切！ 你说比一多是什么意思？你要比那还多的干啥？！ 一枚硬币……两……噢，真是的，我知道这个的！给我点时间…… 看到了吗？这就是大海的作用。它能毁灭一切。 与大多数东西一样，你应该让剑保持干爽。用它来扎人的时候除外。 用它来扎人非常有效。尤其是这个尖尖的头。 它太美了！几乎抵得上一枚金币的价值了！ 等等，你们有一枚金币？ 我想不到有什么更好的东西了。 我觉得你们出不起我要的价钱。 我需要的一切财富就是它了。 看起来挺酷的是吧？ 说句实话，这东西我都不会用。 这是来自我认识的一位海盗的美丽礼物。 噢，这里发生太多事情了！ 就是这东西。 噢，等等，不对，是这个才对！ 有时候人就是想从红酒杯里大口喝威士忌。 你好啊，朋友！想喝上一杯吗？ 这是手枪附送的。 快看，科拉松画的画就在口袋里！ 我的手枪插在这里面酷炫得很。 这里有个什么都能装的口袋！我的手枪，这条鱼，一枚金币，那个瓶子...... 这是我从被我干掉的某个人那里拿来的。 我觉得它很衬我的耳朵。 非常重要--它能让我保持干爽。 把所有羽毛都用上是最好的。 港口的拉斯特以前是一名海盗，却因为讨厌过度潮湿而放弃了海上生涯。他现在试图在陆地上当一名冒险者来讨生活，因此愿意向一切能给予他心之所向（一枚金币）的人提供帮助，奉献他的游荡者技能。 拉斯特用手枪射击一名随机敌人。 拉斯特用手枪射击一名随机敌人。 拉斯特爬进一门大炮，瞄准敌人将自己发射出去，在大范围内造成伤害。 拉斯特将自己装进一门大炮，瞄准敌人将自己发射出去，落地时在大范围内造成伤害。如果拉斯特有一枚闪亮金币，他在空中飞行时会把它弄掉。 拉斯特提高队伍的金币获取量，当他持有“一枚金币”时，此效果大幅提升 拉斯特提高所有勇士的伤害，此效果会根据队伍的金币获取量数量级而获得提升。

The range can be extended with clever formations. The range of Shen-state is increased by for each Healer Champion in the formation, stacking additively. Increase the effect of Shen State by % for each enemy attacking Dragonbait and for each enemy enrage stack (additive). This effect is increased by % for each other Tanking Champion in the formation. Dragonbait is a defensive tank, and will increase the damage of all Champions when he comes under attack. Increase the effect of Shen State for each Support Champion in the formation. The increase amount is based on how close the Support Champion is to Dragonbait.^ Dragonbait emits a rich chicken-y scent which changes how his buffs affect his allies based on distance. Increases the effect of 's ability by % Champions in Formation Targeted: Dragonbait enjoys working alongside other defensive Champions, and emits a pleasantly spicy scent while doing so. Deekin speaks for Dragonbait. Deekin understands bad smells. [click] [whistle] [click] [click] [low whistle] Deekin doesn't like when you call Dragonbait short. Boss keeps getting up whenever he's knocked down. Boss looks angry. Deekin thinks we should hit that really big thing. He looks most content when he has allies to protect & a quarry to chase. Boss smells like a burning bakery. It's rusted shut. Whoever gave it to Dragonbait certainly enjoyed the bow. Close to the heart. Protecting the heart. Dragonbait carries a drawing of Artus Cimber. It's just some boards, nails, and metal. Plus the resolve to stand behind it. Deekin thinks it smells like dino dung. He's surprisingly nimble with it! You can always tell who took a shield to the face. He reapplies the paint often. I've seen him use it as an improvised weapon. It was awesome! Sometimes, simple is best. Any bets on what he finds in there? He always has something to help hidden away. You can find one in any weapon shop in Chult. Much like this blade, Dragonbait is a solid addition to any adventuring party. Luckily Artus taught us what most of Dragonbaits scents mean before he left. It's been used for generations to protect the land of Chult. We have a few of them in a pack somewhere... He's a saurial of few words. But the wear on his longsword says a lot. Whenever Dragonbait smells like baked bread, someone is in a world of hurt. Artus left Dragonbait, but he continues the fight as a Champion. The jungles of Chult were not kind to it. How old is Dragonbait? From the smell of his cloak, he's basically undead. [lemon scent] What does he hide in there? Dragonbait is a champion of good and a saurial - a species that originated on a distant world and whose members have long lives. Very few saurials dwell in the Forgotten Realms, and no saurial communities are believed to exist anywhere in the world. The saurial's language is a combination of clicks and whistles beyond the human range of hearing, so Dragonbait relies on 'shouting' scents to communicate emotions. Dragonbait's known scents include: brimstone (confusion), roses (sadness), lemon (pleasure or joy), baked bread (anger), violets (danger or fear), honeysuckle (tenderness or concern), wood smoke (devotion or piety), tar (victory or celebration), and ham (nervousness or worry). Dragonbait attacks the closest enemy with his sword, hitting all nearby enemies with a small cleave. Dragonbait jumps out and strikes with his Holy Avenger, dealing damage to all enemies on screen and clearing any stun/charm effects on Champions. Dragonbait jumps out and strikes with his Holy Avenger, dealing damage to all enemies on screen and immediately clearing any stun/charm effects on Champions. Any Fiends or Undead left alive are marked with an overlay of the Holy Avenger. Champions who attack marked enemies deal 400% additional damage. body.zh: 提升阵型中其他所有勇士的生命值，数值相当于龙饵最大生命值的 % 龙饵提高附近勇士的伤害。巧妙的阵型可以扩大其范围。 阵型中每位治疗者均使神态的范围扩大 ，以加算方式堆叠 每名攻击龙饵或使其堆叠怒气的敌人，均使神态的效果提高 %（以加算方式堆叠）。阵型中每有另外一名坦克勇士，此效果就提升 % 龙饵是一位防御型坦克，会在自身受到攻击时提高所有勇士的伤害。 阵型中每有一位支援型勇士，就会提升神态的效果。提升数值取决于支援型勇士与龙饵的距离有多近^ 龙饵散发出浓郁的鸡肉味，根据距离改变他的增益对盟友的影响。 将 的 技能效果提升 % 《冠军在酝酿中》目标金额： 龙饵喜欢与其他防御型勇士并肩作战，并会在这种时候散发出令人愉悦的辛辣气味。 德金为龙饵开口说话。德金懂得那些可怕气味的意义。 [咔哒] [吹口哨] [咔哒] [咔哒] [小声吹口哨] 德金不喜欢你叫龙饵矮子。 首领每次被打倒后，都会不断爬起来。 首领看起来很生气。 德金认为我们应该攻击那个超大的东西。 当有盟友要保护、有猎物要追赶时，他看起来最为满足。 首领闻起来就像着火的面包店一样。 锈迹斑斑打不开了...... 把它送给龙饵的人一定很喜欢使用弓。 放在心上。守护心房。 龙饵随身携带着阿图斯·西姆贝尔的画像。 只是一些木板、钉子和金属。再加上站到它后面的决心。 德金认为它闻起来像恐龙粪便。 有了它，他的动作出奇地敏捷！ 你总能看出谁用过盾牌来护脸。他经常重刷油漆。 我见过他用它来做临时武器。效果太棒了！ 有时候，简单是最好的。 有谁要赌一下他在里面找到了什么吗？ 他总是有东西要人帮忙藏起来。 你在楚尔特的任意一家武器店都能找到这东西。 跟这把利刃一样，对任何一支探险队来说，龙饵都是坚实有力的生力军。 幸好阿图斯在离开之前教会了我们龙饵大部分气味的含义。 它世世代代都被用来保卫楚尔特之地。 我们在某处的一个包里有几把这样的剑...... 他是个沉默寡言的爬虫人，但他破损的长剑却有道不完的故事。 每当龙饵闻起来有烤面包的味道，某人就要有血光之灾了。 阿图斯离开了龙饵，但他还是像个勇士一样在战斗。 楚尔特的丛林对它很不友好。 龙饵有多大年纪了？从他的斗篷散发的气味来判断，他基本是不死的。 [柠檬的清香] 他藏了什么在里面？ 龙饵是一名善良的勇士，也是一名爬虫人——这是个起源于遥远世界的种族，其成员拥有漫长的生命。很少有爬虫人居住在被遗忘的国度，据说世界上任何地方都没有爬虫人社区的存在。爬虫人的语言是由超出人类听觉范围的咔哒声和口哨声组合而成，所以龙饵依靠“喊叫”的气味来传达情感。龙饵的已知气味包括：硫磺石（混乱）、玫瑰（悲伤）、柠檬（快乐或喜悦）、烤面包（愤怒）、紫罗兰（危险或恐惧）、金银花（温柔或关切）、木烟（奉献或虔诚）、焦油（胜利或庆祝）和火腿（紧张或担忧）。 龙饵用他的剑攻击距离最近的敌人，同时对附近所有敌人触发小顺势斩。 龙饵跳起并使用神圣复仇者发动攻击，对屏幕上的所有敌人造成伤害，并清除所有勇士身上的任何眩晕/魅惑效果。 龙饵跳起并使用神圣复仇者发动攻击，对屏幕上的所有敌人造成伤害，并立即清除所有勇士身上的任何眩晕/魅惑效果。所有在此之后还存活的炼狱生物和亡灵会被神圣复仇者标记，勇士对被标记的敌人造成 400% 额外伤害。

body.en: Nova is intrinsically curious about the creatures inhabiting the world. She inspects enemies as soon as they spawn, increasing their damage taken by %. This increases by 10% (additively) every second they are alive, to a cap of 1000% (90 seconds). This ability is increased by 200% if Nova is in the front-most column of the formation. Nova is intrinsically curious about the world around her. She increases the damage done to creatures the longer they are alive. Nova increases the damage of Champions within two slots by % for each Champion level on the affected Champions, stacking multiplicatively. Each Champion's contribution caps at levels after their last available upgrade. Nova increases the damage of all nearby Champions based on the sum of their levels. Nova increases the max health of all other Champions by 25% of her base max health. Nova contributes one stack to Aerois Synergy every time an enemy is stunned, rooted, or slowed. Their maximum number of stacks is 200 plus the highest area completed in the current run divided by 5 (rounded down). 10% of her contributed stacks are removed when changing areas. The Crew is increased by 20% times the total number of Aerois Synergy stacks. Nova's attacks slow the movement of enemies she damages by 50% for 5 seconds. Enemies that are Slowed by this ability deal half damage to Nova. This effect does not stack if it is applied again before it expires, but the cooldown is refreshed. When Nova becomes Overwhelmed, Tiangong creates a protective barrier around her and all other Champions in her column, granting them each 250% of Nova's max health as temporary HP. The effect of The Crew is increased by 400% for each Champion's shield that remains in place (stacking multiplicatively). Nova is stunned until the shield is broken or she is no longer overwhelmed. This can only trigger once per area. Changing areas resets it so it can happen again, but also resets the damage bonus and un-stuns Nova. The Crew now applies to all Champions within 3 slots, but the extra Champions are only counted towards its levels total at 50% effectiveness. Nova focuses on expanding her crew Increases the effect of The Crew by 100% Nova focuses on her closest crewmates Nova increases the damage of the Champions in the formation with the highest Intelligence score by %. This effect is buffed by % for each monster heart she has collected (stacking additively and then applying multiplicatively), and % for each monster brain she has collected (stacking multiplicatively and then applying multiplicatively).^Heroes of Aerois are automatically buffed by Discovery and are not included in the calculations for highest INT score. Nova increases the damage of the Champions in the formation with the highest Intelligence score by %. This effect is buffed by % for each monster heart she has collected (stacking additively and then applying multiplicatively), and % for each monster brain she has collected (stacking multiplicatively and then applying multiplicatively). The needs of the many, you know how it goes. ME?? I mean...uh...We can do this! Yay! Go us! I'd recalculate your odds, but that's just me. What? My Ma always taught me to dress in layers! With a name like Brookstone, I'm sure we can trust him! So what planet are we on again? I'm happy to wait here till my theory is confirmed. Perhaps we can talk this out? No? You've handled worse, Nova. You've definitely handled worse. Have you ever seen so many beautiful worlds? If we all work together, what could go wrong? Oh, you want me to lead? Well...Let's go team! I'm open to suggestions... Now that it's confirmed, let's put my theory to the test. They put an amazing hue on everything! Try them! Because Safety is Sexy. Eyes work MUCH better when they aren't exposed to excess heat. I tested. I'm trying to get a better look, but Quill keeps getting in my light! I'm sure it controls something. Let's keep searching. We found it on the orbital citadel, Aegis V. If I could harness its knowledge, that'll give us the edge over Starbane. I've been speaking with it. It makes sense...I just. NO! Don't touch it! Oh dear, it smells really bad. The price for saving my friends. I'd do it again without question! Huh? You can heal it? Yes. Yes, please! A couatl gifted me with my restored hand! She was beautiful. Just stories I wrote about home. My old home, that is. It's - It's a long story. What is it that makes Aerois so special? Can it be the key to saving the universe? 'A Short History of the Wonders and Dangers of Planar Magic.' She wrote it herself! Volume 24, pertaining to the location of planetary bodies within the Astral Sea. Okay, so maybe it needs a wash. Keeping my neck warm helps me to think. She knitted it from the finest wool, each color representing our family. To keep me warm and safe, no matter how far I find myself from Ma. It called to me from the dark. Its light is what guided me to find it aboard that crashed skiff. I need more fragments, so I can piece it back together. This is important! Just one part of the Eternal Triumvirate. Will I ever hear them speak? Nova V'ger has a voracious appetite for knowledge; she needs to know anything and everything about anything and everything. Her magic powers have been gifted to her by a mysterious entity called Tiangong. She dreams of travelling to the stars and discovering the location of the true genasi homeworld. Nova leaps out and slices through the nearest enemy with Tiangong. Nova leaps out and slices through the nearest enemy with Tiangong. If her attack kills the enemy, it drops a monster heart. Nova levitates with Tiangong, releasing three waves of blue energy damaging all enemies. Nova levitates up in the air as Tiangong floats in front of the formation, releasing three waves of blue energy that deal damage to all enemies. The damage is increased by 1% times to total number of Aerois Synergy stacks. body.zh: 诺娃天生对居住在这个世界中的生物充满好奇。她会在敌人出现后立即进行检查，使其受到的伤害提高 %。敌人每存活一秒，此数字就会提高 10%（以加算方式堆叠），上限为 1000%（90 秒）。如果诺娃处于阵型的最前列，则此技能提高 200%。 诺娃天生对周围的世界充满好奇。根据生物存活的时间，时间越长，她对其造成的伤害越大。 诺娃提高距离她 2 格内勇士的伤害，受影响勇士的每个勇士等级均可提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每位勇士的贡献上限是其最后一次可用进阶后的 级。 诺娃根据相邻勇士的等级总和提高所有相邻勇士的伤害。 诺娃提升其他所有勇士的最大生命值，数值相当于她基础最大生命值的 25%。 每当一名敌人被眩晕、定身或减速时，诺娃都为埃罗伊斯协同贡献一层堆叠。其最大堆叠层数为 200 加上当前关卡中完成的最高区域除以 5（向下舍入）。改变区域时，移除她所贡献堆叠的 10%。“小队”提高 20% 乘以埃罗伊斯协同的堆叠总层数。 诺娃的攻击使受到她伤害的敌人减速 50%，持续 5 秒。被此技能减速的敌人对诺娃造成的伤害减半。如果在此效果消失之前再次应用，则此效果不会堆叠，但会刷新冷却时间。 当诺娃被击溃时，天工在她和所有与她同列的勇士周围制造一道保护屏障，使其获得诺娃最大生命值的 250% 作为临时生命值。每个存在的勇士护盾均使“小队”技能的效果提高 400%（以乘算方式堆叠）。诺娃被眩晕，直到护盾被打破或者她不再被“击溃”。每个区域只能触发一次。改变区域会重置此技能，从而可以再次触发，但也会重置伤害加成和解除诺娃的眩晕。 “小队”现在应用于距离 3 格内的所有勇士，但额外的勇士仅以 50% 的有效性计入其总等级。 诺娃专注于扩大她的小队 “小队”的效果提高 100% 诺娃专注于她最亲密的队友 诺娃为阵型中智力点数最高的 位勇士提升 % 伤害。她每收集到一颗怪物心脏，此效果即加强 %（以加算方式堆叠，并以乘算方式生效），她每收集到一个怪物大脑，此效果即加强 %（以乘算方式堆叠，并以乘算方式生效）。^埃罗伊斯的英雄们会自动被发现技能强化，无需接受最高智力点数检定。 诺娃为阵型中智力点数最高的 位勇士提升 % 伤害。她每收集到一颗怪物心脏，此效果即加强 %（以加算方式堆叠，并以乘算方式生效），她每收集到一个怪物大脑，此效果即加强 %（以乘算方式堆叠，并以乘算方式生效）。 很多人的需求，你知道是怎么回事。 我？？我是说......呃......我们可以做到的！耶！我们加油！ 我会重新计算你的概率，但那也只是我。 什么？我妈妈经常叫我多穿衣服！ 就冲着溪石这个名字，我敢肯定我们可以相信他！ 那么我们又到了什么位面？ 我很高兴在这里等着我的理论被证实。 也许我们可以谈谈？不是吗？ 诺娃，你已经做得很差劲了，你绝对做得很差劲。 你见过这么多美丽的世界吗？ 如果我们同心协力，还会有什么问题呢？ 哦，你想让我当首领？好吧......我们走，队员们！ 我随时接受建议…… 既然已经确认了，那就来检验一下我的理论吧。 戴上后整个世界都变了一种色调！你快试试看！ 因为安全就是性感。 眼睛在不受高温的持续轰炸时会提高工作效率。我亲测过。 我在努力仔细查看，但是鹅毛笔总是挡住光线！ 它肯定是控制某个机关的。我们继续寻找吧。 这是我们在轨道堡垒宙斯盾五号上找到的。 要是能够获取它的知识，那我们就能稳压灾星一筹了。 我跟它聊了一会儿。它说得挺有道理的......我。不要！别碰它！ 天呀，这味道实在太难闻了。 这就是拯救我朋友的代价。如果上天再给我一次机会我一定会毫不犹疑地重复这么做！ 啥？你有办法治疗？太好了。拜托你了！ 这是某个羽蛇送我的替代手臂！她真的好美丽。 这是我撰写的关于我家的故事。当然，我指的是我老家。说来话长了。 埃罗伊斯为何如此的特别？难道它就是拯救宇宙的关键？ “关于位面魔法的神奇与危险的简短历史。”这是她自己的作品！ 第24册，关于星界之海中的天体的位置 好吧，或许需要洗一洗了。 暖和我的颈部以助我思考。 这是她采用最优质的绒线编织的，每个颜色各代表着我们的家族。 无论离母亲多遥远，它都能暖和着我保护着我。 它在黑暗中呼唤着我。 是它的光亮指引我来到失事的小艇上发现它的。 我需要找到更多的碎片才能将它拼凑回去。这很重要！ 这仅仅是不朽三体的一部分。我是否会有机会听见他们的声音？ 诺娃·威格对知识有种贪婪的渴望，她想要了解关于任何事情的一切。她的魔力是由名为“天工”的神秘实体赐予。她的梦想是前往星空，找到真正的元素裔家园。 诺娃跳起用天工割裂距离最近的敌人。 诺娃跳起用天工割裂距离最近的敌人。如果攻击将敌人击杀，会掉落一颗怪物心脏。 诺娃与天工一起漂浮，释放三波蓝色能量波，伤害所有敌人。 诺娃漂浮于空中，将天工悬浮于阵型之前，释放三道蓝色能量波对所有敌人造成伤害。此伤害提高 1% 乘以埃罗伊斯协同的堆叠总层数。

Event Buffs/Boons Unlocked: Strongheart is encouraged by a party that actively participates in important gatherings. You have my word that no harm will come to you. With me! Together we can push through! They may have bigger numbers, but we are stronger together! The battle is almost won! Stand together! I hope my years of experience benefit you. Hold! We will give them no ground! Let my words sing through your hearts! To save people - no matter the cost - is what makes someone a hero! Let my steel fly like a falcon! Heart of Gold, lead me true! With valor in heart and Steel in hand, I give my all to protect this world and all things good! Know your enemy's weakness as best you can. A maintained blade is more effective on the battlefield. Steel, strike true! Altogether now! May our blades strike true! It will take far more than that to fell me! There! The enemy attacks from our flank! The creature was so surprised by my attack that it nearly froze in place! My heart now beats with the majesty of a dragon! My courage shall never waver! Change is inevitable -- and I will change with it. We all must start our adventure somewhere. It's not much, but it has saved me on countless occasions. I pledge myself to your service. It is an honor to fight by your side. This once helped a band of brave adventurers escape the Prison of Agony. This was my first cap, and only because it was all they had left. I found myself fond of the wings and kept them as a guard. Gifted to me by a dear friend in lands far from here. I never thought I would soar through clouds -- until I found this. This stopped more blades than it should have been able to. Enchanted by an elven cleric in the forests of Icewind Dale. Armor is only as good as the knight who wears it. A promise was made when this was crafted. I will honor it forever. Armor doesn't clean itself after all. Well, unless you're a wizard I suppose. I stood in line for four hours in the Neverwinter market for this. This was made for me by a bronze dragon. It never runs out! There's no reason one can't look fabulous on the battlefield! Some scoff at always having rope with you. They're fools. This has gotten me out of quite a few binds. The best advice I can give you is to ALWAYS have this in your adventuring pack. No villain can hide with this at my side. A knight's horse should be as clean as they are. My steed likes the extra care, so it's worth the extra coin to me. You should trust your saddle as much as your horse. A trusty steed deserves a set of trusty armor. Strongheart is a fearless seeker of justice, risking his life to ensure that good triumphs over evil. He is thoughtful, kind, and seldom rash, yet never hesitant to punish those who spit in the face of law and order. Strongheart attacks the closest enemy with his sword, Steel, dealing one hit. Strongheart commands the enemy with the most health to Yield. It is stunned and all attacks deal additional BUD damage. Strongheart moves forward and Commands the enemy with the most health to Yield, stunning it for 6 seconds. While it is stunned, all attacks against the enemy deal additional 15 seconds worth of BUD. Strongheart buffs the damage of the Champions adjacent to him. body.zh: 造成暴击的基础概率为 %。 使所有相邻勇士的伤害提高 %。 强心会强化相邻勇士的伤害！ 击杀首领时，强心可以帮助收集最多 枚额外的活动代币。未达上限时，强心有 % 几率在每次首领掉落战利品袋子时收集 枚活动代币。该上限每天增加 。 强心有几率在每个被击败的首领身上发现活动代币，上限随日期提升。 治疗受“正义需要勇士”影响的勇士，每秒回复 生命值。 当 造成暴击时，他会在接下来 20 秒内使 的伤害提高 %， 的治疗量增加 %，并且让自己和受“正义需要勇士”影响的勇士的基本攻击速度冷却缩短 秒。 阵型中每有一位善良勇士， 会使 的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 善良勇士数量： 强心受到阵型中善良勇士的鼓舞。 加入阵型中人数最多的从属组织，并且每有一位该从属组织的勇士， 的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 强心加入阵型中连结紧密的最大队伍。 每有一个当前已解锁的活动增益或恩赐，强心会使“正义需要勇士”的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 已解锁的活动增益/恩赐数量： 强心受到积极参与重要集会的团队鼓舞。 我向你保证，没有人能伤害到你。 跟着我！我们一起排除万难！ 他们人数虽多，但团结使我们更强大！ 战斗差一点就胜利了！我们要站在一起！ 我希望我多年的经验可以帮到你。 坚持住！让他们无路可退！ 让我的话萦绕在你们心头！ 不惜一切代价去拯救他人——这就是英雄！ 我的钢针像隼鹰一样飞舞！ 黄金之心，带我走向真理！ 心有勇气，手有钢刃，我将倾尽全力保护这个世界和一切美好的事物！ 知己知彼，百战不殆。 常言道，磨刀不误砍柴工，这句话同样适用于刀剑。 利刃啊，精准出击！ 大家一起上！ 愿我们的刀刃一击必中！ 这种程度还打不倒我。 小心！敌人在攻击我们的侧翼！ 那只怪物被我的攻击吓了一大跳，差点就僵在原地了！ 我的心脏脉动着龙族的威严！ 我的勇气永远不会动摇！ 改变是不可避免的--而我也会随机应变。 每个人迟早都会开始自己的冒险之旅。 它并不起眼，但却无数次救我于危难之间。 我发誓对你效忠。与你并肩作战是我的无上荣耀。 它曾帮助一伙勇敢的冒险者成功逃离痛苦牢狱。 它曾是我第一顶帽子，只是因为这是他们唯一留下来的。 我发现自己很喜欢这些翅膀，把它们当做我的守护者。 遥远地方的挚友送我的礼物。 我从没想过有朝一日能翱翔在云间--直到我遇见了它。 它实际比看起来更坚固。 被冰风谷森林里的精灵牧师附过魔。 穿在骑士身上的才是好盔甲。 它的诞生伴随着一个坚不可摧的承诺。我会矢志不渝地坚持。 盔甲毕竟不会自己变干净。当然，除非你是法师，那就另当别论。 为了买它，我在无冬市场上排了整整四个小时的队。 这是一头青铜龙专门为我制作的。它永远也用不完！ 谁说战场上不能保持帅气的造型！ 有些人笑你总是带着绳子。他们才是傻瓜呢。 它让我逃脱了好多次被捆绑的命运。 我可以给你的最好建议是，在冒险背包里常备这玩意儿。 有它在手，恶棍无处走。 骑士的马应该和骑士本人一样光鲜亮丽。 我的战马很享受做美容，所以多花钱也值。 你应该像对你的马一样信任你的马鞍。 一匹可靠的战马需要一套配得上它的铠甲。 强心是勇敢无畏的正义追求者，他会冒着生命危险来保证正义总能战胜邪恶。他贴心、善良，而且极少莽撞行事，但会毫不犹豫地惩罚那些藐视法律和秩序的人。 强心用他的剑--钢针攻击距离最近的敌人并命中一次。 强心命令生命值最高的敌人投降。它被眩晕，而且所有攻击都会造成额外的基础杀招伤害。 强心向前移动，并命令生命值最高的敌人投降，使其眩晕 6 秒。当敌人被眩晕时，所有针对它的攻击将造成额外 15 秒基础杀招伤害。 强心对相邻勇士的伤害进行强化。 强心提高完成赛季任务时的奖励进度

Enemies that die while cursed by Warden spawn Accursed Specters, which increase the damage taken by nearby enemies by % The maximum number of Accursed Specters that can be active at once is equal to the number of Evil aligned Champions in the formation. Evil Champions in the formation: Warden works with the evil Champions in the formation to spawn more Accursed Specters at once. The maximum number of Accursed Specters that can be active at once is equal to the number of Champions with a DEX score of 16 or higher in the formation. Champions in Formation Targeted: Warden works with the most agile Champions in the formation to spawn more Accursed Specters at once. The maximum number of Accursed Specters that can be active at once is equal to the number of Champions with Charisma as their highest ability score in the formation. Champions in Formation Targeted: Warden works with the most charismatic Champions in the formation to spawn more Accursed Specters at once. When Warden attacks, all active Accursed Specters rush toward the location of their target prior to them hitting it. Hex can now stack up to 4 times on each enemy. Hex can stack up to 4 times. The more Warden attacks, the more damage enemies take. Whenever a Champion kills an enemy near an Accursed Specter, the Specter reacts violently, applying Hex stack to all enemies in its radius. Warden's attacks also deal area damage in a small radius around them equal to % times the highest number of active Hex stacks that there has been in the current area. This effect does not apply any additional Hex stacks. ^ I am a creature of nightmares, or so I'm told. If you get that close you won't survive it. I am trained in the ways of combat. I am here to observe. If need be, I shall lead you to the void. The whispers echo through my very being. My hex will be carved into your mind. This land is... curious. The minions of the void are waiting for you. How can you stop what you cannot comprehend? The words I utter have existed since time itself. Engulf my enemies. Break them down. One touch of these specters will curse your soul for eternity. These are spirits of time itself. My hex will follow you across the planes. There is no escape from this. Is this form not satisfactory? I persist through many catastrophes. Follow me, or suffer my wrath. Built for one of the first of the Warforged from the Genesis Forge. The metal appears to be... sick? From the void it devours... [Indecipherable Deep Speech] A poem about King Jarot ir'Wynarn adorns the face of this shield. These words are faintly visible: for the Honor of Cyre. The words and icons have been scratched out... Eldritch runes have been carved across the face of this shield. A dark red stone that almost appears to be liquid. This blood red stone pulses like a heartbeat. From Her the first were spawned. Her blood is creation. A black leather bound book with runic writing along the binding. These pages are warm to the touch... Explore the further regions of experience... Knowledge without limits... how enticing. A black stone with a strange lusture. Something moves within this dark pendant. No light reflects from this onyx talisman. There is truth in shadow. A worn, patched cloak Perfect for those who hunt at night. There's something... 'off' about this fabric... May the Soaring City return once more. Forged to be the jailer for a prison filled with eldritch horrors in a faraway land, Warden became corrupted by the monstrosities they sought to keep locked away. Now they journey at the behest of an otherworldly master, seeking souls for the insatiable Dark Hunger to corrupt and feast upon. Warden leaps to a random enemy and attacks them with their armblade. Warden opens a rift to the void, pulling all enemies and specters to one spot on the screen. Warden opens a rift to the void, damaging and momentarily stunning all enemies and pulling them and all active specters to a position slightly in front of the formation. body.zh: 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每个敌人同时可以附带最多 10 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每个敌人同时可以附带最多 6 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每个敌人同时可以附带最多 8 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每个敌人同时可以附带最多 7 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每个敌人同时可以附带最多 4 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每个敌人同时可以附带最多 3 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。每个敌人同时可以附带最多 5 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者在攻击前诅咒自己的目标敌人，对其施加 1 层“巫术”。每层“巫术”堆叠均使受影响敌人受到的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。一开始，每个敌人只能同时附带 1 层“巫术”。^堆叠后“巫术”加成： % 守望者对攻击的所有敌人施加巫术，使其受到额外伤害。 敌人在受到守望者的“诅咒幽灵”诅咒时死亡，将使附近敌人受到的伤害提高 % 同时可激活的“诅咒幽灵”最大数量等同于阵型中邪恶阵营勇士的数量。 阵型中的邪恶勇士： 守望者与阵型中的邪恶勇士合作，同时刷新更多诅咒幽灵。 同时可激活的“诅咒幽灵”最大数量等同于阵型中敏捷属性值大于等于 16 的勇士数量。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 守望者与阵型中最敏捷的勇士合作，同时刷新更多诅咒幽灵。 同时可激活的“诅咒幽灵”最大数量等同于阵型中最高属性值为魅力的勇士数量。 阵型中的目标勇士数量： 守望者与阵型中最具魅力的勇士合作，同时刷新更多诅咒幽灵。 守望者攻击时，所有激活的“诅咒幽灵”都会在击中目标之前冲向目标所在的位置。 每个敌人现在最多可以堆叠 4 层“巫术”。 巫术最多可以叠加 4 次。守望者攻击的次数越多，敌人受到的伤害越大。 每当勇士击杀“诅咒幽灵”附近的敌人时，幽灵就会做出激烈反应，对其范围内的所有敌人施加 层“巫术”。 守望者的攻击还会在其周围造成小范围的范围伤害，数值相当于 % 乘以当前区域内已激活的最高“巫术”堆叠层数。此效果不施加任何额外的巫术层数。 ^ 我是一个梦魇生物，别人是这么跟我说的。 如果你靠得那么近，可能会死。 我接受过各种战斗训练。 我来这里是为了观察。 如果需要，我可以带你前往虚空。 低语在我的内心回响。 我的巫术将刻入你的心灵。 这片土地......很奇怪。 空虚的仆从正等待着你。 你要如何阻挡无法理解的事物？ 我口中的话语与时间同样古老。 吞噬我的敌人。把他们大卸八块。 这些幽灵的轻触将永远诅咒你的灵魂。 这些都是时间本身的幽灵。 我的巫术会穿梭位面追踪你。 这是无法逃避的。 对这个形态不满意吗？ 在诸多灾难当中，我亦屹立不倒。 跟随我，否则你将承受我的怒火。 这是为诞生于起源熔炉的首批机关人所打造的武器。 这金属看起来似乎......生病了？ 来自虚空的它吞噬一切...... [无法分辨的异怪语] 有这么一首诗歌描述的正是加洛特·尔维纳恩国王对此盾牌的喜爱。 依稀刻印着以下一行字：赛尔公国万岁。 上头的文字和字符已经被划掉了...... 恶魔符文遍布着此盾牌的盾面。 这是一颗看起来像液态状的暗红色石头。 这个鲜血色的石头宛如脉动中的心脏。 是她哺育出首批底栖魔鱼。 她的血液就是起源。 这本黑色皮革装订书上密密麻麻的全都是符文字。 这些书页摸上去有些烫手...... 继续深入探索禁忌的知识...... 无边无际的知识......真是让人兴奋。 让人浮想翩翩的奇怪黑石。 这个吊坠里似乎有东西在移动着。 这个玛瑙护符幽暗得没有半点光亮。 阴影中往往潜藏着真相。 多次缝补过的陈旧斗篷。 适合夜间行动的人佩戴。 这布料......让人有种说不出来的感觉...... 愿翱翔之城西弗重新归来。 在遥远之地一个充斥着奥术恐怖的监狱里，守望者被锻造成一名狱卒，最终却被他们试图锁住的怪兽所腐蚀。现在，他们在另一个世界主人的指示下开始旅行，为贪得无厌的黑暗渴望寻找灵魂，使灵魂堕落供黑暗渴望所享用。 守望者跳向一名随机敌人，用臂刃发动攻击。 守望者打开一条虚空裂隙，将所有敌人和幽灵拉至屏幕上的某一点。 守望者打开一条虚空裂隙，对所有敌人造成伤害和短暂眩晕，并将他们和所有激活的幽灵拉扯至阵型稍前方处的一个位置。

Increases damage dealt by by % for each Champion affected, stacking additively Increases the damage of all Champions by % for every Champion death in the formation while Strix is in it, with stacks persisting until you reset Strix increases your party's damage for each ally who has been killed. If an ally within 2 spaces of Strix is about to be killed, Strix instead loses % of her max health and the ally regains % of their max health and is immune to all damage for 10 seconds. This effect can only trigger once every seconds and adds 5 stacks to Haunted. While this ability is on cooldown, Aura of Unclean is increased by 400%. ^ Enemies that approach the party within % of the distance from the formation to where enemies appear take % more damage due to Strix's unique odor Strix causes enemies that approach your party to take additional damage. The radius of Poor Hygiene is increased by % (stacking additively and then applying multiplicatively) and the damage bonus is increased by % (stacking multiplicatively) for each other Acquisitions Incorporated, "C" - Team, or Waffle Crew Champion in the formation. The base damage bonus effect of The Power of Friendship (and Nose Plugs) is increased by %. Strix's best friends don't seem bothered by her unique odor as much as most people are. Buff Aura of Unclean by % for each Tiefling in the formation Strix doesn't spend much time around her own species, but when she does there is a distinctive scent. The effect of Poor Hygiene is increased by %. Strix can't quite remember what it was she ate, but it sure was tasty (and possibly expired). I don't usually burn things I shouldn't. Usually... Of course I know magic! Oops! Sorry about your roof! I don't want anyone to sacrifice themselves! I know I ran, but it was only to get more pies! Oh sure, I *could* shower, but this is better. OOH! A green one! It's not gross, you're gross. Now THIS is how you use an eldritch blast! Oh, you're alive again? That's good. I guess. You want to be my friend? That sounds like a lot of work... You call it trash, I call them components. The smell is actually just the waffles in my pocket. NO, no, no, no, no, NO! No, no, no, nooo! We're friends? Are you moving into my trash pile? Do you smell burning trash? Yeah? Okay, good. It's a *good* mold. I made them just for you. No promises that the flavors are tasty. There's barely anything that will kill you! 'Get a new hat,' they say. No, I like this one! It's comfy! It got caught on a bramble in Barovia. Holey, not holy! Very much not holy. What?! There's all that wasted space! That's not dirt, that's Stinky! I really should patch that up someday. Dang rat's heavier now than he was when he was alive. I miss my old cranium rat. RIP, buddy. Hey, there's some good stuff in there! Garbage? I'll show you garbage! They're irreplacable! I can't believe nobody else wants this stuff! It's priceless! I can't quite make out the runes. They look kinda magic. A solid staff for someone who knows magic. Do you think maybe it knows magic? I know magic! Stinky? I don't smell anything. The hem doesn't drag along the ground. I'd rather it did. Keeps me cozy in cold places. I can hide within its folds if I need to. The sorcerer known as Strix hails from Sigil, the City of Doors at the center of the multiverse. Very little is known of Strix's heritage, even to herself, but it was recently discovered that she was a powerful member of the Skizziks family, who long ago made a pact with Asmodeus, ruler of the Nine Hells, to become Tieflings. Strix is careful, suspicious, and paranoid. She assumes the worst in everyone and is always ready to run away or hide. She lacks basic manners and maintains poor personal hygiene, exemplified by the collection of filthy oddities she hoards within her robes. As a child, Strix witnessed a shadowy creature slaughter her friends at the bakery where she worked, but was spared for unknown reasons. Her survivor's guilt drives her to try and help those in need, no matter the personal cost. Strix throws a fireball at a random enemy, dealing a small amount of area damage. Strix's staff polymorphs into a random object, changing the way she attacks for a brief period. Strix's staff polymorphs into a pie plate, an owlbear plushy, or a flying broom, and changes her base attack for a brief period of time. body.zh: 所有与 不相邻的勇士提升 % 伤害。每有一位勇士被效果影响， 造成的伤害提高 %，以加算方式堆叠 如果斯崔克丝在阵型中时有任何勇士死亡，则提升所有勇士 % 伤害，此效果将持续堆叠，直到你重置冒险 每当一名盟友死亡，斯崔克丝均使队伍的伤害提高。 如果距离斯崔克丝 2 格范围内的队友即将被击杀，斯崔克丝会以损失自身 % 最大生命值为代价，使该队友恢复其最大生命值的 %，并免疫所有伤害 10 秒。此效果在 秒内仅可触发一次，并增加 5 层“鬼影缠身”堆叠。此技能冷却期间，“不洁灵光”效果提高 400%。 ^ 因为斯崔克丝的独特腐臭，靠近队伍的距离达到敌人出现点与阵型间距离 % 以内的敌人额外受到 %的伤害。 斯崔克丝使靠近队伍的敌人受到额外伤害。 阵型中的每位其他艾奎兹玄有限责任公司、“C”小队或华夫饼小队勇士均使“肮脏传染”的范围扩大 %（以加算方式堆叠并以乘算方式生效），并且伤害加成提高 %（以乘算方式堆叠）。 “友谊（和鼻塞）的力量”的基础伤害加成提高 %。 斯崔克丝最好的朋友们似乎并不像大多数人那样被她独特的气味所困扰。 阵型中每有一位提夫林勇士，“不净灵光”效果提高 % 斯崔克丝不会花太多时间和自己的族人待在一起，但当她这样做时，会发出一种独特的气味。 “肮脏传染”的效果提高 % 斯崔克丝不太记得她吃的是什么，但肯定很好吃（可能过期了）。 我通常不会烧那些不该烧的东西，通常...... 我当然会魔法！ 哎呀！抱歉弄破了你的屋顶！ 我不希望任何人牺牲自己！ 我知道我逃跑了，但只有这样才能拿到更多的派！ 当然了，我*可以*洗澡，但这样更好。 噢！这个是绿色的！ 这不恶心，恶心的是你。 这就是你用魔能爆弹的办法吗！ 哦，你又活了？挺好的。应该吧。 你想跟我交朋友？听起来很费功夫...... 你之垃圾，我之材料。 这味道其实只是我口袋里的华夫饼。 不不不，不不不！不不，不！ 我们是朋友？你要搬进我的垃圾堆吗？ 你有闻到垃圾烧焦的味道吗？有？好，太好了。 “霉”好的零食。 特意为你而做的。 不保证味道一定是美味的哦。 世上已经没有任何东西可以伤害到你了！ 人们总是喜新厌旧。我则不同，我就爱这顶舒适的帽子！ 在巴洛维亚时被荆棘划破了。 是孔，不是空！你的脑子才空洞呢。 啥？！不装点零食太浪费空间了！ 那不是脏，是恶臭！ 真的得找个机会修补下它了。 可恶的老鼠，死了比活着时还要沉重。 好怀念我的头骨老鼠。安息吧，小兄弟。 咦，里头似乎有好东西！ 垃圾？我来让你见识下真正的垃圾！ 它们是无可取代的！ 万万没想到竟然没有人懂得欣赏这东西！这可是无价之宝呀！ 我不认识那些符文。感觉应该是有魔法的吧。 适合懂得运用魔法的人使用。 你觉得它究竟有没有魔法？ 我会魔法了！ 有臭味吗？我没闻到呀。 竟然不是拖地的长披肩。真是可惜了。 在天寒地冻的气候下为我保暖。 在必要时它可以把我隐匿起来。 术士斯崔克丝来自位于多元宇宙中心的众门之城印记城。包括斯崔克丝自己在内，没人清楚斯崔克丝的血缘，但最近有人发现她是斯奇克家族的一名强大成员。他们很久以前就与九层地狱的统治者阿斯摩蒂斯签订契约，成为了提夫林。斯崔克丝小心、多疑且偏执，她以最大的恶意去揣测所有人，并随时准备逃跑或藏起来。她缺乏基本的礼仪，个人卫生状况也很糟糕，例如她的长袍里总会囤积着一些肮脏的怪东西。小时候，斯崔克丝在她工作的面包店里目睹了她的朋友被一只暗影生物追杀，但由于不明原因而幸免。她对幸存者的愧疚感，驱使着她努力帮助那些需要帮助的人，而不计较个人的得失。 斯崔克丝向一名随机敌人投掷火球，造成少量范围伤害。 斯崔克丝的手杖变化成一件随机物体，在短时间内改变她的攻击方式。 斯崔克丝的手杖变化成馅饼盘、毛绒枭熊或飞行扫帚，在短时间内改变她的基本攻击方式。

body.en: Tasslehoff is immune to being Stunned. Tasslehoff increases the damage of Champions in the rear-most column by %. Some of Tasslehoff's maps date as far back as before the Cataclysm, an event so powerful it reshaped the lands of Krynn. Tasslehoff increases the damage of Champions in the second to rear-most column by % Tasslehoff's maps that date after the Cataclysm come from a time when the people believed the gods had abandoned Krynn. Tasslehoff increases the damage of Champions in the third to rear-most column by % Tas' newest maps were often inspired by his own travels. Tasslehoff prevents any Champion-sourced non-healing positional formation abilities from targeting his slot or adjacent slots. For each prevented ability per slot, he gains a Diversion stack. Tasslehoff increases the effect of his Map Collector specialization by % for each Diversion stack, stacking multiplicatively. Tasslehoff prevents non-healing positional formation abilities from buffing his slot and adjacent slots, but his buff grows stronger for each instance this occurs. Each time the party completes an area, Tasslehoff somehow comes into possession of some future quest items, setting his Found Item stacks to 7. When Tasslehoff attacks an enemy that can drop quest items, there is a % chance he spends a Found Item stack and adds a quest item to the party's quest progress. In areas requiring quest items, Tasslehoff will sometimes find a quest item when he attacks. Tasslehoff increases the next ultimate's damage by 400% Tasslehoff grows impatient if he remains in the same area for a long time. Tasslehoff increases the effect of his Map Collector specialization by % for every 10 seconds the party is in an area, stacking multiplicatively up to times and resetting when changing areas. Tasslehoff increases the effect of his Map Collector specialization by % for each dwarf or Small Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. (Small Champions are fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold, and plasmoid Champions.) Qualified Champions: Tas considers the dwarf Flint as his best friend, and while it may seem one-sided, Flint cares for him just as deeply. Tasslehoff increases the effect of his Map Collector specialization by % for each Speed Champion and/or Champion with a Dexterity of 16 or higher in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Tas approaches everyone with an open heart and is quick to make new friends. Tasslehoff increases the effect of his Map Collector specialization by % for each Hero of the Lance and Champions that are 38 years and older in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Tas is fiercely loyal to his friends, especially his old adventuring companions. We have to keep trying and hoping. ~Tas We'll take the lead, we mighty warriors. ~Tas Have you got a map of this area, Tas? ~Tanis The Haven Road through Solace Vale is quickest, that's for sure. ~Tas Looks are as deceptive as light-fingered kender. ~Raistlin Keep your hands out of other people's belongings. ~Tanis I'm not going to take it! I just mentioned it, as an item of interest. ~Tas I'm not supposed to be the one that thinks. I just come along for the fun. ~Tas No one would ever suspect a kender traveling alone. ~Tas I am Tasslehoff Burrfoot. My friends call me Tas. Who are you? ~Tas Let's trust these old gods, since it seems we have found them. ~Tas I demand the right to represent my people on the advisory council. ~Tas Where is that kender? I suppose he stole the barmaid. ~Flint We kender cause lots of trouble, I suppose, without meaning to. I grabbed a rock from my pouch, threw it, and hit the wizard right on the head. New roads demand a hoopak. No road is ever old. My goodness, how remarkable! Good enchantment? Or bad? I don't want it back. You can never get rid of the smell, you know. Do I have to fight your battles for you? You know, Laurana, everyone always underestimates us Kender. And Caramon told me it wouldn't be of any use unless I met a vicious rabbit! You rascal! ~Flint Occasionally some of us do happen to acquire certain things which aren't ours. These scum will fight for anyone, Tanis. I think Sturm chopped off my hair! I thought you knew every tree personally around these parts, Tanis. I'm making a map! The perfect map! I'll be famous. Look! I can't help it if something happened to the ocean! What is the matter with you? How did you get us lost? Is this yours? I'm glad I found it. You must have dropped it at the inn. Did I ever tell you about my magic ring? Oh, uh, these? They were just lying on a table! Honest! I have a lot to learn about dragons, apparently. I asked my father once why kenders were little. I really wanted to be big, He said kenders were small because we were meant to do small things. All the big things are really made up of small things all joined together. It's the small things that make the difference. Excitable, friendly, and insatiably curious, Tasslehoff Burrfoot is a kender of no small renown. Tas is the beating heart of the Heroes of the Lance, and his knack for 'borrowing' somehow manages to solve more problems than it causes. While Tas may not see himself as a hero, he is fearless in the face of Krynn's greatest dangers, and he always comes to the aid of his friends. Tasslehoff fires a stone at the closest enemy, dealing one hit. Tasslehoff causes the next ultimate used to deal 400% more damage with that ultimate. Tasslehoff encourages the next Champion to use their ultimate to deal 400% more damage with that ultimate. body.zh: 泰索何夫免疫眩晕。 泰索何夫使身处最后一列中的勇士伤害提高 %。 泰索何夫的一些地图可以追溯到大灾变之前，那是一件影响十分重大的事件，它重塑了克莱恩的土地。 泰索何夫使身处倒数第二列中的勇士伤害提高 % 泰索何夫那些绘制于大灾变之后的地图，出自一个人们相信众神已抛弃克莱恩的时代。 泰索何夫使身处倒数第三列中的勇士伤害提高 % 泰索最新的地图往往是受他自己的游历启发的。 泰索何夫会阻止任何来自勇士的非治疗位置阵型技能以他所在的格子或相邻的格子为目标。每阻止了一项此类技能（每个格子计一次），他获得一层“声东击西”堆叠层数。每有一层“声东击西”堆叠层数，泰索何夫会使他“地图收藏家”专精的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 泰索何夫会阻止非治疗的位置阵型技能对他所在的格子和相邻的格子提供增益，但他每阻止一次增益，他自己的增益效果会变得更强。 每当探险队完成一个区域，泰索何夫会以某种方式获得一些未来的任务物品，并将他的“找到的物品”堆叠层数设为 7。当泰索何夫攻击一名会掉落任务物品的敌人时，有 % 的几率他会消耗一层“找到的物品”堆叠，并添加一件任务物品到探险队的任务进度。 在需要任务物品的区域，泰索何夫进行攻击时有时会找到任务物品。 泰索何夫使下一次杀招的伤害提高 400% 如果泰索何夫在同一个区域待太久，他会变得不耐烦。探险队每在一个区域中停留 10 秒，泰索何夫会使他“地图收藏家”专精的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠，最多堆叠 次，并且在区域切换时重置。 阵型中每有一位矮人或小个子勇士，泰索何夫会使他“地图收藏家”专精的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 （小个子勇士是指仙女、侏儒、地精、半身人、坎德人、狗头人和等离子体勇士。） 满足条件的勇士数量： 泰索认为矮人弗林特是他最好的朋友，虽然似乎只有他单方面这样认为，但弗林特同样很关心他。 阵型中每有一位速度型勇士和/或敏捷大于等于 16 的勇士，泰索何夫会使他“地图收藏家”专精的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足条件的勇士数量： 泰索对谁都敞开心扉，很快就能交到新的朋友。 阵型中每有一位“长枪英雄”或年龄大于等于 38 岁的勇士，泰索何夫会使他“地图收藏家”专精的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足条件的勇士数量： 泰索对朋友极其忠诚，尤其是和他一起冒险的老伙计。 我们必须不断尝试，不能放弃希望。~泰索 我们来打头阵，我们是强大的战士。~泰索 你有这片区域的地图吗，泰索？~塔尼斯 走穿过索拉斯谷的海文路是最快的，那是肯定的。~泰索 长相就跟手脚不干净的坎德人一样，十分具有欺骗性。~雷斯林 不要碰别人的东西。~塔尼斯 我没有要拿走它！我只是提到了它，觉得它很有意思罢了。~泰索 我不应该是动脑思考的那个人。我只是跟着来找乐子的。~泰索 没人会怀疑一个独自旅行的坎德人。~泰索 我是泰索何夫·柏伏特。我的朋友都叫我泰索。你是谁？~泰索 既然我们似乎已经找到这些古老的神了，那我们就信他们吧。~泰索 我要求拥有在顾问委员会中代表我族人的权利。~泰索 那个坎德人去哪儿了？我看他连酒馆女招待都给偷走了。~弗林特 我们坎德人应该无意中引起了很多麻烦。 我从口袋里掏出一块石头，扔了出去，正好打中那个法师的脑袋。 走新的路需要带上弹弓矛。而这世上就没有旧的路。 我的天呐，这也太棒了吧！是好的魔法吗？还是坏的？ 我可不想把它拿回来。那味道怎么也散不去，你懂的。 我非得替你打你自己的仗吗？ 你知道的，劳拉娜，大家总是小看我们坎德人。 卡拉蒙跟我说，除非我遇到一只恶毒兔子，否则它毫无用处！ 你个无赖！~弗林特 我们中的一些人偶尔会碰巧得到一些不属于我们的东西。 这些人渣会为任何人而战，塔尼斯。 斯特姆好像把我的头发削掉了！ 我还以为这一片的每棵树你都熟悉得不得了呢，塔尼斯。 我在制作一幅地图！完美的地图！我会出名的。瞧！ 要是海洋出了什么事，我也没办法！ 你怎么回事？你怎么害我们迷路了？ 这是你的？幸好我找到了它。你肯定是把它落在旅店了。 我有没有跟你讲过我的魔法戒指？ 噢，呃，这副吗？它当时就放在桌子上！真的！ 显然，我对龙的了解还远远不够。 我曾经问过我父亲为什么坎德人身材这么矮小。我真的很想长得高大一点。 他说坎德人之所以身材矮小是因为我们天生是做小事的。 所有大事实际上是由一件件小事组合而成的。 那些小事才是真正重要的。 泰索何夫·柏伏特是一位颇有名气的坎德人，他容易激动，待人友善，而且有着永不满足的好奇心。泰索是“长枪英雄”的灵魂人物，而他那“借用东西”的本事往往能解决比制造出来的还要多的问题。虽然泰索不认为自己是英雄，但他在面对克莱恩最危险的威胁时也毫不畏惧，并且总会向他的朋友伸出援手。 泰索何夫向距离最近的敌人发射一枚石头，造成一次命中。 泰索何夫使下一次使用的杀招造成 400% 的额外伤害。 泰索何夫会鼓励下一个使用杀招的勇士，使该杀招造成 400% 的额外伤害。

body.en: Vlithryn increases the damage of all Champions in the columns in front of her by %. Every second, Vlithryn heals the most damaged Champions for health. This amount is increased by % for each Tanking Champion in the formation. Vlithryn increases the damage of Champions in the columns in front of her and heals the most damaged Champion in the formation every second. Vlithryn raises her Mace in the air, which is struck by lightning from above. Then the enemy with the most remaining Health is zapped by lightning, dealing ultimate damage. For 15 seconds, her mace is charged with lightning. For the duration, she decreases her base attack cooldown by 3 seconds, and her base attacks deal 3 seconds of bud-based damage with each hit. Vlithryn increases the effect of Justice of the Depths by % for each Global Tier Blessing you have unlocked, stacking multiplicatively. Vlithryn's main damage buff is multiplicatively boosted by the number of Global Tier Blessings you have unlocked. Vlithryn increases Justice of the Depths' damage bonus by % for every Champion in the formation with an INT score of 12 or lower, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Life above the waves can seem calm, but it can be just as harsh. Vlithryn increases Justice of the Depths' damage bonus by % for each Champion in the formation with a total ability score of 78 or lower, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Ever since she was a hatchling, Vlithryn has dreamed about coming to the surface to help the unfortunate souls that dwell above. Vlithryn increases Justice of the Depths' damage bonus by % for each unique Species in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Qualified Champions: Vlithryn's faith in Persana is what allows her to make a real impact on the surface. When a Champion is defeated, Vlithryn consumes a Revivify charge and screams in frustration, pushing back all enemies a short distance. She then casts Revivify and heals the defeated Champion, bringing them back to life at full health. Vlithryn's Revivify charges are equal to the number of Awful Ones in the formation and reset upon changing areas. The effect of Justice of the Depths is increased by % for each Revivify charge used in the current area, stacking multiplicatively. When a Champion is defeated, Vlithryn consumes a Revivify charge and screams in frustration, pushing back all enemies a short distance. She then casts Revivify and heals the defeated Champion, bringing them back to life at full health. Vlithryn gains one Dire Straits stack every time she effectively heals a Champion with Cleric Clinic. When she reaches stacks, Persana appears and blesses her with the following: - Revivify immediately gains an additional charge^- Justice of the Depths is increased by % for each Dire Straits stack, stacking multiplicatively^- The healing amount of Cleric Clinic is increased by % for each Dire Straits stack, stacking additively. Dire Straits stacks continue to increase after Persana appears, up to a maximum of . Upon changing areas, Vlithryn loses up to Dire Straits stacks, and if her stacks drop below , Persana disappears, taking his blessings with him. Vlithryn calls for her deity Persana in areas where she effectively heals 30 times, letting her Revivify an additional time, and increase the potency of her main support bonus and healing amount. You're literally dying! Of course I can spare the spell slot. How can I help? Did you really think I'd abandon someone in need? You're lucky I'm here to do your job for you. Shall I call down lightning to fry them to a crisp? It's okay. I'll take care of you. You can repay me by getting back in the fight. This will only take a moment. A tidal wave? It's a bit much. This is the fourth time today this has happened. I was calling to my god and he answered my prayer! Thanks for having me. I'm really happy to be here. They get in these situations with or without me. I'm not just sitting around. I'm helping. I'm killing people! Please grant me the strength to defeat my enemies. I summoned it! It's under my control. My faith in Persana allows me to make a real impact on the surface. That is absolutely not going on my head. Ew. I am a priestess of Persana, not some common servant. It's because of Persana that I can save them from drowning. May Persana's current guide me through the storm. Ahem. You owe me money. We appreciate your patronage! It's hard work being a cleric, but it can be rewarding. Turns out that giant had a pretty big stash of gold. You shouldn't drink that. Don't say I didn't warn you. In the name of Persana, Justice of the Depths, I bless this vial. Persana, if this is the right path for me, send me a sign. Resurrection spells require a lot of expensive material components. Persana, please grant me the strength to make it through another day. There we are. All patched up. To help me survive friendly fire, misadventure, and downright stupidity. I have an unbreakable connection with my god. Since I was a hatchling, I dreamed of leaving the sea to help the unfortunate. I underestimated just how much help the unfortunate need. Shh! Spoilers. You want to see true suffering? How about I cast Inflict Wounds instead? Ever since she was a hatchling in her kingdom under the sea, Vlithryn has dreamt of helping the less fortunate land dwellers and spreading the good word of her God, Persana. She’s always willing to lend a helping hand, or a healing word, to those who need it - for the right price of course. She is usually cool, calm, and collected, but don’t get on her bad side, or her banshee scream and lighting attacks will leave you begging for a revivify that you can’t afford. Vlithryn attacks a random enemy, dealing 1 hit and knocking them back a short distance. Vlithryn zaps the enemy with the most Health, empowering her attacks for 15 seconds. Vlithryn zaps the enemy with the most remaining Health, and then empowers her attack with lightning for 15 seconds, increasing her attack speed and adding BUD-based damage. body.zh: 维列瑟琳会使她前列所有勇士的伤害提高 %。 维列瑟琳每秒为受伤最严重的 名勇士恢复 点生命值。阵型中每有一位坦克勇士，此数值提高 %。 维列瑟琳会提高她前列勇士的伤害，并每秒治疗阵型中生命值最低的勇士。 维列瑟琳将钉头锤举向空中，降下闪电劈向钉头锤。然后剩余生命值最多的敌人会被闪电击中，受到杀招伤害。钉头锤会充满闪电能量 15 秒。在此期间，她的基本攻击冷却时间减少 3 秒，且每次基础攻击命中都会造成持续 3 秒的基于基础杀招伤害的伤害。 每解锁一个全局层级祝福，维列瑟琳就会使“深渊正义”的效果提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 维列瑟琳琳的主要伤害增益会根据你已解锁的全局层级祝福数量以乘算方式提升。 阵型中每有一位智力低于等于 12 的勇士，维列瑟琳均使深渊正义的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 海浪之上的生活看似平静，但也可能同样严酷。 阵型中每有一位总技能评分低于等于 78 的勇士，维列瑟琳均使深渊正义的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 自维列瑟琳还是一只幼崽时起，她就一直梦想着来到海面之上，去帮助那些生活在海面之上的不幸之人。 阵型中每有一位每个独特种族的勇士，维列瑟琳均使深渊正义的伤害加成提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 满足资格勇士： 维列瑟琳对佩塞纳的信仰，正是让她能够在地表传播他的福音的原因。 当一名勇士被击败时，维列瑟琳会消耗一个“复活术”充能，并懊恼地尖叫，将所有敌人击退一小段距离。然后她会施展“复活术”，治疗被击败的勇士，使其满血复活。维列瑟琳的“复活术”使用次数等同于阵型中“恶人”的数量，并且在更换区域时重置。在当前区域内，每使用一次“复活术”，“深渊正义”的效果就会提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 当一名勇士被击败时，维列瑟琳会消耗一个“复活术”充能，并懊恼地尖叫，将所有敌人击退一小段距离。然后她会施展“复活术”，治疗被击败的勇士，使其满血复活。 每当维列瑟琳用“牧师诊所”有效地治疗一名勇士时，她就会获得一层“绝境”。当她的层数达到 时，佩塞纳会出现并赐予她以下祝福： - “复活术”立即额外获得一次充能。^- 每有一层“绝境”，“深渊正义”的效果增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。^- 每有一层“绝境”，“牧师诊所”的治疗量增加 %，以加算方式堆叠。 佩塞纳出现后，“绝境”的层数继续增加，上限为 。更换区域后，维列瑟琳会失去最多 层“绝境”层数，如果她的层数少于 ，佩塞纳会消失，并带走他的祝福。 在特定区域内，维利斯林会呼唤她的神明佩尔萨娜，使其实际治疗效果提升30倍，从而让她额外使用一次“复活术”，并增强其主要支援加成和治疗量。 你都快死了！我当然能腾出这个法术栏位来救你。 我能帮上什么忙？ 你真以为我会抛弃需要帮助的人吗？ 算你走运，我来这儿帮你完成你的工作。 要我召唤闪电把他们烤得外焦里嫩吗？ 没事的。我会照顾好你的。 你重回战斗就是对我的报答。 一会儿就好。 海啸？有点太过分了吧。 这已经是今天第四次发生这种事了。 我向我的神明祈祷，而他回应了我的祈求！ 感谢你们接纳我。我真的很高兴能加入这里。 不管有没有我，他们都会陷入这种境地。 我可不是在闲坐着。我在帮忙呢。我在杀人！ 请赐予我击败敌人的力量。 我召唤出它了！我可以控制它了。 我对佩塞纳的信仰让我能在地表传播他的福音。 那绝对不能戴在我头上。 恶心。我可是佩塞纳的女祭司，可不是什么普通的仆人。 多亏了佩塞纳，我才能把他们从水中救出来。 愿佩塞纳的力量引领我穿越风暴。 咳咳。你还欠我钱呢。 感谢您的惠顾！ 当牧师很辛苦，但也可能会有回报的。 原来那个巨人藏有这么多金子。 你不应该喝那个。别说我没警告过你。 以深渊正义佩塞纳之名，我祝福这个药瓶。 佩塞纳，如果这是适合我的道路，请给我降下一个神迹。 复生术需要很多昂贵的材料。 佩塞纳，请赐予我力量撑过新的一天。 好了，都修补好了。 助我在友军误伤、意外灾祸以及彻头彻尾的愚蠢行为中活下来。 我与我的神明有着牢不可破的链接。 从我还是一只幼崽起，我就梦想着离开大海去帮助那些不幸的人。 我低估了那些不幸的人到底有多需要帮助。 嘘！别剧透。 你想见识真正的痛苦吗？不如我改成“施加伤口”法术如何？ 自维列瑟琳还是海底王国里的一只幼崽时起，就梦想着帮助那些较为不幸的陆地居民，并传播她的神明佩塞纳的福音。她总是乐于向那些身处困境的人伸出援手，或是给予治愈的话语——当然，对方需要付出与之相称的报酬。她处变不惊、泰然自若，但千万别惹她生气，否则她的女妖尖叫和闪电攻击会让你祈求高不可攀的复活机会。 维列瑟琳随机攻击一名敌人，造成 1 次伤害并将其击退一小段距离。 维列瑟琳电击生命值最高的敌人，使她的攻击获得 15 秒的强化。 维列瑟琳电击剩余生命值最高的敌人，然后用闪电强化她的攻击 15 秒，提高攻击速度并附加基于基础杀招伤害的伤害。

title.en: The Dark Urge The Dark Urge

body.en: The Dark Urge is eligible to start in all adventures, even if the Patron, Variant, or other restrictions would say otherwise. He also does not interact with any Champion abilities or variant effects that are based on age. Each time the Dark Urge defeats an enemy, he gains a Murder stack. The Dark Urge increases his damage by % for each Murder stack he has. Stacks persist between adventures. The Dark Urge increases his damage each time he defeats an enemy, with a count that persists between adventures. Your formation gains one Ceremorphosis stack due to the mind flayer tadpole in the Dark Urge's brain. The Dark Urge increases his damage by % for each Ceremorphosis stack, stacking multiplicatively. The Dark Urge has Outcast stacks, minus stack for each adjacent Champion that does not have the DPS role. The Dark Urge increases his damage by % for each Outcast stack, stacking multiplicatively. The Dark Urge deals more damage when on the formation's edge or when next to Champions with the DPS role. The Dark Urge's Murderous Slash attack is empowered by lightning. This increases the range by % and deals up to % more damage to enemies based on how close they are to him. The Dark Urge's Storm Sorcery origin causes his normal attacks to deal more damage with a larger area of effect. The Dark Urge's damage is increased by % for each Dragonborn Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Dragonborn Champions: The Dark Urge embraces his draconic heritage and deals more damage when other Dragonborn are in the formation. The Dark Urge increases the number of The Urge's Murder stacks he gains each time he defeats an enemy by %. The Dark Urge's path of destruction draws the attention of divine powers invested in his murderous ways. The Dark Urge unlocks the Form of the Slayer ultimate, and deals % more damage for each Evil Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Evil Champions: The Dark Urge succumbs to his murderous impulses, delighting evil Champions and unlocking an ultimate transformation. The Dark Urge's alignment becomes Lawful Good, he gains the Control role and he unlocks the Withers' Resurrection ultimate, and deals % more damage for each Good Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Good Champions: The Dark Urge suppresses his violent instincts, winning the approval of good Champions and gaining assistance from an unusual ally. Go ahead, my sanguineous master - use your claws! Now that they're unconscious, take off their head! You are an exquisite artist with a blade, sire. You gave coins to a beggar once. Gave me nightmares for weeks! It is an honor to follow your trail of gore, milord. Such a unique way of introducing yourself. We have some free time if you want to get your hands dirty, master. These tadpoles are deliciously vicious. Making more True Souls for your own purposes, eh, milord? I like the company you keep, sire. Always soaked in blood. They'll never delight in gore as much as you do. Your followers crave the sight of your sanguine deeds, milord! You have a purpose, sire. Don't turn away from it! Your restraint is curious, but I am sure you know what you're doing, sire. The hells themselves will quake at your passing, milord! Time for the final act. Ooh, that's sure to leave a nasty scar, milord. Bravo! In another world - another life - would my destiny be any different? There are only a few knife holes in these. These are very... plain, milord... Very stylish, milord. Could use some gore. These really hold onto the blood, milord. You were always skilled at avoiding the internals you liked playing with. Oh, if this metal could talk. The horrors it could tell! After you make them still - then the fun can really begin. This belongs in your sanguine hands! Curious creatures these are... Use their power, sire. They can't possibly control you. Every artist needs their brushes, eh, milord? What do you have planned for this, my demiurge? Please, sire, do not lower yourself to my pathetic level. It is unworthy of you to be wearing the raiment of a mere Butler! Take great care of this wicked artifact. It will please the one it belongs to... A gift for murderous escapades! The bard broke those strings as your knife sliced his throat. A fond reminder of bloodshed and gore. Very funny, milord. Your depravity brings such jocularity. One down, Master. Two to go... I was not allowed to read what you had written here, milord. I don't know what you see in that Enver Gortash, Milord. Oh, such fond, twisted memories of our dissection days. Very wise, milord - now you can heal them and hurt them again! The Dark Urge remembers nothing but a path paved with blood. Unimaginable cruelty whispers from within. Can he escape it? Would he even want to? The Dark Urge strikes nearby enemies with a slash of his dagger. The Dark Urge transforms into the Slayer form for 15 seconds, dealing massive damage for the duration. The Dark Urge transforms into the Slayer form for 15 seconds, dealing massive damage for the duration. Sceleritas Fel, immune to damage, takes his place in the formation for the duration. The Dark Urge increases his damage each time he defeats an enemy, count persists between adventures. The Dark Urge deals more damage when on the formation's edge or next to other DPS Champions. body.zh: 即使不满足赞助者、支线任务或其他限制的要求，邪念仍有资格开始所有探险。他不适用任何基于年龄的勇士能力或支线任务效果。 每次邪念击败敌人时，他获得一层杀戮堆叠。每从持有一层杀戮堆叠，邪念提升伤害 %。堆叠跨冒险保留。 邪念每次击败敌人都会提升自身伤害，计数在各冒险之间保留。 邪念大脑中的夺心魔蝌蚪使你的阵型获得一层蜕变堆叠。每层蜕变使邪念的伤害提升 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 邪念有 层放逐层数，相邻每名没有伤害输出角色的勇士扣除 层。每有一层放逐层数，邪念提升 % 伤害，以乘算方式堆叠。 位于阵型边缘或与伤害输出勇士相邻时，邪念可造成更多伤害。 邪念的“杀戮斩击”攻击获得闪电强化，提升射程 % 并根据与敌人的距离，对敌人造成最多 % 额外伤害。 邪念的“风暴术士”起源导致他的普通攻击可造成更广更大的伤害。 阵型中的每位龙裔勇士均使邪念的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 龙裔勇士： 邪念接受自己的龙裔遗产，在阵型中存在其他龙裔时造成更多伤害。 邪念提升渴求每次击败敌人获得的杀戮堆叠层数 %。 邪念的破坏之路引起了投入到他杀戮手段的神圣力量的注意。 邪念解锁“屠杀者形态”杀招，阵型中的每位邪恶阵营勇士均使伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 邪恶勇士： 邪念屈服于自己的杀戮冲动，令邪恶阵营的勇士感到快乐，解锁杀招变形。 邪念的阵营变为守序善良，他获得控制者角色，并解锁“威瑟斯的复活”杀招，阵型中的每位善良阵营勇士均使伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 善良勇士： 邪念克制自己的暴力本能，赢得善良阵营勇士的认可，获得一名非凡盟友的协助。 去吧，我的血腥大师 - 用上您的爪子吧！ 既然对方已经昏迷了，那就把他的头给拧下来！ 大人啊，您真是用刃器的绝妙艺术家。 您给乞丐施舍了一次金币，却让我做了几星期的噩梦！ 跟随您的血肉之径是我的无上荣耀，大人。 真是独特的自我介绍方式。 大人，如果想要弄脏双手，我们还有点空闲时间。 这些蝌蚪真是恶毒得美妙。 大人，呃，为了您自己的目的，多制造一些真实灵魂吧？ 大人，我喜欢您选的同伴 - 总是满身鲜血的，真好。 他们可不会像您这样对血肉如此欣喜。 大人，追随者们渴望看到您的欢愉之举！ 大人，您是有自己目的的。不要偏离方向！ 您的克制很奇怪，但我肯定够您知道自己是在做些什么，大人。 你光是路过地狱都要抖三抖啊，大人！ 是时候上演最后一幕了。 噢，那肯定会留下难看的疤痕的，老爷。好极了！ 在另一个世界——另一段人生——我的命运会有所不同吗？ 只有几个刀捅的孔洞。 大人……这些非常地……朴素…… 大人，这袍子很帅气。多来点血就更好了。 这甲上血气十足啊，大人。 您总是擅长避开自己喜欢玩耍的内脏。 啊，要是这东西能够说话，那它就能讲述无上恐怖！ 静滞之后 - 快乐才真正开始。 这个属于您沾满鲜血的双手！ 真是些奇妙的生物…… 运用它们的力量吧，大人。它们没可能控制您的。 每位艺术家都需要自己的画笔，对吧，大人？ 我的造物主啊，您对这个有何计划？ 拜托，大人，不要屈尊到我这个可怜的水准。 不值得让您穿上区区管家的衣服啊！ 好好保管这件邪恶圣器。它会令归属的一方感到欢喜…… 杀人越轨的馈赠！ 你的刀刃划过吟游诗人的咽喉，这些琴弦应声而断。 令人想起流血与血腥。 真有意思呢，大人。您的堕落带来如此的滑稽。 搞定一个，大人。还剩两个…… 我不被准许阅读您在这里写下的东西，大人。 大人，我不知道您在那个恩弗·戈塔什那里看到了什么。 噢，真是绝妙，我们剥离的日子的扭曲记忆。 此举非常明智，大人 - 这样您就可以治疗对方，然后再施以伤害了！ 邪念只记得用鲜血铺就的道路。难以想象的残酷之声由心而发。他能否逃离？甚至是否想逃离？ 邪念会用自己的匕首斩击附近的敌人。 邪念转为杀手形态，持续 15 秒，在此期间造成大量伤害。 邪念转为杀手形态，持续 15 秒，在此期间造成大量伤害。在此期间，免疫伤害的斯克莱里塔斯·费尔会在阵型中代替他。 邪念每次击败敌人都会提升自身伤害，计数在各冒险之间保留。 位于阵型边缘或与伤害输出勇士相邻时，邪念可造成更多伤害。

body.en: increases the damage of adjacent Champions by %. Imoen buffs the champions adjacent to her. Beast enemies become Imoen's Favored Foe. Her Short Bow attacks against Beast enemies deal an additional BUD-based damage with each hit. Imoen favors slaying beasts, increasing her damage against them. Dragon enemies become Imoen's Favored Foe. Her Short Bow attacks against Dragon enemies deal an additional BUD-based damage with each hit. Imoen favors slaying dragons, increasing her damage against them. Monstrosity enemies become Imoen's Favored Foe. Her Short Bow attacks against Monstrosity enemies deal an additional BUD-based damage with each hit. Imoen favors slaying monstrosities, increasing her damage against them. Aberration enemies become Imoen's Favored Foe. Her Short Bow attacks against Aberration enemies deal an additional BUD-based damage with each hit. Imoen favors slaying aberrations, increasing her damage against them. Any time any Champion's Favored Foe appears or is defeated, increases the effect of by %, stacking multiplicatively and then applying multiplicatively. Stacks up to times. Stacks are reset each time the Champions change areas. Imoen increases her buff any time a Favored Foe appears or is defeated. Before every eighth attack, or upon entering a new area, casts Stoneskin on all Champions in the front-most column of the formation, granting them temporary hit points. The amount is increased by 5% (additively) for each Favored Foe that is alive. Total Temporary Hit Points: Before every third attack, polymorphs a random non-boss non-static enemy into a monster with the same type as her Favored Foe, but only 10% of its original health. She can not polymorph enemies that are already polymorphed by this ability a second time. I'll sneak in first. I don't know why you're following me, but if we're doing this, let's go! Have you heard the one about the giant space hamster? Did I ever tell you about the time I climbed up Candlekeep's tower? I'm me. Imoen. And I'd like to stay that way. I just pick myself up and carry on. I'll give you a little boost! Those arrows won't stop coming, so let's make it harder for them. What do you mean, I'm stronger than I look? I look plenty strong! It could be worse! Well this is curious AND terrifying... I'll never give up the fight! Ah, fond memories. I grew up among the monks of Candlekeep, but that doesn't mean I didn't train. Sometimes the best defense is a sword you're ready to use. Everything's better with some magic added in! I used to practice by aiming at empty inkpots! I won't say I was a prodigy, but I was no slouch with the bow. Let's start with an arrow before we move on to magic missiles. I don't know of a shortbow more powerful than this one. If you aim just right, you can get it to stick on a monk's forehead! They don't let kids in Candlekeep have sharp weapons. Always keep it full, in case you don't want to waste a spell. I have one for beasts, one for dragons, one for aberrations, one for monstrosities... The first time I found one of these, I thought maybe there was a funny story in it. There's something about magic that calls to me. The cocoons are cheap, but seasonal. The diamond dust is year-round but PRICY. I've so many good spells in here. When you don't give a child lockpicks, they start experimenting. You can pick a lock with a sewing needle if you're patient. And the lock's not great. I've got everything I need here. There's not a lock made I can't crack with these. This old thing? I probably stole it. Some memories are private. I'll tell you later. I have a cowl and I'm a wizard, but I'm not a Cowled Wizard. Got it? I'm ready for anything. Which is good when you're with Minsc. Imoen is a surprisingly cheerful young woman considering she eventually discovered that she was the child of a deadly murder god. As an orphan, she moved to Candlekeep at the age of 10 with her adoptive father and innkeeper, Winthrop. She eventually traveled to Baldur's Gate with a childhood friend, where she joined forces with powerful Champions like Minsc and Jaheira. Imoen shoots a random enemy with her bow. Imoen attacks five enemies, hitting each 5 times. She prioritizes hits-based enemies. Imoen leaps out into the fray, attacking five enemies in sequence with her short sword in one hand and her lockpicks in the other. She prioritizes enemies with hits-based health and deals 5 hits per attack; if no hits-based enemies are available she deals normal ultimate damage to enemies she attacks. Imoen increases her support buffs when Favored Foes appear or are defeated Before every third attack, Imoen polymorphs a non-boss enemy into her Favored Foe. body.zh: 使相邻勇士的伤害提高 %。 伊梦为与她相邻的勇士们提供增益。 兽类敌人成为伊梦的偏好对手。她的“短弓”攻击每次命中均对兽类敌人造成额外的基础杀招伤害。 伊梦喜欢屠杀兽类，她对兽类的伤害提高。 龙族敌人成为伊梦的偏好对手。她的“短弓”攻击每次命中均对龙族敌人造成额外的基础杀招伤害。 伊梦喜欢屠杀龙族，她对龙族的伤害提高。 怪兽敌人成为伊梦的偏好对手。她的“短弓”攻击每次命中均对怪兽敌人造成额外的基础杀招伤害。 伊梦喜欢屠杀怪兽，她对怪兽的伤害提高。 异怪敌人成为伊梦的偏好对手。她的“短弓”攻击每次命中均对异怪敌人造成额外的基础杀招伤害。 伊梦喜欢屠杀异怪，她对异怪的伤害提高。 每当任意勇士的偏好对手出现或被击败时， 均使 的效果提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠，并以乘算方式生效。最多可堆叠 层。每次勇士变更区域时，堆叠都会重置。 每当偏好对手出现或被击败时，伊梦的增益效果提高。 每发动八次攻击之前，或进入新区域时， 对阵型最前列的所有勇士施放石肤术，使其获得 点临时生命值。每个存活的偏好对手均使此数值提高 5%（以加算方式堆叠）。 总临时生命值： 每发动三次攻击之前， 将一名随机非首领非静态敌人变形为一只怪物，并与她的偏好对手类型相同，但只有其原始生命值的 10%。她不能将已被此技能变形的敌人二次变形。 我先溜进去。 我不知道你们为什么追随我，但如果势在必行，那就开干吧！ 你听说过巨型太空仓鼠的故事吗？ 我有说过我爬上烛堡高塔的故事吗？ 我就是我。伊梦。我很乐意保持下去。 我会振作精神，继续前进。 我来给你加把劲。 那些箭不会自动停止，那就给它们设置障碍吧。 什么叫我比看起来更强壮？我看起来就很强壮！ 这不是最糟的！ 嗯，这还真是既有意思又可怕…… 我永远不会放弃战斗！ 啊，多么美好的回忆。 我在烛堡的武僧中长大，但这并不意味着我没有受过训练。 有时候最好的防御是你随时准备使用的剑。 加点魔法，一切都会更好！ 我以前常常瞄准空墨水瓶练习射击！ 我不准备自称神童，但我对弓箭并不陌生。 先从射箭开始，以后再讨论魔法飞弹。 我没见过比它更厉害的短弓。 如果你瞄得够准，就能把它贴在武僧的额头上！ 他们不允许烛堡的孩子拥有锋利的武器。 如果不想浪费法术，那就记得把它装满。 一支给兽类，一支给龙族，一支给异怪，一支给怪兽...... 第一次找到这种卷轴时，我以为里面写着有趣的故事。 我对魔法有一种感应。 茧很便宜，但有季节性。钻石尘虽然全年有货，但价格昂贵。 这里记着很多好用的法术。 如果不给孩子开锁器，他们就会自己实验。 你可以用缝纫针撬开一把锁，只要有耐心。并且锁不复杂。 我需要的一切都在身上。 借助这些工具，世上没有我打不开的锁。 这件旧东西？可能是我偷的。 有些回忆非常私密。我以后再告诉你。 我有一件斗篷，并且我是一名法师，但我不是那个斗篷法师。明白吗？ 我时刻准备面对一切。当你和明斯克在一起时，这是必须的。 尽管最终发现自己是某个致命杀神的孩子，但伊梦依然是个极其活泼的年轻女子。作为一名孤儿，她在 10 岁时和养父兼旅店老板温斯洛普一起搬到了烛堡。后来，她与一位儿时好友一起来到博德之门，并在那里与明斯克和贾希拉等强大的勇士队成为盟友。 伊梦使用弓箭射击一名随机敌人。 伊梦攻击五名敌人，每名攻击 5 次。她优先瞄准命中次数型敌人。 伊梦跃入鏖战中心，一手持短剑，一手握开锁器，依次攻击五名敌人。她优先瞄准命中型生命值的敌人，每次攻击造成 5 次命中；如果没有命中型敌人，则对所攻击的敌人造成普通的杀招伤害。 当偏好对手出现或被击败时，伊梦的支援增益效果提高 每发动三次攻击之前，伊梦将一个非首领的敌人变形为她的偏好对手。

body.en: When 6+ Enemies are attacking , his base attack gains a small cleave and does 5x damage. When 16+ Enemies are attacking, his base attack is a massive flame breath attack that does 25x damage. Counts each enemy enrage stack as an additional attacker. (Current Attackers: ) Arkhan attacks more ferociously when there are more enemies attacking him. Place him in your front line! Increases the Health of all other Champions by % of 's Max Health All positional Formation Abilities receives are buffed by % if is in the front column of the formation (base 50%) Arkhan increases the effect of formation abilities affecting him through sheer force of will. Arkhan increases the affect of formation abilities targeting him. Buff him up to take advantage of this effect! receives (at % rate) all positional Formation Abilities received by adjacent Champions that don't already target (base 50%) Arkhan taps into the power of Tiamat to "borrow" formation abilities affecting other Champions adjacent to him. Arkhan is also affected by some formation abilities affecting champions adjacent to him. Build your formation accordingly. Increases the damage of evil champions by % for each enemy attacking and/or each enemy enrage stack. attacks seconds sooner for each other Dark Order member in the formation Only four to deal with? I only work in fives. Chango, hold them down so I can chop off their arm! Nobody scratches Arkhan the Cruel! With this hand, I shall rule Avernus with my queen at my side! I may have broken my oath, but I'm stronger for it! Quicker than you expected, huh? I'm not scared of anything. Yes, line up to fight me! I'll take you all! I alone can save Tiamat! Being Tiamat's Chosen brings its own rewards. Give me a blade. Even a blunt blade can bash in a skull. Ah, a freshly sharpened axe. What more does a guy need? The craftsmanship is exquisite. A magical axe of extreme power. My enemies flee in fear when they see it. A crude symbol, but any reverence to Tiamat is a good thing. A well crafted symbol, though it lacks a certain finesse. Forged in the dragonflame for only the most devout followers. I've foresworn my paladin oaths and dedicated my life to serving Tiamat. Should probably get this tightened up. The noise is very distracting. Good for bashing down doors and breaking through walls. I'll impale the heads of my enemies on these spikes! Hah hah hah! Forged from obsidian and granted to me by the Dragon Queen herself. It may be flimsy, but you still wouldn't want to get bashed by it. Don't let appearances deceive you. This is a sturdy, well-crafted shield. Blessed by the Cult of the Dragon and carried into battle against their enemies. Crafted from the scales of Tiamat's enemies and worn by her unholy Paladin followers. Whatever is in it won't be in it for long! A sturdy vial containing a murky, greyish liquid. A crystal vial with a finely crafted silver stopper. Filled to the brim with unholy power. Reserved for only the most bad-ass warriors. Mere child's play. Bring me a real choker. A golden wreath of thorns worn about ones neck. Grants me control over a beast of my choosing. I chose Chango. Arkhan the Cruel is a dragonborn oathbreaker paladin in the service of the five-headed dragon goddess Tiamat. Due to 'The Wreath of the Prism' that he wears around his neck, he has gained control of the vicious manticore Chango. Arkhan attacks the closest enemy with the fury of Tiamat. Arkhan breaths deadly dragon fire on a cone of enemies. Arkhan rushes forward to the nearest enemy and breaths dragon fire on them and all enemies in a large cone. body.zh: 当 6 名以上敌人正在攻击 时，他的基本攻击获得小顺势斩效果，并造成 5 倍伤害。如果有 16 名以上敌人向他攻击，则他的基本攻击化为强烈的烈焰呼吸，造成 25 倍伤害。每名敌人造成的怒气堆叠都被视为额外的攻击者。 （当前攻击者人数： ） 更多阿克汉的敌人越多，他的攻击就越凶残。将他放置在你的前线！ 提高所有其他勇士的生命值，数值相当于 最大生命值的 %。 如果 处于阵型前列，则所有作用于 的阵型技能强化 %（基础值为 50%） 阿克汉通过纯粹的意志力来强化影响他的阵型技能效果。 阿克汉会强化以他为目标的阵型技能效果。充分利用这个效果为他施加增益！ 有 % 几率获得相邻勇士所获得的未以 为目标的阵型技能效果（基础值为 50%） 阿克汉利用提亚马特的力量“借用”影响其身边其他勇士的阵型技能。 某些影响阿克汉身边勇士的阵型技能也会影响到他，请据此构建你的阵型。 每有一名攻击 或使其堆叠怒气的敌人，即提升邪恶阵营勇士 % 伤害 阵型中每有一位黑暗教团其他成员， 攻击加速 秒 只有四个人？至少五个人才够我打。 昌戈，按住他们，我来砍断他们的胳膊！ 没人能伤残暴者阿克汉一根汗毛！ 有了这只手，我将和我的皇后共同统治阿弗纳斯！ 我也许违背了自己的誓言，但我也因此而更加强大！ 比你预料的更快，对吧？ 我什么都不怕。 对，排好队来和我打！我要打你们所有人！ 只有我才能拯救提亚马特！ 成为提亚马特选中的人自有其回报。 给我一把剑。 哪怕是钝刀刃也是可以砸破头骨的。 啊，崭新的锋利战斧。得斧如此，夫复何求？ 这做工真是超凡入圣。 这是一把蕴含着惊人力量的魔法斧头。敌人见到它时都会鸡飞狗走。 很简陋的圣徽，但任何向提亚马特的供奉都是好事。 做工精细的圣徽，但还是缺乏了些技艺。 这是用龙焰铸造而成的，只有最虔诚的信徒才配拥有它。 我决心放弃圣武士的誓言，将我的一生奉献给提亚马特。 得想办法把它绑紧。这噪音实在是太烦人了。 适合用来撞门或破墙而入。 可以将敌人的头颅穿在尖刺上！哈哈哈哈！ 这是采用黑曜石铸造而成，并由龙女王亲自赠送给我的礼物。 虽然很薄弱，但是被它盾击还是很要命的。 别让它的外表所迷惑。这是个牢固的精良护盾。 这是受过龙巫教赐福的护盾，它对抗过无数龙巫教的敌人。 这是采用提亚马特的阵亡敌人的鳞片打造而成的护盾，由女神的邪恶圣武士信徒所使用。 无论里头装的是什么，很快就会流失一空！ 这个坚固的瓶子中盛着污浊的灰色液体。 这个水晶瓶子附带着一个精美的银质瓶塞。 里头蕴含着满满的邪恶力量。 只有最狠的战士才有资格佩戴它。 小儿科。给我来个真正有能耐的贴颈项链。 佩戴在脖子上的黄金带刺花圈。 可以让我使唤一头猛兽。我选择了昌戈。 残暴者阿克汉是一位龙裔破誓者圣武士，为五头龙女神提亚马特效忠。由于脖子上戴着的“棱镜花环”，他获得了对邪恶蝎尾狮昌戈的控制。 阿克汉使用提亚马特之怒攻击距离最近的敌人。 阿克汉对锥形范围的敌人喷吐致命龙息。 阿克汉快速冲向距离最近的敌人，并向其身后锥形大范围内所有敌人喷吐龙息。

body.en: Azaka is a weretiger. After attacks in human form, she changes into a weretiger for seconds, increasing her damage by % Azaka transforms into a weretiger after several hits. Her damage increases while she's a weretiger. Increases all Gold found by %. This ability is reduced by 50% while Azaka is in weretiger form Azaka increases your gold found; this bonus is reduced when she's in weretiger form. Increases the damage of all Champions by % if they are in an exterior location While in weretiger form, Azaka does an additional % more damage per attack (stacking multiplicatively). Resets when she changes back to human form. Reduces the amount of time Azaka spends in weretiger form by % Azaka resists her lycanthropic curse, reducing the amount of time spent in weretiger form. Reduces the number of attacks needed to trigger Azaka's weretiger transformation by Azaka embraces her lycanthropic curse, decrease the time it takes to enter weretiger form. Didn't we meet in a tavern? Or was that someone else? Be careful around grappler vines. They're better at it. You need a leader? I'm but a guide. The jungles of Chult are no match for us! The riches of Omu are ours to discover. It'll do in a pinch. I found it in a ruin south of Nyanzaru. It's been with me ever since. Never head into the jungles of Chult without a good sword. I refuse to transfer my curse to others, so my scimitar is my weapon of choice. The champions were captured. I was the only one who could stop the Death Curse. Papazotl was the first cube I found. The crocodiles were easy to deal with. I'Jins cube was the second cube I found. It helped me prepare for my final battle. I gave the push for Obo'laka's cube everything I could and almost lost my soul. Why do I still have this thing? I end my hunts and it's just empty! It's always good to have a few coins to spare for wary travelers. You never know who you'll meet when you head into the jungle! It always has more room! A tooth from my first hunt. To commemorate its sacrifice and my skill. The triceratops never saw me coming. I waited in silence for 18 hours straight, stalking this creature. In Chult, trophies from the jungle are hot commodities. I sell these to those who can't afford my guide services. It has all the precarious cliffs highlighted. I hate heights. I spent months in the jungle as a tiger in order to create this map. I picked it up from a rather chatty mustached man from the Sword Coast. If I growl just right, the tigers don't try to eat me. I'm not a spellcaster, but this mask allows me to cast animal friendship. It's a family heirloom that was stolen, but I was able to track the thieves down. I can finally shed my misgivings over my curse and embrace my inner beast. Azaka Stormfang was once a guide who operated out of Port Nyanzaru on Chult. She originally concealed her curse of lycanthropy from the champions, as she has lost many friends to that revelation in the past. Her true self was revealed to the Champions after she valiantly helped them collect 3 of the 9 puzzle cubes they needed to defeat the villain Acererak in the Tomb of the Nine Gods. She was killed in the battle, but was able to be resurrected after the champions defeated Acererak's soulmonger. Now, she travels with her new friends, as a champion. Azaka leaps into the air and strikes a random enemy; 33% cleave chance Azaka dons her Mask of the Beast, summoning 2 tigers to her side for 30 seconds, the tigers attack every 5 seconds Azaka dons her Mask of the Beast, summoning 2 tigers to her side that attack every 5 seconds. The tigers stay for 30 seconds. If Azaka specs with Lycanthrope Forever the tiger attacks count towards her weretiger transformation, and her weretiger cooldown is paused during her Ultimate. If she specs with Resist the Curse, the tigers' attacks cause enemies to drop gold even if they aren't killed. body.zh: 阿扎卡是一名虎人。当 在人类形态下攻击后，她会转化为虎人形态，持续 秒，提升自身 % 伤害 阿扎卡在命中数次后变身虎人。成为虎人期间，她的伤害会提高。 提升所有金币获得量 %。阿扎卡处于虎人形态时，此技能效果降低 50% 阿扎卡使获得金币增加。成为虎人期间，此加成降低。 在户外场景时，提升所有勇士 % 伤害 在虎人形态下，阿扎卡每次攻击时造成 % 额外伤害（以乘算方式堆叠），此效果在她变回人类形态时重置。 减少 % 阿扎卡处于虎人形态的时间 阿扎卡抵抗她的兽化诅咒，减少虎人形态的持续时间。 减少 次触发阿扎卡的虎人形态所需的攻击次数 阿扎卡接纳她的兽化诅咒，缩短化身虎人形态所需的时间。 我们是不是在酒馆见过？还是我记错了？ 在擒抱者藤蔓周围要小心，他们更擅长于此。 你需要一名首领？我只是个向导。 楚尔特的丛林不是我们的对手！ 奥穆的财富等着我们去发掘。 在危急关头还是能派上用场的。 这是我在南扎路港的南边某处废墟中找到的。打从那以后就一直随身带着。 要是身上没有一把好刀的话，千万不要踏入楚尔特丛林半步。 我不想把自己的诅咒传染给别的人，所以我选择了这把弯刀作为武器。 勇士们都被俘虏了。我是仅存唯一能够阻止死亡诅咒的人。 帕帕佐托是我找到的第一个魔方。那些鳄鱼并不难以对付。 伊金魔方是我发现的第二个魔方。它协助了我为最终之战做好准备。 为了欧博拉卡魔方，我拼尽了全力，甚至差点连灵魂都丢了。 我怎么就摊上了这破玩意？一个猎物都没能装回来！ 身上有点钱是好事，这样才可以路见不平掏钱相助。 天知道会在丛林中碰上什么样的人！ 用之不尽的空间！ 这是我首个猎物的獠牙，这是为了纪念它的牺牲以及我的技术。 那只三角龙从头到尾都没察觉到我的出现。 为了这只猎物，我足足潜行埋伏了18个小时。 丛林猛兽身上的战利品在楚尔特向来都是抢手货。 这些地图是卖给那些雇佣不起我的导游服务的人的。 这地图上详尽地注释着每一处危险的峭壁。因为我有畏高症。 我化成老虎在丛林中居住了好几个月才总算完成了这幅地图。 这是在剑湾的某个爱唠叨的胡须老头送我的。 只要我适当地吼叫几声，其他老虎就不会敢对我轻举妄动。 我并不是什么魔法师，但这面具却能够让我跟百兽们缔造出友谊。 这个家传之宝曾经被盗走过，但我最终成功追捕到那些盗贼。 我终于可以放下对身上这个诅咒的不安，惝开心怀去面对内心的自我。 阿扎卡·风暴之牙曾经在楚尔特的南扎路港担任导游。最初她对勇士们隐瞒了她的兽化诅咒，因为过去的很多朋友得知这件事后都离开了她。在她对勇士们提供了英勇无畏的帮助，收集到了在九神之墓中消灭恶人阿瑟瑞拉克所需 9 个谜题方块中的 3 个后，她的真实身份被勇士们所知晓。她在战斗中英勇牺牲，但在勇士们消灭了阿瑟瑞拉克的灵魂商贩后得以复活。现在她也成为了一名勇士，和她的新朋友们一起踏上旅程。 阿扎卡跳到空中，攻击一名随机敌人，并有 33% 几率使用顺势斩。 阿扎卡戴上野兽面具，召唤 2 只老虎来陪伴她。持续 30 秒，老虎每 5 秒攻击一次。 阿扎卡戴上野兽面具，召唤 2 只老虎来陪伴她。持续 30 秒，老虎每 5 秒攻击一次。如果阿扎卡选择永久兽化专精，老虎的攻击也会计入她的虎人形态转化所需的攻击次数，同时她虎人形态的冷却在杀招持续时间内会暂停。如果她专精抵抗诅咒，则在老虎的攻击未能击杀敌人时，敌人会掉落金币。

Baldric left his position as a prominent member of his family's mercantile empire to seek his fortunes elsewhere. He's a unique cleric that often confounds other clerics because he refuses to pledge his service or faith to a single deity. He prefers to bargain with any and all of them, depending on the situation, to receive his magic. This has lent him a confidence/cockiness that has landed him in his share of trouble. But now he's with the Fallbacks, and over the course of their adventures, his faith in them has become unshakable. Baldric attacks the closest enemy, dealing 1 hit. Baldric prevents Champions from being stunned and he empowers his attacks for a short duration. body.zh: 乌吉加入探险队，并将默认与巴尔德里克相邻，除非她已在阵型中并与另一位“后备队”勇士相邻。乌吉会使所有非相邻的勇士伤害提高 % 巴尔德里克的交涉伙伴是“后备队”勇士和/或魅力大于等于 15 的勇士。阵型中每有一名巴尔德里克的交涉伙伴，他会使他的交涉伙伴的伤害提高 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 巴尔德里克的交涉伙伴还包括： 巴尔德里克会提高他交涉伙伴的伤害，他的交涉伙伴包括初始为“后备队”成员的勇士和有着高魅力值的勇士。你可通过他的专精选项来让更多的勇士加入其中！ 巴尔德里克的大锤被耀眼的金光点燃，持续 秒。此效果触发时，巴尔德里克会消除勇士们的眩晕状态。在效果持续期间，勇士们会免疫眩晕，并且巴尔德里克的攻击会造成杀招伤害。 免疫眩晕 当巴尔德里克在阵型中时，乌吉的增益提高 %。 巴尔德里克会使处于他身前各列的勇士每秒恢复 点生命值。 巴尔德里克会治疗处于他身前各列的勇士，并且当有任何勇士受重伤时，他的“治疗提灯”会强化所有治疗技能。 巴尔德里克使“交涉之力”叠加前的加成提高 %。 巴尔德里克与法律与正义之神提尔有着复杂的关系。 即使赞助者、支线任务或其他限制条件不允许，你仍可以在当前的冒险中使用一切矮人勇士。此外，矮人勇士也算作巴尔德里克的交涉伙伴。 矮人型勇士： 所有矮人都熟知他们万神殿的主神摩拉丁的力量。 巴尔德里克获得金币寻获角色定位，并且阵型中每有一位交涉伙伴，他会使探险队的金币寻获量提高 100%，以乘算方式堆叠。此外，拥有金币寻获角色定位的勇士也算作巴尔德里克的交涉伙伴。 金币寻获型勇士： 当巴尔德里克需要运气和财富时，他会与幸运女神交涉。 巴尔德里克的基本攻击也会造成等同于 5 秒基础杀招伤害的伤害，并算作魔法攻击。此外，以魔法为基本攻击的勇士也算作巴尔德里克的交涉伙伴。 魔法攻击型勇士： 当巴尔德里克需要魔法和知识时，他会去乞求神秘女神。 巴尔德里克使“治愈真言”的效果提高 %。此外，拥有治疗角色定位的勇士也算作巴尔德里克的交涉伙伴。 治疗型勇士： 当暴力无法解决问题时，巴尔德里克会去向树林守护神艾达丝求助。 当乌吉在巴尔德里克身边时，所有作为巴尔德里克“治愈真言”目标的勇士单次受到的伤害不会超过其最大生命值的 %。 当任意勇士的生命值降至其最大生命值的 % 或更低时，在当前区域的剩余时间内巴尔德里克会一直点亮他的提灯，阵型中每有一名治疗型勇士，阵型中的勇士受到的所有治疗量增加 %，以乘算方式堆叠。 巴尔德里克使“交涉之力”叠加前的加成额外提高 %，但“治愈真言”的效果降低 %。
